zh.why: 4-1BB（CD137，TNFRSF9）是活化CD8 T细胞和NK细胞上的共刺激受体，经TRAF–NF-κB信号促进增殖、存活和记忆形成，可以补充PD-1阻断无法提供的激活信号。其胞内结构域也是CAR-T构建中的常用共刺激模块，因此这一靶点既可做激动剂，也可用于细胞治疗。
learned: 临床证据仍然很少。已有的3项读出（NCT03917381、NCT05117242、NCT06984328）都属于acasunlimab，结果均为无统计检验或提前终止。终止原因是Genmab调整产品组合，与机制无关。未来6个月内也没有追踪到的读出，因此短期内不会有疗效上的检验。
opps: acasunlimab停止开发后，本站追踪到的项目只剩Lyvgen单抗（2期）、invoX（1期）和AbelZeta细胞治疗。可验证的假设：以肿瘤抗原或基质（非PD-L1）作锚点的条件性4-1BB双抗，可能在扩大治疗窗的同时避免全身激活。
acasunlimab覆盖了PD-1经治黑色素瘤和转移性NSCLC。如果NCT05117242和NCT03917381公开完整数据，可以看PD-L1表达水平或既往PD-1治疗状态能否区分应答人群，为后续项目筛选患者提供依据。
Prizloncabtagene Autoleucel是本站追踪到的唯一血液瘤项目（复发/难治LBCL）。在细胞治疗中，4-1BB共刺激结构域与CD28的持久性及毒性差异，仍是可以比较的设计问题。

en.why: 4-1BB (CD137, TNFRSF9) is a co-stimulatory receptor on activated CD8 T cells and NK cells. Through TRAF–NF-κB signaling it drives proliferation, survival and memory formation, adding an activating signal that PD-1 blockade alone does not supply. Its intracellular domain is also a standard co-stimulatory module in CAR-T constructs, so the target can be used both for agonists and in cell therapy.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The three readouts (NCT03917381, NCT05117242, NCT06984328) all involve acasunlimab and were either untested or stopped early, because Genmab reprioritized its portfolio, not because of the mechanism. No tracked readouts are due in the next six months, so no near-term efficacy test is expected.
opps: With acasunlimab discontinued, the programs tracked here are Lyvgen's antibody (phase 2), invoX (phase 1) and AbelZeta's cell therapy. A testable hypothesis: conditional 4-1BB bispecifics anchored on tumor or stromal antigens other than PD-L1 could widen the therapeutic window without systemic activation.

Acasunlimab was tested in PD-1-experienced melanoma and metastatic NSCLC. If full data from NCT05117242 and NCT03917381 are published, they could show whether PD-L1 level or prior PD-1 exposure separates responders, which would help later programs select patients.

Prizloncabtagene Autoleucel is the only hematologic program tracked here (relapsed/refractory LBCL). In cell therapy, how 4-1BB co-stimulation compares with CD28 on persistence and toxicity remains an open design question.

zh.why: 5-HT2A是Gq偶联的5-羟色胺受体，在皮层锥体神经元高表达。psilocybin等经典致幻剂通过激动该受体诱导神经可塑性，提示少数几次给药即可带来快速、持久的抗抑郁作用；而阻断该受体是多种非典型抗精神病药的机制之一。
learned: 本靶点的临床记录仍然很少，目前没有已追踪的读出或失败案例。最先能检验机制的是CYB003的3期MDD试验NCT06564818和AbbVie GM-2505的2期MDD试验NCT06236880，两者均已过主要完成日期，结果尚待公布。
opps: 在本站追踪的项目中，适应症集中于MDD/TRD，PTSD和适应障碍各仅有少数项目，焦虑类疾病等其他适应症基本空白，可作为验证5-HT2A激动剂泛诊断作用的方向。
现有项目全部为小分子激动剂，多为psilocybin或其类似物。值得探索的问题是：新一代分子（CYB003、GM-2505、bretisilocin）能否在给药时长、疗效持久性或耐受性上与psilocybin形成差异。
目前缺乏用于患者筛选和疗效预测的生物标志物，功能性揭盲也给对照设计带来挑战。NCT06564818能否在3期中重复早期信号，将是检验疗效稳健性的关键。

en.why: 5-HT2A is a Gq-coupled serotonin receptor highly expressed on cortical pyramidal neurons. Classic psychedelics such as psilocybin act through it to induce neuroplasticity, supporting rapid, durable antidepressant effects after one or a few doses. Blocking the same receptor is part of how many atypical antipsychotics work.
learned: The clinical record is still thin: no readouts or failures are tracked here yet. The first real tests will be CYB003's phase 3 MDD trial NCT06564818 and AbbVie's GM-2505 phase 2 MDD trial NCT06236880. Both have passed their primary completion dates, and results are still pending.
opps: Among programs tracked here, work centers on MDD and TRD. PTSD and adjustment disorder have only a few programs, and other anxiety-related indications are largely open. These could test whether 5-HT2A agonism works across diagnoses.

All tracked programs are small-molecule agonists, mostly psilocybin or its analogs. An open question is whether newer molecules (CYB003, GM-2505, bretisilocin) can set themselves apart from psilocybin on session length, durability or tolerability.

There are no biomarkers yet for choosing patients or predicting response, and functional unblinding makes controlled trials hard to design. Whether NCT06564818 reproduces the earlier signals in phase 3 will be a key test of how robust the effect is.

zh.why: 该类别汇集多个5-HT受体亚型：5-HT2C激动可降低癫痫易感性，是fenfluramine（已获批用于Dravet综合征）与选择性激动剂LP352的作用基础；5-HT1F激动剂lasmiditan不收缩血管即可抑制三叉神经痛觉传递，已获批用于成人偏头痛；5-HT3拮抗是经典止吐机制。
learned: 临床记录仍薄：仅有两项lasmiditan儿科读出，均因商业原因终止（NCT04396236达到主要终点，NCT04396574无统计检验），不能作为否定机制的证据；首轮真正检验看LP352的NCT06719141、NCT06660394及fenfluramine的NCT06118255。
opps: 选择性5-HT2C激动（LP352）能否在Dravet及DEE中接近作用更广的fenfluramine，同时规避5-HT2B相关的心脏瓣膜风险，是核心未解问题，NCT06660394与NCT06719141将给出初步答案。
CDKL5缺乏症和Rett综合征在本站追踪的适应症中仅有少数项目，可作为5-HT2C激动拓展到Dravet之外的候选人群，并可按发作类型分层入组。
5-HT1F激动用于儿童偏头痛急性治疗，在NCT04396236达到终点后因商业原因中止，本站追踪范围内暂无项目接续；5-HT4、5-HT6亚型目前也没有在追踪项目。

en.why: This group covers several serotonin receptor subtypes. 5-HT2C agonism lowers seizure susceptibility and underlies fenfluramine, approved for Dravet syndrome, and the selective agonist LP352. The 5-HT1F agonist lasmiditan, approved for acute migraine in adults, blocks trigeminal pain signalling without constricting blood vessels. 5-HT3 antagonism is a long-standing antiemetic mechanism.
learned: The record is thin: there are two pediatric lasmiditan readouts, both stopped for business reasons (NCT04396236 still met its primary endpoint; NCT04396574 had no formal test). Neither counts against the mechanism. The first real tests will be LP352 in NCT06719141 and NCT06660394, and fenfluramine in NCT06118255.
opps: The main open question is whether selective 5-HT2C agonism (LP352) can match the broader-acting fenfluramine in Dravet and DEE while avoiding 5-HT2B-linked heart-valve concerns. NCT06660394 and NCT06719141 should begin to answer it.

CDKL5 deficiency disorder and Rett syndrome appear among the conditions tracked here, but few programs target them. They are candidate indications for testing 5-HT2C agonism beyond Dravet, ideally with patients stratified by seizure type.

Pediatric acute migraine with 5-HT1F agonism was left unfinished when NCT04396236 met its endpoint but was stopped for business reasons. No program tracked here has picked it up, and 5-HT4 and 5-HT6 have no tracked programs at all.

zh.why: AKT（AKT1-3）是PI3K–AKT–mTOR通路的核心激酶，调控细胞增殖、存活和代谢。PIK3CA突变、PTEN缺失和AKT1 E17K突变都会使其过度激活，与HR阳性乳腺癌内分泌耐药及PTEN缺失前列腺癌进展相关。AKT2参与胰岛素信号，因此高血糖属于靶点相关毒性。
learned: 本站追踪范围内的临床记录仍然偏少。CAPItello-281（NCT04493853）在激素敏感性前列腺癌中达到rPFS主要终点；PROFECTA-II（NCT04374630）没有正式统计检验。下一个关键检验是capivasertib乳腺癌III期NCT06635447。
opps: 前列腺癌阳性结果（NCT04493853）提示AKT抑制在乳腺癌以外也可能有效。其他PTEN缺失瘤种，以及PROFECTA-II（NCT04374630）未作正式检验的卵巢癌，仍值得探索，可用PTEN或通路变异做患者筛选。
不抑制AKT2的突变选择性或亚型选择性抑制剂，可能减轻高血糖并实现更充分的靶点抑制。Alterome、Atavistik、Terremoto的I期和I/II期项目将首次检验选择性能否拓宽治疗窗。
本站追踪的8个项目均为小分子，降解剂等其他分子类型尚未出现，可尝试用来应对通路再激活引起的耐药。乳腺癌领域已有5个项目，三阴性和HER2-low亚群项目较少，可能是差异化方向。

en.why: AKT (AKT1-3) is the central kinase of the PI3K–AKT–mTOR pathway and controls cell growth, survival and metabolism. PIK3CA mutations, PTEN loss and the AKT1 E17K mutation all overactivate it. This drives endocrine resistance in HR-positive breast cancer and progression of PTEN-deficient prostate cancer. AKT2 helps carry insulin signaling, so high blood sugar (hyperglycemia) is an on-target side effect.
learned: Among programs tracked here, the clinical record is still thin. CAPItello-281 (NCT04493853) met its rPFS primary endpoint in hormone-sensitive prostate cancer. PROFECTA-II (NCT04374630) in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer had no formal statistical test. The next real test is the capivasertib breast cancer phase 3, NCT06635447.
opps: The prostate hit (NCT04493853) suggests AKT inhibition can work outside breast cancer. Other tumors with PTEN loss remain open, as does ovarian cancer, where PROFECTA-II (NCT04374630) had no formal test. Selecting patients by PTEN status or pathway alterations could help.

Mutant-selective or isoform-selective inhibitors that spare AKT2 could ease hyperglycemia and allow fuller target suppression. The phase 1 and 1/2 programs from Alterome, Atavistik and Terremoto will be the first test of whether selectivity widens the therapeutic window.

All eight tracked programs are small molecules. Degraders and other modalities have not been tried here and could address resistance caused by the pathway switching back on. Five programs are in breast cancer, while triple-negative and HER2-low subsets have fewer, which may leave room to stand out.

zh.why: ALK融合（如EML4-ALK）使激酶持续活化，驱动约3–5%的非小细胞肺癌。ALK改变也驱动间变性大细胞淋巴瘤和部分神经母细胞瘤，后者多为点突变。crizotinib、alectinib、lorlatinib已获批，但靶点耐药突变和脑转移仍限制长期控制。
learned: 已追踪的临床记录仍很薄。唯一的读出NCT03194893是alectinib的安全性描述性研究，没有疗效检验。首批实质检验将来自alectinib的III期NCT06624059、NCT05170204，以及ALK阳性NSCLC的II/III期NCT05987956。
opps: 已追踪的12个项目中有10个是小分子。neladalkib已进入III期，TRI-611、SIM0518、anecatibin仍处早期。可检验的假设是：靠覆盖G1202R等复合突变、脑内活性和避开TRK来区分，而不是再做一线同类药。
Ashibio单抗和Diagonal的DIAG723是仅有的抗体类项目。ALK融合蛋白没有胞外区，抗体更可能作用于全长ALK受体，例如神经母细胞瘤。已追踪的1项心血管/代谢试验也提示代谢方向值得探索。
按适应症看，已追踪项目以NSCLC为主，只有1个项目针对ALK融合阳性实体瘤/CNS肿瘤。间变性大细胞淋巴瘤、炎性肌纤维母细胞瘤和儿童肿瘤的不限瘤种入组，以及ctDNA指导的耐药突变分层，都还是空白。

en.why: ALK fusions such as EML4-ALK keep the kinase switched on and drive roughly 3–5% of non-small cell lung cancer. ALK alterations also drive anaplastic large-cell lymphoma and some neuroblastoma, where they are mostly point mutations. Crizotinib, alectinib and lorlatinib are approved, but on-target resistance mutations and brain metastases still limit long-term control.
learned: The tracked clinical record is still thin. The only readout, NCT03194893, is a descriptive alectinib safety study with no efficacy test. The first real tests will be the alectinib Phase 3 trials NCT06624059 and NCT05170204 and the Phase 2/3 ALK-positive NSCLC trial NCT05987956.
opps: Ten of the 12 tracked programs are small molecules. Neladalkib is in Phase 3, while TRI-611, SIM0518 and anecatibin are early. A testable hypothesis: these drugs can stand out by covering compound mutations such as G1202R, working in the brain and sparing TRK, rather than as first-line copies.

The Ashibio antibody and Diagonal's DIAG723 are the only antibody programs. ALK fusion proteins have no extracellular domain, so antibodies more plausibly work on full-length ALK receptor, as in neuroblastoma. The one tracked cardiovascular/metabolic trial also suggests a metabolic angle worth exploring.

Tracked programs focus mostly on NSCLC, and only one targets ALK fusion-positive solid or CNS tumors. Open gaps: tumor-agnostic enrollment covering anaplastic large-cell lymphoma, inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor and pediatric tumors, and ctDNA-guided grouping of patients by resistance mutation.

zh.why: ACVR1编码BMP I型受体ALK2。经典FOP几乎都由R206H功能获得性突变引起：突变受体会对activin A产生异常应答，驱动异位骨化，遗传学验证非常明确。此外，DIPG中存在体细胞ACVR1突变，ALK2–hepcidin通路也与炎症性贫血相关。
learned: 临床证据仍很薄弱。本站仅追踪到Regeneron一项FOP III期单抗项目（2026年4月登记），目前没有读出，未来六个月内也没有试验达到主要完成，近期缺少可检验机制的数据。
opps: 本站追踪的项目只有抗体一种模式，小分子ALK2激酶抑制剂或选择性作用于突变受体的策略尚未出现。已有临床前研究提示部分ACVR1抗体可能激活突变受体，不同模式的比较值得探索。
目前本站追踪的适应症仅限FOP。携带ACVR1突变的DIPG和hepcidin驱动的贫血在生物学上有依据，但尚无项目覆盖，可以作为扩展方向的假设。
FOP病程呈发作性，异位骨化进展缓慢。以影像学测得的新发骨化体积和发作频率作为终点并验证其可靠性，将决定Regeneron这项III期研究能否给出清晰结论。

en.why: ACVR1 encodes ALK2, a BMP type I receptor. The gain-of-function R206H mutation causes nearly all classic FOP: the mutant receptor responds abnormally to activin A and drives heterotopic ossification, giving strong genetic validation. Somatic ACVR1 mutations also occur in DIPG, and the ALK2–hepcidin axis is linked to anemia of inflammation.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site tracks only one program, a Regeneron Phase 3 antibody in FOP registered in April 2026. It has no readouts, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so there is no near-term test of the mechanism.
opps: Among programs tracked here, the only modality is an antibody. Small-molecule ALK2 kinase inhibitors and approaches that selectively hit the mutant receptor are absent. Preclinical work suggests some ACVR1 antibodies can activate the mutant receptor, so comparing modalities is worth exploring.
FOP is the only indication tracked here. ACVR1-mutant DIPG and hepcidin-driven anemia have a biological rationale but no tracked programs, which makes them candidate hypotheses for expansion.

FOP progresses through episodic flare-ups and slow ossification. Whether imaging-measured new heterotopic bone volume and flare frequency hold up as endpoints will decide how clearly the Regeneron Phase 3 study can answer its question.

zh.why: ALK7（ACVR1C）是主要在脂肪组织表达的TGF-β超家族I型受体，被GDF3及activin B/E激活后抑制脂解、促进脂肪储存。人群遗传学显示ACVR1C功能缺失变异与较低的腰臀比及2型糖尿病风险下降相关，提示抑制ALK7可能改善脂肪分布与代谢。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：本站仅追踪到Suzhou Siran一个1期项目（超重/肥胖，2026年3月登记），尚无读出，未来6个月也没有到达主要完成的试验，机制在人体中的首次检验仍待公布。
opps: 遗传学指向的是脂肪分布而非单纯体重：早期试验可检验内脏脂肪、腰臀比等影像或人体测量终点，并按中心性肥胖富集患者，而非照搬常规减重终点。
与肠促胰素类药物联用：可假设ALK7抑制使减重更偏向脂肪、保留瘦体重，从而补充GLP-1类疗法；本站追踪的项目中尚无此类联合研究。
适应证与模式空白：追踪项目仅覆盖超重/肥胖且模式未披露，2型糖尿病、MASLD等代谢适应证，以及脂肪组织靶向的siRNA或阻断抗体，均是可检验的方向。

en.why: ALK7 (ACVR1C) is a TGF-β superfamily type I receptor expressed mainly in adipose tissue. Activated by GDF3 and activins B/E, it suppresses lipolysis and promotes fat storage. Human loss-of-function ACVR1C variants are linked to lower waist-to-hip ratio and reduced type 2 diabetes risk, suggesting that inhibiting ALK7 could improve fat distribution and metabolic health.
learned: The clinical record is still thin: this site tracks one Phase 1 program, from Suzhou Siran in overweight/obesity (first posted March 2026), with no readouts and no trials reaching primary completion in the next six months, so the first human test of the mechanism is still pending.
opps: Genetics points to fat distribution rather than total weight: early trials could test visceral fat, waist-to-hip ratio or imaging endpoints and enrich for central adiposity, rather than borrowing standard weight-loss endpoints.

Combination with incretin drugs: one hypothesis is that ALK7 inhibition shifts weight loss toward fat and spares lean mass, complementing GLP-1-based therapy; no such combination study appears among programs tracked here.

Indication and modality gaps: the tracked program covers only overweight/obesity and its modality is undisclosed; type 2 diabetes, MASLD, and adipose-targeted siRNA or blocking antibodies remain open directions to test.

zh.why: ANGPTL3由肝脏分泌，抑制脂蛋白脂酶和内皮脂酶，从而升高甘油三酯和LDL-C。其降LDL作用不依赖LDL受体，因此适用于HoFH。ANGPTL3功能缺失变异携带者血脂全面偏低、冠心病风险下降，提供了人类遗传学验证。evinacumab已获批用于HoFH。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍很薄：8个项目中尚无读出、无失败或提前终止，未来6个月也没有到达主要完成的试验。zodasiran进展最快，已进入3期，但首个真正的检验不在当前窗口内。
opps: 在本站追踪的项目中siRNA占5/8，主要集中在HoFH和严重高甘油三酯血症；后来者或需靠给药间隔、联合用药或新适应症来差异化。
DKD和混合型血脂异常各仅有1个项目，可检验ANGPTL3抑制在残余甘油三酯风险人群中是否带来肾脏或心血管获益。
CTX310和Verve的一次性基因编辑项目仍处1期，长期安全性和效应持久性是尚未回答的关键问题。

en.why: ANGPTL3 is a liver-secreted inhibitor of lipoprotein lipase and endothelial lipase, raising triglycerides and LDL-C. It lowers LDL independently of the LDL receptor, which suits HoFH. Carriers of loss-of-function variants have low lipids across the board and lower coronary risk, giving human genetic validation. Evinacumab is approved for HoFH.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin: none of the 8 programs has a readout, failure or early stop, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months. Zodasiran is furthest along in phase 3, but the first real test falls outside this window.
opps: siRNA makes up 5 of 8 programs tracked here, clustered in HoFH and severe hypertriglyceridemia. Later entrants may need to stand out on dosing interval, combinations or new indications.

Diabetic kidney disease and mixed dyslipidemia have one program each. These programs could test whether ANGPTL3 inhibition brings renal or cardiovascular benefit in people with residual triglyceride risk.
The one-time gene-editing programs from CRISPR (CTX310) and Verve are in phase 1. Long-term safety and how long the effect lasts are still open questions.

zh.why: APOC3 抑制脂蛋白脂肪酶，并阻碍肝脏清除富含甘油三酯的脂蛋白残粒。功能缺失突变携带者甘油三酯水平低，冠心病风险也较低，遗传学证据较强。严重高甘油三酯血症可引发急性胰腺炎。APOC3 降低甘油三酯还有不依赖 LPL 的途径，因此对 LPL 通路缺陷的 FCS 患者也有作用。
learned: 临床记录仍然有限：本站尚无带 NCT 的正式读出，只记录到 Plozasiran 的 SHASTA-3/SHASTA-4 两项三期顶线结果为阳性。真正检验 ASO 在 sHTG 中表现的下一个节点是 Olezarsen 的 NCT05681351，主要完成时间为 2027-03。
opps: 本站追踪的项目几乎都集中在 sHTG 和 FCS。遗传学提示 APOC3 与动脉粥样硬化风险相关，但中度高甘油三酯血症人群和心血管结局目前在本站尚无对应项目，可作为假设去验证。
目前已有 3 个 siRNA 和 1 个 ASO 项目，Hengrui、Zhejiang Doer 等后来者需要找到差异化方向，例如给药间隔、胰腺炎事件终点，或中国人群数据。NCT05681351 的结果将为 ASO 与 siRNA 的比较提供参照。
可以按遗传背景区分 FCS 与多因素乳糜微粒血症，并以基线甘油三酯和胰腺炎病史分层，检验哪些患者获益最大。与 ANGPTL3 等通路联合的思路，在本站追踪的项目中也尚未出现。

en.why: APOC3 inhibits lipoprotein lipase and blocks the liver from clearing triglyceride-rich remnant particles. People carrying loss-of-function variants have low triglycerides and lower coronary risk, which is strong genetic validation. Severe hypertriglyceridemia can cause acute pancreatitis. APOC3 also lowers triglycerides through LPL-independent routes, so it can help in FCS, where the LPL pathway is defective.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. There are no formal readouts with NCT ids here, only positive Phase 3 topline results for plozasiran in SHASTA-3 and SHASTA-4. The next real test, for the ASO approach in sHTG, is olezarsen's NCT05681351, with primary completion due 2027-03.
opps: Nearly every program tracked here targets sHTG or FCS. Genetics links APOC3 to atherosclerotic risk, yet no program tracked here addresses moderate hypertriglyceridemia or cardiovascular outcomes. That gap is a hypothesis worth testing.

With 3 siRNA programs and 1 ASO already in play, newer entrants such as Hengrui and Zhejiang Doer need a point of difference: dosing interval, pancreatitis-event endpoints, or data in Chinese patients. NCT05681351 will give a reference point for comparing ASO with siRNA.

Patients could be stratified by genetics (FCS vs multifactorial chylomicronemia), baseline triglycerides and history of pancreatitis to find who benefits most. Combining with other pathways such as ANGPTL3 has not appeared among programs tracked here.

zh.why: APOL1 G1/G2变异常见于西非裔人群，属毒性获得性功能：携带两个风险等位基因者发生FSGS、高血压相关CKD及HIV相关肾病的风险显著升高。变异蛋白被认为在足细胞中形成阳离子通道并造成损伤，而APOL1缺失者似无明显异常，因此抑制或下调该靶点有较充分的遗传学依据。
learned: 临床证据仍少：本站追踪的3个项目均在2期，尚无注册试验读出。Vertex新闻稿称inaxaplin 2b期AMPLIFIED研究结果阳性；NCT06794996（主要完成日期2026年7月）结果待公布，将是首个注册数据检验。
opps: 本站追踪的项目中2个为小分子，AstraZeneca项目的模式未披露。下调APOL1表达（如寡核苷酸）与阻断通道功能相比，疗效和持久性是否不同，仍有待比较。
现有项目聚焦蛋白尿性肾病。经基因型筛选但蛋白尿不明显的人群，如双风险等位基因携带者的早期CKD、HIV相关肾病或高风险基因型供肾移植，在追踪项目中鲜有覆盖，可用来检验早期干预的价值。
关键问题在于蛋白尿下降能否转化为eGFR下降减缓，以及获益是否覆盖G1、G2不同基因型和干扰素等“二次打击”情境，需后续试验回答。

en.why: APOL1 G1 and G2 variants are common in people of recent West African ancestry and act through a toxic gain of function. Carrying two risk alleles sharply raises the risk of FSGS, hypertension-attributed CKD and HIV-associated nephropathy. Variant APOL1 is thought to form cation channels that injure podocytes, while people lacking APOL1 appear healthy. That gives inhibiting or lowering it strong genetic grounding.
learned: The clinical record is still thin: among programs tracked here, there are three Phase 2 programs and no registry readouts. Vertex reported positive Phase 2b AMPLIFIED results for inaxaplin by press release. The first registry test is NCT06794996 (primary completion listed July 2026), whose results are not yet tracked.
opps: Two tracked programs are small molecules, and AstraZeneca's modality is undisclosed. It is still an open question whether lowering APOL1 expression (for example with oligonucleotides) differs from blocking channel function in efficacy or durability.

Tracked programs target proteinuric disease. Genotype-selected groups without heavy proteinuria are rarely covered among programs tracked here: early CKD in two-risk-allele carriers, HIV-associated nephropathy, or transplants of kidneys from high-risk-genotype donors. These groups could test whether earlier intervention prevents injury.

A key open question is whether proteinuria reduction translates into slower eGFR decline. Another is whether benefit holds across G1 and G2 genotypes and under 'second-hit' triggers such as interferon exposure. Later trials will need to answer both.

zh.why: AR是配体激活的核受体转录因子，雄激素结合后驱动前列腺上皮生长与存活相关基因表达，是前列腺癌的核心致癌驱动。雄激素剥夺和enzalutamide等AR抑制剂已是标准治疗，但耐药后AR信号常经扩增、配体结合域突变或剪接变体持续存在。
learned: 临床记录仍偏少：仅ARASEC（NCT05059236）在mHSPC达到PFS终点，NCT03568656为无统计检验的安全性研究。首批实质检验将来自apalutamide（NCT05884398、NCT03767244）、rezvilutamide（NCT07241416）III期及AZD9750（NCT07336446）。
opps: 在本站追踪的21个项目中，降解剂占5个，BMS-986365已进入III期。可检验的假设是：用ctDNA筛选AR突变或扩增的ARPI耐药患者，能否区分降解剂与抑制剂的疗效。AZD9750（NCT07336446）将给出早期线索。
已追踪的试验几乎都在前列腺癌，非前列腺适应症只有一个唾液腺肿瘤项目。AR阳性唾液腺导管癌、AR阳性三阴性乳腺癌等方向，生物学依据明确但布局很少。
mHSPC已有apalutamide、darolutamide、rezvilutamide及MSD小分子挤在III期。差异化可能更多来自与非AR机制的联用，如放射性药物AAA617、Amgen双抗、GSK ADC，而不是再做一个同类抑制剂。

en.why: AR is a ligand-activated nuclear receptor. When androgen binds, it switches on genes that drive prostate epithelial growth and survival, which makes it the core oncogenic driver of prostate cancer. Androgen deprivation and AR inhibitors such as enzalutamide are standard care. After resistance develops, AR signaling usually continues through AR amplification, ligand-binding-domain mutations or splice variants.
learned: The record is still thin. Only ARASEC (NCT05059236) met its PFS endpoint, in mHSPC, and NCT03568656 was a safety study with no hypothesis test. The first real tests will be Phase 3 apalutamide (NCT05884398, NCT03767244) and rezvilutamide (NCT07241416), plus first AZD9750 data (NCT07336446).
opps: Five of the 21 programs tracked here are degraders, and BMS-986365 has already reached Phase 3. One testable hypothesis: in ARPI-resistant patients selected by ctDNA for AR mutation or amplification, do degraders outperform inhibitors? AZD9750 (NCT07336446) should give an early signal.

Nearly all tracked trials are in prostate cancer. The only non-prostate program is one in salivary gland tumors. AR-positive salivary duct carcinoma and AR-positive triple-negative breast cancer have clear biology behind them but few programs among those tracked here.

mHSPC is crowded, with apalutamide, darolutamide, rezvilutamide and an MSD small molecule all in Phase 3. Combining with non-AR mechanisms may set a program apart more than another same-class inhibitor would. Candidates include the radioligand AAA617, Amgen's bispecific and GSK's ADC.

zh.why: AT1 受体介导血管紧张素II的主要效应：血管收缩、醛固酮释放、钠潴留及肾脏和心脏纤维化，并在肾小球疾病中推动足细胞损伤和蛋白尿。losartan等ARB早已是高血压和蛋白尿性肾病的标准用药；sparsentan在单一分子中同时阻断ETA和AT1受体。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍很少：仅有Travere的两个sparsentan二期项目（FSGS和微小病变病），尚无读出记录。未来六个月也没有试验到达主要完成日期，近期没有可检验该机制的已追踪读出。
opps: 在本站追踪的项目中，AT1靶点只有同一家公司的ETA/AT1双重拮抗剂。选择性或偏向性AT1配体，以及针对抗体介导移植排斥中AT1激活型自身抗体的方案，目前均未出现。
微小病变病多数对激素敏感，关键问题在于哪些患者能从双重阻断中获益：激素抵抗或频繁复发者，以及遗传性与原发性FSGS患者。按这些特征分层，有助于判断加入内皮素阻断的价值所在。
已追踪项目只覆盖FSGS和微小病变病。Alport综合征、糖尿病肾病等同样受该通路驱动的蛋白尿性疾病，在本站尚无AT1方向项目，可作为检验双重阻断的方向。

en.why: The AT1 receptor carries most of angiotensin II's effects: vasoconstriction, aldosterone release, sodium retention, and fibrosis in kidney and heart. In glomerular disease it drives podocyte injury and proteinuria. Angiotensin receptor blockers such as losartan have long been standard for hypertension and proteinuric kidney disease. Sparsentan blocks both the endothelin A and AT1 receptors in a single molecule.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. There are two Phase 2 sparsentan programs from Travere, in FSGS and minimal change disease, with no readouts logged. No trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so no tracked readout will test the mechanism soon.
opps: Among programs tracked here, every AT1 program is one company's dual ETA/AT1 antagonist. Nothing in this set tests selective or biased AT1 ligands, or approaches against the AT1-activating autoantibodies seen in antibody-mediated transplant rejection.

Minimal change disease often responds to steroids, so the open question is which patients gain from dual blockade: steroid-resistant or frequently relapsing patients, and genetic versus primary FSGS. Stratifying by these features could show where the added endothelin arm matters.

Tracked programs cover only FSGS and minimal change disease. Other proteinuric diseases driven by the same pathway, such as Alport syndrome or diabetic kidney disease, have no AT1-directed program in this set and are candidates for testing dual blockade.

zh.why: ATM是DNA双链断裂后最先被激活的PIKK家族激酶，通过磷酸化CHK2、p53等启动细胞周期检查点和同源重组修复。抑制ATM可阻断肿瘤细胞修复放疗及拓扑异构酶抑制剂造成的损伤，因此主要用作放化疗增敏剂，也可与其他DDR抑制剂联用。
learned: 临床证据仍很薄。本站仅追踪到CSPC Megalith的小分子SYH2051一个项目，处于1/2期，覆盖乳腺癌和晚期实体瘤，尚无读出。未来六个月内也没有到达主要完成日期的试验，机制的首次实际检验时间尚不明确。
opps: 本站追踪的项目只有单药或未注明联用方案的实体瘤试验。可以考虑与放疗、拓扑异构酶I类化疗或以其为载荷的ADC联用，验证ATM抑制的增敏作用能否转化为临床获益。
可探索按生物标志物选择患者，例如其他DDR基因缺陷或p53功能异常的肿瘤，检验合成致死假设；同时需关注与PARP或ATR抑制剂联用时叠加的骨髓毒性。
本站追踪范围内尚无具备脑渗透性的ATM抑制剂项目，与放疗联用治疗胶质瘤或脑转移是一个可检验的空白方向；降解剂等其他分子类型也还没有出现。

en.why: ATM is a PIKK-family kinase that is among the first activated by DNA double-strand breaks. It phosphorylates CHK2, p53 and other substrates to trigger checkpoints and homologous-recombination repair. Blocking ATM keeps tumor cells from repairing damage caused by radiation and topoisomerase inhibitors, so it is pursued mainly as a radio- and chemosensitizer and as a partner for other DDR inhibitors.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Only one program is tracked here: CSPC Megalith's small molecule SYH2051, in phase 1/2 for breast cancer and advanced solid tumors, with no readouts yet. No trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so it is unclear when the mechanism will get its first real test.
opps: The tracked trials are in solid tumors with no stated combination partner. A hypothesis to test is pairing ATM inhibition with radiotherapy, topoisomerase-I chemotherapy, or ADCs carrying topo-I payloads, to see whether the sensitizing effect produces clinical benefit.

Patients could be selected by biomarker, such as defects in other DDR genes or abnormal p53 function, to test synthetic-lethality hypotheses. Combinations with PARP or ATR inhibitors would need close watching for added bone-marrow toxicity.

No brain-penetrant ATM inhibitor is tracked here. Combining one with radiation for glioma or brain metastases is an open question that could be tested. Other modalities, such as degraders, have not appeared yet.

zh.why: ATR是复制应激反应的核心激酶，被停滞复制叉上的单链DNA激活，经CHK1阻滞细胞周期并保护复制叉。癌基因驱动的复制应激以及ATM缺失等DDR缺陷使肿瘤依赖ATR，构成合成致死逻辑；但ATR本身是必需基因，治疗窗是核心问题。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：此处追踪的3个项目均为1期或1/2期小分子，入组未经分子筛选的晚期实体瘤，尚无读出或失败，未来6个月也无试验达到主要完成，近期没有首个真正检验。
opps: 此处追踪的项目都未限定生物标志物人群。ATM缺失、ARID1A缺失或CCNE1扩增等高复制应激特征能否富集应答者，仍是值得验证的假设。
三个项目都在泛实体瘤中探索，未见血液肿瘤，也未见明确的联合方案。与PARP抑制剂、铂类、拓扑异构酶载荷ADC或放疗联用，可能是寻找增效窗口的方向。
三个项目全部是小分子，后来者FXS887和Actuate的项目需要与较早的RP-3500拉开差异。间歇给药、更高选择性或肿瘤靶向递送能否拓宽治疗窗，尚待检验。

en.why: ATR is the central kinase of the replication-stress response. Single-stranded DNA at stalled forks activates it, and it signals through CHK1 to halt the cell cycle and protect forks. Oncogene-driven replication stress and DDR defects such as ATM loss make tumours depend on ATR, which gives a synthetic-lethal rationale. Because ATR is essential, the therapeutic window is the core question.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The three programs tracked here are phase 1 or 1/2 small molecules in unselected advanced solid tumours. None has a readout or a failure yet, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term test is in sight.
opps: None of the programs tracked here restricts enrolment to a biomarker-defined population. Whether ATM loss, ARID1A loss or high replication stress such as CCNE1 amplification picks out responders is still an open hypothesis.

All three programs run in all-comer solid-tumour settings, with no haematologic cancers and no stated combinations. Pairing ATR inhibition with PARP inhibitors, platinum, topoisomerase-payload ADCs or radiotherapy could be tested for a synergy window.

All three programs are small molecules, and the newer entrants (FXS887, Actuate's compound) need to stand apart from the earlier RP-3500. Whether intermittent dosing, higher selectivity or tumour-targeted delivery widens the therapeutic window is untested.

zh.why: AXL是TAM家族受体酪氨酸激酶，由配体GAS6激活，可促进上皮间质转化、肿瘤侵袭和免疫抑制性微环境。AXL高表达与多种实体瘤预后不良相关，也是EGFR-TKI、化疗及免疫治疗耐药的旁路机制之一，因此被视为逆转耐药的候选靶点。
learned: 本站追踪的AXL项目仅有Xuanzhu Biopharmaceutical一款处于1期的小分子，适应症为晚期实体瘤和NSCLC。目前尚无读出，未来六个月也没有试验到达主要完成日期，现有临床数据还不足以总结经验。
opps: 可在EGFR-TKI治疗后进展、AXL高表达或带EMT特征的NSCLC中检验AXL抑制，看生物标志物富集能否让耐药机制假说转化为可测量的获益。
本站追踪的项目中还没有抗体、ADC或降解剂。AXL位于细胞表面且在耐药肿瘤中上调，ADC有可能不依赖激酶活性，直接靶向AXL高表达细胞。
鉴于AXL参与免疫抑制，可探索与PD-1/PD-L1抑制剂联用，以及NSCLC以外的适应症，如血液肿瘤或纤维化。这些方向在本站追踪范围内尚无项目。

en.why: AXL is a TAM-family receptor tyrosine kinase activated by GAS6. It drives epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, invasion and an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. High AXL expression is linked to poor prognosis in several solid tumors and is a known bypass route of resistance to EGFR inhibitors, chemotherapy and immunotherapy. That makes it a candidate target for reversing resistance.
learned: Among programs tracked here, AXL has only one: a Phase 1 small molecule from Xuanzhu Biopharmaceutical in advanced solid tumors and NSCLC. It has no readouts yet, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so the clinical record is too thin to draw lessons from.
opps: Test AXL inhibition in NSCLC that has progressed on EGFR inhibitors and shows high AXL expression or an EMT signature. This would show whether biomarker enrichment turns the resistance hypothesis into a measurable benefit.
No antibodies, ADCs or degraders are tracked here. AXL sits on the cell surface and goes up in resistant tumors, so an ADC might kill AXL-high cells without depending on kinase signaling.

Because AXL suppresses immune responses, combinations with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors are worth exploring. So are indications beyond NSCLC, such as blood cancers or fibrosis. No tracked programs address either yet.

zh.why: 肿瘤微环境中，CD39/CD73把ATP降解为腺苷。腺苷作用于T细胞、NK细胞和髓系细胞上的A2A/A2B受体，升高cAMP，从而抑制抗肿瘤免疫。在纹状体中，A2A调节多巴胺通路，A2A拮抗剂istradefylline已获批用于帕金森病“关期”。
learned: 这里收录的临床记录仍然很少：4个小分子项目还没有读出，也没有失败或提前终止记录，未来6个月也没有到达主要完成期的试验。目前进展最快的是Zhejiang Vimgreen的VG081821AC（2/3期），它的结果可能会是第一次真正的检验。
opps: 收录的肿瘤适应症有晚期实体瘤、肾细胞癌和去势抵抗性前列腺癌。可以检验一个假设：用CD73表达或腺苷相关基因特征筛选患者，能否让肿瘤内腺苷水平高的人群更明确地获益。
这里收录的项目全是小分子。仍未回答的问题包括：A2A/A2B双重阻断是否优于单靶点阻断，以及与PD-1抑制剂、CD73/CD39抗体联用，能否克服腺苷轴的代偿。
神经领域只收录了1项帕金森病试验。A2A在运动症状之外的作用，例如异动症和非运动症状，在本站收录的项目中还很少涉及，可以作为差异化的研究方向。

en.why: In tumors, CD39 and CD73 break ATP down into adenosine. Adenosine acts on A2A and A2B receptors on T cells, NK cells and myeloid cells, raising cAMP and suppressing anti-tumor immunity. In the striatum, A2A modulates dopamine signaling. The A2A antagonist istradefylline is approved for Parkinson's disease "off" episodes.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. None of the four small-molecule programs has a readout. There are no failures or early stops, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months. The most advanced program is Zhejiang Vimgreen's VG081821AC (Phase 2/3), and its readout may be the first real test.
opps: The tracked cancer indications are advanced solid tumors, renal cell cancer and castrate-resistant prostate cancer. One hypothesis to test: selecting patients by CD73 expression or an adenosine gene signature may pick out those with high tumor adenosine who benefit most.

Every program tracked here is a small molecule. Open questions: does blocking both A2A and A2B beat blocking one, and can adding PD-1 inhibitors or CD73/CD39 antibodies overcome compensation within the adenosine pathway?

Only one Parkinson's trial is tracked. Among programs tracked here, few address A2A beyond motor symptoms, for example dyskinesia or non-motor symptoms. This could be a way for new programs to stand apart.

zh.why: Ang-2由受损内皮释放，拮抗Tie2信号，使血管失稳并对VEGF更敏感，导致渗漏、炎症和新生血管。DME和nAMD患者眼内Ang-2水平升高。VEGF/Ang-2双重阻断旨在比单纯抗VEGF更好地恢复血管稳定，faricimab已获批用于nAMD和DME。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍很有限：尚无读出或失败，两个项目均为Roche的VEGF/Ang-2双抗，处于1/2期。首个真正检验是zifibancimig在黄斑变性中的NCT04567303，2026年8月主要完成，结果待公布。
opps: 本站追踪的项目全部是Roche眼科双抗，Tie2直接激动、基因治疗或口服药物等路径尚未出现，可借此检验稳定血管本身是否比单纯中和Ang-2更有获益。
该靶点标注于肿瘤血管生成，另有一项试验涉及心血管/代谢/肾领域，但本站未追踪到肿瘤或全身性血管渗漏项目，Ang-2阻断在眼外的作用仍是开放问题。
患者选择尚未探索：眼内Ang-2水平或渗漏表型或可识别相对单纯抗VEGF获益更大的人群。NCT04567303将显示第二代分子形式能否形成有别于faricimab的特征。

en.why: Ang-2 is released from stressed endothelium and antagonises Tie2 signalling, destabilising vessels and sensitising them to VEGF, which drives leakage, inflammation and neovascularisation. Intraocular Ang-2 is elevated in diabetic macular edema and neovascular AMD. Dual VEGF/Ang-2 blockade aims to restore vascular stability beyond anti-VEGF alone; faricimab is approved for nAMD and DME.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin: no readouts or failures yet, and both programs are Roche VEGF/Ang-2 bispecifics in phase 1/2. The first real test is zifibancimig in macular degeneration (NCT04567303), which reached primary completion in August 2026 with results pending.
opps: All programs tracked here are Roche bispecifics in ophthalmology. Direct Tie2 activation, gene therapy or oral agents are absent, leaving open whether stabilising vessels, not just neutralising Ang-2, adds benefit.

The target is annotated to tumour angiogenesis and one trial touches the cardiovascular/metabolic/renal area, yet no oncology or systemic vascular-leak programs are tracked here. Ang-2 blockade outside the eye remains an open question.

Patient selection is unexplored: intraocular Ang-2 levels or leakage phenotypes might identify patients who gain most over anti-VEGF alone. NCT04567303 should show whether a second-generation format offers a profile distinct from faricimab.

zh.why: Aurora A（AURKA）是有丝分裂激酶，调控中心体成熟和纺锤体组装，在多种实体瘤中扩增或高表达。它可结合并稳定MYCN，与神经母细胞瘤相关。临床前研究提示，RB1缺失肿瘤对Aurora A抑制存在合成致死依赖，为生物标志物指导用药提供了依据。
learned: 临床证据仍很有限：本站追踪的仅有Jacobio的JAB-2485（1/2期）和Eli Lilly一款未具名分子（1期），均为小分子，尚无读出或失败记录，未来六个月也无主要完成节点，目前看不到近期的关键检验。
opps: 患者选择或是主要突破口：可前瞻性按RB1缺失、MYCN扩增或AURKA扩增分层，检验合成致死假说能否转化为临床获益。
本站追踪的项目均为激酶抑制剂。降解剂或阻断Aurora A–MYCN相互作用的分子可同时作用于其非催化的支架功能，目前尚属空白。
ER+乳腺癌已出现在追踪项目的适应症中，内分泌治疗或CDK4/6抑制剂耐药后的联合用药是否有效，有待验证。

en.why: Aurora A (AURKA) is a mitotic kinase that controls centrosome maturation and spindle assembly, and it is amplified or overexpressed in many solid tumors. It binds and stabilizes MYCN, which links it to neuroblastoma. Preclinical work suggests RB1-deficient tumors depend on Aurora A, a synthetic-lethal relationship that offers a basis for biomarker-guided use.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Only two small-molecule programs are tracked here: Jacobio's JAB-2485 (Phase 1/2) and an unnamed Eli Lilly molecule (Phase 1). Neither has a readout or a recorded failure, and no tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term test is in view.
opps: Patient selection may be the main opening. Prospective enrichment for RB1 loss, MYCN amplification or AURKA amplification would test whether the synthetic-lethal hypothesis turns into clinical benefit.
Every program tracked here is a kinase inhibitor. Degraders, or molecules that block the Aurora A–MYCN interaction, would also act on its non-catalytic scaffolding role, and none are tracked yet.
ER+ breast cancer is among the tracked indications. Whether combinations work after resistance to endocrine therapy or CDK4/6 inhibitors is still an open question.

zh.why: B7-H3（CD276）是B7家族免疫调节分子，在小细胞肺癌、前列腺癌、非小细胞肺癌、食管鳞癌和脑胶质瘤等多种实体瘤中高表达，正常组织表达有限，且高表达与预后不良相关。因此它适合作为ADC、CAR-T和双抗的肿瘤表面靶点。
learned: 临床记录仍然偏少：本站尚未收录带结论的注册试验读出，也没有失败或提前终止记录。唯一的信号是两款B7-H3 ADC（Tam-peli/YL-201与Ris-rez）在中国三期中达到复发SCLC的总生存期主要终点。下一个关键检验是广泛期SCLC三期NCT06954246，主要完成时间为2027-05。
opps: 前列腺癌（含mCRPC）和食管鳞癌是本站收录项目较多的适应症，但目前没有阳性读出。ADC在SCLC中的获益能否延伸到这些瘤种，仍是有待验证的假设。
本站收录7个细胞治疗项目，均未超过二期，其中包括脑室内给药CAR-T（T-MAXIMUM）和BCB-276（BrainChild Bio）。局部给药治疗中枢神经系统肿瘤是ADC尚未覆盖的方向。
本站收录的ADC进入三期的已有多款（Ifinatamab deruxtecan、GSK、BNT324、YL201），后来者可考虑以B7-H3表达水平筛选患者、改进载荷或联合用药来做差异化，单抗和双抗路线也还相对靠后。

en.why: B7-H3 (CD276) is a B7-family immunoregulatory protein. It is overexpressed in many solid tumours, including small-cell lung cancer, prostate cancer, NSCLC, oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma and glioma, but shows limited expression in normal tissue, and high levels go with poor prognosis. That profile makes it a good surface target for ADCs, CAR-T and bispecifics.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site has no registry readouts with a verdict and no failures or early stops for B7-H3. The one signal is that two B7-H3 ADCs (Tam-peli/YL-201 and Ris-rez) met the overall-survival primary endpoint in Chinese phase 3 trials in relapsed SCLC. The next real test is the extensive-stage SCLC phase 3 NCT06954246 (primary completion 2027-05).
opps: Prostate cancer (including mCRPC) and oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma draw several programs tracked here, but none has a positive readout yet. Whether the ADC benefit seen in SCLC carries over to these tumours is still an open hypothesis.

This site tracks seven cell-therapy programs, none past phase 2. They include intracerebroventricular CAR-T (T-MAXIMUM) and BCB-276 (BrainChild Bio). Delivering therapy directly into the CNS for brain tumours is a niche the ADCs do not cover.

Several ADCs tracked here are already in phase 3 (ifinatamab deruxtecan, GSK, BNT324, YL201). Later entrants might stand out by selecting patients on B7-H3 expression level, using a different payload, or testing combinations. Antibody and bispecific programs are less advanced.

zh.why: B7-H4（VTCN1）属B7家族共抑制配体，可抑制T细胞增殖与细胞因子分泌。它在卵巢癌、乳腺癌和子宫内膜癌中高表达，正常组织表达有限，且常与PD-L1表达互不重叠，因此被视为ADC等靶向递送药物的候选抗原。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：本站追踪的3个项目均在1-2期，尚无读出，未来6个月亦无试验到达主要完成；Hansoh的2期ADC有望成为首个实质检验。
opps: 本站追踪项目集中于泛实体瘤和卵巢/输卵管癌，乳腺癌（含TNBC）与子宫内膜癌虽常高表达B7-H4，但尚未见专门项目。
可检验按B7-H4 IHC表达分层能否区分ADC获益人群；B7-H4与PD-L1表达常不重叠，PD-L1阴性人群或与PD-1抑制剂联用值得探索。
已知模态的项目均为ADC，B7-H4×CD3或×4-1BB双抗、CAR-T在本站尚无追踪项目，其作为检查点或T细胞重定向靶点的价值仍未检验。

en.why: B7-H4 (VTCN1) is a B7-family co-inhibitory ligand that dampens T-cell proliferation and cytokine release. It is highly expressed in ovarian, breast and endometrial cancers with limited normal-tissue expression, and often does not overlap with PD-L1, making it a candidate antigen for ADCs and other targeted payload delivery.
learned: The clinical record is still thin: all three programs tracked here are in phase 1-2, none has read out, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months. Hansoh's phase 2 ADC is the likeliest first real test.
opps: Among programs tracked here, work centres on advanced solid tumours and ovarian/fallopian tube cancer; breast cancer (including TNBC) and endometrial cancer, where B7-H4 is often highly expressed, have no dedicated program.
Test whether B7-H4 IHC thresholds identify ADC responders; because B7-H4 and PD-L1 expression often diverge, PD-L1-negative tumours or PD-1 combinations are a hypothesis worth testing.
Every tracked program with a known modality is an ADC; B7-H4×CD3 or ×4-1BB bispecifics and CAR-T are not represented here, leaving its value as a checkpoint or T-cell-redirecting target untested.

zh.why: BAFF（BLyS）与APRIL属TNF家族细胞因子，经BAFF-R、TACI和BCMA维持B细胞与浆细胞存活。APRIL还驱动IgA类别转换，在IgA肾病中促进低半乳糖IgA1生成。抗BAFF单抗belimumab获批用于狼疮已久，验证了这一通路；双靶阻断希望进一步压低浆细胞和致病性自身抗体。
learned: 本站跟踪的有效读出仍很少：ORIGIN 3（NCT04716231）未做正式统计检验，ianalumab ITP 2期（NCT07039422）以科学与可行性考量为由终止，tibulizumab皮肤病2期（NCT06843239）未达终点。首批真正的检验来自NCT05653349、NCT05639114和NCT06456580。
opps: IgA肾病是本站最拥挤的适应症，既有TACI-Fc融合蛋白（atacicept、povetacicept、telitacicept），也有仅靶向APRIL的单抗（sibeprenlimab、zigakibart）。差异化可能取决于双靶还是单靶、给药间隔，以及能否按低半乳糖IgA1水平筛选患者；NCT07020923可补充数据。
肾外的自身抗体病仍有空间：telitacicept的gMG 3期（NCT06456580、NCT07249632）和ianalumab ITP 3期（NCT05653349）将检验浆细胞减少能否带来临床获益。原发性膜性肾病仅2个项目，可尝试用抗PLA2R滴度筛选和监测患者。
细胞治疗是最早期的模态，Luminary的BAFF CAR-T仍处1-2期。待回答的问题是：BAFF可结合三种受体，基于它构建的CAR清除B系细胞是否比CD19 CAR-T更彻底，感染风险又如何。

en.why: BAFF (BLyS) and APRIL are TNF-family cytokines that keep B cells and plasma cells alive through BAFF-R, TACI and BCMA. APRIL also drives IgA class switching and, in IgA nephropathy, production of galactose-deficient IgA1. Belimumab, an anti-BAFF antibody long approved for lupus, validated the pathway. Blocking both cytokines aims to push down plasma cells and pathogenic autoantibodies further.
learned: Among programs tracked here, there are still very few informative readouts. ORIGIN 3 (NCT04716231) ran no formal test, ianalumab's ITP phase 2 (NCT07039422) stopped citing scientific and feasibility concerns, and tibulizumab missed in skin disease (NCT06843239). The first real tests are NCT05653349, NCT05639114 and NCT06456580.
opps: IgA nephropathy is the most crowded indication here, with TACI-Fc fusion proteins (atacicept, povetacicept, telitacicept) and APRIL-only antibodies (sibeprenlimab, zigakibart). Standing out may depend on dual versus APRIL-only blockade, dosing interval, and selecting patients by galactose-deficient IgA1 levels. NCT07020923 may add data.

Autoantibody diseases outside the kidney are still open. Telitacicept's gMG phase 3s (NCT06456580, NCT07249632) and ianalumab in ITP (NCT05653349) will test whether fewer plasma cells means clinical benefit. Primary membranous nephropathy has only two programs; anti-PLA2R titers could be used to select and monitor patients.

Cell therapy is the earliest modality, with Luminary's BAFF CAR-T still in phase 1-2. The open question: BAFF binds three receptors, so does a CAR built on it clear B-lineage cells more fully than CD19 CAR-T, and what is the infection risk?

zh.why: BCL-2是抗凋亡蛋白，通过结合BH3-only蛋白及BAX/BAK阻断线粒体凋亡。CLL（13q14 miR-15/16缺失）、滤泡淋巴瘤（t(14;18)）和AML等常依赖BCL-2存活。选择性BH3模拟物venetoclax已在CLL和AML获批，验证了该靶点。
learned: 此处追踪的4项读出均无正式统计检验，两项提前终止（NCT04161885 VIALE-T、NCT06508489）均出于策略原因，并非疗效或安全性问题。首批真正检验将来自venetoclax骨髓瘤（NCT03539744）和CLL（NCT03836261），以及sonrotoclax CLL（NCT06637501）。
opps: 此处追踪到4个进入Phase 3的小分子（venetoclax、sonrotoclax、lisaftoclax、TQB3909）。后来者可能需要在克服BCL2 G101V等耐药突变、简化剂量爬坡或与BTK抑制剂固定疗程联用上做出差异，NCT06637501可提供线索。
CLL和AML之外，骨髓瘤（NCT03539744）和Waldenström巨球蛋白血症（NCT05952037）布局较少，可用t(11;14)等生物标志物筛选BCL-2依赖患者。VIALE-T（NCT04161885）因策略原因终止，移植后AML维持治疗的问题仍未回答。
此处追踪的非小分子路线仅到Phase 1（Bio-Path反义寡核苷酸BP1002等）。蛋白降解剂，以及联合MCL-1或BCL-xL抑制来应对适应性耐药，在这里尚未见到项目，可作为待验证的假设。

en.why: BCL-2 is an anti-apoptotic protein that binds BH3-only proteins and BAX/BAK, which holds back mitochondrial cell death. CLL (13q14 miR-15/16 loss), follicular lymphoma (t(14;18)) and AML often depend on it to survive. Venetoclax, a selective BH3 mimetic, validated the target with approvals in CLL and AML.
learned: None of the four readouts tracked here had a formal hypothesis test. Both early stops (NCT04161885 VIALE-T, NCT06508489) were for strategic reasons, not efficacy or safety. The first real tests will come from venetoclax in myeloma (NCT03539744) and CLL (NCT03836261), and sonrotoclax in CLL (NCT06637501).
opps: Four small molecules tracked here are in Phase 3 (venetoclax, sonrotoclax, lisaftoclax, TQB3909). Later entrants may need to stand out by overcoming resistance mutations like BCL2 G101V, simplifying dose ramp-up, or running fixed-duration BTK-inhibitor combinations. NCT06637501 may offer early signals.

Beyond CLL and AML, few programs here address myeloma (NCT03539744) or Waldenström macroglobulinemia (NCT05952037). Biomarkers such as t(11;14) could pick out BCL-2-dependent patients. VIALE-T (NCT04161885) stopped for strategic reasons, so post-transplant AML maintenance remains unanswered.

Non-small-molecule approaches tracked here have only reached Phase 1 (e.g., Bio-Path's antisense BP1002). No programs here test degraders, or combinations with MCL-1 or BCL-xL blockade to counter adaptive resistance. Both are open hypotheses.

zh.why: BCL-XL是BCL-2家族的抗凋亡蛋白，通过结合BAX/BAK及BH3-only蛋白阻断线粒体凋亡。多种实体瘤和JAK2驱动的骨髓增殖性肿瘤依赖BCL-XL存活，BCL-XL上调也是venetoclax耐药的途径之一。血小板存活同样依赖BCL-XL，因此靶向血小板减少限制了抑制剂的剂量。
learned: 此处追踪的临床记录仍很单薄：仅有AbbVie的navitoclax（3期）和Guangzhou Lupeng一款2期小分子，尚无读出，未来6个月也没有试验到达主要完成，目前无法据此判断机制成败。
opps: 此处追踪的两款药物均为小分子。PROTAC降解剂或ADC可借组织选择性降解或肿瘤靶向递送减少血小板暴露，此处尚未出现，可作为拓宽治疗窗的差异化假设。
此处追踪的适应症集中于骨髓纤维化、MPN和复发/难治CLL，尚无实体瘤项目。可用BH3谱分析或BCL-XL表达筛选依赖型实体瘤，并探索与化疗或靶向药联用。
BCL-XL上调与venetoclax耐药相关。复发/难治CLL中的在研项目可检验venetoclax经治患者能否从BCL-XL抑制中获益，入组时宜记录既往治疗和耐药机制。

en.why: BCL-XL is an anti-apoptotic BCL-2 family protein that blocks mitochondrial apoptosis by binding BAX/BAK and BH3-only proteins. Many solid tumors and JAK2-driven myeloproliferative neoplasms depend on it to survive, and its upregulation is one route to venetoclax resistance. Platelets also need BCL-XL to survive, so on-target thrombocytopenia limits how high inhibitors can be dosed.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin: just AbbVie's navitoclax (Phase 3) and one Guangzhou Lupeng small molecule (Phase 2). No readouts are logged and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so nothing can yet be said about whether the mechanism works.
opps: Both programs tracked here are small molecules. PROTAC degraders or ADCs could limit platelet exposure through tissue-selective degradation or tumor-targeted delivery. None appear here, so they are a hypothesis for getting a wider therapeutic window.

The indications tracked here are myelofibrosis, MPN and relapsed/refractory CLL. There are no solid-tumor programs. BH3 profiling or BCL-XL expression could pick out BCL-XL-dependent solid tumors, alongside chemotherapy or targeted-therapy combinations.

BCL-XL upregulation is linked to venetoclax resistance. The relapsed/refractory CLL program could test whether venetoclax-pretreated patients benefit from BCL-XL inhibition. Recording each patient's prior therapy and resistance mechanism would help answer that.

zh.why: BCL6 是生发中心 B 细胞形成所必需的转录抑制因子，通过 BTB 结构域招募共抑制复合物，压制 DNA 损伤应答和终末分化程序。DLBCL 中常见 BCL6 易位或持续高表达，小鼠模型中组成性表达 BCL6 可诱发类 DLBCL 淋巴瘤，因此它是淋巴瘤的驱动靶点，但作为转录因子长期难以成药。
learned: 临床证据仍很薄弱：本站目前只追踪到 BMS-986458 一个项目（Bristol Myers Squibb，1/2 期，复发/难治性 NHL），尚无读出、失败或提前终止记录，未来六个月也没有到达主要完成日期的试验，暂无法判断该机制在临床上是否成立。
opps: 适应证留白：本站追踪到的项目都集中在复发/难治性 NHL。BCL6 依赖性在滤泡性淋巴瘤、Burkitt 淋巴瘤中同样有生物学依据，Tfh 细胞依赖 BCL6 也提示自身免疫方向，可作为可验证的假设。
患者选择：可以按细胞起源（GCB 与 ABC）、BCL6 易位或表达水平富集患者，检验 BCL6 依赖性能否预测疗效。这一问题在目前追踪的项目中尚无数据回答。
BMS-986458 的首批数据将确定安全性和活性基线，后续进入者可以围绕联合用药（如与标准免疫化疗或其他淋巴瘤靶向药联用）和起效深度做差异化设计。

en.why: BCL6 is a transcriptional repressor required for germinal-center B-cell formation. Through its BTB domain it recruits corepressor complexes that silence DNA-damage-response and terminal-differentiation programs. BCL6 translocations and sustained overexpression are common in DLBCL, and mice that constitutively express BCL6 develop DLBCL-like lymphoma. That makes it a lymphoma driver, but one that has long been hard to drug because it is a transcription factor.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only program tracked here is BMS-986458 (Bristol Myers Squibb, phase 1/2, relapsed/refractory NHL). It has no readouts, failures or early stops on record, and no tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so there is not yet a clinical test of the mechanism.
opps: Indication white space: every program tracked here is in relapsed/refractory NHL. BCL6 dependence also has a biological rationale in follicular and Burkitt lymphoma, and the reliance of Tfh cells on BCL6 points to autoimmunity. Both are testable hypotheses.

Patient selection: enrolling patients by cell of origin (GCB vs ABC), BCL6 translocation or expression level could test whether BCL6 dependence predicts response. No program tracked here has data on this yet.

The first BMS-986458 data will set the baseline for safety and activity. Later entrants could then design for differentiation through combinations (for example with standard immunochemotherapy or other lymphoma-targeted agents) and through deeper target suppression.

zh.why: BCMA（TNFRSF17）是APRIL/BAFF的受体，维持浆细胞存活。多发性骨髓瘤细胞几乎普遍表达BCMA，正常组织分布有限。ide-cel、cilta-cel等CAR-T和teclistamab等双抗已获批，验证了这一靶点。基于同样的浆细胞生物学，它也被用于AL淀粉样变和抗体介导的自身免疫病。
learned: 本站跟踪的三期阳性结果均来自T细胞衔接双抗向早线推进：elranatamab在抗CD38和来那度胺经治患者中达到PFS终点，teclistamab联合talquetamab（MonumenTAL-6）在早线RRMM中顶线阳性。
双抗原策略开始显现价值：BCMA与GPRC5D双抗联用三期阳性，IASO的BCMA/GPRC5D双靶CAR-T RD140也报告了一期积极信号，都指向同时覆盖两个抗原、减少单靶逃逸的思路。
近期四项登记读出（NCT07150104、NCT07217184、NCT07217119、NCT07150091）均为belantamab mafodotin剂量扩展研究，终点是DLT和不良事件的描述性统计。本站跟踪的唯一ADC目前重心在剂量与耐受性，而不是新的疗效检验。
管线高度拥挤：60个项目中36个为细胞治疗，16个已进入三期。本站尚未记录任何失败或提前终止，因此各项目之间的分化还没有通过公开挫折显现出来。
opps: 向肿瘤以外延伸的项目仍是少数：本站跟踪的项目中SLE仅3个，AL淀粉样变也只有少数几个，免疫/炎症试验共14项。值得检验的问题是：深度清除浆细胞能否带来持久缓解，且安全性可以接受。
BCMA双抗前移后，BCMA经治患者的后续序贯与抗原逃逸成为空白。可以考虑按BCMA表达或可溶性BCMA分层，探索BCMA/GPRC5D双靶设计，以及非T细胞衔接的模式（本站仅跟踪到1个ADC）。
未来6个月本站跟踪的试验中没有主要完成节点，新证据将主要来自三期结果发布。尚待回答的是：CM336、TQB2934等双抗和AZD0120、anitocabtagene-autoleucel等细胞疗法，能否与已获批药物拉开差异。

en.why: BCMA (TNFRSF17) is a receptor for APRIL and BAFF that keeps plasma cells alive. Nearly all myeloma cells express it, with little expression elsewhere. Approved CAR-Ts (ide-cel, cilta-cel) and bispecifics (teclistamab) validate the target. The same plasma-cell biology extends it to AL amyloidosis and antibody-driven autoimmune disease.
learned: Both phase 3 wins tracked here come from T-cell engagers moving into earlier relapse. Elranatamab met its PFS endpoint in patients previously treated with anti-CD38 and lenalidomide, and teclistamab plus talquetamab (MonumenTAL-6) was positive in earlier-line relapsed/refractory myeloma.

Dual-antigen approaches are starting to pay off. The BCMA plus GPRC5D bispecific combination was positive in phase 3, and IASO's BCMA/GPRC5D dual-target CAR-T RD140 reported a positive phase I signal. Both aim to reduce escape when only one antigen is targeted.

The four recent registry readouts (NCT07150104, NCT07217184, NCT07217119, NCT07150091) are all belantamab mafodotin dose-expansion studies with descriptive DLT and adverse-event endpoints. For the only ADC tracked here, the current focus is dosing and tolerability, not new efficacy tests.

The field is crowded: 36 of 60 programs are cell therapies and 16 are in phase 3. No failures or early stops are recorded here yet, so differences between programs have not shown up as public setbacks.
opps: Few programs go beyond cancer. Among programs tracked here, only 3 address SLE and only a few address AL amyloidosis, across 14 immunology/inflammation trials. One question to test: does deep plasma-cell depletion give durable remission with acceptable safety?

As BCMA bispecifics move into earlier lines, it is unclear what to give patients after BCMA exposure, and antigen escape becomes a bigger issue. Options to explore: selecting patients by BCMA expression or soluble BCMA, BCMA/GPRC5D dual targeting, and approaches other than T-cell engagers (only one ADC is tracked here).

None of the trials tracked here reach primary completion in the next six months, so new evidence will mostly come from phase 3 announcements. The open question is whether bispecifics such as CM336 and TQB2934, or cell therapies such as AZD0120 and anitocabtagene-autoleucel, can stand out from approved drugs.

zh.why: BCR-ABL是t(9;22)易位（费城染色体）产生的融合激酶，持续激活下游增殖信号，是CML的始动驱动因素，也见于部分ALL。Imatinib的成功使其成为靶向治疗验证最充分的靶点，后续研发主要围绕耐药突变（如T315I）、耐受性和停药后无治疗缓解展开。
learned: 临床记录仍然偏少：目前只有一项读出，即Asciminib的III期ASC4START（NCT05456191）达到以不良事件停药时间为终点的主要终点，说明耐受性本身可以作为一线CML的注册路径。下一项检验是Olverembatinib在GIST中的III期NCT06640361。
opps: 在本站追踪的项目中，一线及难治CML已有多个III期药物，Enliven、CTTQ（TQB3911）和Hansoh的I期分子若要差异化，可能需要在T315I或复合突变、长期耐受性或无治疗缓解率上拿出证据。
新诊断Ph+ ALL仅有少数项目在做，可以探索TKI联合减化疗方案，并以MRD为导向做分层，这一方向仍有空间。
NCT06640361将检验Olverembatinib能否拓展到GIST。需注意其在GIST中的活性主要来自对KIT/PDGFRA的作用，而非BCR-ABL，按突变类型筛选患者可能是关键。

en.why: BCR-ABL is the fusion kinase created by the t(9;22) translocation (the Philadelphia chromosome). It is constantly switched on and drives chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) and part of acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL). Imatinib made it the textbook validated target for targeted therapy. Newer work focuses on resistance mutations such as T315I, on tolerability, and on treatment-free remission.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Only one readout exists: Asciminib's phase 3 ASC4START (NCT05456191) met its primary endpoint, time to stopping treatment because of adverse events. That shows tolerability can carry a frontline CML registration. The next test is Olverembatinib's phase 3 in GIST, NCT06640361.
opps: Among programs tracked here, frontline and resistant CML already has several phase 3 agents. To stand out, the phase 1 molecules from Enliven, CTTQ (TQB3911) and Hansoh may need evidence on T315I or compound mutations, long-term tolerability, or treatment-free remission rates.
Few tracked programs address newly diagnosed Ph+ ALL. TKI-based regimens with less chemotherapy, with treatment adjusted by minimal residual disease (MRD), remain a possible opening.
NCT06640361 will test whether Olverembatinib extends to GIST. Its activity in GIST likely comes from KIT/PDGFRA inhibition, not BCR-ABL, so selecting patients by mutation type may decide the result.

zh.why: BDCA2（CD303）是浆细胞样树突状细胞（pDC）特异表达的C型凝集素受体，抗体结合后可抑制TLR7/9介导的I型干扰素产生。I型干扰素是SLE和皮肤型红斑狼疮的核心致病通路，anifrolumab阻断IFNAR获批也验证了这一轴线。靶向BDCA2是从上游源头压低干扰素。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍然很薄，尚无正式登记读出，也没有失败记录，仅有Biogen就Phase 2/3 AMETHYST研究52周Phase 2数据发布的积极新闻稿。第一次真正检验将来自litifilimab的三项研究：SLE的NCT04961567、NCT04895241和亚急性皮肤型狼疮的NCT05531565，均已到主要完成日，结果尚待公布。
opps: 皮肤病灶中pDC浸润明显，可以假设BDCA2抗体在皮肤主导型狼疮中效果优于全身性SLE。NCT05531565与两项SLE Phase 3结果对照，将显示该机制最适合的人群。
本站追踪到的项目仅3个，Biogen遥遥领先，Sunshine Guojian（Phase 2）和Biocad BCD-256（Phase 1）作为跟随者，可考虑按干扰素基因特征筛选患者，以形成差异化。
在其他pDC/干扰素驱动的疾病（如皮肌炎、干燥综合征）中，本站尚未追踪到BDCA2项目，这是一个生物学依据充分但临床上空白的方向。

en.why: BDCA2 (CD303) is a C-type lectin receptor found only on plasmacytoid dendritic cells (pDCs). Antibody binding suppresses TLR7/9-driven type I interferon production. Type I IFN drives SLE and cutaneous lupus, and the approval of the IFNAR blocker anifrolumab validated that axis. Targeting BDCA2 aims to shut down interferon at its source.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. There are no registry readouts and no failures. The only data point is a positive Biogen press release on 52-week Phase 2 data from the ongoing Phase 2/3 AMETHYST study. The first real tests are three litifilimab trials: NCT04961567 and NCT04895241 in SLE, and NCT05531565 in subacute cutaneous lupus. All have passed primary completion, and results are pending.
opps: pDCs are abundant in cutaneous lupus lesions. One hypothesis is that BDCA2 antibodies work better in skin-dominant lupus than in systemic SLE. Comparing NCT05531565 with the two SLE Phase 3 trials should show which patients the mechanism suits best.

Only 3 programs are tracked here, and Biogen is well ahead. The followers, Sunshine Guojian (Phase 2) and Biocad's BCD-256 (Phase 1), could set themselves apart by selecting patients with an interferon gene signature.
Other pDC- and interferon-driven diseases, such as dermatomyositis and Sjögren's, have strong biological rationale. No BDCA2 programs for them are tracked here.

zh.why: BRAF是RAS–MAPK通路中的RAF激酶，V600E等激活突变使其不依赖RAS即可持续激活MEK–ERK信号。这类突变见于约半数黑色素瘤，以及部分结直肠癌、NSCLC和甲状腺癌。vemurafenib、dabrafenib、encorafenib已获批，BRAF作为致癌驱动靶点已得到验证。
learned: 本站目前只追踪到两项读出，均为达到PFS终点的3期试验（encorafenib NCT04607421，dabrafenib用于DTC NCT04940052），没有失败记录。接下来的检验是黑色素瘤试验NCT04657991、NCT05270044和mCRC试验NCT06008119。
opps: 在本站追踪的项目中，非V600突变和中枢肿瘤覆盖很少：针对广义BRAF变异的项目和针对HGG的项目各一项。II/III类突变与融合以二聚体形式传递信号，可以检验能抑制二聚体、并能透过血脑屏障的设计。
8个项目都是小分子，后期管线集中在V600黑色素瘤、NSCLC和结直肠癌。降解剂等其他modality尚未出现。Shanghai Kechow的3期新药进入V600领域，需要在疗效持久性或延缓MAPK再激活上体现差异。
结直肠癌中EGFR反馈会削弱BRAF抑制剂单药的效果，联合方案是关键。即将读出的mCRC 3期NCT06008119有助于判断联合策略和治疗线数的价值；耐药生物标志物可以用来优化患者选择。

en.why: BRAF is a RAF kinase in the RAS–MAPK pathway. Activating mutations, mainly V600E, switch on MEK–ERK signaling without RAS and drive about half of melanomas, plus subsets of colorectal, lung and thyroid cancers. Approved inhibitors such as vemurafenib, dabrafenib and encorafenib have established BRAF as a validated cancer driver.
learned: The site tracks only two readouts so far. Both are phase 3 trials that met their PFS endpoint: encorafenib (NCT04607421) and dabrafenib in DTC (NCT04940052). No failures are recorded. The next tests are the melanoma trials NCT04657991 and NCT05270044 and the mCRC trial NCT06008119.
opps: Among programs tracked here, non-V600 alterations and brain tumors get little coverage: one program targets broad BRAF alterations and one targets high-grade glioma. Class II/III mutants and fusions signal as dimers, so drugs that block dimers and reach the brain are a gap worth testing.

All eight tracked programs are small molecules, and late-stage work centers on V600 melanoma, NSCLC and colorectal cancer. Degraders and other modalities are absent. Shanghai Kechow's new phase 3 V600 asset would need to stand out on durability or on delaying MAPK reactivation.

In colorectal cancer, EGFR feedback weakens BRAF inhibitors given alone, so combinations are key. The upcoming phase 3 NCT06008119 in metastatic CRC should help show which combinations and lines of therapy add value. Resistance biomarkers could help select patients.

zh.why: BRD4等BET蛋白通过溴结构域识别乙酰化组蛋白，招募P-TEFb，维持MYC、BCL2及NF-κB靶基因等超级增强子驱动的转录。这一依赖性见于血液肿瘤、AR驱动的前列腺癌和骨髓纤维化的炎症信号。泛BET抑制剂常见血小板减少等类效应毒性，治疗窗一直是主要难点。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄，未来6个月没有追踪到的读出。唯一读出NCT07309432因商业原因终止，而且REGN5713-5715针对的是桦树花粉过敏原Bet v 1，并非BET蛋白，对该机制没有参考价值。
opps: 骨髓纤维化方面，本站追踪的项目中Novartis的Pelabresib进展最快（3期）。一个待验证的问题是：BET与JAK联用除改善脾脏和症状外，能否改变疾病进程，以及血小板减少能否控制在可接受范围。
Pocenbrodib（Pathos AI）和Jacobio的项目处于1/2期，覆盖mCRPC、NSCLC和实体瘤。可检验的假设是：按AR信号或MYC依赖性筛选患者，并与通路抑制剂联用，能否让BET抑制在实体瘤中真正起效。
本站追踪的BET项目均为小分子抑制剂（单抗那一项实为Bet v 1误归类）。BD2选择性分子或BRD4降解剂尚未出现在追踪范围内，或可用于测试能否拓宽治疗窗。

en.why: BRD4 and other BET proteins read acetylated histones through their bromodomains and recruit P-TEFb. This sustains super-enhancer-driven transcription of MYC, BCL2 and NF-κB target genes. That dependency shows up in blood cancers, AR-driven prostate cancer and the inflammatory signaling of myelofibrosis. Pan-BET inhibitors share class toxicities such as low platelet counts, so finding a usable dose range has been the main challenge.
learned: The clinical record is still thin, and no readouts tracked here are due in the next six months. The only readout, NCT07309432, stopped for business reasons. Also, REGN5713-5715 targets the birch allergen Bet v 1, not BET proteins, so it tells us nothing about this mechanism.
opps: In myelofibrosis, Novartis's Pelabresib is the most advanced program tracked here (Phase 3). An open question: does adding a BET inhibitor to JAK inhibition change the course of the disease, beyond spleen and symptom benefit, while keeping low platelet counts manageable?

Pocenbrodib (Pathos AI) and Jacobio's program are in Phase 1/2 across mCRPC, NSCLC and solid tumors. One hypothesis to test: selecting patients by AR signaling or MYC dependence, and pairing with pathway inhibitors, could make BET inhibition work in solid tumors.

All BET programs tracked here are small-molecule inhibitors; the antibody entry is a misfiled Bet v 1 program. BD2-selective compounds and BRD4 degraders are absent from the programs tracked here and could test whether a wider safety margin is possible.

zh.why: BTK传导B细胞受体信号，驱动恶性B细胞存活与增殖，并参与肥大细胞、髓系细胞和小胶质细胞的Fc受体信号。BTK功能缺失导致X连锁无丙种球蛋白血症。Ibrutinib在CLL获批多年，早已验证该靶点，研发正向自免、过敏和神经炎症延伸。
learned: 非共价抑制剂pirtobrutinib在初治CLL达到PFS主要终点（NCT05023980），站内记录显示已获FDA批准。所追踪28个项目中19个在III期，集中于CLL/SLL和MCL，竞争拥挤。
肿瘤之外，BTK抑制在肥大细胞或自身抗体驱动的疾病中见效：rilzabrutinib在CSU达到终点（NCT05107115），奥布替尼ITP III期据新闻达到主要终点；在特应性皮炎则未达到（NCT05018806）。
近期多项读出没有正式假设检验：ASSURE（NCT04008706）、ibrutinib小样本CLL研究（NCT05105841）和LOU064花生过敏研究（NCT05432388）均属描述性，只能支持安全性评估和信号探索。
opps: CNS疗效仍待验证：LOU064两项RMS III期（NCT05147220、NCT05156281）已于2026年7月到达主要完成日，本站尚未收录结果，将检验同时作用于小胶质细胞和B细胞的BTK抑制能否转化为临床获益。
自身抗体和肥大细胞相关适应症值得深挖：rilzabrutinib ITP III期（NCT07216079）和LOU064 CSU研究（NCT05677451）将于11月前后完成。AD失利提示可按IgE、肥大细胞或自身抗体特征筛选患者。
降解剂有望在抑制剂治疗后的人群中实现差异化：tacabrutideg和NX-5948已列入III期，但尚无读出。清除BTK蛋白可能克服耐药突变和非激酶支架功能，按突变入组值得验证。

en.why: BTK relays B-cell receptor signals that keep malignant B cells alive and dividing. It also carries Fc receptor signals in mast cells, myeloid cells and microglia. Loss-of-function mutations cause X-linked agammaglobulinemia. Ibrutinib's long-standing approval in CLL validated the target, and development is now moving into autoimmune, allergic and neuroinflammatory disease.
learned: The non-covalent inhibitor pirtobrutinib met its PFS primary endpoint in frontline CLL (NCT05023980), and the site's notes record an FDA approval. Of 28 tracked programs, 19 are in phase 3, mostly in CLL/SLL and MCL, so the malignancy field is crowded.

Outside oncology, BTK inhibition works where mast cells or autoantibodies drive disease. Rilzabrutinib met in chronic spontaneous urticaria (NCT05107115), and company news reports that orelabrutinib's ITP phase 3 met. Rilzabrutinib missed in atopic dermatitis (NCT05018806), a disease driven more by T cells and barrier defects.

Much of the recent record has no formal hypothesis test. ASSURE (NCT04008706), a small ibrutinib CLL study (NCT05105841) and LOU064 in peanut allergy (NCT05432388) are descriptive, so they inform safety and signal-finding, not efficacy claims.
opps: Whether BTK inhibition works in the CNS is still open. LOU064's two phase 3 trials in relapsing MS (NCT05147220, NCT05156281) reached primary completion in July 2026, with no results tracked yet. They will test whether hitting both microglia and B cells gives a clinical benefit.

Autoantibody and mast-cell diseases look like the strongest fit. Rilzabrutinib's ITP phase 3 (NCT07216079) and LOU064 in CSU (NCT05677451) reach primary completion around November 2026. The atopic dermatitis miss suggests selecting patients by IgE, mast-cell or autoantibody biology.

Degraders may stand out in patients already treated with BTK inhibitors. Tacabrutideg and NX-5948 are listed in phase 3, but no degrader readout is tracked yet. Removing the BTK protein may overcome resistance mutations and the kinase's non-catalytic scaffolding role, so enrolling by mutation is a hypothesis worth testing.

zh.why: C1q识别抗原-抗体复合物并激活C1r和C1s，后者裂解C4和C2，启动补体经典途径。在C3激活之前阻断这一步，可抑制自身抗体介导的补体攻击，同时基本保留凝集素和旁路途径，适用于CIDP、自身免疫性溶血性贫血等抗体介导疾病。
learned: 证据仍很薄：唯一读出是Annexon在wAIHA的7例描述性II期NCT04691570，不构成成败判断；riliprubart的CIDP III期尚无读出，未来6个月无主要完成节点。
opps: CIDP中riliprubart是本站追踪的唯一经典途径项目。能否与其他机制拉开差距可能取决于患者分层，如自身抗体亚类或补体沉积证据，值得在III期中前瞻验证。
wAIHA以IgG介导为主，补体参与程度因人而异。NCT04691570之外，可考虑在直接抗球蛋白试验C3d阳性等补体活化人群中开展对照研究，检验C1q/C1s阻断是否让特定亚群获益。
本站追踪的两个项目均为单抗，仅覆盖CIDP和wAIHA。多灶性运动神经病、抗体介导移植排斥等补体结合型疾病，及口服小分子、siRNA等形式仍待探索。

en.why: C1q binds antibody–antigen complexes and activates C1r and C1s, the proteases that start the classical complement pathway by cleaving C4 and C2. Blocking this step stops autoantibody-driven complement attack before C3 activation while largely sparing the lectin and alternative pathways, giving a rationale in antibody-mediated diseases such as CIDP and autoimmune hemolytic anemia.
learned: The record is still thin: the only readout tracked is NCT04691570, Annexon's 7-patient descriptive phase 2 in wAIHA on safety and hemoglobin, neither a hit nor a miss. Sanofi's riliprubart phase 3 CIDP program has no readouts here, and nothing reaches primary completion in the next six months.
opps: In CIDP, riliprubart is the only classical-pathway program tracked here. Whether upstream C1s blockade stands apart from other mechanisms may depend on patient selection, such as autoantibody subclass or evidence of complement deposition; prospectively testing such markers could define who benefits.

wAIHA is mainly IgG-driven and complement involvement varies between patients. Beyond the small descriptive study NCT04691570, a controlled trial enriched for complement-activated patients (e.g., C3d-positive direct antiglobulin test) would test whether C1q/C1s blockade helps a defined subset.

Both programs tracked here are monoclonal antibodies, limited to CIDP and wAIHA. Other complement-fixing antibody diseases, such as multifocal motor neuropathy or antibody-mediated transplant rejection, and non-antibody modalities such as oral small molecules or siRNA remain untested hypotheses.

zh.why: C9orf72第1内含子GGGGCC六核苷酸重复扩增是家族性和散发性ALS及FTD最常见的遗传病因。致病机制涉及三条途径：C9orf72蛋白功能丧失（损害自噬与溶酶体功能）、重复RNA形成核内聚集灶，以及RAN翻译产生有毒的二肽重复蛋白。因此，这一患者群体由基因定义，可明确识别。
learned: 临床证据仍很有限。本站目前仅追踪到1个项目：IRulya的小分子LAM-002A在ALS中开展的II期研究NCT05163886。该研究共15例受试者，主要终点为安全性和耐受性，属于无统计检验的读出，不能据此判断疗效。未来6个月内暂无已登记的读出可作为首个真正的检验。
opps: 本站追踪的唯一项目是作用于下游自噬/溶酶体通路的小分子。直接靶向重复RNA的手段，如ASO、siRNA或基因编辑，在本站数据中尚无项目，可作为验证RNA毒性假说的方向。
可以考虑用脑脊液poly(GP)等二肽重复蛋白生物标志物做入组筛选和药效学读出，在小样本早期研究中先确认靶点调控，再推进疗效研究。
在本站追踪的项目中，C9orf72相关FTD和症状前携带者均无项目覆盖。同一基因突变驱动ALS与FTD两种表型，适应症还有扩展空间。

en.why: A GGGGCC hexanucleotide repeat expansion in intron 1 of C9orf72 is the most common genetic cause of both familial and sporadic ALS and FTD. It causes disease through three routes: loss of C9orf72 protein (which impairs autophagy and lysosomes), toxic repeat-RNA foci, and dipeptide-repeat proteins made by RAN translation. That gives a genetically defined patient group that can be clearly identified.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site tracks one program: IRulya's small molecule LAM-002A, in a Phase 2 ALS study (NCT05163886). The study enrolled 15 people, and its primary endpoints were safety and tolerability, with no formal hypothesis test, so it says nothing about efficacy. No tracked readout is due in the next six months to give a first real test.
opps: The only tracked program is a small molecule that acts on the downstream autophagy/lysosome pathway. No program tracked here targets the repeat RNA directly with ASOs, siRNA or gene editing. That approach could test the RNA-toxicity hypothesis.

CSF poly(GP) and other dipeptide-repeat biomarkers could be used to select patients and to measure drug effect. That would let small early studies confirm target engagement before moving to efficacy trials.
Among programs tracked here, none covers C9orf72-linked FTD or presymptomatic carriers. Because one mutation drives both ALS and FTD, there is room to expand into these indications.

zh.why: CB1是中枢表达最丰富的GPCR之一，位于突触前膜，介导内源性大麻素和THC对神经递质释放、疼痛、食欲和情绪的调节，外周CB1参与肝脏与脂肪代谢。rimonabant曾在欧盟获批治疗肥胖，后因精神不良反应撤市，既验证了代谢获益，也暴露了中枢风险。
learned: 本站追踪的CB1临床记录仍很薄：仅有Sinfatin S.L一个2期小分子项目，两项试验分别针对慢性卒中和新冠后综合征，2026年11月才登记，尚无读出，未来6个月也没有试验到达主要完成日。
opps: 本站追踪的项目中尚无针对肥胖、代谢相关脂肪性肝病或糖尿病肾病的项目，而外周CB1的生物学依据在这些领域最充分；不入脑的外周限制性反向激动剂是一个值得验证的方向。
Sinfatin两项试验的关键未知在于化合物是激活还是阻断CB1、入脑程度如何；同时纳入精神安全性监测和靶点结合标志物，结果才更具可解释性。
本站目前只见到小分子。偏向性或别构调节剂，以及难以穿过血脑屏障的CB1抗体，可用于检验外周获益能否与中枢效应分开。

en.why: CB1 is among the most abundant GPCRs in the brain. On presynaptic terminals it mediates how endocannabinoids and THC dampen neurotransmitter release, shaping pain, appetite and mood. Peripheral CB1 also regulates liver and fat metabolism. Rimonabant, an inverse agonist once approved in the EU for obesity and later withdrawn for psychiatric adverse effects, confirmed the metabolic biology but exposed the central safety risk.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. There is one Phase 2 small molecule from Sinfatin S.L, with two trials in chronic stroke and post-COVID-19 syndrome first posted in November 2026. There are no readouts yet, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months.
opps: None of the programs tracked here target obesity, metabolic liver disease or diabetic kidney disease, where the biology of peripheral CB1 is strongest. Peripherally restricted inverse agonists that stay out of the brain are an open hypothesis to test.

For the Sinfatin trials, the key unknowns are whether the compound activates or blocks CB1 and how much of it reaches the brain. Adding psychiatric safety monitoring and target-engagement markers would make the results easier to interpret.

Only small molecules appear here. Biased or allosteric modulators, and CB1 antibodies that do not cross the blood-brain barrier, could test whether peripheral benefit can be separated from central effects.

zh.why: CBL-B是T细胞和NK细胞内的E3泛素连接酶，决定T细胞活化所需的信号强度，并在缺乏CD28共刺激时诱导无能。小鼠敲除CBL-B后T细胞无需共刺激即可活化，能排斥肿瘤，并能抵抗TGF-β等抑制信号。它位于细胞内，难以用抗体干预，因此成为小分子免疫检查点的候选靶点。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍然很少：仅有2个小分子项目，Nurix的NX-1607处于1期，HotSpot的HST-1011处于1/2期，都没有公开读出，未来六个月也没有到达主要完成日的试验，尚无法判断疗效或安全性。
opps: 目前追踪的适应症集中在晚期实体瘤、卵巢癌和胃癌。可以考察是否需要按T细胞浸润程度或PD-1耐药状态筛选患者，验证CBL-B抑制能否在免疫"冷"肿瘤中降低T细胞活化阈值。
敲除小鼠会出现自身免疫倾向，首批数据需要说明免疫相关不良事件的情况，以及药效学标志物（如外周T细胞活化、IL-2）和剂量之间的关系。这将决定治疗窗口有多大。
本站追踪的项目都是全身给药的小分子。可以评估其他方式，比如在CAR-T或NK细胞疗法中做体外CBL-B敲除或药物预处理，以减少全身性自身免疫风险。

en.why: CBL-B is an intracellular E3 ubiquitin ligase that sets the activation threshold of T and NK cells and enforces anergy when CD28 co-stimulation is absent. In CBL-B knockout mice, T cells activate without co-stimulation, reject tumors and resist suppressive signals such as TGF-β. Because the target sits inside the cell and is hard to reach with antibodies, it is a candidate small-molecule immune checkpoint.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. There are two small-molecule programs: Nurix's NX-1607 in Phase 1 and HotSpot's HST-1011 in Phase 1/2. Neither has reported results, and no tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so efficacy and safety remain open questions.
opps: The tracked programs cover advanced solid tumors, ovarian cancer and gastric cancer. A testable question is whether selecting patients by T-cell infiltration or PD-1-refractory status shows where lowering the T-cell activation threshold matters most, especially in immune-cold tumors.

Knockout mice tend toward autoimmunity. Early data need to show the rate of immune-related adverse events and how pharmacodynamic markers such as peripheral T-cell activation or IL-2 track with dose. That will define how wide the therapeutic window is.

All tracked programs are systemic small molecules. One untested option is to delete CBL-B ex vivo, or pre-treat cells with a drug, in CAR-T or NK cell therapies, which could limit the risk of body-wide autoimmunity.

zh.why: CCR8主要表达于肿瘤浸润的活化调节性T细胞（Treg），外周Treg和效应T细胞表达很低。用Fc介导的抗CCR8抗体清除瘤内Treg，有望解除局部免疫抑制，同时保留全身免疫耐受，从而避开CTLA-4、CD25类策略的自身免疫风险。目前的依据主要来自临床前研究。
learned: 临床证据仍很薄：本站收录的11个项目尚无读出，也无失败或终止记录。项目以单抗为主，多数处于1/2期，LM-108进展最快，已进入3期。首个实质性检验将是LM-108的NCT05518045，主要完成日期定于2026年10月。
opps: 本站收录的项目几乎全是单抗，双抗（如与PD-1共靶向）、ADC或小分子均未见。可以研究其他分子形式能否更彻底地清除瘤内Treg，或改善与其他疗法联用的便利性。
适应症目前集中在晚期实体瘤篮子试验，单病种只有胃/胃食管结合部腺癌、NSCLC、宫颈癌和胰腺癌。以瘤内CCR8+ Treg密度作为入组生物标志物，可能有助于筛选获益人群。
BMS同时推进BMS-986340和一款NF抗CCR8单抗，说明Fc设计仍未定型。即将公布的数据可回答两个问题：Fc增强型清除能否带来疗效差异，以及保留外周Treg能否降低免疫相关不良事件。

en.why: CCR8 is expressed mainly on activated, highly suppressive tumor-infiltrating regulatory T cells (Tregs), with little expression on peripheral Tregs or effector T cells. Fc-mediated anti-CCR8 antibodies aim to clear Tregs inside the tumor and lift local immune suppression while sparing tolerance elsewhere in the body, avoiding the autoimmunity risk of CTLA-4- or CD25-directed approaches. The evidence so far is mostly preclinical.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. None of the 11 programs tracked here has a readout, failure or early stop yet. Almost all are monoclonal antibodies, mostly in phase 1/2, and LM-108 is furthest along in phase 3. The first real test is LM-108's NCT05518045, with primary completion scheduled for October 2026.
opps: Among programs tracked here, nearly all are monoclonal antibodies. No bispecifics (such as CCR8 x PD-1), ADCs or small molecules appear. Researchers could test whether other formats clear tumor Tregs more completely or combine more easily with other therapies.

Trials are concentrated in basket studies of advanced solid tumors. Only a few single-tumor trials exist: gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma, NSCLC, cervical and pancreatic cancer. Selecting patients by the density of CCR8+ Tregs in the tumor could help find who benefits.

BMS is running both BMS-986340 and an NF anti-CCR8 mAb, which suggests Fc design is not yet settled. Upcoming data can answer two questions: does Fc-enhanced depletion change efficacy, and does sparing peripheral Tregs lower immune-related side effects?

zh.why: CD123（IL-3Rα）在AML原始细胞及白血病干细胞上高表达，BPDCN几乎全部阳性，正常造血干细胞表达较低，是清除白血病干细胞的候选靶点。tagraxofusp已获批用于BPDCN，验证了该靶点；主要难点是对正常髓系细胞和内皮的靶上毒性。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：本站唯一读出是IMGN632在BPDCN的NCT03386513，为描述性分析，无正式假设检验；未记录失败，未来6个月也无试验到达主要完成，近期缺少新的检验点。
opps: 本站追踪的10个项目均涉及AML，但多处于1期；3个细胞治疗与双抗MGD024能否在不造成长期骨髓抑制的前提下清除病灶，或作为移植桥接，仍是待解问题。
MDS（2个）和MPN（1个）项目稀少；已有报道CD123在高危MDS干细胞上表达，按CD123表达密度或干细胞负荷筛选患者，是可检验的方向。
进度最快的pivekimab sunirine（2/3期，与本站分列的IMGN632为同一分子）将检验ADC路线能否从BPDCN延伸至AML；其与去甲基化药物或venetoclax联用的定位尚待回答。

en.why: CD123 (IL-3Rα) is overexpressed on AML blasts and leukaemic stem cells and is near-universal in BPDCN, with lower levels on normal haematopoietic stem cells, offering a route to the stem-cell compartment that drives relapse. Tagraxofusp's approval in BPDCN validated the target; on-target toxicity to normal myeloid and endothelial cells is the main constraint.
learned: The clinical record is still thin: the only readout tracked here is IMGN632 in BPDCN (NCT03386513), descriptive with no formal hypothesis test. No failures are recorded and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term test is scheduled.
opps: All 10 programs tracked here include AML, yet most are phase 1. Whether the three cell therapies and bispecific MGD024 can clear disease without prolonged myelosuppression, perhaps as a bridge to transplant, remains open.
MDS (2 programs) and MPN (1) are thinly covered here. CD123 has been reported on stem cells in higher-risk MDS; selecting patients by CD123 density or stem-cell burden is a testable approach.

The most advanced program, pivekimab sunirine (phase 2/3; the same molecule as IMGN632, listed separately here), will test whether the ADC approach extends from BPDCN into AML. How it fits with hypomethylating agents or venetoclax is still unanswered.

zh.why: CD19是BCR信号共受体，从前B细胞到浆母细胞广泛表达，覆盖多数B细胞恶性肿瘤和自身反应性B细胞。blinatumomab和tisagenlecleucel已验证其在B-ALL和淋巴瘤中的价值，深度B细胞清除现正延伸至狼疮等自身免疫病。
learned: 已追踪读出中尚无正式疗效检验，KYV-101和GNR-084的终止均出于商业原因，不能据此否定机制。首批实质检验将是tafasitamab的DLBCL三期（NCT04824092）和obexelimab的SLE试验（NCT06559163）。
opps: 已追踪的106个项目中有74个是细胞治疗，双抗只有5个，基因治疗3个。T细胞衔接器或体内CAR能否在狼疮中达到CAR-T级别的B细胞清除、同时免去清淋预处理，仍是待验证的假设。
SLE领域中，非清除性的obexelimab（NCT06559163）和CAR-T rapcabtagene autoleucel（NCT05798117）相继接近主要完成，可首次对比抑制与清除两种策略，并为按B细胞负荷或血清学分层提供线索。
系统性硬化（8个项目）和神经免疫适应症（10项试验）的布局少于狼疮。KYV-101在SSc的停止属商业决定（NCT06400303），CD19清除在该适应症中是否有效仍无答案。

en.why: CD19 is a co-receptor for B-cell receptor signalling. It is expressed from pro-B cells through plasmablasts, so it marks most B-cell cancers and autoreactive B cells. Blinatumomab and tisagenlecleucel proved it as a target in B-ALL and lymphoma, and the same deep B-cell depletion is now being tested in lupus and other autoimmune diseases.
learned: None of the readouts tracked here has formally tested efficacy yet. The KYV-101 and GNR-084 trials were stopped for business reasons, which says nothing against the mechanism. The first real tests will be tafasitamab's phase 3 in DLBCL (NCT04824092) and obexelimab in SLE (NCT06559163).
opps: Of the 106 programs tracked here, 74 are cell therapies. Only five are bispecifics and three are gene therapies. An open question is whether T-cell engagers or in vivo CAR approaches can deplete B cells as deeply as CAR-T in lupus without lymphodepletion.

In SLE, the non-depleting antibody obexelimab (NCT06559163) and the CAR-T rapcabtagene autoleucel (NCT05798117) are both near primary completion. Together they give a first comparison of blocking B cells versus depleting them, and may hint at selecting patients by B-cell burden or serology.

Systemic sclerosis (8 programs) and neuro-immune indications (10 trials) are less crowded than lupus. KYV-101 was stopped in systemic sclerosis by a business decision (NCT06400303), so whether CD19 depletion works there is still unknown.

zh.why: CD20表达于前B细胞到成熟B细胞，不表达于干细胞和长寿浆细胞，所以清除B细胞后既有的体液免疫基本保留，B细胞之后也能重建。rituximab早已确立其在B细胞淋巴瘤和CLL中的地位，ocrelizumab则验证了B细胞清除在多发性硬化中的价值。
learned: CD20单抗正从肿瘤和MS扩展到其他自身免疫病：obinutuzumab在SLE（NCT04963296）和儿童特发性肾病综合征（NCT05627557）中均达到主要终点。这支持在自身抗体驱动的疾病中做更深度的B细胞清除
在DLBCL中，epcoritamab的III期试验EPCORE DLBCL-1（NCT04628494）未达到OS终点；联合lenalidomide的NCT05660967则因商业原因终止，并非安全性问题。在本站追踪的III期数据中，双抗的生存获益尚未得到证实
MS领域近期试验多为皮下制剂、PK或长期随访（NCT05232825、NCT05123703、NCT03599245），没有正式假设检验；唯一做疗效检验的GAVOTTE（NCT04548999）未达到残疾进展终点
本站追踪46个项目，涉及45家公司，14个处于III期，以大药企的单抗和双抗为主。14个细胞治疗项目大多仍在I–II期，同靶点竞争集中在后期抗体
opps: obinutuzumab在SLE和儿童肾病综合征中取得阳性后，其他抗体介导的肾脏和风湿病在本站追踪的项目中仍很少。可研究的问题包括：II型抗CD20抗体是否优于rituximab，以及能否用B细胞重建或自身抗体水平指导给药
DLBCL双抗可转向联合用药和更前线治疗，待读出的glofitamab联合obinutuzumab（NCT03533283）可提供参考。双抗治疗后出现CD20阴性复发的患者，可能需要双靶点细胞治疗
进展型MS仍未解决：ocrelizumab的NCT03523858和ublituximab的III期（NCT07211633、NCT05877963）将检验抗CD20能否在控制复发之外延缓残疾进展。针对中枢内B细胞的策略在本站追踪的项目中尚无人尝试

en.why: CD20 sits on B cells from the pre-B to the mature stage but not on stem cells or long-lived plasma cells, so depleting it spares existing antibody immunity and allows B cells to recover. Rituximab has long been established in B-cell lymphoma and CLL, and ocrelizumab showed that B-cell depletion works in multiple sclerosis.
learned: CD20 antibodies are spreading from cancer and MS into other autoimmune diseases. Obinutuzumab met its primary endpoint in SLE (NCT04963296) and in childhood idiopathic nephrotic syndrome (NCT05627557), which supports deeper B-cell depletion in diseases driven by autoantibodies.

In DLBCL, epcoritamab missed overall survival in the Phase 3 EPCORE DLBCL-1 (NCT04628494). Its lenalidomide combination (NCT05660967) stopped for business reasons, not safety. Among the Phase 3 data tracked here, bispecifics have not yet shown a survival benefit.

Recent MS trials are mostly about subcutaneous dosing, PK or long-term follow-up (NCT05232825, NCT05123703, NCT03599245), with no formal hypothesis test. The one efficacy test, GAVOTTE (NCT04548999), missed its disability-progression endpoint.

This site tracks 46 programs from 45 companies. The 14 at Phase 3 are mostly antibodies and bispecifics from large companies. Most of the 14 cell therapies are still in Phase 1-2, so the crowding is in late-stage antibodies.
opps: After the wins in SLE and childhood nephrotic syndrome, few programs tracked here address other antibody-mediated kidney or rheumatic diseases. Open questions: does a type II anti-CD20 beat rituximab, and can B-cell recovery or autoantibody levels guide dosing?

DLBCL bispecifics could move into combinations and earlier lines; the pending glofitamab plus obinutuzumab readout (NCT03533283) will inform this. Patients who relapse CD20-negative after a bispecific are a possible niche for dual-target cell therapy.

Progressive MS is still unsolved. Ocrelizumab NCT03523858 and the ublituximab Phase 3s (NCT07211633, NCT05877963) will test whether anti-CD20 slows disability, not just relapses. No program tracked here targets B cells inside the CNS.

zh.why: CD22（Siglec-2）是B细胞特异的抑制性共受体，负调控B细胞受体信号。它在多数B-ALL和不少B细胞淋巴瘤上表达，抗体结合后快速内吞，适合做ADC，inotuzumab ozogamicin已获批用于复发B-ALL。CD19丢失后，CD22也是CAR-T最主要的替代靶点。
learned: 本站尚未收录CD22项目的读出或失败，临床记录仍很薄。第一个真正的检验是Cellectis异体UCART22的NCT04150497（B-ALL），主要完成日期登记为2026年9月，本站尚未收录其结果。
opps: 本站跟踪的9个项目中有7个是细胞治疗，多为国内自体CD19/CD22设计。异体（UCART22、UCART20x22）和体内CAR-T（UB-VV400）是差异化方向，NCT04150497将初步说明通用型CD22 CAR-T能否维持足够的持久性。
本站只跟踪到两个ADC项目，未见CD22 T细胞衔接双抗。AZD4512等新一代ADC能否把CD22从B-ALL拓展到B细胞淋巴瘤，CD22双抗是否可行，都还没有答案。
抗原密度下调导致逃逸是CD22 CAR-T的已知短板。可以检验两个假设：前瞻性按CD22位点密度筛选患者，或用能覆盖CD19/CD20丢失的双靶点设计，来区分可能应答的人群。

en.why: CD22 (Siglec-2) is an inhibitory co-receptor found only on B cells, where it dampens B-cell receptor signalling. It is expressed on most B-ALL and many B-cell lymphomas, and it is internalised quickly after antibody binding, which suits ADCs. Inotuzumab ozogamicin is approved in relapsed B-ALL. CD22 is also the main fallback CAR-T target when tumours lose CD19.
learned: No CD22 readouts or failures are tracked here yet, so the clinical record is still thin. The first real test is Cellectis's allogeneic UCART22 in B-ALL (NCT04150497). Its primary completion date is listed as September 2026, and results are not yet tracked here.
opps: Of the 9 programs tracked here, 7 are cell therapies, mostly autologous CD19/CD22 designs from Chinese groups. Allogeneic (UCART22, UCART20x22) and in vivo (UB-VV400) approaches are the differentiated niche. NCT04150497 should give a first look at whether off-the-shelf CD22 CAR-T persists long enough.
