Only two ADCs are tracked, and no CD22 T-cell engager. Two questions remain open: whether a newer ADC such as AZD4512 can take CD22 beyond B-ALL into B-cell lymphoma, and whether a CD22-directed bispecific is feasible.

Escape through lower CD22 antigen density is a known weakness of CD22 CAR-T. Two hypotheses could help pick out likely responders: selecting patients prospectively by CD22 site density, or using dual-target designs that cover CD19 or CD20 loss.

zh.why: CD3ε是T细胞受体复合物中恒定的信号亚基，结合它可以不依赖抗原特异性激活任意T细胞。把CD3与肿瘤抗原连接起来的双抗能引导T细胞杀伤肿瘤，blinatumomab在B细胞ALL中已验证这一思路。抗CD3单抗还能调节自身反应性T细胞，为自身免疫病提供了另一条路径。
learned: 不同适应症的结果出现分化。按新闻稿，elranatamab在抗CD38和来那度胺治疗后的复发骨髓瘤中达到III期PFS终点；epcoritamab在复发DLBCL中未达到OS终点（NCT04628494）。对照组为活性疗法时，OS比缓解率或PFS更难达到。
此处追踪到的提前终止大多出于策略考虑，并非机制失败。NCT05660967终止是因为已收集到足够数据，且未见新的安全性问题；Roche停止开发forimtamig（NCT06055075），同靶点的talquetamab已进入III期。
赛道高度集中：32个项目中21个是双抗，15个已到III期，仅骨髓瘤就有9个。近期多项读出为描述性或无统计检验（NCT04980222、NCT07226752），领先药物之间的头对头证据仍然很少。
opps: 在此处追踪的范围内，自身免疫方向布局很少：相关试验仅5项，肿瘤领域有161项，其中包括3个SLE项目和鼻用foralumab。一项针对继发进展型MS的CD3项目（NCT06292923）将检验黏膜给药的T细胞调节在进展期疾病中是否有效。
除tarlatamab和tebentafusp外，实体瘤仍有较大空间。值得验证的假设包括：用条件激活或遮蔽型CD3臂扩大治疗窗，以及联用共刺激分子，改善T细胞浸润不足肿瘤中的疗效。
DLBCL的OS失败提出了用药定位的问题：前移治疗线、联合化疗或按MRD决定固定疗程，可能比复发后单药更关键。NCT03533283会提供glofitamab在NHL中更长期的随访，补充疗效持久性的数据。

en.why: CD3ε is the invariant signalling subunit of the T-cell receptor complex. Binding it can activate any T cell, whatever antigen that T cell recognises. Bispecifics that link CD3 to a tumour antigen therefore redirect T cells to kill cancer cells, an approach blinatumomab validated in B-cell ALL. Anti-CD3 monoclonals can also dampen autoreactive T cells, which gives a separate route into autoimmune disease.
learned: Results differ by setting. According to a press release, elranatamab met its Phase 3 PFS endpoint in relapsed myeloma after anti-CD38 therapy and lenalidomide. Epcoritamab missed overall survival in relapsed DLBCL (NCT04628494). Against an active comparator, OS is a much harder endpoint to hit than response or PFS.

Most early stops tracked here were strategic, not failures of the mechanism. NCT05660967 ended because enough data had been collected, with no new safety findings. Roche dropped forimtamig (NCT06055075), whose same-target rival talquetamab is already in Phase 3.

The field is concentrated: 21 of 32 programs are bispecifics, 15 are in Phase 3, and myeloma alone has 9. Several recent readouts were descriptive or had no formal test (NCT04980222, NCT07226752), so there is still little head-to-head evidence among the leading drugs.
opps: Among trials tracked here, autoimmune disease has barely been explored: 5 trials versus 161 in oncology. These include 3 SLE programs and nasal foralumab. A CD3 program in secondary progressive MS (NCT06292923) should show whether T-cell modulation given through the mucosa has any effect in progressive disease.

Solid tumours remain largely open beyond tarlatamab and tebentafusp. Hypotheses to test: conditionally active or masked CD3 arms that could widen the therapeutic window, and co-stimulatory partners that could help in tumours with few T cells.

The OS miss in DLBCL raises a positioning question. Earlier lines, chemo combinations or MRD-guided fixed treatment duration may matter more than monotherapy at relapse. Longer glofitamab follow-up in NHL from NCT03533283 will add data on how durable responses are.

zh.why: CD30（TNFRSF8）在经典霍奇金淋巴瘤Reed-Sternberg细胞和间变性大细胞淋巴瘤中高表达，在其他淋巴瘤中表达不一，正常组织中主要见于活化淋巴细胞。分布局限使其适合靶向递送，ADC药物brentuximab vedotin已在上述淋巴瘤中获批多年。
learned: 此处跟踪的临床记录有限：唯一有正式检验的是ECHELON-3（NCT04404283），brentuximab vedotin在DLBCL中达到OS终点，把CD30靶向延伸到霍奇金以外；NCT05673785为描述性。未来六个月无到期试验，细胞治疗尚无读出。
opps: 此处跟踪的四个细胞治疗项目（Tessa两款CD30.CAR-T、Unicar CAR-T、EB-CAR30-NK）均处于1期或1/2期，尚无读出。活化T细胞表达CD30可能限制自体CAR-T扩增，异体CAR-NK能否规避这一问题，以及在brentuximab经治人群中的表现，仍待验证。
ECHELON-3（NCT04404283）打开了DLBCL适应症，而该病CD30表达异质性大。获益是否与CD30表达水平相关，能否推广到PTCL等表达不一的淋巴瘤，是现有记录尚未回答的患者筛选问题。
在此处跟踪的项目中，没有CD30双抗、NK细胞衔接器或非MMAE载荷的ADC，这类分子有望应对brentuximab后的耐药或神经毒性问题。适应症中出现胸腺癌，提示CD30阳性实体瘤是另一个基本空白的方向。

en.why: CD30 (TNFRSF8) is highly expressed on Reed-Sternberg cells of classical Hodgkin lymphoma and on anaplastic large cell lymphoma. Its expression varies in other lymphomas, and in normal tissue it is largely limited to activated lymphocytes. This narrow distribution makes it well suited to targeted payload delivery: the ADC brentuximab vedotin has been approved in these lymphomas for years.
learned: The record tracked here is thin. The only formal readout is ECHELON-3 (NCT04404283), where brentuximab vedotin met its overall survival endpoint in DLBCL, taking CD30 targeting beyond Hodgkin lymphoma. NCT05673785 is descriptive. No CD30 trials reach primary completion in the next six months, and no cell-therapy readouts are tracked yet.
opps: All four cell-therapy programs tracked here (Tessa's two CD30.CAR-T products, Unicar's CAR-T, EB-CAR30-NK) are at phase 1 or 1/2 with no readouts. Two questions are open: can allogeneic CAR-NK get around CD30 on activated T cells limiting autologous CAR-T expansion, and how do these products do after brentuximab?

ECHELON-3 (NCT04404283) opens up DLBCL, where CD30 expression varies widely. The tracked record does not yet show whether benefit depends on CD30 expression level, or whether it extends to other lymphomas with variable expression such as PTCL.

Among programs tracked here there are no CD30 bispecifics, no NK-cell engagers and no ADCs with non-MMAE payloads. These could address resistance or neuropathy after brentuximab. Thymic carcinoma appears among the listed conditions, which points to CD30-positive solid tumours as a second, largely untested area.

zh.why: CD33（Siglec-3）是髓系表面受体，在多数AML患者的原始细胞上表达，是该病验证最充分的靶点之一，ADC gemtuzumab ozogamicin已获批用于CD33阳性AML。但正常髓系祖细胞同样表达CD33，骨髓抑制是CAR细胞等强效疗法的主要限制。
learned: 本站追踪的CD33项目仅有两项处于1期（iCell Gene的抗CD33-CLL1 CAR-T与Senti的SENTI-202），尚无读出或失败记录，未来六个月也无主要完成节点，临床证据仍很薄。
opps: iCell Gene的CAR-T同时靶向CD33与CLL1。双抗原设计能否覆盖异质性AML、同时避免长期骨髓抑制是核心未决问题，目前尚无追踪到的读出数据可作回答。
本站追踪范围内暂无CD33 ADC、T细胞衔接器或放射性偶联物。将强效CD33疗法与敲除CD33的供者造血干细胞联用以保护移植物，或可使移植后维持治疗成为可能，值得验证。
患者筛选几乎空白：CD33表达密度及去除IgV结构域表位的rs12459419剪接变异可能预测获益人群；MDS仅出现在一个追踪项目的适应证中。

en.why: CD33 (Siglec-3) is a myeloid surface receptor found on leukemic blasts in most patients with AML, making it one of the best-validated antigens in the disease; the antibody-drug conjugate gemtuzumab ozogamicin is approved for CD33-positive AML. Because normal myeloid progenitors also express CD33, myelosuppression is the main limit for more potent modalities such as CAR cells.
learned: Among programs tracked here, CD33 has only two phase 1 programs (iCell Gene's anti-CD33-CLL1 CAR-T and Senti's SENTI-202), with no readouts or failures and no primary completions expected in the next six months, so the clinical record is still too thin to draw lessons.
opps: iCell Gene's CAR-T pairs CD33 with CLL1. Whether dual-antigen designs cover heterogeneous AML better without causing prolonged marrow aplasia is the core open question; no tracked readout answers it yet.

Among programs tracked here there are no CD33 ADCs, T-cell engagers or radioconjugates. Pairing potent CD33 agents with CD33-edited donor stem cells, so the graft is spared, is a hypothesis that could make post-transplant maintenance feasible.

Patient selection is largely unexplored: CD33 expression density and the rs12459419 splice variant, which removes the IgV-domain epitope, could predict who benefits. MDS appears in only one tracked program's indications.

zh.why: CD38是一种NAD水解外切酶，在骨髓瘤浆细胞以及产生致病性抗体的浆母细胞和长寿浆细胞上高表达。抗CD38单抗通过ADCC、CDC、吞噬和免疫调节清除这类细胞。daratumumab和isatuximab已确立其在多发性骨髓瘤中的地位，近年研发重点正延伸到抗体介导的自身免疫病和肾病。
learned: 目前临床记录仍然偏少：已追踪的两项读出均未做正式假设检验，NCT07217184为isatuximab剂量扩展期安全性数据，NCT01946477为daratumumab的ORR描述性结果，暂无失败或提前终止记录。首批真正的检验将是felzartamab在抗体介导排斥中的III期NCT06685757，以及isatuximab在浆细胞骨髓瘤中的III期NCT03319667。
opps: 在已追踪项目中，抗体介导疾病仍是空白较多的领域：AMR、PMN、IgAN、gMG和Graves病各仅有1-2个项目，主要来自felzartamab和mezagitamab。可以检验的假设是：以供体特异性抗体或抗PLA2R滴度筛选患者，能否更清楚地体现清除浆细胞的获益。
已追踪的17个项目中单抗占11个，ADC（STI-6129）和细胞治疗各仅1个。双抗、ADC或规避CD38阳性T细胞自相残杀的CAR-T设计，能否在单抗治疗后进展的骨髓瘤中带来增量获益，仍有待验证。
NCT06685757将首次在III期层面检验CD38单抗在骨髓瘤以外适应症的价值。若结果为阳性，自身免疫和移植领域会很快变得拥挤；后来者或需在给药途径、NK细胞清除带来的感染风险或长期缓解持久性上形成差异。

en.why: CD38 is an NAD-hydrolysing ectoenzyme expressed at high levels on myeloma plasma cells and on the plasmablasts and long-lived plasma cells that make pathogenic antibodies. Anti-CD38 antibodies clear these cells through ADCC, CDC, phagocytosis and immunomodulation. Daratumumab and isatuximab are established in multiple myeloma, and development is now moving into antibody-driven autoimmune and renal disease.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Both tracked readouts lacked a formal hypothesis test: NCT07217184 reported isatuximab dose-expansion safety, and NCT01946477 reported daratumumab ORR descriptively. No failures or early stops are recorded. The first real tests will be felzartamab's Phase 3 in antibody-mediated rejection (NCT06685757) and isatuximab's Phase 3 in plasma cell myeloma (NCT03319667).
opps: Among programs tracked here, antibody-mediated disease is still open. AMR, PMN, IgAN, gMG and Graves' disease each have only 1-2 programs, mostly felzartamab and mezagitamab. A testable hypothesis: selecting patients by donor-specific antibodies or anti-PLA2R titres could make the benefit of plasma-cell depletion easier to see.

Monoclonal antibodies make up 11 of the 17 tracked programs, with one ADC (STI-6129) and one cell therapy. It is unproven whether bispecifics, ADCs, or CAR-T designs that avoid fratricide of CD38-positive T cells add benefit in myeloma that progresses after antibody therapy.

NCT06685757 will be the first Phase 3 test of a CD38 antibody outside myeloma. A positive result would quickly crowd the autoimmune and transplant space, so later entrants may need to stand out on route of administration, infection risk from NK-cell depletion, or how long remissions last.

zh.why: CD39（ENTPD1）把胞外ATP/ADP水解为AMP，AMP再由CD73转化为腺苷，腺苷通过A2A受体抑制T细胞和NK细胞。CD39富集于Treg、耗竭CD8 T细胞和髓系细胞。阻断CD39可在两端同时起效，保留促炎ATP，减少腺苷生成。
learned: 目前临床证据仍很少：本站只追踪到一个CD39项目，即Elpiscience的未命名单抗，处于2期，适应症为实体瘤和硬纤维瘤。尚无读出，未来6个月内也没有试验到达主要完成日期。
opps: 免疫肿瘤药物很少做硬纤维瘤。硬纤维瘤间质中的CD39表达或腺苷信号能否预测获益，目前还没有答案，可以用肿瘤组织生物标志物研究来回答。
本站追踪的项目中还没有看到患者筛选策略。富集CD39+ CD8 T细胞浸润高的肿瘤，或与PD-1、CD73、A2A受体阻断联用，都可以用来检验CD39阻断能否在现有检查点抑制剂之上带来额外获益。
本站只追踪到单抗这一种形式。CD39与PD-1或CD73的双抗、小分子抑制剂，以及经CD39改造的细胞疗法，都是还没人走过的验证路径。

en.why: CD39 (ENTPD1) is the enzyme on the cell surface that breaks down extracellular ATP and ADP to AMP. CD73 then converts AMP to adenosine, which suppresses T and NK cells through A2A receptors. CD39 is concentrated on Tregs, exhausted CD8 T cells and myeloid cells. Blocking it works at both ends of the pathway: it keeps pro-inflammatory ATP around and cuts adenosine production.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Only one CD39 program is tracked here: an unnamed Elpiscience monoclonal antibody in phase 2 for solid tumors and desmoid tumor. It has no readouts yet, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term test is in sight.
opps: Desmoid tumor is an unusual indication for an immuno-oncology antibody. Nobody knows yet whether CD39 expression or adenosine signalling in desmoid stroma predicts benefit. Biomarker studies on tumor tissue could answer that.

None of the programs tracked here use patient selection. Two testable hypotheses: enrich for tumors with dense CD39+ CD8 T-cell infiltrates, or combine with PD-1, CD73 or A2A receptor blockade, to see whether CD39 blockade adds benefit on top of existing checkpoint inhibitors.

The only format tracked here is a monoclonal antibody. Bispecifics pairing CD39 with PD-1 or CD73, small-molecule inhibitors, and cell therapies engineered at CD39 would each be a separate, untried way to test the target.

zh.why: CD40是TNF受体家族成员，表达于树突状细胞、B细胞和巨噬细胞，与活化T细胞上的CD40L结合后，促使抗原提呈细胞成熟，进而启动CD8 T细胞应答。激动CD40有望把免疫“冷”肿瘤转为“热”肿瘤，阻断CD40–CD40L则可抑制过度的炎症和自身免疫反应。
learned: 临床证据仍很少：此处追踪的4个项目均未超过2期，没有读出，没有失败或提前终止记录，未来六个月也没有试验到达主要完成日，近期没有可检验该机制的节点。
opps: 此处追踪的项目以肿瘤为主（黑色素瘤、软组织肉瘤、转移性胰腺导管腺癌、实体瘤），另有一项覆盖脓毒症/社区获得性肺炎；自身免疫和移植方向的CD40拮抗在此处尚无项目，值得评估。
两款单抗之外还有小分子TQB2916和多肽OPT101。一个待验证的问题是：非抗体分子能否实现激动所需的受体聚集，或带来不同于全身给药抗体的暴露特征和耐受性。
目前没有项目体现生物标志物分层或肿瘤局部递送。按髓系细胞浸润、树突状细胞密度筛选患者，或采用局部激活设计，可能是与早期单抗拉开差异的方向。

en.why: CD40 is a TNF-receptor family member on dendritic cells, B cells and macrophages. When CD40L on activated T cells binds it, antigen-presenting cells mature and prime CD8 T-cell responses. Agonizing CD40 could turn immunologically cold tumors hot, while blocking CD40–CD40L can damp excess inflammation and autoimmunity.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. All four programs tracked here are at Phase 2 or earlier, with no readouts and no failures or early stops. No trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so nothing scheduled will test the mechanism soon.
opps: The programs tracked here are mostly in cancer (melanoma, soft tissue sarcoma, metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, solid tumors), plus one covering sepsis and community-acquired pneumonia. No program tracked here addresses CD40 antagonism in autoimmunity or transplant, which may be worth assessing.

Besides two antibodies, the field includes the small molecule TQB2916 and the peptide OPT101. An open question is whether non-antibody agents can cluster the receptor enough to agonize it, or give exposure and tolerability that differ from systemic antibodies.

No tracked program shows biomarker-based selection or delivery confined to the tumor. Selecting patients by myeloid infiltrate or dendritic-cell density, or activating CD40 only locally, could be ways to stand apart from the early antibodies.

zh.why: CD40L（CD154）表达于活化CD4+ T细胞，与B细胞和树突状细胞上的CD40结合，驱动生发中心反应、类别转换和自身抗体产生。CD40L缺陷导致X连锁高IgM综合征，从遗传上证实它是T细胞辅助B细胞的关键节点，因此适用于自身免疫病和移植排斥。
learned: 血小板也表达CD40L，血栓风险一直是该靶点类别的主要顾虑，现有分子多去除或沉默Fc。dazodalibep在OASIZ 301中未见血栓栓塞或机会性感染失衡，为这一设计提供了首个III期安全性证据。
本站追踪范围内首个III期成功出现在干燥综合征：Amgen新闻稿报告dazodalibep达到主要终点，第4周即起效。B细胞驱动的疾病与该机制契合，但公司未公布效应量，难以与其他药物横向比较。
移植领域，Eledon的tegoprubart在II期BESTOW中对比他克莫司，肾功能和生活质量呈积极信号，提示CD40L阻断有望替代钙调磷酸酶抑制剂，但目前仅有II期新闻稿数据。
本站尚未追踪到该靶点的失败或提前终止，阳性记录几乎全部来自干燥综合征和移植；SLE、MS尚无结果，现有结论不宜外推到其他适应症。
opps: SLE机制最直接但尚无结果：SAR441344的II期NCT05039840已过主要完成日期，UCB的dapirolizumab pegol处于III期。按自身抗体谱或干扰素特征分层，可能是区分疗效的关键。
frexalimab的MS III期NCT06141473将检验CD40L阻断在中枢神经疾病中能否与B细胞清除疗法拉开差距；本站追踪的MS项目仅2个，结果将决定神经免疫方向是否成立。
本站追踪的项目中，1型糖尿病、FSGS和微小病变肾病各仅1个，形式也只有单抗和1个融合蛋白；同时阻断CD40L与BAFF/APRIL等B细胞通路的双特异分子仍属空白。

en.why: CD40L (CD154) on activated CD4+ T cells binds CD40 on B cells and dendritic cells, driving germinal-center reactions, class switching and autoantibody production. Loss of CD40L causes X-linked hyper-IgM syndrome, genetic proof that it is a key node of T-cell help to B cells. That makes it a target in autoimmunity and transplant rejection.
learned: Platelets also express CD40L, so thrombosis has been the class's main concern, and current molecules remove or silence Fc. In OASIZ 301, dazodalibep showed no imbalance in thromboembolic events or opportunistic infections, the first Phase 3 safety support for this design.

Among trials tracked here, the first Phase 3 win came in Sjögren's: Amgen press releases report dazodalibep met its primary endpoint, with onset by week 4. A B-cell-driven disease fits the mechanism, but Amgen has not disclosed effect sizes, so comparison with other drugs is not possible.

In transplant, Eledon's tegoprubart showed positive kidney-function and quality-of-life signals against tacrolimus in the Phase 2 BESTOW trial. That suggests CD40L blockade could replace calcineurin inhibitors, but so far the data are Phase 2 press-release results only.

No failures or early stops are tracked here for this target, and nearly all positive data come from Sjögren's and transplant. SLE and MS have no results yet, so current conclusions should not be applied to other indications.
opps: SLE is the most direct mechanistic fit but still has no result. SAR441344's Phase 2 NCT05039840 has passed primary completion, and UCB's dapirolizumab pegol is in Phase 3. Selecting patients by autoantibody profile or interferon signature may decide whether efficacy shows.

Frexalimab's Phase 3 MS trial NCT06141473 will test whether CD40L blockade can stand apart from B-cell depletion in CNS disease. With only two MS programs tracked here, it will show whether neuroimmunology is a real path for this target.

Among programs tracked here, type 1 diabetes, FSGS and minimal change disease have one program each, and the only formats are antibodies plus one fusion protein. Bispecifics that block CD40L together with B-cell pathways such as BAFF/APRIL remain untried.

zh.why: CD47广泛表达于肿瘤细胞，通过结合巨噬细胞上的SIRPα发出“别吃我”信号，抑制吞噬作用。阻断该通路可释放先天免疫对肿瘤的清除，并有望与促调理作用的抗体协同。由于红细胞也表达CD47，贫血风险推动了SIRPα融合蛋白、红细胞豁免型抗体等差异化设计。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍较少：NCT03869190（含ONO-7913）因商业原因提前关闭且无正式统计检验，不能据此否定机制；evorpacept的ASPEN-06二期新闻判定为达到。首个随机三期检验将是AK117在头颈鳞癌的NCT06601335，预计2027年1月达到主要完成。
opps: NCT06601335将首次在随机三期中检验CD47阻断能否在头颈鳞癌带来增益，其结果有望决定AK117在该适应症及结直肠癌等实体瘤中的拓展路径。
ADC与偶联药物（Daiichi Sankyo）及ImmuneOncia项目仍处一期，可检验靶向递送或新型结构能否在保留吞噬增益的同时降低红细胞相关毒性。
在本站追踪项目中，MDS、AML、广泛期小细胞肺癌和三阴性乳腺癌各仅一个项目；可探索以肿瘤CD47/SIRPα表达或巨噬细胞浸润作为入组生物标志物。

en.why: CD47 is overexpressed on tumor cells and binds SIRPα on macrophages, sending a "don't eat me" signal that suppresses phagocytosis. Blocking it unleashes innate clearance of tumor cells and may synergize with opsonizing antibodies. Because red blood cells also carry CD47, anemia risk has driven differentiated designs such as SIRPα fusion proteins and RBC-sparing antibodies.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. NCT03869190 (including ONO-7913) closed early for business reasons with no formal test, so it says nothing against the mechanism, and evorpacept's ASPEN-06 phase 2 was reported as met. The first randomized phase 3 test is AK117's NCT06601335 in head and neck cancer, completing January 2027.
opps: NCT06601335 will be the first randomized phase 3 test of whether CD47 blockade adds benefit in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Its result will likely shape how AK117 expands into other solid tumors such as colorectal cancer.

The ADC/conjugate program (Daiichi Sankyo) and ImmuneOncia's asset are still in phase 1. They could test whether targeted delivery or new formats keep the phagocytosis benefit while reducing red-cell toxicity.

Among programs tracked here, MDS, AML, extensive-stage SCLC and triple-negative breast cancer each have just one program. Tumor CD47/SIRPα expression or macrophage infiltration could be tried as enrollment biomarkers.

zh.why: CD7高表达于多数T-ALL/LBL原始细胞，也见于正常T细胞和NK细胞。复发/难治T系淋巴母细胞肿瘤治疗选择有限，CD7是少数可行靶点。CAR-T需敲除或阻断自身CD7表达以避免自相残杀，并存在T细胞长期缺失风险。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍很有限：3家公司的4个细胞治疗项目均集中于T-ALL/LBL，最高仅至2期，尚无读出记录，未来6个月也没有试验到达主要完成日期。
opps: 所追踪项目全部集中于T-ALL/LBL。CD7也表达于部分AML及部分成熟T/NK细胞淋巴瘤，在本站追踪范围内，这些适应症尚无项目探索。
所追踪项目均为细胞治疗。靶向CD7的ADC或CAR-NK可省去防自相残杀的工程改造，但正常T细胞被清除带来的免疫缺陷仍是核心安全性问题。
首批读出值得关注：缓解能否持久、CD7阴性复发的比例，以及CD7 CAR-T更适合作为异基因移植的桥接还是独立治疗。监测CD7表达密度和T细胞恢复情况可能有助于患者筛选。

en.why: CD7 is found on most T-ALL and T-lymphoblastic lymphoma blasts, and also on normal T and NK cells. Relapsed or refractory T-lymphoblastic disease has few effective options, and CD7 is one of the few workable targets. CD7 CAR-T cells would attack each other (fratricide), so their own CD7 must be knocked out or blocked. Prolonged loss of normal T cells is a known risk.
learned: Among programs tracked here, the clinical record is still thin. Three companies run four cell-therapy programs, all in T-ALL/LBL and none past Phase 2. No readouts are logged, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months.
opps: Every tracked program is in T-ALL/LBL. CD7 is also expressed on a subset of AML and on some mature T- and NK-cell lymphomas. Among programs tracked here, none has entered these indications.

Every tracked program is a cell therapy. CD7-directed ADCs or CAR-NK products would not need the engineering that prevents fratricide. Immune deficiency from depleting normal T cells would still be the main safety question.

Open questions for the first readouts: how durable remissions are, how often CD7-negative relapse occurs, and whether CD7 CAR-T works best as a bridge to allogeneic transplant or on its own. Measuring CD7 antigen density and T-cell recovery could help select patients.

zh.why: CD70为CD27的TNF家族配体，正常仅见于活化淋巴细胞，但在透明细胞肾癌（VHL缺失、HIF驱动）和AML原始细胞及白血病干细胞上高表达，是肿瘤选择性靶点；它也标记活化的自身反应性T、B细胞，因而被拓展至狼疮等自身免疫病。
learned: 临床证据仍很有限：本站暂无读出或失败记录，未来六个月也无试验到达主要完成；10个项目均在1–2期，8个为细胞治疗，最快的是OncoVerity单抗cusatuzumab（2期）。
opps: 本站跟踪的10个项目中8个为细胞治疗，尚无ADC或T细胞衔接器；CD70在透明细胞肾癌中表达广泛，这类形式可绕开CAR-T自相残杀（活化T细胞也表达CD70）来验证靶点。
本站跟踪3项自身免疫试验（SLE、肌炎、幼年皮肌炎、多关节型JIA）。清除CD70+活化淋巴细胞能否补充B细胞靶向疗法仍无答案，狼疮中升高的CD70+ T细胞或可用于患者筛选。
AML在本站仅有1个项目。去甲基化药物可上调原始细胞CD70表达，为联合用药和靶向白血病干细胞提供依据；治疗前后检测CD70密度或有助于患者筛选和剂量设定。

en.why: CD70, the TNF-family ligand for CD27, is normally found only on activated lymphocytes. It is overexpressed in clear cell renal cell carcinoma (driven by VHL loss and HIF) and on AML blasts and leukaemic stem cells, which makes it a tumour-selective target. Because it also marks activated autoreactive T and B cells, it is being extended to lupus and other autoimmune diseases.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. No readouts or failures are tracked here, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months. All 10 programs are in phase 1–2, 8 of them cell therapies. The most advanced is OncoVerity's antibody cusatuzumab (phase 2).
opps: Of the 10 tracked programs, 8 are cell therapies, one is an antibody, and none is an ADC or T-cell engager. CD70 is broadly expressed in ccRCC, so those formats could test the target without CAR-T fratricide (activated T cells also express CD70).

Three tracked trials are in autoimmune disease (SLE, myositis, juvenile dermatomyositis, polyarticular JIA). Whether depleting CD70+ activated lymphocytes adds anything to B-cell-directed therapy is still open. CD70+ T cells are elevated in lupus and could be used to select patients.

AML has only one program among those tracked. Hypomethylating agents raise CD70 on blasts, which supports combination regimens and targeting leukaemic stem cells. Measuring CD70 density before and after treatment could help with patient selection and dosing.

zh.why: CD73（NT5E）把细胞外AMP水解为腺苷，腺苷经A2A/A2B受体抑制T细胞和NK细胞功能。CD73在多种实体瘤及基质中高表达，与预后不良相关。化疗和放疗释放的ATP会进一步推高腺苷水平，因此阻断CD73被视为增强PD-1抑制剂和化疗疗效的思路。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍然很少：8个项目均无读出，也没有失败记录，未来6个月内没有试验达到主要完成。进展最快的是Arcus处于3期的小分子，其结果将是该机制首次真正的检验。
opps: 本站追踪的项目以单抗（5个）和双抗（2个）为主，小分子只有1个。可以研究小分子在瘤内渗透、抑制可溶性CD73方面是否优于抗体，以及酶活抑制完全程度与疗效的关系。
适应症集中在泛实体瘤、胰腺导管腺癌和NSCLC，结直肠癌仅1个项目。可以探索按CD73表达或腺苷相关基因特征筛选患者，验证生物标志物能否帮助富集获益人群。
机制上，CD73阻断与释放ATP的化疗、放疗联用，或与CD39、A2AR抑制剂联用，有望更彻底地压低腺苷信号。胰腺癌3期结果将初步回答联用策略是否成立。

en.why: CD73 (NT5E) converts extracellular AMP into adenosine, which acts through A2A/A2B receptors to suppress T and NK cells. CD73 is highly expressed in many solid tumors and their stroma and is linked to poor prognosis. Chemotherapy and radiation release ATP, which raises adenosine further. Blocking CD73 is therefore a rationale for strengthening PD-1 blockade and chemotherapy.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin: none of the 8 programs has a readout, there are no recorded failures, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months. The most advanced program, Arcus's Phase 3 small molecule, will be the first real test of the mechanism.
opps: Tracked programs are mostly antibodies (5 mAbs, 2 bispecifics), with one small molecule. A hypothesis to test: do small molecules penetrate tumors better and block soluble CD73 more fully than antibodies, and does more complete enzyme blockade translate into efficacy?

Indications cluster in solid tumors broadly, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and NSCLC, with one colorectal program. Selecting patients by CD73 expression or an adenosine gene signature could show whether a biomarker identifies the patients who benefit.

Biologically, pairing CD73 blockade with ATP-releasing chemotherapy or radiation, or with CD39 or A2AR inhibitors, could suppress adenosine signaling more fully. The pancreatic Phase 3 will give a first answer on whether combination strategies hold up.

zh.why: CDC7与DBF4组成DDK激酶，磷酸化MCM2-7解旋酶以启动复制起点放电，是DNA复制起始的关键开关。肿瘤细胞复制压力高、高度依赖CDC7，抑制后易发生复制灾难和凋亡，正常细胞多为可逆停滞，因此被视为具有治疗窗口的周期靶点。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：本站目前仅追踪到Lin公司一个未命名的1/2期项目，适应症为复发或难治性急性白血病，尚无读出、失败记录，未来6个月内也没有到达主要完成日的试验，该试验结果将是首个真正检验。
opps: 本站追踪的项目只覆盖急性白血病，复制压力高的实体瘤（如TP53突变或MYC驱动肿瘤）尚无项目，可作为检验CDC7依赖性的候选人群。
可探索以复制压力相关标志物（如MCM2磷酸化、TP53状态）进行患者筛选，以区分可能获益的亚群。
与DNA损伤类化疗、ATR抑制剂或白血病标准方案联用是否存在协同，以及降解剂等其他分子形式，在本站追踪范围内均未见验证。

en.why: CDC7 pairs with DBF4 to form DDK, which phosphorylates the MCM2-7 helicase to fire replication origins, a key switch for starting DNA replication. Cancer cells under high replication stress depend on it and tend to die when it is inhibited, while normal cells mostly pause reversibly. That suggests a usable therapeutic window for a cell-cycle target.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Among programs tracked here, the only one is an unnamed Phase 1/2 program from Lin in relapsed or refractory acute leukaemias. There are no readouts, no failures, and no trials reaching primary completion in the next six months. That trial's results will be the first real test.
opps: The only program tracked here is in acute leukaemias. Solid tumours with high replication stress, such as TP53-mutant or MYC-driven cancers, have no tracked programs and could test how far CDC7 dependence extends.
Replication-stress biomarkers such as MCM2 phosphorylation or TP53 status could be tested as a way to pick the patients most likely to respond.

Whether CDC7 inhibitors work better alongside DNA-damaging chemotherapy, ATR inhibitors or standard leukaemia regimens is untested among tracked programs. The same goes for other modalities such as degraders.

zh.why: CDH17（肝肠钙黏蛋白）是肠上皮黏附分子，在多数结直肠癌及部分胃癌、胃肠神经内分泌肿瘤中高表达，适合作为ADC、CAR-T等疗法的表面靶点。核心顾虑是正常肠道的脱肿瘤毒性，不过它在正常组织中多位于细胞间连接处，药物可能较难接触到。
learned: 临床证据仍很薄：4个项目均处早期，尚无注册试验读出。唯一信号是ArriVent在ESMO 2026公布的ADC ARR-217初步I期数据，未来六个月也没有追踪中的试验到达主要完成。
opps: 本站追踪的项目中，结直肠癌有3个，胃肠神经内分泌肿瘤和胃癌各只有1个。CDH17阳性NET以及胰腺癌等其他表达CDH17的消化道肿瘤，可作为竞争较少的探索方向。
追踪项目以抗体类（含ADC ARR-217）和CAR-T（CHM-2101）为主，未见T细胞衔接器或联合方案。双抗、ADC联合标准化疗或免疫治疗都是待验证的假设，前提是肠道耐受性可接受。
核心未决问题是正常肠上皮能否不受损伤。如果ARR-217和CHM-2101的完整剂量递增数据能把消化道毒性和疗效与CDH17表达水平对照，就能判断按表达筛选患者是否可以拓宽治疗窗。

en.why: CDH17 (liver-intestine cadherin) is an adhesion protein of the intestinal lining. It stays highly expressed in most colorectal cancers and in many gastric cancers and gastrointestinal neuroendocrine tumours, which makes it a candidate surface target for ADCs, CAR-T and similar therapies. The main worry is damage to normal gut. In healthy tissue it sits mostly at junctions between cells, where drugs may have trouble reaching it.
learned: The clinical record is still thin: four early programs and no registry readouts. The only signal is ArriVent's initial Phase 1 data for the ADC ARR-217 in GI cancers (press release, ESMO 2026). No tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months.
opps: Among programs tracked here, three address colorectal cancer, while GI neuroendocrine tumours and gastric cancer have one each. CDH17-positive NETs and other CDH17-expressing GI tumours, such as pancreatic cancer, could be tested as less crowded settings.

Tracked programs are antibody-based (including the ADC ARR-217) or CAR-T (CHM-2101). None is a T-cell engager or a combination regimen. A bispecific, or an ADC paired with standard chemotherapy or immunotherapy, is an open hypothesis if the gut tolerates it.

The key open question is whether normal intestinal lining is spared. Full dose-escalation data from ARR-217 and CHM-2101 that compare GI toxicity and response with CDH17 expression levels would show whether selecting patients by expression widens the therapeutic window.

zh.why: CDH6（K-cadherin）是一种II型钙黏蛋白，主要在胚胎肾脏表达，成人正常组织中表达有限，但在卵巢浆液性癌、肾细胞癌等肿瘤中高表达，并能被内吞。肿瘤与正常组织表达差异大，加上内吞特性，使其适合作为ADC等表面抗原靶向疗法的靶点。
learned: 临床记录尚少：本站尚未收录任何CDH6项目的读出或失败。三项3期项目都集中在Daiichi Sankyo/MSD的raludotatug deruxtecan（R-DXd）。首个实质检验将是胃肠道肿瘤2期试验NCT06864169，登记的主要完成日期为2026-08-18，本站尚未收录其结果。
opps: 在本站追踪的项目中，适应症以卵巢癌和泛实体瘤为主，尚无专门针对肾细胞癌的项目。考虑到CDH6在肾癌中的表达，这一适应症值得验证。
本站追踪的项目中尚无双抗、CAR-T或放射性偶联药物。Hansoh、Qilu、Phrontline等后来者可以尝试从不同载荷、连接子或其他模式切入，与DXd类ADC形成区隔。
疗效是否取决于CDH6表达水平，目前仍无答案。NCT06864169的结果有望初步说明，卵巢癌之外的低表达瘤种能否获益，以及是否需要按表达水平筛选患者。

en.why: CDH6 (K-cadherin) is a type II cadherin expressed mainly in fetal kidney. Adult normal tissues express little of it, but serous ovarian cancer, renal cell carcinoma and other tumours overexpress it, and it internalises. That gap between tumour and normal tissue, plus internalisation, makes it a good fit for ADCs and other therapies that target surface antigens.
learned: The clinical record is still thin: this site has no tracked CDH6 readouts or failures yet. All three Phase 3 programs centre on Daiichi Sankyo/MSD's raludotatug deruxtecan (R-DXd). The first real test is the Phase 2 gastrointestinal cancer trial NCT06864169. Its listed primary completion date is 2026-08-18, and this site has not tracked results yet.
opps: Among programs tracked here, ovarian and broad solid-tumour indications dominate, and no program focuses on renal cell carcinoma. Given that CDH6 is expressed in kidney cancer, that indication looks worth testing.

None of the programs tracked here is a bispecific, CAR-T or radioconjugate. Later entrants such as Hansoh, Qilu and Phrontline could set themselves apart from DXd-based ADCs with a different payload, linker or modality.

Whether efficacy depends on how much CDH6 a tumour expresses is still unknown. NCT06864169 may give a first signal on whether lower-expressing tumours outside ovarian cancer respond, and whether patients need to be selected by expression level.

zh.why: CDK2与cyclin E结合，推动细胞由G1期进入S期。CCNE1扩增驱动部分肿瘤，如高级别浆液性卵巢癌；HR+乳腺癌对CDK4/6抑制剂耐药时，cyclin E–CDK2活性是公认的逃逸旁路之一。如何做到对CDK1的选择性，一直是该靶点化学优化的难点。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：本站追踪的12个项目尚无读出、失败或提前终止记录，未来6个月也没有达到主要完成的试验。进度最快的是CTTQ的TQB3616（3期）和Pfizer的PF-07104091（2期）。
opps: 追踪项目多以晚期实体瘤或乳腺癌入组，卵巢癌/HGSOC与SCLC各仅1项。按CCNE1扩增筛选患者，并纳入胃癌、子宫内膜癌等瘤种，或可更清晰地检验机制。
12个项目中只有NiKang的NKT5097是降解剂。与小分子抑制剂相比，降解策略能否进一步提高对CDK1的选择性、改善血液学耐受性，仍待回答。
乳腺癌是最拥挤的方向，追踪项目中相关适应症条目共7项。差异化可能不在全人群入组，而在CDK4/6抑制剂进展后按cyclin E高表达或RB完整等生物标志物分层。

en.why: CDK2 pairs with cyclin E to push cells from G1 into S phase. CCNE1 amplification drives a subset of tumors, such as high-grade serous ovarian cancer. When HR+ breast cancer becomes resistant to CDK4/6 inhibitors, cyclin E–CDK2 activity is a recognized escape route. Getting selectivity over CDK1 has long been the main chemistry hurdle.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. None of the 12 programs tracked here has a readout, failure or early stop on file, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months. The furthest along are CTTQ's TQB3616 (phase 3) and Pfizer's PF-07104091 (phase 2).
opps: Most tracked programs enroll broad advanced solid tumors or breast cancer. Ovarian/HGSOC and SCLC have one program each. Selecting patients by CCNE1 amplification, including tumor types such as gastric or endometrial cancer, could test the mechanism more cleanly.

Only one of the 12 programs, NiKang's NKT5097, is a degrader. Whether degradation can improve selectivity over CDK1 and blood-related tolerability compared with small-molecule inhibitors is still an open question.

Breast cancer is the most crowded setting, with 7 condition entries among tracked programs. Instead of enrolling all comers, programs might stand out by selecting patients after CDK4/6 inhibitor progression using biomarkers such as high cyclin E expression or intact RB.

zh.why: CDK4/6与cyclin D结合后磷酸化RB、释放E2F，推动细胞从G1期进入S期。雌激素信号上调cyclin D1，HR+/HER2-乳腺癌因此高度依赖该通路，palbociclib、ribociclib、abemaciclib联合内分泌治疗已是一线标准。RB缺失和cyclin E–CDK2激活是主要耐药机制。
learned: 本站收录的3项提前终止试验（NCT05935748、NCT05573555、NCT05358249）都是已上市CDK4/6抑制剂联用新机制药物（HIF-2α、ER降解剂、KRAS G12C），均因管线调整停止。NCT05573555虽标注为疗效原因，但申办方明确说明与疗效无关。
研发重心正转向CDK4选择性抑制剂。在本站收录的选择性项目中，atirmociclib进展最快，已到3期；其早期试验（NCT06206837、NCT06465368）以DLT、ORR和第14天完全细胞周期阻滞为描述性终点，尚无正式疗效比较。
乳腺癌以外的读出只有剂量探索或描述性数据，包括尤文肉瘤（NCT03709680）和ccRCC（NCT05935748），都没有做假设检验。虽有3个项目布局mCRPC，但在本站记录中，向其他瘤种拓展仍未得到验证。
生物标志物研究在推进：BioItaLEE（NCT03439046）把PFS与C1D15时ctDNA的早期动态变化挂钩，数据足够后提前结束；NCT03671330按绝经状态分队列报告PFS。两者都是描述性结果，不能算达到或未达到。
opps: 可检验的假设：避开CDK6能否拓宽治疗窗，从而实现更充分的靶点覆盖。NCT06465368采用的第14天完全细胞周期阻滞可作为早期决策指标，但仍需与第一代药物做随机对照。
CDK4/6治疗进展后的人群仍是空白。本站仅收录1个降解剂（NiKang的NKT5097，靶向CDK2），cyclin E高表达肿瘤中联合CDK2，以及CDK4/6降解剂，探索都还很少。
未来6个月只有1项读出：3期palbociclib乳腺癌试验NCT05909397，主要完成日期为2026-12-30。乳腺癌以外，可按RB状态或CCND1扩增筛选患者，检验mCRPC和肉瘤中的获益是否真实。

en.why: CDK4 and CDK6 bind cyclin D and phosphorylate RB. This releases E2F and moves cells from G1 into S phase. Estrogen signalling drives cyclin D1, so HR+/HER2- breast cancer depends heavily on this pathway, and palbociclib, ribociclib or abemaciclib plus endocrine therapy is standard first-line care. RB loss and cyclin E–CDK2 activation are the main resistance routes.
learned: The three early stops tracked here (NCT05935748, NCT05573555, NCT05358249) all combined an approved CDK4/6 inhibitor with a new partner (HIF-2α, an ER degrader, KRAS G12C). All were ended for portfolio reasons. NCT05573555 carries an efficacy code, but the sponsor says the stop was unrelated to efficacy.

Development is moving toward CDK4-selective agents. Among selective programs tracked here, atirmociclib is furthest along, at phase 3. Its earlier trials (NCT06206837, NCT06465368) used DLTs, response rate and complete cell-cycle arrest at day 14 as descriptive endpoints, so no formal efficacy comparison exists yet.

Outside breast cancer, the readouts are dose-finding or descriptive only: Ewing sarcoma (NCT03709680) and ccRCC (NCT05935748). Neither tested a hypothesis. Three programs list mCRPC, but in this record, extension to other cancers is still unproven.

Biomarker work is advancing. BioItaLEE (NCT03439046) linked PFS to early ctDNA changes at cycle 1 day 15 and ended early once it had enough data. NCT03671330 reported PFS by menopausal cohort. Both are descriptive, so neither counts as a hit or a miss.
opps: Hypothesis to test: sparing CDK6 widens the therapeutic window enough to allow fuller target coverage. Complete cell-cycle arrest at day 14, the endpoint used in NCT06465368, could serve as an early go/no-go marker, but randomized comparisons with first-generation agents are still needed.

Patients who progress after CDK4/6 therapy remain largely unaddressed. Only one degrader is tracked here (NiKang's NKT5097, which targets CDK2), so adding CDK2 inhibition in cyclin E-high tumors, and CDK4/6 degraders, are both little explored.

Only one readout is due in the next six months: NCT05909397, a phase 3 palbociclib breast cancer trial with primary completion on 2026-12-30. Outside breast cancer, selecting patients by RB status or CCND1 amplification could test whether benefit in mCRPC or sarcoma is real.

zh.why: CDK7与cyclin H、MAT1组成CAK复合物，激活CDK1/2/4/6；它也是TFIIH的组成部分，通过磷酸化RNA Pol II启动转录。依赖super-enhancer驱动癌基因（如MYC）或ER信号的肿瘤对其更敏感，因此CDK7可同时作用于细胞周期和转录两条依赖通路。
learned: 临床证据仍很薄弱。samuraciclib的NCT03363893以安全性为主要终点，未做正式统计检验；与vepdegestrant联用的NCT06125522入组11例后因战略原因关闭。该试验虽标为疗效失败，但终止原因注明与疗效、安全性无关。未来6个月没有可追踪的读出。
opps: CDK7抑制联合ER降解剂用于HR+乳腺癌的问题仍未回答，因为NCT06125522提前关闭。在CDK4/6抑制剂耐药人群中检验这一组合，仍是一个尚未验证的假设。
本站追踪的项目都按广谱实体瘤或乳腺癌入组。可以考虑以MYC扩增、super-enhancer依赖等转录成瘾特征来筛选患者，用于小细胞肺癌、TNBC或卵巢癌等瘤种。
本站追踪的项目中，已知形式只有小分子。CDK7参与正常组织的全局转录，选择性降解剂或间歇给药方案能否拓宽治疗窗，值得探索。

en.why: CDK7 forms the CDK-activating kinase with cyclin H and MAT1, switching on CDK1/2/4/6. As part of TFIIH it also phosphorylates RNA Pol II to start transcription. Tumors that depend on super-enhancer-driven oncogenes such as MYC, or on ER signaling, are more sensitive to its loss, so CDK7 hits cell-cycle and transcriptional dependencies at the same time.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The samuraciclib trial NCT03363893 had a safety primary endpoint and no formal statistical test. The vepdegestrant combination trial NCT06125522 closed after 11 patients for strategic reasons. It is coded as an efficacy failure, but its stop reason says the decision was not related to efficacy or safety. No readouts tracked here are due in the next six months.
opps: Because NCT06125522 closed early, nobody has answered whether CDK7 inhibition adds benefit to an ER degrader in HR+ breast cancer. Testing it in patients resistant to CDK4/6 inhibitors remains an untested hypothesis.

Programs tracked here enroll broad solid tumors or breast cancer. Selecting patients by transcriptional addiction (MYC amplification, super-enhancer dependence) in SCLC, TNBC or ovarian cancer could be explored.

Among programs tracked here, the only known modality is small molecules. CDK7 also drives transcription in normal tissue, so it is worth testing whether selective degraders or intermittent dosing widen the therapeutic window.

zh.why: CDK9是P-TEFb复合物的催化亚基，通过磷酸化RNA聚合酶II促进转录延伸。MCL1、MYC等半衰期短的致癌转录本高度依赖CDK9，因此血液肿瘤等转录成瘾型肿瘤可能对其敏感。早期泛CDK抑制剂受毒性限制，选择性CDK9抑制剂意在拉开治疗窗。
learned: 临床证据仍然很少。本站目前仅追踪到GFH009（Genfleet）和SLS009（Sellas）两个1/2期项目，都集中在大B细胞淋巴瘤和血液肿瘤，尚无已判定的读出，未来6个月内也没有到达主要完成日期的试验，近期缺少可检验该机制的节点。
opps: 本站追踪的项目只覆盖血液肿瘤。MYC扩增或依赖MCL1的实体瘤尚未见到选择性CDK9项目，可作为待验证的适应症假设。
在追踪范围内，有明确记录的只有一个小分子项目。CDK9降解剂等新型分子尚未出现，可以检验它们能否减轻抑制后的转录代偿，并改善间歇给药下的耐受性。
用MCL1/MYC依赖性生物标志物筛选患者，或与venetoclax等BCL2抑制剂联用来同时阻断抗凋亡通路，是区分早期项目的可行方向。

en.why: CDK9 is the catalytic subunit of P-TEFb. It phosphorylates RNA polymerase II so that transcription can proceed past the start of a gene. Short-lived oncogenic transcripts such as MCL1 and MYC depend heavily on it, so cancers addicted to transcription, including blood cancers, may be vulnerable. Toxicity held back earlier pan-CDK inhibitors, and selective CDK9 inhibitors aim for a wider therapeutic window.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site tracks two phase 1/2 programs, GFH009 (Genfleet) and SLS009 (Sellas), both in large B-cell lymphoma and hematologic malignancies. Neither has a judged readout, and no tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term test of the mechanism is in view.
opps: The tracked programs cover only blood cancers. Solid tumors with MYC amplification or MCL1 dependence have no selective CDK9 program here, which leaves an indication hypothesis to test.

Only one tracked program is clearly a small molecule. CDK9 degraders and other new modalities do not appear yet. They could be tested for whether they blunt the transcriptional rebound after inhibition and are better tolerated on intermittent dosing.
Two ways an early program could set itself apart: selecting patients with MCL1/MYC dependency biomarkers, or combining with a BCL2 inhibitor such as venetoclax to block both anti-apoptotic routes.

zh.why: CEACAM5（CEA）是GPI锚定的黏附糖蛋白，在结直肠癌、胃癌、胰腺癌和肺腺癌中高表达，血清CEA是经典肿瘤标志物。正常组织表达主要限于胃肠上皮腔面，适合开发ADC和CAR-T，但可溶性CEA脱落和肠道在靶毒性是主要难点。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：本站追踪的11个项目尚无读出，也没有失败或提前终止记录，未来6个月内无主要完成节点。进展最快的是Merck KGaA的3期项目，其结果将是首个真正检验。
opps: 追踪项目中细胞治疗（4个）和ADC（3个）占多数，尚未见明确的双特异性T细胞衔接器。可探索遮蔽型或条件激活型双抗，以减轻肠道正常表达带来的在靶毒性。
适应症集中在泛实体瘤、胃癌和结直肠癌，胰腺导管腺癌和胆管癌各仅1个项目，NSCLC项目也较少。这些CEACAM5高表达瘤种或值得开展专门研究。
患者选择仍是空白：按肿瘤CEACAM5 IHC表达强度分层，并评估血清可溶性CEA作为抗原池对药物暴露的影响，可能是解释ADC和细胞疗法疗效差异的关键变量。

en.why: CEACAM5 (CEA) is a GPI-anchored adhesion glycoprotein overexpressed in colorectal, gastric, pancreatic and lung adenocarcinomas, and serum CEA has long served as a tumour marker. In normal tissue it is largely confined to the luminal surface of gut epithelium, which suits ADCs and CAR-T. Shed soluble CEA and on-target gut toxicity are the main hurdles.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. None of the 11 programs tracked here has a readout or a recorded failure, and none reaches primary completion in the next six months. Merck KGaA's Phase 3 program is furthest along and will be the first real test.
opps: Among tracked programs, cell therapies (4) and ADCs (3) dominate, and no bispecific T-cell engager is listed. Masked or conditionally active engagers could be tested as a way to limit on-target toxicity from normal gut expression.

Indications cluster in basket solid-tumour, gastric and colorectal studies. Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and cholangiocarcinoma have one program each, and NSCLC has few. These CEACAM5-expressing tumours may merit dedicated studies.

Patient selection is still open. Stratifying by tumour CEACAM5 IHC intensity, and measuring how serum soluble CEA acts as an antigen sink that lowers drug exposure, could be the key variables behind different responses to ADCs and cell therapies.

zh.why: CETP介导胆固醇酯从HDL向含apoB脂蛋白转移，抑制后LDL-C与apoB下降、HDL-C升高。CETP功能缺失变异与较低冠心病风险相关，提供遗传学支持。既往同类药物心血管结局不一，获益更可能取决于apoB降幅而非HDL升高。
learned: 本站尚无CETP相关读出或失败记录，临床证据仍很薄弱。所追踪的4个项目均为NewAmsterdam的obicetrapib，III期ASCVD试验NCT05202509预计于2026年11月到达主要完成，将是首个实质性检验。
opps: 在本站追踪范围内，项目全部集中于单一分子和单一公司，尚未见siRNA、ASO等核酸类或其他机制路径。长效或肝靶向的CETP抑制能否形成差异化，仍是开放问题。
已有临床前阿尔茨海默病项目，提示适应症可向脂质代谢以外延伸。可在APOE4携带者等遗传分层人群中，检验CETP抑制对脑脂质代谢及AD生物标志物的影响。
2型糖尿病项目可用于检验CETP抑制对血糖代谢的作用。待NCT05202509读出后，可结合apoB降幅与事件获益的关系，界定最可能获益的人群。

en.why: CETP moves cholesteryl ester from HDL to apoB-containing lipoproteins. Blocking it lowers LDL-C and apoB and raises HDL-C. Loss-of-function CETP variants are linked to lower coronary risk, which gives genetic support. Earlier inhibitors had mixed cardiovascular outcome results, and the benefit appears to track how much apoB falls, not how much HDL rises.
learned: The site has no CETP readouts or failures yet, so the clinical record is thin. All 4 tracked programs are NewAmsterdam's obicetrapib. The Phase 3 ASCVD trial NCT05202509 is due to reach primary completion in November 2026 and will be the first real test.
opps: Among programs tracked here, everything rests on one molecule from one company. No siRNA, ASO or other approach is tracked. Whether long-acting or liver-targeted CETP inhibition could stand apart is still an open question.

A preclinical Alzheimer's program suggests uses beyond lipids. A testable idea: in genetically defined groups such as APOE4 carriers, does CETP inhibition change brain lipid handling and AD biomarkers?

The type 2 diabetes program can test whether CETP inhibition affects glucose metabolism. Once NCT05202509 reads out, the link between apoB lowering and fewer events could help show which patients benefit most.

zh.why: CFTR是上皮细胞顶膜上的氯离子/碳酸氢根通道，两个等位基因均发生功能缺失突变会导致囊性纤维化。ivacaftor和ELX/TEZ/IVA已获批上市，证明恢复通道功能可以改变病程。但无义突变等对调节剂无应答的患者，仍需要基因层面的疗法。
learned: 目前临床记录较少。唯一的读出NCT05882357是ELX/TEZ/IVA的III期PK与安全性描述性研究，没有正式假设检验，本站也没有失败记录。首批真正的检验将是NCT06237335（ivacaftor，II期，2026-11）和NCT05331183（ELX/TEZ/IVA，III期，2027-04）。
opps: 调节剂无效患者需要不依赖突变类型的基因疗法。本站追踪的项目中，只有ARCT-032（吸入mRNA，II期）和SpliSense项目（模态未标明）走这条路线，尚无DNA基因治疗或基因编辑项目。气道递送的效果能否持久仍待验证。
CF以外的适应症：本站有一个项目针对射血分数降低的心衰，可以检验CFTR调节在上皮以外是否有作用。吸烟相关气道疾病中的获得性CFTR功能障碍在生物学上说得通，但本站尚未追踪相关项目。
与Vertex形成差异：ELX/TEZ/IVA和D-IVA都已进入III期。Qanatpharma等的新小分子（II期）可能需要聚焦罕见突变或残余功能突变，并借助类器官或汗液氯离子检测来筛选患者。

en.why: CFTR is a chloride and bicarbonate channel on the surface of epithelial cells. Loss-of-function mutations in both gene copies cause cystic fibrosis. Approved modulators such as ivacaftor and elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor showed that restoring channel function changes the course of the disease. Patients with nonsense mutations or other mutations that do not respond to modulators still need genetic approaches.
learned: The clinical record here is thin. The only readout, NCT05882357, is a descriptive Phase 3 PK and safety study of ELX/TEZ/IVA with no formal hypothesis test, and no failures are tracked. The first real tests will be NCT06237335 (ivacaftor, Phase 2, completing 2026-11) and NCT05331183 (ELX/TEZ/IVA, Phase 3, April 2027).
opps: Patients that modulators cannot help need genetic medicines that work regardless of mutation. Among programs tracked here, only ARCT-032 (inhaled mRNA, Phase 2) and a SpliSense program (modality not specified) take this route. No DNA gene therapy or gene editing program is tracked. Whether airway delivery gives a lasting effect is still open.

Indications beyond CF: one tracked program targets heart failure with reduced ejection fraction. It will test whether CFTR modulation matters outside epithelia. Acquired CFTR dysfunction in smoking-related airway disease makes biological sense as a setting, but no programs there are tracked here.

Standing apart from Vertex: ELX/TEZ/IVA and D-IVA are both in Phase 3. Newer small molecules, such as Qanatpharma's Phase 2 program, may need to focus on rare or residual-function mutations, using organoid or sweat-chloride testing to select patients.

zh.why: CGRP 由三叉神经感觉神经元释放，可引起血管扩张、神经源性炎症和痛觉敏化。偏头痛发作时 CGRP 水平升高，外源输注 CGRP 可诱发偏头痛患者发作，这些证据为该通路提供了临床验证。erenumab、galcanezumab、fremanezumab 等单抗和 rimegepant、ubrogepant 等 gepant 类药物已获批多年。
learned: 小分子 gepant 在预防和急性治疗中均取得阳性结果：rimegepant（NCT05810038）和 atogepant（NCT05861427）减少每月偏头痛天数，鼻喷 zavegepant 在急性止痛终点达标（NCT05989048）。
后期试验开始在耐受性上与老药比较：atogepant 对比 topiramate，以因不良事件停药为主要终点，结果达标（NCT05748483）。fremanezumab（NCT04530110）和 atogepant 联用 Botox（NCT05216263）的研究仅为描述性安全性数据。
机制已验证不代表每项试验都能成功：erenumab 的 OASIS(CM) 慢性偏头痛试验未达主要终点（NCT03832998），这是本站记录中唯一的疗效失败。
本站跟踪的 9 个项目均处于 3 期，全部是已上市药物的适应症或人群扩展，未见早期新进入者。
opps: 特殊人群仍是空白：rimegepant 月经性偏头痛（NCT06641466）和 eptinezumab 儿童慢性偏头痛（NCT04965675）将检验抗 CGRP 获益能否延伸到这些人群。
PACAP/PAC1 列为相关靶点，但本站未跟踪到相关项目。对 CGRP 阻断应答不佳的患者，以及预测应答的生物标志物，可能是值得探索的方向。
联合用药目前仅有安全性数据。gepant 与单抗双重阻断、与 Botox 联用的疗效，以及偏头痛以外的头痛类型，在本站跟踪的项目中尚无人涉及。

en.why: CGRP is released by trigeminal sensory neurons and drives vasodilation, neurogenic inflammation and pain sensitization. Levels rise during migraine attacks, and CGRP infusion triggers attacks in people with migraine, which validates the pathway clinically. Antibodies (erenumab, galcanezumab, fremanezumab) and gepants (rimegepant, ubrogepant) have been approved for years.
learned: Small-molecule gepants succeeded in both prevention and acute treatment: rimegepant (NCT05810038) and atogepant (NCT05861427) reduced monthly migraine days, and intranasal zavegepant met its acute pain-freedom endpoint (NCT05989048).

Late-stage trials now compete on tolerability against older drugs. Atogepant met its primary endpoint against topiramate, which was discontinuation due to adverse events (NCT05748483). Studies of fremanezumab (NCT04530110) and atogepant plus Botox (NCT05216263) produced descriptive safety data only.
A validated mechanism does not guarantee every trial succeeds. Erenumab's OASIS(CM) chronic migraine trial missed its primary endpoint (NCT03832998), the only efficacy failure recorded here.
All 9 programs tracked here are in Phase 3. All are expansions of marketed drugs into new indications or populations, and no early-stage newcomers are tracked.
opps: Special populations are still open. Rimegepant in menstrual migraine (NCT06641466) and eptinezumab in pediatric chronic migraine (NCT04965675) will test whether the benefit of blocking CGRP extends to these groups.
PACAP/PAC1 is listed as a related target, but no programs are tracked here. Patients who respond poorly to CGRP blockade, and biomarkers that predict response, may be worth exploring.
Combinations have only safety data so far. No program tracked here tests the efficacy of a gepant plus an antibody, or a gepant plus Botox, or covers headache types other than migraine.

zh.why: CLDN18.2是紧密连接蛋白claudin-18的胃特异剪接体，正常组织中仅见于分化的胃黏膜上皮，且被包埋在紧密连接内。恶变后其表位暴露于胃、胃食管结合部及胰腺等肿瘤细胞表面，因此是单抗、ADC和CAR-T等疗法选择性较高的表面靶点。
learned: 本站尚无该靶点的登记读出或失败记录，仅有新闻稿称sonesitatug vedotin在后线胃癌中达到OS主要终点，数据未公布。首批真正检验来自NCT07143604（AZD0901）、NCT03816163（zolbetuximab胰腺癌）和III期NCT06206733。
opps: 胰腺癌是本站追踪项目中胃/胃食管结合部以外的主要适应症。NCT03816163将显示裸单抗在胰腺癌中能否起效；若不能，该领域可能更依赖ADC载荷或CAR-T。
ADC是最拥挤的形式（10个项目），胃癌已有多个进入III期。可检验的差异化方向是覆盖CLDN18.2中低或异质性表达人群（依靠旁观者效应），并按治疗模式界定表达阈值。
T细胞衔接器较少（含AZD5863在内仅2个双抗），细胞治疗正转向双靶点CAR-NK。这些设计能否克服抗原异质性，以及靶向正常胃黏膜带来的毒性，仍待验证。

en.why: CLDN18.2 is the stomach-specific splice isoform of the tight-junction protein claudin-18. In normal tissue it is confined to differentiated gastric mucosa and buried within tight junctions. After malignant transformation its epitopes become exposed on gastric, gastroesophageal junction and pancreatic tumour cells, which makes it a fairly selective surface target for antibodies, ADCs and CAR-T.
learned: No registry readouts or failures are tracked yet. A press release reports that sonesitatug vedotin met overall survival in later-line gastric cancer, with data not yet released. The first real tests are AZD0901 in gastric cancer (NCT07143604), zolbetuximab in pancreatic cancer (NCT03816163) and phase 3 NCT06206733 in GEJ adenocarcinoma.
opps: Pancreatic cancer is the main indication outside gastric/GEJ among programs tracked here. NCT03816163 will show whether a naked antibody works in pancreatic disease. If it does not, ADC payloads or CAR-T may be needed there.

ADCs are the most crowded modality (10 programs), with several in phase 3 for gastric cancer. One testable way to differentiate is reaching patients with moderate or patchy CLDN18.2 expression, where bystander payloads may help, and setting expression cutoffs for each modality.

T-cell engagers are sparse (two bispecifics, including AZD5863), and cell therapy is moving toward dual-target CAR-NK designs. It is still unknown whether these designs can overcome patchy antigen expression and the toxicity expected from hitting normal gastric mucosa.

zh.why: CLDN6是紧密连接蛋白，在胚胎上皮表达，成人正常组织基本沉默，但在睾丸生殖细胞肿瘤、卵巢癌及部分肺癌、胃癌、子宫内膜癌中重新表达。这种近乎肿瘤特异的分布适合ADC、T细胞衔接器和CAR-T，关键难点是与CLDN9、CLDN3/4高度同源带来的选择性问题。
learned: 在本站追踪范围内，CLDN6尚无读出或失败记录，未来六个月也无试验到达主要完成日。8个项目多处于1期，Qilu的3期项目和BioNTech的2期CAR-T走得最远。
opps: 生殖细胞肿瘤CLDN6表达最高，但本站追踪的项目中睾丸和性腺外生殖细胞肿瘤各仅1个项目涉及。复发难治患者人群虽小，却是检验CLDN6靶向能否带来深度缓解的较干净场景。
卵巢癌之外布局稀疏：NSCLC和胃癌各仅1个项目，子宫内膜癌尚无。如何在这些瘤种中用IHC筛选CLDN6高表达亚群、确定可靠的表达阈值，仍待回答。
ADC、双抗和CAR-T各有2个项目，尚无领先形式。哪种形式能在规避CLDN9/3/4交叉反应的同时获得最宽治疗窗，以及Qilu的3期项目（此处未注明形式）能否成为标杆，仍需数据回答。

en.why: CLDN6 is a tight-junction protein expressed in embryonic epithelia but largely silent in healthy adult tissue, and re-expressed in testicular germ cell tumours, ovarian cancer and subsets of lung, gastric and endometrial cancers. That near-tumour-restricted pattern suits ADCs, T-cell engagers and CAR-T; the main design challenge is selectivity over closely related claudins such as CLDN9, CLDN3 and CLDN4.
learned: Among programs tracked here the clinical record is still thin: no readouts, no reported failures, and no trials reaching primary completion in the next six months. Of 8 programs at 7 companies most are in phase 1; Qilu's phase 3 and BioNTech's phase 2 CAR-T are furthest along.
opps: Germ cell tumours carry the highest CLDN6 expression, yet testicular and extragonadal germ cell tumours each appear for only one tracked program. Relapsed, refractory disease is a small but biologically clean setting to test whether CLDN6 targeting yields deep responses.

Outside ovarian cancer coverage is sparse: NSCLC and gastric cancer have one tracked program each and endometrial cancer none. IHC-based selection of CLDN6-high subsets in these tumours, with a validated expression cutoff, is an open question.

ADCs, bispecifics and CAR-T each have two programs, so no format leads yet. Which one gives the widest window against CLDN9/3/4 cross-reactivity, and whether Qilu's phase 3 (modality not specified here) sets the benchmark, remain to be shown.

zh.why: CLL1（CLEC12A）是一种C型凝集素样受体，在多数AML原始细胞和白血病干细胞上表达，正常造血干细胞上基本不表达。因此它可能比CD33、CD123更少伤及造血重建。不过CLL1也表达于成熟粒细胞和单核细胞，靶向治疗预计会带来中性粒细胞减少和感染风险。
learned: 这个靶点的临床证据仍很薄弱：本站跟踪的3个项目均处于1期或1/2期，尚无读出、失败或终止记录，未来六个月也没有预计到达主要完成日的试验，近期缺少能检验该机制的数据节点。
现有布局集中在复发AML的细胞治疗：ARCE的ARD103和iCell Gene的CD33-CLL1双靶CAR-T都属于这一类，Guangzhou Bio-gene的项目未细分剂型，适应症同样是AML。
opps: 在本站跟踪的项目中，还没有ADC、T细胞衔接器或NK细胞疗法。这些剂型可以现货供应、剂量可调，可能更适合管理靶向粒细胞带来的毒性，值得验证。
CLL1在白血病干细胞上表达，可以检验它在MRD阳性AML或移植前桥接阶段能否清除残留病灶，并把CLL1表达水平作为入组生物标志物。
双靶设计（如CD33-CLL1）有望减少抗原逃逸，但两种抗原都表达于正常髓系细胞，叠加的血液毒性和恢复时间是早期数据需要回答的关键问题。

en.why: CLL1 (CLEC12A) is a C-type lectin-like receptor found on most AML blasts and leukaemic stem cells. Normal haematopoietic stem cells largely lack it, so targeting CLL1 may spare marrow recovery better than CD33 or CD123. Mature granulocytes and monocytes do express it, so neutropenia and infection are expected on-target risks.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The 3 programs tracked here are all in phase 1 or 1/2, with no readouts, failures or early stops so far. No trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term readout will test the mechanism.
Activity so far centres on cell therapy for relapsed AML: ARCE's ARD103 and iCell Gene's CD33-CLL1 dual CAR-T. Guangzhou Bio-gene's program has no stated modality but also targets AML.
opps: Among programs tracked here, there are no ADCs, T-cell engagers or NK-cell therapies. These could be off-the-shelf and dose-adjustable, which may make the toxicity from hitting granulocytes easier to manage. This is worth testing.
Because CLL1 is on leukaemic stem cells, one hypothesis is that it could clear residual disease in MRD-positive AML or as a bridge to transplant, with CLL1 expression used to select patients.

Dual targeting such as CD33-CLL1 may limit antigen escape. Both antigens are on normal myeloid cells, though, so the added blood toxicity and time to count recovery are the key questions for early data.

zh.why: CNP 通过生长板软骨细胞上的 NPR-B（NPR2）升高 cGMP，拮抗软骨发育不全中 FGFR3 功能获得性突变驱动的 MAPK 信号。遗传证据明确：NPR2 失功能导致严重矮小，CNP 过量则导致过度生长。每日给药的 vosoritide 已获批用于软骨发育不全。
learned: 临床记录尚薄。navepegritide 周制剂在软骨发育不全中达到 AGV 终点（NCT05598320）。vosoritide 的 Noonan 试验（NCT06668805）已终止，所述理由为可行性与治疗格局，不能据此否定机制。未来六个月没有追踪中的试验读出。
opps: 软骨发育不全以外的适应症仍待验证：已追踪软骨发育不良（2 个项目）和特发性矮小（1 个），Noonan 已被放弃。Noonan 存在 RAS/MAPK 过度激活，CNP 在生物学上说得通，值得重新评估。
在特发性矮小中，可检验 NPR2 杂合失功能变异或生长板标志物（如 collagen X 标志物 CXM）能否用来富集应答人群，以基因型分层入组。
已追踪的 4 个项目均为注射用多肽，来自 2 家公司。口服或小分子 NPR-B 激动剂、更长给药间隔、与 FGFR3 靶向药联用，以及身高以外的终点（身体比例、枕骨大孔狭窄），在此尚无数据。

en.why: CNP signals through NPR-B (NPR2) on growth-plate chondrocytes. It raises cGMP and damps the MAPK signaling that gain-of-function FGFR3 drives in achondroplasia. The genetics are clear: NPR2 loss-of-function causes severe short stature, and CNP excess causes overgrowth. Vosoritide, a daily CNP analog, is approved for achondroplasia.
learned: The record is thin. Weekly navepegritide met its growth-velocity endpoint in achondroplasia (NCT05598320). Vosoritide's Noonan trial (NCT06668805) was stopped, citing feasibility and the treatment landscape, so it says little about the mechanism. No tracked trial reads out in the next six months.
opps: Indications beyond achondroplasia remain open. Hypochondroplasia (2 programs) and idiopathic short stature (1) are tracked, and Noonan was dropped. Noonan's RAS/MAPK overactivity makes CNP biologically plausible there, so it may be worth revisiting.
In idiopathic short stature, heterozygous NPR2 loss-of-function variants or growth-plate biomarkers (e.g., the collagen X marker CXM) could be tested as a way to select likely responders by genotype.

All four tracked programs are injected peptides from two companies. Oral or small-molecule NPR-B agonists, longer dosing intervals, combinations with FGFR3-directed agents, and endpoints beyond height (proportionality, foramen magnum stenosis) have no data here.

zh.why: CSF1R是控制巨噬细胞和小胶质细胞存活与分化的受体酪氨酸激酶。腱鞘巨细胞瘤（TGCT）常因CSF1基因易位导致配体过表达，吸引大量巨噬细胞形成瘤体，因此对CSF1R抑制高度敏感，pexidartinib的获批也验证了这一机制。肿瘤相关巨噬细胞和纤维化中的巨噬细胞同样依赖这一信号。
learned: 临床记录仍然很薄：本站尚未追踪到任何读出或失败，未来6个月也没有到达主要完成日期的试验。现有2个3期项目（vimseltinib、pimicotinib）都集中在TGCT/PVNS，胰腺癌、胃癌、食管癌等实体瘤方向仍处于早期。
opps: 实体瘤方向：本站追踪的胰腺癌、胃食管癌项目均处于早期，可检验CSF1R抑制剂联合化疗或免疫治疗，并按肿瘤相关巨噬细胞密度筛选患者，能否克服单纯清除巨噬细胞疗效有限的问题。
本站仅追踪到1个cGVHD项目，巨噬细胞驱动的纤维化和慢性炎症适应症布局较少，可作为TGCT之外的拓展假设。
本站追踪的已知模态全部为小分子。在TGCT中，提高对KIT、FLT3等的选择性以降低pexidartinib式肝毒性，或探索抗体及脑渗透分子用于小胶质细胞相关疾病，都是差异化方向。

en.why: CSF1R is a receptor tyrosine kinase that controls macrophage and microglia survival and differentiation. Tenosynovial giant cell tumor (TGCT) often carries a CSF1 translocation that drives ligand overexpression and macrophage recruitment, making it highly sensitive to CSF1R blockade, as pexidartinib's approval showed. Tumor-associated and fibrotic macrophages also rely on this signal.
learned: The clinical record is still thin: no readouts or failures are tracked here, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months. Both Phase 3 programs (vimseltinib, pimicotinib) are in TGCT/PVNS, while pancreatic, gastric and esophageal cancer work is early-stage.
opps: Solid tumors: the pancreatic and gastroesophageal programs tracked here are early. They could test whether combining with chemotherapy or immunotherapy, and selecting patients by tumor-associated macrophage density, gets past the limits of simply depleting macrophages.
Only one cGVHD program is tracked here. Macrophage-driven fibrosis and chronic inflammation are lightly covered and are a hypothesis for expansion beyond TGCT.

Every program tracked here with a known modality is a small molecule. In TGCT, more selectivity over KIT and FLT3 could avoid pexidartinib-type liver toxicity. Antibodies or brain-penetrant agents for microglia-linked disease are other ways to stand apart.

zh.why: CTLA-4与CD28竞争结合CD80/CD86，在T细胞活化早期发出抑制信号，也是Treg发挥抑制功能的关键分子。胚系CTLA4单倍剂量不足会导致严重自身免疫病，从遗传上证实了它的作用。ipilimumab在黑色素瘤中验证了阻断这一靶点的生存获益，但免疫相关毒性一直限制剂量和联合方案。
learned: 临床记录仍然很少。追踪到的两项读出（NCT05529316的botensilimab联合balstilimab、NCT05932212的AK112联合AK104）都因商业原因终止，不能据此判断机制成败。第一批真正的检验是volrustomig（NCT05984277、NCT05775159）、tremelimumab（NCT05557838、NCT06008093）、cadonilimab（NCT06221748）和BCD-217（NCT05751928）的结果。
opps: 双抗与单抗联合的比较：HCC领域同时有tremelimumab（NCT05557838）和PD-1×CTLA-4双抗volrustomig（NCT05775159）的读出，两者正好可以对比，看单分子设计能否在疗效相当的前提下改善安全性。
在本站追踪的项目中，Fc增强或pH敏感等新一代抗体正把CTLA-4推向冷肿瘤，例如ONC-392用于卵巢癌（NCT05446298）、多个项目布局转移性结直肠癌。能否在PD-1耐药人群中出现应答，是值得验证的假设。
现有项目几乎全部集中在肿瘤（89项试验中86项），也很少看到基于生物标志物的入组设计。用Treg浸润、CD80/CD86表达或FcγR基因型来筛选更可能获益的患者，仍是一块空白。

en.why: CTLA-4 competes with CD28 for CD80/CD86, sending an inhibitory signal early in T-cell activation, and it is central to how regulatory T cells suppress immune responses. Germline CTLA4 haploinsufficiency causes severe autoimmunity, which validates the target genetically. Ipilimumab showed that blocking CTLA-4 extends survival in melanoma, but immune-related toxicity has always limited doses and combinations.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Both tracked readouts were stopped for business reasons, so they say nothing about the mechanism: botensilimab plus balstilimab (NCT05529316) and AK112 plus AK104 (NCT05932212). The first real tests will come from volrustomig (NCT05984277, NCT05775159), tremelimumab (NCT05557838, NCT06008093), cadonilimab (NCT06221748) and BCD-217 (NCT05751928).
opps: Bispecific versus combination: HCC has readouts pending for both tremelimumab (NCT05557838) and the PD-1×CTLA-4 bispecific volrustomig (NCT05775159). Together they can show whether a single-molecule design matches efficacy while improving safety.

Among programs tracked here, next-generation antibodies (Fc-enhanced or pH-sensitive) are moving CTLA-4 into cold tumors. Examples are ONC-392 in ovarian cancer (NCT05446298) and several metastatic colorectal programs. A testable hypothesis is whether they produce responses in PD-1-refractory patients.

Nearly all activity is in oncology (86 of 89 trials), and biomarker-selected enrollment is rarely visible. Selecting patients by Treg infiltration, CD80/CD86 expression or FcγR genotype remains largely open.

zh.why: CXCR1/2是CXCL8（IL-8）等ELR+趋化因子的受体，主要介导中性粒细胞的募集与活化，也参与肿瘤微环境中髓系抑制细胞的聚集。1型糖尿病早期胰腺内可见中性粒细胞浸润，由此提出阻断CXCR1/2以减轻胰岛炎症、保护β细胞功能的设想。
learned: 临床证据仍很有限：本站追踪的唯一读出是Ladarixin在新发1型糖尿病中的2期试验NCT04628481，C-peptide AUC主要终点未达到，并按方案因无效提前终止。未来6个月内暂无可作为下一次检验的读出。
opps: 本站追踪的管线只覆盖1型糖尿病。中性粒细胞驱动的炎症性疾病，或与免疫检查点抑制剂联用以减少髓系抑制细胞募集，或可作为验证该机制的替代方向。
NCT04628481在未经筛选的新发人群中失败。可探索按中性粒细胞活化或趋化因子水平筛选患者的生物标志物策略，或与其他免疫调节剂联用。
目前追踪到的项目均为小分子。单靶点抗体，或区分CXCR1与CXCR2选择性的分子，能否带来不同的疗效与安全性特征，仍有待回答。

en.why: CXCR1 and CXCR2 are receptors for CXCL8 (IL-8) and other ELR+ chemokines. They drive neutrophil recruitment and activation, and also help gather myeloid suppressor cells in tumors. Neutrophils infiltrate the pancreas early in type 1 diabetes, which led to the idea that blocking CXCR1/2 could reduce islet inflammation and preserve beta-cell function.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout tracked here is ladarixin's Phase 2 trial in recent-onset type 1 diabetes (NCT04628481). It missed its C-peptide AUC primary endpoint and was stopped early for futility under the protocol. No readouts are expected in the next six months to test the target again.
opps: Among programs tracked here, only type 1 diabetes is covered. Other ways to test the mechanism could be neutrophil-driven inflammatory diseases, or combining with checkpoint inhibitors to limit myeloid suppressor cell recruitment.

NCT04628481 failed in an unselected recent-onset population. One approach to explore: select patients by biomarkers of neutrophil activation or chemokine levels, or combine with other immunomodulators.
Every program tracked here is a small molecule. It is still unknown whether antibodies, or molecules selective for CXCR1 versus CXCR2, would give a different efficacy or safety profile.

zh.why: DHODH位于线粒体内膜，催化嘧啶从头合成的第四步，并与电子传递链偶联。快速增殖的肿瘤细胞高度依赖嘧啶从头合成，这是把该靶点用于肿瘤治疗的依据。leflunomide和teriflunomide已在自身免疫病中长期使用，说明该靶点可以成药。
learned: 临床证据仍然很少：本站目前只跟踪到Jabez的一个实体瘤I期小分子项目，没有读出，也没有失败记录，未来六个月内也没有试验到达主要完成日，短期内看不到第一次真正的临床检验。
opps: 本站跟踪的项目只覆盖实体瘤。血液肿瘤（如AML）里，DHODH抑制可诱导分化，这一方向在本站跟踪范围内还没有项目，值得作为假设去验证。
肿瘤可以通过尿苷补救途径绕开DHODH抑制。按补救途径活性（如UCK2、核苷转运体表达）筛选患者，或联用补救途径阻断，可能是提高单药活性的思路。
嘧啶耗竭可能影响肿瘤抗原呈递和代谢应激，与免疫治疗或DNA损伤类药物联用的合理性，目前尚无本站跟踪的临床数据检验。

en.why: DHODH sits in the inner mitochondrial membrane, catalyses the fourth step of de novo pyrimidine synthesis and is coupled to the electron transport chain. Fast-growing tumour cells lean heavily on de novo pyrimidine supply, which is the case for using it in oncology. Leflunomide and teriflunomide, long used in autoimmune disease, show the target can be drugged.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The site tracks one Phase 1 small-molecule program in solid tumours, from Jabez. It has no readouts and no failures, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no real clinical test is in sight.
opps: The tracked program covers solid tumours only. In blood cancers such as AML, DHODH inhibition can push cells to differentiate, and no program tracked here addresses that, which makes it a hypothesis worth testing.

Tumours can get around DHODH blockade through uridine salvage. Selecting patients by salvage capacity (for example UCK2 or nucleoside transporter expression), or adding a drug that blocks salvage, could improve single-agent activity.

Pyrimidine depletion may affect antigen presentation and metabolic stress. That gives a rationale for pairing DHODH inhibitors with immunotherapy or DNA-damaging agents, but no clinical data tracked here tests it yet.

zh.why: DLL3 是 Notch 通路的抑制性配体，受 ASCL1 驱动，在小细胞肺癌（SCLC）及其他高级别神经内分泌肿瘤表面异常高表达，而正常组织中几乎只存在于胞内。这种肿瘤选择性使其成为 T 细胞衔接双抗、ADC、CAR-T 和放射性药物的理想靶点，而 SCLC 预后差、治疗选择有限。
learned: 本站跟踪的 DLL3 临床记录仍很薄：尚无带判定的读出或失败记录，未来六个月也没有跟踪中的主要完成节点。目前进展最快的是 Tarlatamab 和 BI 764532 两款 T 细胞衔接双抗，以及 Zai Lab 的一个 3 期项目。Zai Lab 的 DLL3 ADC 一线 SCLC 数据目前仅见于新闻稿中的积极信号，尚待注册试验验证。
opps: SCLC 之外的适应症覆盖较少：本站跟踪的项目中，神经内分泌肿瘤仅 3 个，大细胞神经内分泌癌仅 2 个。可以考虑按 DLL3 表达水平进行筛选，在这类肺外或非典型神经内分泌肿瘤中探索。
模态分布不均：放射性药物仅 Molecular Partners 一个项目，5 个细胞治疗项目（Legend、Novartis、Moonlight Bio 等）均处于 1 或 1/2 期。待验证的问题是，这些模态能否在实体瘤中带来持久缓解，或在耐受性上与双抗形成差异。
一线联合是下一个分化点：Hengrui 正在 2 期中把 SHR-4849 与 PD-L1 抑制剂及铂类化疗联合，Zai Lab 的 ADC 也在一线推进。ADC 与双抗之间如何排序、DLL3 低表达亚型（非 ASCL1 型）能否获益，仍是未解问题。

en.why: DLL3 is an inhibitory Notch ligand, driven by ASCL1. It is aberrantly expressed on the surface of small cell lung cancer (SCLC) and other high-grade neuroendocrine tumours, while in normal tissue it stays largely intracellular. That tumour selectivity makes it a strong target for T-cell engagers, ADCs, CAR-T and radioligands in a disease with poor outcomes.
learned: The DLL3 clinical record tracked here is still thin. There are no readouts with verdicts and no failures, and no tracked trials reach primary completion in the next six months. The most advanced programs are two T-cell engagers, Tarlatamab and BI 764532, plus a Zai Lab Phase 3 asset. Zai Lab's first-line SCLC data for its DLL3 ADC is only a positive press-release signal so far and has not been tested in a registry trial.
opps: Indications beyond SCLC get little coverage. Among programs tracked here, only 3 target neuroendocrine neoplasms and 2 target large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma. One hypothesis: run DLL3-expression-selected studies in extrapulmonary or atypical neuroendocrine tumours.

The modality mix is uneven. Molecular Partners has the only radioligand, and all 5 cell therapies (Legend, Novartis, Moonlight Bio and others) are in Phase 1 or 1/2. The open question is whether these can give durable responses in solid tumours, or a tolerability profile that sets them apart from bispecifics.

First-line combinations are the next place programs can stand apart. In Phase 2, Hengrui is pairing SHR-4849 with a PD-L1 inhibitor and platinum chemotherapy, and Zai Lab's ADC is moving into first line. Two questions are still open: how to sequence ADCs and T-cell engagers, and whether DLL3-low (non-ASCL1) subtypes benefit.

zh.why: DM1 由 DMPK 基因 3′非翻译区 CTG 重复扩增引起。突变转录本滞留核内，隔离 MBNL 剪接调控蛋白，导致 CLCN1 等基因错误剪接，引发肌强直、肌无力和心脏传导异常。在肌肉中降低毒性 DMPK RNA 有明确遗传学依据，难点在于把寡核苷酸递送进肌肉。
learned: 临床证据仍有限：MARINA（NCT05027269）只评估安全性，Del-desiran 的 III 期 HARBOR 在松手时间上未达到；DYNE-101 在本站尚无读出。NCT06411288 的结果和 DYNE-101 的 III 期将是下一步检验。
opps: HARBOR 在松手时间上未达到，原因可能是 DMPK 敲低本身不能改善功能，也可能出在终点、剂量或疗程上。NCT06411288 完整结果如显示肌力、计时功能或剪接指标的变化，有助于区分这几种可能。
在本站追踪的项目中，DYNE-101 是另一个进入后期的 DMPK 项目。如能证明肌肉内敲低更深或更持久且与剪接纠正相关，可帮助判断 HARBOR 的失败源于暴露不足还是机制本身。
本站追踪的项目均未针对 DM1 的中枢症状、心脏传导异常或先天型，也没有靶向重复序列的基因编辑项目。骨骼肌以外组织的递送仍是待解问题。

en.why: DM1 is caused by an expanded CTG repeat in the 3′ untranslated region of DMPK. The mutant transcript stays in the nucleus, traps MBNL splicing regulators and causes missplicing of genes such as CLCN1, which drives myotonia, weakness and cardiac conduction defects. Lowering toxic DMPK RNA in muscle has a clear genetic rationale. The hard part is getting oligonucleotides into muscle.
learned: The record is thin. MARINA (NCT05027269) tested safety only, and Del-desiran's phase 3 HARBOR missed on hand-opening time, a myotonia measure. DYNE-101 has no readouts tracked here. Results from NCT06411288 and DYNE-101's phase 3 will be the next real tests.
opps: HARBOR's miss on hand-opening time could mean DMPK knockdown does not improve function, or the problem was the endpoint, dose or treatment length. Full NCT06411288 results showing changes in strength, timed function or splicing could help tell these apart.

Among programs tracked here, DYNE-101 is the only other late-stage DMPK program. Showing deeper or longer-lasting knockdown in muscle, linked to splicing correction, would help show whether HARBOR failed because of too little exposure or because of the mechanism.

No tracked program targets DM1's brain symptoms, cardiac conduction defects or the congenital form, and none uses repeat-targeting gene editing. Delivery to tissues beyond skeletal muscle is still an open question.

zh.why: DUX4是一种胚胎期转录因子，在成熟肌肉中本应沉默。FSHD1中4q35 D4Z4重复序列缩短，或FSHD2中SMCHD1突变，导致其在允许性4qA单倍型上异常表达，激活下游基因，造成肌细胞毒性。这是一种毒性获得功能机制，因此直接沉默DUX4有明确的遗传学依据。
learned: 临床证据仍很薄弱：本站仅追踪到Sarepta一项DUX4 siRNA项目（1/2期），尚无数据读出，未来六个月也没有试验到达主要完成日期，近期没有读出能检验该机制。
opps: 本站追踪的项目中只有siRNA一种模态。ASO、抗体-寡核苷酸偶联物，或针对D4Z4区的表观遗传沉默，都可作为验证不同骨骼肌递送策略的方向。
DUX4在肌肉中呈散发、低水平表达，难以直接检测。以DUX4下游基因表达特征结合肌肉MRI作为药效和入组生物标志物，可能决定早期试验能否看到信号。
目前仅有一项早期项目，多数问题尚无答案：沉默程度与肌力或功能获益之间的关系，以及FSHD1与FSHD2患者的应答是否不同。

en.why: DUX4 is an embryonic transcription factor that should be silent in adult muscle. In FSHD, D4Z4 repeat contraction at 4q35 (FSHD1) or SMCHD1 mutations (FSHD2) switch it back on when a permissive 4qA allele is present. It then activates downstream genes that kill muscle cells. This toxic gain of function gives knocking down DUX4 directly a clear genetic rationale.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The site tracks one DUX4 program: an unnamed Sarepta siRNA in Phase 1/2. It has no readouts yet, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term readout will test the mechanism.
opps: siRNA is the only modality among programs tracked here. ASOs, antibody-oligonucleotide conjugates and epigenetic silencing of D4Z4 are untried here, and each would test a different way of reaching skeletal muscle.

DUX4 is expressed sporadically and at low levels, which makes it hard to measure directly. Using a signature of DUX4 target genes plus muscle MRI as pharmacodynamic and enrollment biomarkers may decide whether early trials can detect a signal.
With only one early program, the key questions are open: how much DUX4 knockdown is needed for a strength or function benefit, and whether FSHD1 and FSHD2 patients respond differently.

zh.why: DMD基因移码缺失导致肌营养不良蛋白缺失，引发Duchenne肌营养不良。外显子跳跃可恢复阅读框，产生截短但部分有功能的蛋白，类似病情较轻的Becker表型。每种药物只针对特定外显子（如44、45、51、53）的患者亚群。
learned: 目前追踪到的临床记录很少，没有已公布的读出，也没有失败记录。唯一的III期试验NCT03992430原定于2026-09-07达到主要完成，本站尚未追踪到其结果，这将是首个实质性检验。
opps: 本站追踪的9个项目中有4个是常规反义寡核苷酸（Sarepta、Biomarin、Daiichi Sankyo、NS）。Entrada和PepGen是2025年进入的新项目，未标注具体模式。可以检验的假设：提升骨骼肌和心肌递送效率、提高蛋白表达量，是与先行者拉开差距的主要途径。
在本站追踪的项目中，明确指向外显子44的只有1个，其他较少见的外显子以及多外显子跳跃覆盖仍然很少。Roche和AO GENERIUM的基因治疗或编辑项目有望实现持久跳跃，可用于检验一次给药能否替代长期反复输注。
蛋白表达量与功能获益之间的关系尚未确立。NCT03992430的结果加上Satellos的小分子项目，可以帮助判断单靠恢复肌营养不良蛋白是否足够，还是需要联合非蛋白恢复类的机制。

en.why: Out-of-frame deletions in the DMD gene abolish dystrophin and cause Duchenne muscular dystrophy. Exon skipping restores the reading frame, producing a shorter but partly functional protein, similar to the milder Becker form. Each drug serves only patients whose deletions are fixed by skipping one specific exon, such as 44, 45, 51 or 53.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin: no readouts and no failures. The only Phase 3 trial, NCT03992430, was due to reach primary completion on 2026-09-07. Its results are not yet tracked here, and it will be the first real test.
opps: Of the 9 programs tracked here, 4 are conventional antisense oligonucleotides (Sarepta, Biomarin, Daiichi Sankyo, NS). Entrada and PepGen joined in 2025 with no modality listed. A testable hypothesis: better delivery to skeletal and heart muscle, and higher dystrophin levels, are the main way to stand apart from the leaders.

Among programs tracked here, only 1 explicitly targets exon 44. Rarer exons and multi-exon skipping get little coverage. The gene therapy or editing programs from Roche and AO GENERIUM could test whether a one-time, lasting skip can replace years of repeat infusions.

It is still unclear whether more dystrophin leads to functional benefit. NCT03992430, together with Satellos's small-molecule program, may show whether restoring dystrophin is enough on its own or needs a non-dystrophin partner mechanism.

zh.why: EGFR 是受体酪氨酸激酶，通过 RAS–MAPK 和 PI3K–AKT 通路驱动细胞增殖。19 外显子缺失和 L858R 等激活突变是非小细胞肺癌的经典驱动基因，在亚裔患者中尤其常见。EGFR 过表达还见于结直肠癌和头颈鳞癌。osimertinib、cetuximab 等药物的长期临床应用验证了这个靶点。
learned: osimertinib 正在向早期治疗线和联合方案扩展：新辅助 NeoADAURA（NCT04351555）达到 MPR 终点，savolitinib 联合 osimertinib 的 SAFFRON 三期也取得阳性结果。这说明针对 MET 等旁路耐药机制做联合是可行的。
20 外显子插入亚型的结果分化明显。firmonertinib 三期 FURVENT 未达到 PFS 终点；zipalertinib 一线联合化疗的 REZILIENT3 在期中分析中显著改善 PFS。poziotinib 两项试验（NCT03318939、NCT03744715）因商业原因终止，不能据此否定机制。
EGFR×HER3 双抗 ADC iza-bren 在乳腺癌和 TKI 经治肺癌两项三期中都达到 PFS 终点，说明偶联药物的活性可以延伸到 EGFR 突变以外的人群。TAK-186 在头颈鳞癌中因抗肿瘤活性有限而终止（NCT04844073）。
这个领域竞争拥挤：本站追踪到 95 个项目、79 家公司，失败中有一半是商业或战略原因。MCLA-129 联合 osimertinib（NCT04868877）虽被归为疗效类终止，申办方明确说明是战略决定，与疗效和安全性无关。
opps: 三代 TKI 耐药后的治疗格局尚未确定。iza-bren 的肺癌三期（NCT06382116、NCT06382129）将检验 ADC 在这一人群中的地位。按 MET、HER3 等生物标志物分层选择患者，可能是差异化的方向。
肺癌以外的适应症布局较少。本站追踪的头颈鳞癌和胶质母细胞瘤项目都只有个位数，iza-bren 鼻咽癌三期（NCT06118333）会提供新证据。TAK-186 的失败提示，这些瘤种可能需要不同的分子形式。
非肿瘤领域几乎空白：射血分数降低的心衰二期 NCT06369298 是少数非肿瘤试验之一，可以用来检验 EGFR 信号在心肌重塑中的作用。furmonertinib 三期 NCT05607550 的结果也值得关注。

en.why: EGFR is a receptor tyrosine kinase that drives proliferation through RAS–MAPK and PI3K–AKT signaling. Activating mutations such as exon 19 deletions and L858R are classic drivers of non-small cell lung cancer, especially common in Asian patients. EGFR is also overexpressed in colorectal and head and neck squamous cancers. Long-standing use of osimertinib and cetuximab validates the target.
learned: Osimertinib is moving into earlier lines and combinations. Neoadjuvant NeoADAURA (NCT04351555) met its MPR endpoint, and the SAFFRON Phase III of savolitinib plus osimertinib was positive. Combinations aimed at bypass resistance such as MET look workable.

Exon 20 insertion results are split. Firmonertinib's Phase III FURVENT missed PFS, while zipalertinib plus chemo in first line (REZILIENT3) significantly improved PFS at an interim analysis. Two poziotinib trials (NCT03318939, NCT03744715) stopped for business reasons, which says nothing against the mechanism.

Iza-bren, an EGFR×HER3 bispecific ADC, met PFS in two Phase IIIs: HR+/HER2- breast cancer and TKI-pretreated lung cancer. That suggests conjugate activity reaches beyond EGFR-mutant disease. TAK-186 stopped in head and neck cancer for limited activity (NCT04844073).

The field is crowded: 95 programs from 79 companies tracked here, and half the stops are for business or strategy. MCLA-129 plus osimertinib (NCT04868877) is coded as an efficacy stop, but the sponsor explicitly called it a strategic decision unrelated to efficacy or safety.
opps: Treatment after third-generation TKIs is unsettled. Iza-bren's lung Phase IIIs (NCT06382116, NCT06382129) will test where ADCs fit. Selecting patients by biomarkers such as MET or HER3 could be a way to differentiate.

Few programs go beyond lung cancer. Head and neck and glioblastoma each have only a handful of programs tracked here, and the iza-bren nasopharyngeal Phase III (NCT06118333) will add evidence. TAK-186's failure hints that these tumors may need a different modality.

Non-oncology is nearly empty. The Phase II in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (NCT06369298) is one of the few non-cancer trials and could test EGFR signaling in cardiac remodeling. The furmonertinib Phase III NCT05607550 result is also worth watching.

zh.why: ENPP1水解胞外ATP生成AMP和焦磷酸（PPi），PPi抑制异位钙化，ENPP1功能缺失可致婴儿全身性动脉钙化（GACI）和ARHR2，这为酶替代提供了遗传依据。在肿瘤中，ENPP1降解2'3'-cGAMP并促进腺苷生成，抑制它有望恢复STING介导的先天免疫。
learned: 记录仍薄：仅INZ-701有读出，1/2期为描述性结果（NCT04686175），3期因商业原因终止（NCT06046820），不能据此否定机制；肿瘤抑制剂尚无数据，未来六个月也没有到期试验。
opps: 肿瘤领域追踪到的4个抑制剂均为早期小分子，多数在泛实体瘤人群中开展。按肿瘤ENPP1表达或cGAS-STING通路是否完整入组，并联合放疗或PD-1抑制剂，是有待验证的差异化假设。
NCT06046820终止后，本站未追踪到其他针对ENPP1缺乏症或ARHR2的酶替代项目。恢复PPi能否改善骨骼和血管结局仍未回答，追踪项目中也还没有长效制剂或基因疗法。
系统性抑制ENPP1会降低PPi，而PPi缺乏正是GACI钙化的成因。肿瘤局部化设计、早期试验中监测PPi与血管钙化，目前追踪的肿瘤项目都还没有报告相关数据。

en.why: ENPP1 breaks down extracellular ATP into AMP and pyrophosphate (PPi), which prevents mineral from depositing where it should not. Loss-of-function mutations cause generalized arterial calcification of infancy (GACI) and ARHR2, which gives a genetic basis for enzyme replacement. In tumors, ENPP1 degrades the STING agonist 2'3'-cGAMP and feeds adenosine production, so blocking it may restore innate immune signaling.
learned: The record is still thin. The only tracked readouts are Inozyme's INZ-701 in ENPP1 deficiency: a phase 1/2 with descriptive results (NCT04686175) and a phase 3 stopped for business reasons (NCT06046820), which is not evidence against the mechanism. Oncology inhibitors have no readouts, and none are due in the next six months.
opps: The four oncology inhibitors tracked here are all early-stage small molecules, mostly tested in broad solid-tumor populations. Two untested ways to stand out: enrolling patients by tumor ENPP1 expression or intact cGAS–STING signaling, and combining with radiotherapy or PD-1 blockade.

Since NCT06046820 stopped, no other enzyme-replacement program for ENPP1 deficiency or ARHR2 is tracked here. Whether restoring PPi improves bone and vascular outcomes is still unanswered, and no longer-acting or gene-based approach appears among tracked programs.

Blocking ENPP1 throughout the body lowers PPi, the same shortfall that drives calcification in GACI. Designs that act only in the tumor, or monitoring of PPi and vascular calcification in early trials, are open questions. No tracked oncology program has reported on them yet.

zh.why: ERα是配体激活的转录因子，驱动多数激素受体阳性乳腺癌生长。tamoxifen与fulvestrant验证了阻断或降解ER的价值，但耐药常见，芳香化酶抑制剂治疗后常出现ESR1配体结合域突变。口服SERD、PROTAC降解剂等新药旨在耐药肿瘤中持续抑制ER信号。
learned: 已追踪读出均为1/2期且无正式假设检验，临床记录尚薄。首批真正检验将来自palazestrant III期（NCT06016738）、vepdegestrant III期（NCT05909397）和afuresertib III期（NCT04851613）。
opps: 已追踪管线集中于乳腺癌，子宫内膜癌（giredestrant，NCT05634499）、卵巢癌、脂肪肉瘤项目很少。这些肿瘤的ER依赖性能否支持SERD或降解剂治疗、何种标志物可预测，仍待回答。
vepdegestrant联合ribociclib或samuraciclib的两项试验在1b期后以商业理由关停（NCT05573555、NCT06125522），PROTAC降解剂与CDK4/6或CDK7抑制剂的联合仍未被检验，而非被否定。
已追踪项目中小分子占17个，差异化或来自模态（4个ADC、1个放射性药物）或治疗阶段：早期乳腺癌仅2个项目。即将读出的III期（NCT06016738、NCT05909397）可提示获益是否局限于ESR1突变人群。

en.why: ERα is a ligand-activated transcription factor that drives growth in most hormone receptor-positive breast cancers. Tamoxifen and fulvestrant validated blocking or degrading it, but resistance follows, often through ESR1 ligand-binding-domain mutations selected by aromatase inhibitors. Oral SERDs, PROTAC degraders and other new agents aim to keep suppressing ER signaling in resistant tumors.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is thin: all readouts are phase 1/2 with no formal hypothesis test. The first real tests will be the phase 3 readouts for palazestrant (NCT06016738), vepdegestrant (NCT05909397) and afuresertib (NCT04851613).
opps: Breast cancer dominates the pipeline tracked here; endometrial cancer (giredestrant, NCT05634499), ovarian cancer and liposarcoma have few programs. Whether ER dependence in these tumors supports SERD or degrader therapy, and which biomarker predicts it, is open.

Two vepdegestrant combinations, with ribociclib and samuraciclib, closed after phase 1b for stated business reasons (NCT05573555, NCT06125522), so pairing a PROTAC degrader with CDK4/6 or CDK7 inhibitors remains untested rather than disproven.

With 17 small molecules among programs tracked here, differentiation may come from modality (4 ADCs, 1 radiopharmaceutical) or setting: only 2 programs target early breast cancer. Upcoming phase 3 data (NCT06016738, NCT05909397) may show whether benefit is confined to ESR1-mutant tumors.

zh.why: ERK1/2是RAS–RAF–MEK–ERK通路的末端激酶，调控细胞增殖与存活。肿瘤中ERK再激活是BRAF/MEK抑制剂耐药的常见机制，使ERK成为通路下游的拦截点；VEGFR2信号部分经ERK驱动内皮细胞增殖，这是其用于湿性AMD的依据。
learned: 临床证据仍很有限：本站追踪的唯一项目是Filamon的小分子BETA-TT8。该药用于湿性AMD的1/2期试验于2026年8月登记，目前尚无读出或失败记录，未来6个月内也没有试验到达主要完成节点。
opps: 本站追踪范围内尚无肿瘤领域的ERK项目，而ERK在BRAF/MEK抑制剂耐药及RAS驱动肿瘤中的生物学依据最强。直接抑制ERK能否单药或联合克服这类耐药，仍是待验证的假设。
湿性AMD中的关键问题是相对抗VEGF标准治疗如何定位：ERK抑制能否在应答不佳患者中带来增益，或延长给药间隔。鉴于MEK抑制剂已知可致浆液性视网膜病变，局部给药并密切监测视网膜安全性值得考虑。
可借助磷酸化ERK或下游转录标志物等药效学指标，在早期确认靶点结合并辅助患者筛选。该靶点目前尚无疗效数据，这类指标有助于尽早判断机制是否成立。

en.why: ERK1/2 are the last kinases in the RAS–RAF–MEK–ERK cascade and control cell proliferation and survival. In tumors, ERK reactivation is a common way cancers become resistant to BRAF and MEK inhibitors, so ERK is a downstream choke point. VEGFR2 signaling also drives endothelial cell growth partly through ERK, which is the reason to test it in wet AMD.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Among programs tracked here, the only one is Filamon's small-molecule BETA-TT8, in a phase 1/2 wet AMD trial first posted in August 2026. There are no readouts or failures yet, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months.
opps: Among programs tracked here, no ERK program is in oncology, where the biology is strongest: ERK reactivation after BRAF/MEK inhibition, and RAS-driven tumors. Whether a direct ERK inhibitor, alone or in combination, can overcome that resistance is still an open question.
