In wet AMD, the open question is how ERK inhibition fits next to standard anti-VEGF care. Can it add benefit in patients who respond poorly, or extend dosing intervals? MEK inhibitors are known to cause serous retinopathy, so local eye delivery and close retinal monitoring seem prudent.

Pharmacodynamic markers such as phosphorylated ERK, or readouts of downstream gene activity, could confirm early that the drug hits its target and help select patients. That matters for a target with no efficacy data tracked so far.

zh.why: EZH2是PRC2的催化亚基，通过H3K27me3沉默分化相关基因和抑癌基因。功能获得性突变驱动FL、DLBCL等生发中心淋巴瘤，SWI/SNF缺失肿瘤依赖EZH2，前列腺癌中EZH2参与去势抵抗。EZH1可代偿，由此催生EZH1/2双靶抑制剂。
learned: 临床证据仍少：NCT02875548为描述性研究且已停止入组，NCT06022757因战略原因终止，两者都没有检验疗效。首个实质性检验是tazemetostat复发/难治FL三期研究NCT04224493，预计2027年2月完成主要终点。
opps: 本站跟踪的前列腺癌（含mCRPC）项目有数个，但均未读出。值得验证EZH2抑制能否恢复对AR通路药物的敏感性，以及EZH2活性或AR状态能否用于筛选应答人群。
实体瘤项目多入组未经筛选的晚期患者。按SWI/SNF缺失（如SMARCB1、ARID1A）富集患者，或许比全人群设计更能直接检验合成致死假说。
EZH2抑制能否增强免疫检查点疗效仍无答案。本站跟踪的唯一IO联合研究NCT06022757因战略原因终止，并非疗效或安全性问题，这一问题仍有空间。

en.why: EZH2 is the catalytic subunit of PRC2. It deposits H3K27me3 to silence differentiation and tumor-suppressor genes. Gain-of-function mutations drive germinal-center lymphomas such as FL and DLBCL, SWI/SNF-deficient tumors depend on EZH2, and in prostate cancer it supports castration resistance. EZH1 can compensate for EZH2 loss, which is why dual EZH1/2 inhibitors exist.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. NCT02875548 was descriptive and closed enrollment, and NCT06022757 stopped for strategic reasons, so neither tested efficacy. The first real test is the phase 3 tazemetostat trial in relapsed/refractory FL, NCT04224493, with primary completion due February 2027.
opps: Several prostate cancer programs are tracked here, including mCRPC studies, but none has read out. Two open questions: can EZH2 inhibition restore sensitivity to AR-pathway drugs, and can EZH2 activity or AR status pick out responders?

Most solid-tumor programs enroll unselected patients with advanced tumors. Selecting patients with SWI/SNF loss (e.g., SMARCB1, ARID1A) could test the synthetic-lethal rationale more cleanly than all-comers designs.

Whether EZH2 inhibition boosts checkpoint blockade is still unanswered. The only immunotherapy combination tracked here, NCT06022757, stopped for strategic reasons, not for efficacy or safety, so the question is still open.

zh.why: DPP1（cathepsin C）在骨髓中性粒细胞成熟过程中激活中性粒细胞弹性蛋白酶、PR3和cathepsin G。抑制DPP1可从源头降低这些蛋白酶的活性，减轻支气管扩张症、COPD等疾病中的气道损伤。CTSC功能缺失导致Papillon-Lefèvre综合征，但患者并无明显系统性免疫缺陷，这为长期抑制的耐受性提供了遗传学依据。
learned: 本站跟踪的临床记录仍很有限：目前没有读出或失败记录。首个关键检验是Haisco的HSK31858在非囊性纤维化支气管扩张症中的III期试验NCT06660992，主要完成日期在2026年11月下旬。
opps: 在本站跟踪的管线中，COPD和哮喘只有少数II期项目，DPP1抑制能否从支气管扩张症延伸到这些疾病尚无数据。以痰液弹性蛋白酶活性或中性粒细胞高表型筛选患者，可作为可检验的假设。
Onchilles的N17350是唯一的重组酶项目，用于三阴性乳腺癌和实体瘤，思路与呼吸领域相反：利用弹性蛋白酶杀伤肿瘤细胞。早期数据能否支持这一机制，仍是开放问题。
本站跟踪的呼吸项目均为小分子DPP1抑制剂，同质化明显。可从两方面寻求差异：一是降低PLS相关的皮肤角化、牙周不良反应；二是进入尚无项目覆盖的中性粒细胞驱动疾病。

en.why: DPP1 (cathepsin C) activates neutrophil elastase, PR3 and cathepsin G while neutrophils mature in the bone marrow. Inhibiting it reduces the activity of all three at the source, which may limit airway damage in bronchiectasis and COPD. Loss-of-function CTSC mutations cause Papillon-Lefèvre syndrome without obvious systemic immunodeficiency. This genetic evidence suggests long-term inhibition can be tolerated.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin, with no readouts or failures so far. The first real test is NCT06660992, Haisco's Phase 3 trial of HSK31858 in non-cystic fibrosis bronchiectasis. Its primary completion is due in late November 2026.
opps: Among programs tracked here, COPD and asthma have only a few Phase 2 programs. Whether DPP1 inhibition helps beyond bronchiectasis is untested. Selecting patients by sputum elastase activity or a neutrophil-high phenotype is a testable hypothesis.

Onchilles' N17350 is the only recombinant-enzyme program, tested in triple-negative breast cancer and solid tumors. It inverts the respiratory logic by using elastase to kill tumor cells. Whether early data support this mechanism is an open question.

All tracked respiratory programs are small-molecule DPP1 inhibitors. One way to stand apart is to reduce the skin hyperkeratosis and periodontal effects seen in PLS. Another is to enter neutrophil-driven diseases that no program here addresses.

zh.why: EpCAM是一种上皮细胞黏附糖蛋白，在多数腺癌及部分肿瘤干细胞上高表达，是经典的实体瘤表面抗原。它在正常上皮也有表达，治疗窗主要受这一点限制。EpCAM×CD3双抗catumaxomab曾在欧盟获批经腹腔给药治疗恶性腹水，说明局部给药可以兑现这一靶点的价值。
learned: 临床证据仍很薄弱：本站收录7个项目、7家公司，暂无读出和失败记录，未来6个月也没有试验到达主要完成节点。Wuhan YZY的3期双抗项目进展最快，它的结果将是首次真正的检验。
opps: 正常上皮表达带来的在靶脱瘤毒性仍是核心问题。条件激活或遮蔽型T细胞衔接器（如BA3182）、腹腔等局部给药能否拓宽治疗窗，值得优先验证。
本站收录的项目以双抗和单抗为主，暂未见ADC或放射性配体，细胞治疗和基因治疗各只有一个项目，这些模式的空间还很大。
多数项目以泛实体瘤入组。按EpCAM表达水平或按瘤种（如腹膜转移为主的胃癌、卵巢癌）筛选患者，可能更快得到清晰信号。

en.why: EpCAM is an epithelial adhesion glycoprotein that is highly expressed on most adenocarcinomas and some cancer stem-like cells, which makes it a classic solid-tumour surface antigen. It is also expressed on normal epithelia, and that limits the therapeutic window. The EpCAM×CD3 bispecific catumaxomab was once approved in the EU for intraperitoneal treatment of malignant ascites, showing the target can deliver when given locally.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site tracks 7 programs from 7 companies, with no readouts, no failures and no trials reaching primary completion in the next six months. Wuhan YZY's Phase 3 bispecific is the most advanced, and its eventual readout will be the first real test.
opps: The central problem is still on-target, off-tumour toxicity from EpCAM on normal epithelia. A priority question is whether conditionally active or masked T-cell engagers (e.g., BA3182), or local intraperitoneal dosing, can widen the window.
The programs tracked here are mostly bispecifics and monoclonal antibodies. No ADC or radioligand appears yet, and cell and gene therapy have one program each, so these modalities are largely open.
Most programs enrol broad advanced solid tumours. Selecting patients by EpCAM expression or by tumour type (e.g., gastric or ovarian cancer with peritoneal spread) might give clearer early signals.

zh.why: FAAH和MAGL分别降解内源性大麻素anandamide和2-AG。抑制这两种酶可以提高内源性大麻素水平，间接激活CB1/CB2，有望在获得镇痛、抗痉挛和抗焦虑作用的同时，避开直接激动剂的精神活性。MAGL还为脑内前列腺素合成提供花生四烯酸，因此兼具抗神经炎症的逻辑。
learned: 临床记录仍很有限：本站追踪的2个项目都来自Bristol Myers Squibb，处于2期，适应症为多发性硬化痉挛和阿尔茨海默病激越，目前没有读出，未来6个月内也没有预计完成的试验，短期内暂无数据可以检验这一机制。
opps: 该靶点所属通路覆盖疼痛、癫痫和咳嗽，但本站追踪的项目只涉及多发性硬化痉挛和阿尔茨海默病激越。神经病理性疼痛、难治性癫痫和慢性咳嗽仍是值得验证的适应症假设。
单独抑制FAAH、单独抑制MAGL还是双重抑制，哪一种决定疗效，又是哪一种带来CB1相关的耐受和中枢副作用，目前尚无定论。可以用血浆anandamide/2-AG作为靶点结合标志物来指导剂量和患者筛选。
本站追踪的项目只来自一家公司。外周限制型MAGL抑制剂用于炎症性疼痛，或采用以长期给药耐受性为核心的差异化设计，可能是其他研发者的切入点。

en.why: FAAH and MAGL break down the endocannabinoids anandamide and 2-AG. Blocking them raises endocannabinoid tone and activates CB1/CB2 indirectly, which could give pain-relieving, antispastic and anxiolytic effects without the psychoactivity of direct agonists. MAGL also supplies arachidonic acid for prostaglandin synthesis in the brain, which adds a rationale against neuroinflammation.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Both programs tracked here are Bristol Myers Squibb Phase 2 assets, in MS spasticity and Alzheimer's agitation. None has read out, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term readout will test the mechanism.
opps: The pathway tag covers pain, epilepsy and cough, yet the programs tracked here address only MS spasticity and Alzheimer's agitation. Neuropathic pain, refractory epilepsy and chronic cough remain untested hypotheses.

It is still unknown whether FAAH-only, MAGL-only or dual inhibition drives benefit, and which causes CB1-linked tolerance or CNS side effects. Plasma anandamide and 2-AG could serve as target-engagement markers to guide dosing and patient selection.

Among programs tracked here, only one company is active. Peripherally restricted MAGL inhibitors for inflammatory pain, or designs built around long-term tolerability, could offer other developers a way in.

zh.why: FAP（成纤维细胞活化蛋白）是一种膜型丝氨酸蛋白酶，在多数上皮来源肿瘤的癌相关成纤维细胞上高表达，在正常成人组织中表达很低，也见于组织纤维化和创伤修复。肿瘤间质分布广，因此可作为跨瘤种的影像、放射性配体和间质靶向免疫治疗靶点。
learned: 临床记录仍很有限。目前唯一的读出是诊断性的：SOFIE 的 [18F]FAPI-74 PET 在消化道肿瘤中达到 PPV/敏感性终点（NCT05641896），尚无治疗性读出，未来6个月也没有到期试验。另需注意，雷帕霉素和 REC-4881 的项目针对的是家族性腺瘤性息肉病（同为缩写 FAP），并不针对该靶点。
opps: FAPI PET 已在 NCT05641896 中得到验证，可用于筛选患者，进入本站追踪的6个放射性药物项目（如 Novartis、Immunome 177Lu-IM-3050）。尚待回答的问题是：间质摄取强度和配体在肿瘤内的滞留时间，是否足以产生治疗剂量。
本站追踪的项目全部集中在肿瘤领域，适应症列表中没有纤维化。考虑到 FAP 在活化成纤维细胞中的生物学作用，肝、肺、心脏纤维化的影像诊断和治疗仍是空白。
放射性药物之外，其他治疗手段都只有单一项目：ADC（OMTX705）、CAR-NK（EB-MF-CAR-NK-01）、融合蛋白（Roche FAP IL2V）。间质靶向药物与免疫治疗联用、以 FAP 表达水平分层患者，这两个方向都还缺少数据。

en.why: Fibroblast activation protein is a membrane serine protease. It is highly expressed on cancer-associated fibroblasts in most epithelial tumours, scarce in normal adult tissue, and also induced in fibrosis and wound healing. Because tumour stroma is so widespread, FAP is a pan-tumour handle for imaging, radioligands and stroma-directed immunotherapy.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout is diagnostic: SOFIE's [18F]FAPI-74 PET met its PPV/sensitivity endpoints in GI cancers (NCT05641896). No therapeutic readouts and no trials are due in the next six months. Note: the rapamycin and REC-4881 programs treat familial adenomatous polyposis (also abbreviated FAP), not this target.
opps: FAPI PET, validated in NCT05641896, could select patients for the six radiopharmaceutical programs tracked here (e.g., Novartis, Immunome's 177Lu-IM-3050). The open question is whether stromal uptake and how long the ligand stays in the tumour are enough to deliver a therapeutic dose.

Every program tracked here is in oncology, and no fibrosis indication is listed. Given FAP's biology in activated fibroblasts, imaging and treatment of liver, lung or cardiac fibrosis is untested white space.

Outside radiopharmaceuticals, each modality has only one program: an ADC (OMTX705), a CAR-NK (EB-MF-CAR-NK-01) and a fusion protein (Roche FAP IL2V). Combining stroma-targeted agents with immunotherapy, and selecting patients by FAP expression level, both lack data.

zh.why: FASN是从头脂肪合成（DNL）的关键酶，以乙酰CoA和丙二酰CoA合成棕榈酸。在肝脏，DNL过度活跃会加重MASH的脂肪堆积，并与炎症和纤维化相关。在皮脂腺，FASN提供皮脂的主要脂质来源，参与痤疮的发病。因此抑制FASN在代谢病和皮肤病中都有依据。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄，本站尚未收录任何读出或失败。目前追踪到的唯一项目是Sagimet的denifanstat，处于3期，适应症为寻常痤疮，2026年10月才登记。未来6个月内也没有试验到达主要终点完成，短期内不会有真正的检验。
opps: 该靶点归入MASH通路，但本站追踪的项目中没有脂肪肝适应症。可以用MRI-PDFF或DNL标志物筛选患者，开展肝脂或纤维化研究，检验同一机制在肝脏是否有效。
多种肿瘤高表达FASN，依赖它合成膜脂，但本站未追踪到任何肿瘤项目。按肿瘤FASN表达水平筛选患者，或与标准治疗联用，都还没有答案。
在痤疮中，关键问题是系统性抑制脂肪合成相对现有维A酸和激素类疗法如何定位。本站未追踪到皮肤局部或外用FASN抑制剂，这类药物可检验局部抑制皮脂能否避免系统性脂质影响。

en.why: FASN is the key enzyme of de novo lipogenesis. It builds palmitate from acetyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA. In the liver, excess lipogenesis adds to the fat buildup of MASH and is linked to inflammation and fibrosis. In sebaceous glands, FASN supplies much of the sebum lipid involved in acne. So blocking FASN has a rationale in both metabolic and skin disease.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. No readouts or failures are tracked here yet. The only tracked program is Sagimet's denifanstat in a Phase 3 acne trial, first posted in October 2026. No tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no real test is coming soon.
opps: FASN is mapped to the MASH pathway, but no tracked program is in fatty liver disease. A liver-fat or fibrosis study that selects patients using MRI-PDFF or DNL markers could show whether the mechanism works in the liver.

Many tumors overexpress FASN and rely on it to make membrane lipids, but no oncology program is tracked here. Whether to select patients by tumor FASN expression, or combine FASN inhibition with standard therapy, is still an open question.

In acne, the open question is how a systemic lipogenesis inhibitor compares with existing retinoid and hormonal treatments. No skin-restricted or topical FASN inhibitor is tracked here. One could test whether suppressing sebum locally avoids systemic lipid effects.

zh.why: FGF21是主要由肝脏分泌的代谢激素，经FGFR1c与共受体β-Klotho作用于脂肪、肝脏和中枢，可改善胰岛素敏感性、降低肝脏脂肪并具有抗纤维化作用。天然FGF21半衰期很短，因此开发方向是长效工程化类似物，主攻伴纤维化的MASH。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍很薄：5个项目中已有3个进入3期（GSK、Akero、Roche，均为重组蛋白），但尚无已收录的读出或失败，未来6个月也没有试验达到主要完成日期，第一次真正的检验要等到更晚的3期读出。
opps: 本站追踪的适应症集中在伴纤维化的MASH，酒精相关肝病仅1个项目，另有2项试验归入神经/精神领域；鉴于FGF21的中枢作用，酒精相关肝病及饮酒相关适应症值得作为假设验证。
已知模态的4个项目均为需注射的重组蛋白，追踪范围内未见口服小分子或β-Klotho/FGFR1c激动型抗体；CTTQ的2期项目模态未披露，值得关注其是否代表不同路线。
3个3期项目机制相同，差异化可能来自给药间隔、肝硬化期患者的疗效，以及与GLP-1类药物联用时是否仍有增量获益，这些是后续读出需要回答的问题。

en.why: FGF21 is a mainly liver-derived metabolic hormone that signals through FGFR1c and the co-receptor β-Klotho in fat, liver and brain. It improves insulin sensitivity, lowers liver fat and has anti-fibrotic effects. Native FGF21 has a very short half-life, so the field develops long-acting engineered analogs, mainly for MASH with fibrosis.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. Three of five programs are in Phase 3 (GSK, Akero, Roche, all recombinant proteins), but no readouts or failures are logged, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months. The first real test will be later Phase 3 readouts.
opps: Among programs tracked here, indications cluster in MASH with fibrosis. Alcohol-related liver disease has one program, and two trials fall under neuro/psychiatry. Given FGF21's central effects, alcohol-related liver disease and drinking-related indications are worth testing as hypotheses.

All four programs with a known modality are injected recombinant proteins. No oral small molecules or β-Klotho/FGFR1c agonist antibodies appear among tracked programs. The modality of CTTQ's Phase 2 program is not disclosed, so it is worth watching whether it takes a different route.

The three Phase 3 programs share one mechanism. They may separate on dosing interval, efficacy in cirrhotic patients, and whether they add benefit on top of GLP-1 drugs. Later readouts will need to answer these questions.

zh.why: FGFR2是受体酪氨酸激酶，FGFR2融合或重排可持续激活下游MAPK和PI3K信号，约10%–15%的肝内胆管癌由其驱动，是该病为数不多的可靶向致癌驱动。泛FGFR抑制剂在临床上已验证这一机制，但FGFR1相关的高磷血症以及激酶域耐药突变限制了疗效持续时间。
learned: 临床记录仍很有限：本站尚未收录任何注册试验读出，唯一信号是新闻报道的lirafugratinib获FDA批准用于经治FGFR2阳性胆管癌；未来6个月也没有试验到达主要完成日期，近期暂无明确的下一次检验节点。
opps: 本站收录的项目集中在胆管癌，仅有少数项目覆盖其他FGFR2变异实体瘤。胃癌（FGFR2扩增）、子宫内膜癌等瘤种的跨瘤种开发仍有空间，值得研究者验证。
前线FGFR抑制剂治疗后出现的耐药突变是尚未解决的问题。Cogent、Tyra、KinoTeck的早期项目能否覆盖这些突变，可结合ctDNA监测来筛选患者，以此检验与lirafugratinib的差异化。
本站收录的项目均为小分子或模式未披露，未见抗体、ADC或降解剂。一线、辅助治疗或联合用药同样缺乏收录项目，可作为新的研究假设。

en.why: FGFR2 is a receptor tyrosine kinase. FGFR2 fusions and rearrangements keep MAPK and PI3K signalling switched on and drive roughly 10–15% of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinomas, one of the few actionable drivers in that disease. Pan-FGFR inhibitors have validated the mechanism in the clinic. Their benefit is limited by FGFR1-driven hyperphosphatemia and by acquired kinase-domain resistance mutations.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. No registry readouts are tracked here. The only signal is a press-reported FDA approval of lirafugratinib for previously treated FGFR2-positive cholangiocarcinoma. No trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so there is no scheduled next test.
opps: Programs tracked here focus on cholangiocarcinoma, and only a few cover other solid tumors with FGFR2 alterations. Tumor-agnostic development, for example in FGFR2-amplified gastric or endometrial cancer, is a hypothesis worth testing.

Resistance mutations that appear after a first FGFR inhibitor are still an open problem. One test of differentiation from lirafugratinib: whether early programs from Cogent, Tyra and KinoTeck cover these mutations, with patients selected by ctDNA.

All tracked programs are small molecules or have no stated modality. None are antibodies, ADCs or degraders. First-line, adjuvant and combination settings are also missing among programs tracked here.

zh.why: FGFR3 是抑制软骨细胞增殖的受体酪氨酸激酶。功能获得性突变是软骨发育不全和软骨发育低下的遗传病因；FGFR3 突变或融合也驱动部分尿路上皮癌。erdafitinib 已获批用于 FGFR 改变的尿路上皮癌，验证了其肿瘤靶点地位。
learned: 本站跟踪的临床数据仍然有限：目前唯一的阳性结果来自 PROPEL 3，口服 infigratinib 改善了儿童软骨发育不全的身高增速，未报告药物相关停药。下一项真正的检验是软骨发育低下 2/3 期 NCT06873035，预计 2027 年 1 月达到主要完成。
opps: NCT06873035 将回答 infigratinib 的获益能否延伸到表型更轻、异质性更高的软骨发育低下。可按 FGFR3 基因型（如 N540K 与其他变异）分层，检验疗效差异。
本站跟踪的肿瘤项目仅有 Eli Lilly 一项未命名的膀胱癌 3 期和 Biohaven 一项 1 期。可验证的假设：只抑制 FGFR3、避开 FGFR1/2 的选择性抑制剂能否减轻高磷血症，从而支持联合用药或更早线别使用。
本站跟踪的骨骼发育不良项目均为 QED 的小分子。起始用药年龄、长期身高与身体比例、其他 FGFR3 相关骨病，以及抗体等其他药物形式，目前在这里都还缺乏数据。

en.why: FGFR3 is a receptor tyrosine kinase that restrains chondrocyte proliferation. Gain-of-function mutations cause achondroplasia and hypochondroplasia, and FGFR3 mutations or fusions drive a subset of urothelial cancers. Erdafitinib's approval in FGFR-altered urothelial carcinoma validates the target in oncology.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. The only positive result is PROPEL 3, where oral infigratinib improved height velocity in children with achondroplasia, with no drug-related discontinuations reported. The next real test is the Phase 2/3 hypochondroplasia trial NCT06873035, with primary completion due January 2027.
opps: NCT06873035 will show whether infigratinib's benefit extends to hypochondroplasia, a milder and more varied phenotype. Splitting patients by FGFR3 genotype (N540K versus other variants) could test whether response differs.

Among programs tracked here, oncology has only Eli Lilly's unnamed Phase 3 in bladder cancer and a Biohaven Phase 1. One hypothesis to test: an inhibitor selective for FGFR3 that spares FGFR1/2 may cause less hyperphosphatemia, which could allow combinations or earlier-line use.

All skeletal dysplasia programs tracked here are QED small molecules. Several questions have no data here yet: the best age to start treatment, long-term height and body proportions, other FGFR3-related bone disorders, and other modalities such as antibodies.

zh.why: FGFR4是FGF19在肝脏的主要受体，经共受体KLB调控胆汁酸合成。部分肝细胞癌存在FGF19扩增或过表达，驱动FGF19-FGFR4致癌信号；FGFR4独有的Cys552使选择性抑制成为可能，有望避开泛FGFR抑制剂常见的高磷血症。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：本站追踪的仅有Broadenbio的BB102，处于1期（晚期实体瘤）和2期（肝细胞癌），尚无读出、失败或终止记录，未来六个月也无试验到达主要完成日。
opps: 患者筛选可能决定成败：FGF19扩增或FGF19/KLB高表达或可界定获益人群，BB102的肝细胞癌2期是否按此富集，值得关注。
本站追踪的项目全为小分子，尚未出现抗体、ADC或降解剂等模式；FGFR4激活突变见于横纹肌肉瘤，肝外适应症也缺少针对性项目。
阻断FGF19信号会导致胆汁酸升高和腹泻，属可预见的靶点相关毒性；耐受性管理以及与肝癌现有标准治疗的联用，可能是差异化方向。

en.why: FGFR4 is the main hepatic receptor for FGF19, acting with the co-receptor KLB to regulate bile acid synthesis. Some hepatocellular carcinomas carry FGF19 amplification or overexpression that drives FGF19-FGFR4 oncogenic signalling. A cysteine (Cys552) unique to FGFR4 allows selective inhibitors that may avoid the hyperphosphataemia seen with pan-FGFR drugs.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only program tracked here is Broadenbio's BB102, in Phase 1 (advanced solid tumors) and Phase 2 (HCC). It has no readouts, failures or stops, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months.
opps: Patient selection may decide the outcome. FGF19 amplification or high FGF19/KLB expression could define who benefits, so it is worth watching whether BB102's Phase 2 HCC trial enriches for these markers.

All programs tracked here are small molecules. Antibodies, ADCs and degraders are absent, and no tracked program targets tumors outside the liver, such as rhabdomyosarcoma, where activating FGFR4 mutations occur.
Blocking FGF19 signalling predictably raises bile acids and causes diarrhea. Managing that tolerability, and combining with existing HCC standard-of-care therapies, could set a program apart.

zh.why: FGFR1-3是受体酪氨酸激酶，通过RAS–MAPK等通路驱动细胞增殖和血管生成。FGFR2融合见于部分肝内胆管癌，FGFR3突变或融合常见于尿路上皮癌，FGFR1扩增见于多种实体瘤；FGFR3功能获得性突变是软骨发育不全的遗传病因，这为该靶点提供了很强的遗传学验证。
learned: 本站跟踪的临床记录仍然有限。唯一的读出是pemigatinib一线胆管癌III期FIGHT-302（NCT03656536），记为达到，但该试验因一线标准治疗改变导致入组不足而提前终止（ops），因此不能作为否定机制的证据，解读也需谨慎。首批实质性检验将是dabogratinib尿路上皮癌研究NCT05544552（主要完成2026-11）和II/III期NCT06506955（2027-04）。
opps: FIGHT-302（NCT03656536）因一线标准治疗改变而入组困难，说明FGFR抑制剂在胆管癌中与一线免疫联合化疗的先后次序或联合方案仍是未回答的问题，可作为研究假设加以检验。
本站跟踪的项目中，低级别NMIBC、低级别上尿路尿路上皮癌和软骨发育不全各只有1个项目，主要来自Tyra。FGFR3选择性抑制剂若能避开FGFR1相关的高磷血症，或可在这些需要长期给药的人群中体现差异。
本站跟踪的11个项目中10个为小分子，FGFR扩增适应症仅1个项目。耐药突变覆盖、扩增人群的生物标志物分层，以及抗体或ADC等其他分子类型，仍是相对空白的方向。

en.why: FGFR1-3 are receptor tyrosine kinases that drive proliferation and angiogenesis through RAS–MAPK signalling. FGFR2 fusions occur in a subset of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, FGFR3 mutations and fusions are common in urothelial carcinoma, and FGFR1 is amplified in several solid tumours. Gain-of-function FGFR3 mutations cause achondroplasia, which gives the target strong genetic validation.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. The only readout is pemigatinib's Phase 3 first-line cholangiocarcinoma trial FIGHT-302 (NCT03656536). It is recorded as met, but it stopped early because enrollment dried up after the first-line standard of care changed (ops). That stop is not evidence against the mechanism, and the result should be read with caution. The first real tests will be dabogratinib in urothelial carcinoma, NCT05544552 (primary completion 2026-11), and the Phase 2/3 trial NCT06506955 (2027-04).
opps: FIGHT-302 (NCT03656536) struggled to enroll once first-line care changed. That leaves an open question in cholangiocarcinoma: how FGFR inhibitors should be sequenced or combined with first-line chemo-immunotherapy. This could be tested as a hypothesis.

Among programs tracked here, low-grade NMIBC, low-grade upper tract urothelial carcinoma and achondroplasia each have only one program, mostly from Tyra. An FGFR3-selective inhibitor that avoids FGFR1-driven hyperphosphatemia could stand out in these groups, which need long-term dosing.

Of the 11 programs tracked here, 10 are small molecules, and only one targets FGFR gene amplification. Little is being done on covering resistance mutations, selecting patients with amplification by biomarker, or other modalities such as antibodies or ADCs.

zh.why: FLT3是造血祖细胞上的受体酪氨酸激酶，约三成AML携带FLT3-ITD或TKD激活突变，其中ITD提示复发风险高、预后差。midostaurin和gilteritinib已获批，验证了这一靶点。FLT3在多数AML原始细胞表面表达，也可作为双抗和CAR-T的靶抗原。
learned: 本站目前未收录FLT3项目的读出、失败或提前终止，未来六个月内也没有试验到达主要完成日，暂时总结不出规律。现有10个项目以1期小分子为主，只有quizartinib进入3期。
opps: 非小分子路线仍少，本站仅收录CLN-049双抗和Hemogenyx的CAR-T，均处于早期。依靠表面表达而非突变，可能覆盖FLT3野生型AML；需要回答的是正常造血祖细胞和树突状细胞受损的程度。
quizartinib项目同时列出Kura Oncology，适应症中又有NPM1突变和MLL重排白血病，提示FLT3抑制剂联合menin通路的方向值得验证，可按共突变状态筛选患者。
HPB-092、Zhejiang ACEA等新小分子要做出差异，可能在于覆盖F691L守门突变和D835类TKD耐药突变，或GB3226这类双靶点设计；可以把既往FLT3抑制剂经治后的耐药人群作为切入点。

en.why: FLT3 is a receptor tyrosine kinase on hematopoietic progenitors. About a third of AML cases carry activating FLT3-ITD or TKD mutations, and ITD predicts relapse and poor outcome. Approvals of midostaurin and gilteritinib validated the target. FLT3 is also expressed on the surface of most AML blasts, which makes it an antigen for bispecifics and CAR-T.
learned: The clinical record here is still thin. This site tracks no FLT3 readouts, failures or early stops, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so there is no upcoming test to watch. Of the 10 programs, most are phase 1 small molecules. Only quizartinib is in phase 3.
opps: Few programs use something other than a small molecule. Among programs tracked here, only the CLN-049 bispecific and Hemogenyx's CAR-T do, both early. Because they target surface FLT3 rather than the mutation, they might reach FLT3-wild-type AML. The open question is how much they damage normal progenitors and dendritic cells.

The quizartinib program is co-listed with Kura Oncology, and the conditions include NPM1-mutated and MLL-rearranged leukemia. That points to FLT3-plus-menin-pathway combinations as a hypothesis worth testing, with patients selected by co-mutation status.

Newer small molecules such as HPB-092 and Zhejiang ACEA's compound might stand apart by covering F691L gatekeeper and D835-type TKD resistance mutations, or by dual-target designs like GB3226. Patients who relapse after earlier FLT3 inhibitors are a natural population to start in.

zh.why: FRα是GPI锚定的叶酸受体，结合配体后可内吞。它在多数高级别浆液性卵巢癌中高表达，在子宫内膜癌、肺癌和乳腺癌中也有表达。正常组织中的FRα多位于上皮顶端，循环中的药物较难接触，因此适合作为ADC靶点。mirvetuximab soravtansine已获批用于FRα高表达的铂耐药卵巢癌。
learned: 已有的读出还不足以检验机制。mirvetuximab的1/2期是描述性研究（NCT06390995），farletuzumab ecteribulin的2期因商业原因终止（NCT05613088），luveltamab的AML试验仅入组1例，且未说明终止原因（NCT06679582）。首批真正的检验将来自NCT06619236（Rina-S）、NCT05456685和NCT05445778（mirvetuximab）。
opps: 本站追踪的后期开发集中在卵巢癌，AbbVie、Genmab、Lilly、AstraZeneca等共有6个3期项目。表达FRα的子宫内膜癌、肺腺癌和三阴性乳腺癌项目较少，可以作为后来者寻求差异化的方向。
较新的ADC能否用于FRα低或中表达的肿瘤，而不只限于FRα高表达人群，是患者选择上的关键问题。Rina-S的3期（NCT06619236）和mirvetuximab的后续试验（NCT05456685、NCT05445778）有望说明表达水平还有多大影响。
本站追踪的项目几乎都是抗体或偶联药物，没有CAR-T或T细胞衔接器。Epsilogen的MOv18 IgE是唯一尝试其他效应机制的项目。luveltamab的AML试验已终止（NCT06679582），FRα在血液肿瘤细分人群中的价值仍不清楚。

en.why: FRα is a GPI-anchored folate receptor that internalizes after binding its ligand. It is overexpressed in most high-grade serous ovarian cancers and also appears in endometrial, lung and breast tumours. In normal tissue it sits mostly on apical epithelial surfaces that circulating drugs reach poorly, which makes it a natural ADC target. Mirvetuximab soravtansine is approved for FRα-high platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.
learned: The record so far is too thin to test the mechanism. The mirvetuximab phase 1/2 was descriptive (NCT06390995), the farletuzumab ecteribulin phase 2 stopped for business reasons (NCT05613088), and a one-patient luveltamab AML trial ended without a stated cause (NCT06679582). The first real tests will be NCT06619236 (Rina-S) and NCT05456685 and NCT05445778 (mirvetuximab).
opps: Among programs tracked here, late-stage work is concentrated in ovarian cancer, with six phase 3 programs from AbbVie, Genmab, Lilly, AstraZeneca and others. FRα-expressing endometrial, lung adenocarcinoma and triple-negative breast cancers have few programs and could be where a newer entrant stands apart.

A key patient-selection question is whether newer ADCs work in FRα-low or FRα-medium tumours, beyond the FRα-high patients now treated with mirvetuximab. The Rina-S phase 3 (NCT06619236) and the mirvetuximab trials (NCT05456685, NCT05445778) should help show how much expression level still matters.

Tracked programs are almost all antibodies or conjugates, with no CAR-T or T-cell engager. Epsilogen's MOv18 IgE is the only one testing a different effector mechanism. The luveltamab AML stop (NCT06679582) leaves FRα's value in haematological niches unresolved.

zh.why: 活化FVIII作为辅因子，把FIXa与FX拉近，驱动内源性tenase复合物生成凝血酶。FIXa×FX双抗模拟这一桥接功能，不受FVIII抑制物影响，可皮下给药、给药间隔长。Emicizumab已于2017年获批用于A型血友病，验证了这一机制。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍然很少：4个项目均处于3期，分属Roche与Novo Nordisk两家公司，但目前没有已收录的读出或失败，未来6个月也没有达到主要完成日期的试验，暂时没有即将到来的数据可作为下一代分子的首次检验。
opps: 适应症向先天性A型血友病以外延伸：在本站追踪的项目中，获得性A型血友病和3型VWD各只有1个项目涉及。FVIII缺失或被清除的人群是否同样适合桥接机制，值得验证。
下一代分子的差异化：NXT007（7项试验）和Denecimig（即Mim8）都在挑战Emicizumab。关键未解问题是，更高的类FVIII活性能否带来更低出血率或更长给药间隔，同时不增加血栓风险。
本站追踪的项目均为双抗，或模态未注明。小分子、纳米抗体或基因编码表达的桥接分子尚属空白，可作为探索方向。

en.why: Activated FVIII is a cofactor that brings FIXa and FX together, driving the intrinsic tenase complex that makes thrombin. FIXa×FX bispecific antibodies copy this bridging function. They work whether or not FVIII inhibitors are present, are given subcutaneously and allow long dosing intervals. Emicizumab, approved for haemophilia A in 2017, validated the mechanism.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. All 4 programs are in Phase 3, from just two companies, Roche and Novo Nordisk. No readouts or failures are tracked yet, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so no upcoming readout is lined up to first test the next-generation molecules.
opps: Moving beyond congenital haemophilia A: among programs tracked here, acquired haemophilia A and type 3 von Willebrand disease have one program each. It is worth testing whether bridging works as well in patients whose FVIII is missing or being cleared.

Setting next-generation molecules apart: NXT007 (7 trials) and Denecimig (Mim8) both challenge Emicizumab. The open question is whether higher FVIII-like activity gives fewer bleeds or longer dosing intervals without raising thrombotic risk.
Every program tracked here is a bispecific antibody or has no stated modality. Small molecules, nanobodies and gene-encoded bridging molecules are untested white space.

zh.why: FXR是肝脏和肠道中感知胆汁酸的核受体，激活后经SHP及肠道FGF19抑制CYP7A1，减少胆汁酸合成、促进胆汁酸外排，并有抗炎和抗纤维化作用。因此它一直是原发性胆汁性胆管炎（PBC）等胆汁淤积性肝病和MASH的经典靶点。
learned: 本站仅追踪到Intercept两项obeticholic acid II期PBC试验，均达ALP主要终点（NCT05239468、联用bezafibrate的NCT04594694），后者因FDA要求Ocaliva自愿撤市而出于商业原因终止；未来六个月无读出，临床记录仍很薄。
opps: NCT04594694提示FXR激动联合贝特类可降低PBC患者ALP；在Ocaliva路径受阻后，可假设换用安全性更好的FXR激动剂延续这一联合策略。
本站追踪的项目均为同一公司的同一胆汁酸衍生分子；非甾体或肠道限制性FXR激动剂（经FGF19起效）尚未出现，可检验肠道激活能否保留疗效并降低全身暴露。
尽管通路标签为MASH，本站未追踪到MASH或原发性硬化性胆管炎项目，且ALP只是替代终点；FXR获益能否延伸至组织学或临床结局仍待验证。

en.why: FXR is a bile-acid-sensing nuclear receptor in liver and gut. Activation represses CYP7A1 via SHP and intestinal FGF19, cutting bile acid synthesis and boosting bile acid export, with anti-inflammatory and antifibrotic effects. That makes it a long-standing target in cholestatic liver disease such as primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) and in MASH.
learned: Among programs tracked here, the record is two Intercept Phase 2 PBC trials of obeticholic acid, both meeting the ALP endpoint (NCT05239468; NCT04594694 with bezafibrate). The latter was stopped for business reasons after FDA's withdrawal request for Ocaliva. No readouts are due in six months, so the record stays thin.
opps: NCT04594694 suggests FXR agonism plus a fibrate lowers ALP in PBC. One hypothesis: a different FXR agonist with a cleaner safety profile could carry this combination forward now that the Ocaliva-based path has stalled.

Every tracked program is the same bile-acid-derived molecule from one company. Non-steroidal or gut-restricted FXR agonists acting through FGF19 are absent here. They could test whether activating FXR in the gut keeps the biliary benefit with less systemic exposure.

Although the pathway tag is MASH, no MASH or primary sclerosing cholangitis programs are tracked here. ALP is also only a surrogate endpoint. Whether FXR's benefit extends to histology or clinical outcomes remains untested in this dataset.

zh.why: FcRH5（FCRL5）是B细胞谱系表面受体，几乎在所有多发性骨髓瘤患者的浆细胞上表达，且表达不依赖BCMA，因此适合作为T细胞衔接器靶点。它同样标记正常B细胞和浆细胞，清除FcRH5阳性细胞也被用于探索系统性红斑狼疮等自身抗体驱动的疾病。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄。本站追踪的唯一项目是Roche的FcRH5×CD3双抗Cevostamab（3期，11项试验），目前尚无收录的读出，未来六个月也没有试验到达主要完成节点，近期缺少检验节点。
opps: 在本站追踪范围内，FcRH5仅有一家公司的一个双抗项目，ADC、CAR-T或三特异性抗体尚属空白。可以检验其他模式能否在疗效、给药便利性或细胞因子释放风险上形成差异。
FcRH5的表达不依赖BCMA，可以把BCMA或GPRC5D疗法失败后的人群作为研究对象，同时评估靶点密度和T细胞功能状态能否作为疗效预测标志物。
Cevostamab已进入狼疮研究，但在本站追踪范围内，自身免疫病中只有SLE一项。同时清除B细胞和浆细胞能否带来持久缓解，以及能否扩展到其他自身抗体疾病，仍有待检验。

en.why: FcRH5 (FCRL5) is a B-lineage surface receptor found on myeloma plasma cells in nearly all patients, and its expression does not depend on BCMA. That makes it a target for T-cell engagers. Because it also marks normal B cells and plasma cells, depleting FcRH5-positive cells is being explored in autoantibody-driven disease such as systemic lupus erythematosus.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only program tracked here is Roche's FcRH5×CD3 bispecific cevostamab (Phase 3, 11 trials). No readouts are recorded yet, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no test is due in the near term.
opps: Among programs tracked here, FcRH5 has one bispecific from one company. ADCs, CAR-T and trispecifics are absent. Researchers could test whether other modalities differ in efficacy, dosing convenience or cytokine-release risk.

FcRH5 expression does not depend on BCMA, so patients who relapse after BCMA- or GPRC5D-directed therapy are a natural population to study. Target density and T-cell fitness could be tested as response biomarkers.

Cevostamab has moved into lupus, but SLE is the only autoimmune indication tracked here. Two questions remain open: does depleting both B cells and plasma cells give durable remission, and does the approach extend to other autoantibody diseases?

zh.why: FcRn 在内体酸性环境中结合 IgG 并将其回收至细胞外，使 IgG 半衰期明显延长。阻断 FcRn 可加速包括致病性自身抗体在内的全部 IgG 降解，因此适用于 IgG 自身抗体驱动的疾病。efgartigimod 已获批用于全身型重症肌无力（gMG），验证了这一机制。
learned: 在干燥综合征中，同一机制结果出现分歧：nipocalimab 的 2 期试验 NCT04968912 达到主要终点，而 efgartigimod 皮下制剂的 UNITY 试验在期中分析后因无效终止。可见机制本身不能保证疗效，分子特性与入组人群同样关键。
batoclimab 在 gMG（NCT05403541）和 CIDP（NCT05581199、NCT07188844）的试验均因申办方决定终止，归为商业原因，不能作为否定机制的证据。同期 Immunovant 的 IMVT-1402 已推进 8 项试验，与公司转向下一代分子的判断相符。
gMG 是最拥挤的适应症。argenx 近期读出的 ADAPT SERON（NCT06298552，血清阴性患者）和 ADAPT NXT（NCT04980495，给药方案）均无正式统计检验，更多是在细分人群和给药方式上做生命周期扩展；肌炎 ALKIVIA 达到终点，说明适应症正向 MG 以外延伸。
在本站追踪的 14 个项目中，模态只有单抗和 Fc 融合蛋白两类，竞争主要靠给药途径、间隔和适应症布局来区分，而不是作用机制。
opps: MG 以外的抗体介导疾病仍是空白较多的方向：nipocalimab 的 CIDP 试验 NCT05327114、IMVT-1402 的亚急性皮肤型红斑狼疮试验 NCT06980805 以及 rozanolixizumab 的 MOGAD 试验 NCT05063162 将检验这一机制能否推广。
干燥综合征两项结果分歧，提示可以用自身抗体谱或 IgG 下降深度作为生物标志物筛选患者。nipocalimab 3 期 NCT06741969 将回答 2 期获益能否重复。
本站追踪的项目中尚无口服小分子，也没有 FcRn 阻断联合 B 细胞或浆细胞清除的方案，这两者可作为区别于拥挤生物制剂的研究假设。

en.why: FcRn binds IgG in acidic endosomes and recycles it back to the circulation, which greatly extends IgG half-life. Blocking FcRn speeds up degradation of all IgG, pathogenic autoantibodies included, so it fits diseases driven by IgG autoantibodies. Efgartigimod's approval in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) validated the mechanism.
learned: Sjögren's results split on the same mechanism: nipocalimab's Phase 2 NCT04968912 met its primary endpoint, while subcutaneous efgartigimod's UNITY trial was stopped for futility after an interim analysis. The mechanism alone does not guarantee benefit. The molecule and the patients enrolled matter too.

Batoclimab trials in gMG (NCT05403541) and CIDP (NCT05581199, NCT07188844) all stopped by sponsor decision, coded as business. That is not evidence against the mechanism. Meanwhile Immunovant's IMVT-1402 now has 8 trials, which fits a shift to its next-generation molecule.

gMG is the most crowded indication. argenx's recent readouts, ADAPT SERON (NCT06298552, seronegative patients) and ADAPT NXT (NCT04980495, dosing regimens), had no formal statistical test and look like lifecycle extension. The positive ALKIVIA myositis result shows the target moving beyond MG.
All 14 programs tracked here are monoclonal antibodies or Fc fusion proteins. They compete on route of administration, dosing interval and choice of indication, not on mechanism.
opps: Antibody-driven diseases outside MG are less crowded. Nipocalimab in CIDP (NCT05327114), IMVT-1402 in subacute cutaneous lupus (NCT06980805) and rozanolixizumab in MOGAD (NCT05063162) will test whether the mechanism carries over.
The split in Sjögren's suggests picking patients by autoantibody profile or by how far IgG falls. Nipocalimab's Phase 3 NCT06741969 will show whether the Phase 2 benefit holds up.

No oral small molecules appear among programs tracked here, and neither does FcRn blockade combined with B-cell or plasma-cell depletion. Both are open hypotheses for standing apart from the crowded biologics.

zh.why: GABA-A受体是五聚体氯离子通道，介导脑内主要的快速抑制性传递。神经甾体通过正向变构调节突触及含δ亚基的突触外受体，增强张力性抑制。抑制不足与癫痫性脑病及围产期情绪障碍相关，苯二氮䓬类早已验证该靶点的可成药性。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍然很薄：两个项目均为III期小分子（Immedica的ganaxolone和Lipocine一个未命名分子），尚无读出、失败或提前终止记录，未来6个月也没有到达主要完成的试验，近期缺少可检验的节点。
opps: 本站追踪项目仅覆盖CDKL5缺乏症和产后抑郁。其他发育性癫痫性脑病，以及非产后的抑郁症，可作为检验神经甾体机制能否外推的假设方向。
目前两个项目均为小分子正向调节剂，本站未见亚基选择性分子，如α2/α3选择性或δ亚基突触外选择性分子。这类分子有望把疗效与镇静分开，是值得验证的差异化思路。
Lipocine项目于2026年9月登记，可借此观察给药途径和疗程能否在产后抑郁中形成差异；EEG β功率等药效学标志物也可用于剂量选择和患者分层。

en.why: GABA-A receptors are pentameric chloride channels that carry most fast inhibitory signalling in the brain. Neurosteroids positively modulate both synaptic receptors and extrasynaptic δ-containing receptors, boosting tonic inhibition. Too little inhibition is linked to epileptic encephalopathies and perinatal mood disorders, and benzodiazepines long ago showed the target can be drugged.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. Both programs are Phase 3 small molecules: Immedica's ganaxolone and an unnamed Lipocine compound. Neither has a readout, failure or early stop on record, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term test is scheduled.
opps: Tracked programs cover only CDKL5 deficiency disorder and postpartum depression. Other developmental and epileptic encephalopathies, and depression outside the postpartum setting, are hypotheses for testing whether the neurosteroid mechanism carries over.

Both programs are small-molecule positive modulators. No subunit-selective agents, such as α2/α3- or δ-extrasynaptic-selective molecules, are tracked here. Such agents might separate efficacy from sedation, which makes them a differentiation idea worth testing.

The Lipocine program, registered in September 2026, offers a chance to see whether route and treatment length set a postpartum depression therapy apart. Pharmacodynamic markers such as EEG beta power could guide dosing and patient selection.

zh.why: GAD65是胰岛β细胞的主要自身抗原，抗GAD65抗体是1型糖尿病最常见、出现最早的标志物之一。抗原特异性免疫治疗想通过反复呈递GAD65诱导免疫耐受和调节性T细胞，在不做广泛免疫抑制的情况下保住残余β细胞功能。
learned: 临床记录仍然很少。本站追踪的唯一后期数据是Diamyd Medical的DIAGNODE-3（NCT05018585），GAD抗原联合colecalciferol在β细胞功能和血糖控制上均未达到主要终点，并因无效提前终止。未来六个月没有待读出的试验，短期内不会有新的检验。
opps: NCT05018585因无效终止，但亚组数据仍可能有参考价值：按HLA基因型、GAD抗体滴度、病程和残余C肽分层，看是否存在应答人群，可作为后续患者筛选的假设。
本站追踪的项目只覆盖新发1型糖尿病。在自身抗体阳性、尚未发病的1期或2期人群中，β细胞储备更多，抗原特异性耐受是否更容易起效仍是未检验的问题。
本站目前只追踪到一种重组蛋白加佐剂的方案。耐受性纳米颗粒、核酸编码抗原、抗原特异性Treg细胞，或与抗CD3等免疫调节剂联用，都可以检验是递送方式不对，还是靶点本身不够。

en.why: GAD65 is a major beta-cell autoantigen, and anti-GAD65 antibodies are among the earliest and most common markers of type 1 diabetes. Antigen-specific immunotherapy aims to induce tolerance and regulatory T cells by repeated exposure to GAD65, so that residual beta-cell function is preserved without broad immunosuppression.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only late-stage readout tracked here is Diamyd Medical's DIAGNODE-3 (NCT05018585): GAD antigen plus colecalciferol missed its primary endpoints on beta-cell function and glycemic control and stopped for futility. No trials read out in the next six months, so no new test is coming soon.
opps: NCT05018585 stopped for futility, but its subgroup data may still help. Stratifying by HLA genotype, GAD antibody titer, disease duration and residual C-peptide could show whether any subset responded, which would give a patient-selection hypothesis.

Among programs tracked here, only new-onset type 1 diabetes is covered. Whether antigen-specific tolerance works better in autoantibody-positive stage 1–2 people, who have more beta cells left, has not been tested.

Only one approach is tracked: recombinant protein with adjuvant. Tolerogenic nanoparticles, nucleic-acid-encoded antigen, antigen-specific Treg cells, or pairing with immunomodulators such as anti-CD3 could test whether the problem is the delivery or the target itself.

zh.why: GBA1编码溶酶体酶GCase。双等位突变导致戈谢病，杂合变异是帕金森病最常见的遗传风险因素。GCase活性下降会使葡萄糖神经酰胺蓄积，并促进α-突触核蛋白聚集，因此通过分子伴侣、激活剂或基因治疗恢复酶活性，被视为疾病修饰策略。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄。唯一读出是ambroxol的NCT06193421，因申办方决定提前终止，属商业原因，不能作为机制无效的证据。未来六个月内，本站追踪的试验中没有一项到达主要完成节点。
opps: 可按GBA1变异严重程度分层入组，或用GCase活性、葡萄糖鞘氨醇等生物标志物筛选患者，有望更早看到信号。本站追踪的项目中，明确限定GBA1人群的很少。
三个项目均处于1/2期：两项为小分子，一项为Capsida的基因治疗。本站追踪范围内尚无脑穿透型酶替代等其他方式，哪种递送方式最能恢复脑内GCase仍待检验。
本站追踪的试验全部集中在帕金森病。GBA1变异同样是路易体痴呆的强风险因素，该适应症以及GCase活性偏低的散发性PD，目前在本站追踪范围内仍是空白。

en.why: GBA1 encodes the lysosomal enzyme GCase. Biallelic mutations cause Gaucher disease, and heterozygous variants are the most common genetic risk factor for Parkinson's disease. Low GCase activity lets glucosylceramide build up and promotes alpha-synuclein aggregation. Restoring enzyme activity with chaperones, activators or gene therapy is therefore pursued as a disease-modifying strategy.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout, ambroxol in NCT06193421, was stopped early by sponsor decision. That is a business reason and is not evidence against the mechanism. No tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months.
opps: Enrolling patients by GBA1 variant severity, or selecting them with biomarkers such as GCase activity or glucosylsphingosine, may show signals earlier. Few programs tracked here explicitly limit enrollment to a GBA1 population.

All three programs are in phase 1/2: two small molecules and one Capsida gene therapy. Among programs tracked here, none uses brain-penetrant enzyme replacement or other modalities. Which delivery route best restores brain GCase is still an open question.

All tracked trials are in Parkinson's disease. GBA1 variants are also a strong risk factor for dementia with Lewy bodies. That indication, and sporadic PD with low GCase activity, are not addressed by any program tracked here.

zh.why: GDF15是TGF-β超家族中由应激诱导的细胞因子，通过后脑最后区的GFRAL-RET受体引起厌食、恶心和体重下降，在癌症恶病质中常见高表达。GDF15也被认为能抑制T细胞向肿瘤浸润，因此中和GDF15既可能改善恶病质，也可能增强免疫治疗疗效。
learned: 临床证据仍然很少：本站追踪的6个项目均处于1至2期，尚无读出，也没有失败或提前终止记录，未来6个月内也没有试验到达主要完成日期，目前无法判断该机制在临床上是否成立。
opps: 已追踪项目几乎都是单抗，且全部集中在肿瘤领域（NSCLC、HCC、胰腺癌及恶病质）。GFRAL拮抗剂、小分子等非抗体路径，以及妊娠剧吐、化疗相关恶心等非肿瘤适应症，在本站追踪范围内仍属空白。
可以检验血清GDF15水平能否作为入组标准，用于筛选更可能从中和治疗中获益的恶病质或免疫治疗患者。目前项目尚未体现基于生物标志物的分层设计。
同一抗体同时用于改善恶病质和联合免疫治疗。需要厘清的是，抗肿瘤获益与体重、食欲改善能否在同一批患者中同时出现，以及哪一类终点更适合用来注册。

en.why: GDF15 is a stress-induced TGF-β superfamily cytokine. It acts on GFRAL-RET receptors in the hindbrain area postrema to drive anorexia, nausea and weight loss, and it is often elevated in cancer cachexia. GDF15 is also thought to block T-cell entry into tumors, so neutralizing it could both ease cachexia and make immunotherapy work better.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. All six programs tracked here are in Phase 1 to 2. None has a readout, none has failed or stopped early, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so the mechanism has not yet been tested clinically.
opps: Nearly all tracked programs are monoclonal antibodies, all in oncology (NSCLC, HCC, pancreatic cancer, cachexia). Among programs tracked here, nobody is pursuing non-antibody routes such as GFRAL antagonists or small molecules, or non-cancer uses such as hyperemesis gravidarum or chemotherapy-induced nausea.

Serum GDF15 levels could be tested as an entry criterion to pick cachexia or immunotherapy patients most likely to benefit from neutralization. No biomarker-stratified design is visible in the programs tracked here.

The same antibodies are being aimed at both cachexia and immunotherapy combinations. Open questions: do anti-tumor benefit and weight or appetite gains show up in the same patients, and which endpoint is the better route to registration?

zh.why: GIPR 是肠促胰素 GIP 的受体（B 类 GPCR），见于β细胞、脂肪和中枢，促进葡萄糖依赖的胰岛素分泌，并影响脂肪储存与食欲。与 GLP-1 激动联用（如 tirzepatide）可增强降糖减重；GIPR 功能缺失变异与较低 BMI 相关，拮抗路线也有依据。
learned: 含 GIPR 的多靶点激动剂减重疗效已有较充分验证：retatrutide 在 TRIUMPH-1/-2/-3 三期均报告阳性，本站追踪的 9 个项目全部处于三期。问题已从是否有效转向如何差异化。
减重不一定带动器官特异性终点：retatrutide 二期研究 NCT05936151 以第 24 周实测 GFR 变化为主要终点，未达到，是本站记录的唯一疗效失败。肾脏获益可能需要更长的专门设计。
激动与拮抗两条路线均已进入三期：Amgen 的 maridebart cafraglutide 是阻断 GIPR、同时偶联 GLP-1 激动肽的抗体，与 8 个多肽激动剂项目并行。两种方向都能减重，说明 GIPR 的确切作用仍未厘清。
心血管结局证据仍待解读：入组超 1.3 万人的 SURPASS-CVOT（NCT04255433）在本站记为无统计检验，既不算成功也不算失败。ASCVD 与 HFpEF 各只有 2 个项目布局。
opps: OSA、肝病与神经领域布局稀少。HRS9531 的两项 OSA 三期（NCT06994650、NCT06974851）将检验 GIPR 共激动在肥胖并发症中的价值。
T1D 尚少验证。tirzepatide 两项三期（NCT06962280、NCT06914895）将检验其辅助胰岛素治疗的价值；鉴于 GIP 促进胰高血糖素分泌，低血糖安全性需重点观察。
模态与人群选择较单一：9 个项目中 8 个为注射多肽、1 个为抗体，未见口服小分子。按 GIPR 变异分层，或开展激动与拮抗的机制对照研究，或可明确哪些患者从 GIPR 组分获益最多。

en.why: GIPR is the class B GPCR for the incretin GIP. It is found on beta cells, in fat tissue and in the brain. It boosts glucose-dependent insulin secretion and affects fat storage and appetite. Adding it to GLP-1 agonism, as in tirzepatide, increases glucose and weight lowering. Human GIPR loss-of-function variants are linked to lower BMI, which also supports antagonism.
learned: Weight loss with GIPR-containing multi-agonists is now well supported. Retatrutide reported positive phase 3 results in TRIUMPH-1, -2 and -3, and all nine programs tracked here are in phase 3. The question is no longer whether it works but how to stand out.

Weight loss does not automatically move organ-specific endpoints. A phase 2 retatrutide study (NCT05936151) missed its primary endpoint, change in measured GFR at week 24. It is the only efficacy failure tracked here. Kidney claims may need longer, dedicated designs.

Agonism and antagonism have both reached phase 3. Amgen's maridebart cafraglutide, an antibody that blocks GIPR and carries GLP-1 agonist peptides, runs alongside eight peptide agonist programs. Since both directions produce weight loss, GIPR's exact role remains unresolved.

Cardiovascular outcome evidence still needs interpretation. SURPASS-CVOT (NCT04255433), with over 13,000 participants, is recorded here as having no formal hypothesis test, so it counts as neither a hit nor a miss. Only two programs each address ASCVD and HFpEF.
opps: Few programs cover OSA, liver disease or neurology. Hengrui's two HRS9531 OSA phase 3 trials (NCT06994650, NCT06974851) will test whether GIPR co-agonism adds value in obesity complications.

Type 1 diabetes is largely untested. Two tirzepatide phase 3 trials (NCT06962280, NCT06914895) will test its value as an add-on to insulin. Because GIP stimulates glucagon release, hypoglycemia safety deserves close watching.

Modalities and patient selection are narrow: eight of nine programs are injectable peptides and one is an antibody, with no oral small molecule. Stratifying by GIPR variants, or mechanistic studies comparing agonism with antagonism, could show which patients benefit most from the GIPR component.

zh.why: GLP-1R 为 B 类 GPCR，表达于胰岛 β 细胞、下丘脑/后脑和胃肠道，激活后葡萄糖依赖性促进胰岛素分泌、抑制胰高血糖素、延缓胃排空并抑制食欲。liraglutide、semaglutide 早已获批用于 2 型糖尿病和肥胖，并有心血管结局获益，是代谢领域验证最充分的靶点之一。
learned: 口服小分子已在三期得到验证：orforglipron 在肥胖（NCT05869903、NCT05872620）和 2 型糖尿病中达到主要终点，并对口服 semaglutide 显示非劣效（NCT06045221）；本站追踪的小分子项目达 16 个。
减重和 HbA1c 终点几乎全部达到，唯一失败的是器官功能终点：retatrutide 肥胖三期阳性，但 24 周实测 GFR 未改善（NCT05936151），说明减重不等于短期肾功能获益。
获益可延伸到合并症终点：semaglutide 在 HFpEF 合并糖尿病人群中改善 KCCQ 评分（NCT04916470）；SURPASS-CVOT（NCT04255433）以 dulaglutide 为活性对照，本站记为无统计检验。
赛道拥挤：本站追踪的 53 个项目中 29 个处于三期，涉及 45 家公司。后来者转向多靶点（retatrutide、survodutide、CagriSema）、延长给药间隔（月制剂 bofanglutide、抗体类 maridebart cafraglutide）或口服来做差异化。
opps: 本站追踪的非代谢适应症试验仍少（神经/精神 4 项、消化/肝 2 项）。OSA（NCT06649045）、酒精使用障碍（NCT06987513）和膝骨关节炎（NCT07225829）的读出将检验中枢和抗炎作用能否独立于减重。
MASH 仅有 4 个项目；efinopegdutide（NCT06465186）、survodutide 等胰高血糖素共激动剂可直接作用于肝脏，可检验其能否在肝脏终点上与单靶点 GLP-1 激动剂拉开差距。
retatrutide 实测 GFR 未达标（NCT05936151）后，问题仍待回答：肾脏获益是否需要更长疗程，或需富集基线 CKD、高滤过人群。这可作为后续肾脏试验设计的假设。

en.why: GLP-1R is a class B GPCR on pancreatic beta cells, hypothalamic and hindbrain neurons, and the gut. Activation boosts glucose-dependent insulin release, suppresses glucagon, slows gastric emptying and curbs appetite. Liraglutide and semaglutide have long been approved for type 2 diabetes and obesity and have shown cardiovascular outcome benefit, making GLP-1R one of the best-validated metabolic targets.
learned: Oral small molecules now work at Phase 3: orforglipron met primary endpoints in obesity (NCT05869903, NCT05872620) and type 2 diabetes, including non-inferiority to oral semaglutide (NCT06045221). This site tracks 16 small-molecule programs.

Weight and HbA1c endpoints almost always hit. The one tracked miss is an organ-function endpoint: retatrutide succeeded in Phase 3 obesity trials but did not improve measured GFR at 24 weeks (NCT05936151), so weight loss does not guarantee short-term kidney gains.

Benefit carries into comorbidity endpoints: semaglutide improved KCCQ scores in HFpEF with diabetes (NCT04916470). SURPASS-CVOT (NCT04255433) compared tirzepatide with active dulaglutide and is logged here with no formal hypothesis test.

The field is crowded: 29 of the 53 programs tracked here are in Phase 3, spread across 45 companies. Newer entrants compete on co-agonism (retatrutide, survodutide, CagriSema), longer dosing intervals (once-monthly bofanglutide, antibody-based maridebart cafraglutide) or oral delivery.
opps: Few tracked trials cover non-metabolic indications (4 neuro/psychiatric, 2 GI/liver). Readouts in sleep apnea (NCT06649045), alcohol use disorder (NCT06987513) and knee osteoarthritis (NCT07225829) will test whether central and anti-inflammatory effects hold up apart from weight loss.

Only four tracked programs target MASH. Glucagon co-agonists act directly on the liver, including efinopegdutide (NCT06465186) and survodutide. They could test whether liver endpoints separate co-agonists from pure GLP-1 agonists.

After the retatrutide mGFR miss (NCT05936151), it is still unclear whether kidney benefit needs longer exposure or patients selected for baseline CKD or hyperfiltration. That is a working hypothesis for designing future renal trials.

zh.why: GPC3是GPI锚定的硫酸乙酰肝素蛋白聚糖，属典型的癌胚抗原：在多数肝细胞癌中高表达，而在正常成人组织中几乎不表达，并参与Wnt等生长信号。这种肿瘤选择性使其成为CAR-T、ADC和T细胞衔接类药物在肝癌中的主要靶点之一。
learned: 临床证据仍很有限：本站追踪的13个项目分属12家公司，全部处于1至2期，其中7个为细胞治疗，但尚无读出或失败记录，未来6个月也无主要完成节点，近期难以从本站数据验证该机制。
opps: 适应症几乎集中于肝细胞癌，鳞状非小细胞肺癌仅1个项目；GPC3阳性的其他实体瘤（如肝母细胞瘤）在本站追踪中尚属空白，可作为扩展方向。
细胞治疗以自体CAR-T为主，CAR-NK、armored构建体和ADC仍处早期；通用型或可克服肝脏免疫抑制微环境的设计可能是差异化方向。
仅1个项目在入组标准中明确要求GPC3阳性，按GPC3表达水平分层筛选患者，或可帮助厘清疗效与靶点密度的关系。

en.why: GPC3 is a GPI-anchored heparan sulfate proteoglycan and a classic oncofetal antigen. It is highly expressed in most hepatocellular carcinomas, barely present in normal adult tissue, and modulates Wnt and other growth signals. That tumour selectivity makes it one of the main targets for CAR-T, ADC and T-cell-engaging approaches in liver cancer.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The 13 programs tracked here come from 12 companies and are all in phase 1-2; 7 are cell therapies. There are no readouts or failures yet, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term test is tracked here.
opps: Nearly every program targets hepatocellular carcinoma; only one covers squamous NSCLC. Other GPC3-positive solid tumours, such as hepatoblastoma, are untouched among programs tracked here and could be worth exploring.

Most cell therapies are autologous CAR-T. CAR-NK, armored constructs and ADCs are all early. Off-the-shelf formats or designs that resist the immunosuppressive liver microenvironment could set a program apart.
Only one program explicitly requires GPC3-positive disease. Selecting or stratifying patients by GPC3 expression level could show how response depends on antigen density.

zh.why: GPRC5D是一种孤儿G蛋白偶联受体，在恶性浆细胞上高表达，正常组织中主要见于毛囊、甲床和舌乳头等角化组织，因此适合作为多发性骨髓瘤的靶点。其表达不依赖BCMA，可为BCMA疗法后复发的患者提供另一条靶向路径；角化组织表达也提示皮肤、指甲和味觉相关的on-target毒性。
learned: 目前最明确的阳性证据来自GPRC5D与BCMA联合靶向：talquetamab联合teclistamab的MonumenTAL-6三期顶线阳性，IASO的BCMA/GPRC5D双靶CAR-T RD140一期也有积极信号，提示双抗原覆盖可能是主要发展方向。
Roche的forimtamig联合carfilzomib研究（NCT06055075）因申办方决定停止开发而提前终止。该研究为安全性终点、无统计检验，这次终止不能作为否定机制的证据，更可能反映后来者难以与领先的talquetamab拉开差异。
在本站追踪的12个项目中，细胞治疗占6个，多为中国公司的一期研究，但目前还没有带正式统计检验的CAR-T读出。管线虽然拥挤，临床验证仍集中在J&J一家。
opps: 适应症方面，本站追踪的项目中只有1个涉及原发性浆细胞白血病，这一高侵袭性浆细胞疾病中GPRC5D疗法的作用仍有待研究。
在本站追踪的项目中未见ADC或体内CAR等形式；通过亲和力调节或新型分子形式减轻皮肤、指甲和味觉毒性，可能是与talquetamab形成差异的切入点。
未来6个月本站未追踪到即将完成主要终点的试验。BCMA治疗后GPRC5D表达状态与抗原丢失能否用于患者筛选，以及MonumenTAL-6之后单靶向疗法在早线中如何定位，仍是未回答的问题。

en.why: GPRC5D is an orphan G protein-coupled receptor that is highly expressed on malignant plasma cells. In normal tissue it is largely confined to hair follicles, nail beds and tongue papillae, which makes it a workable myeloma target. Its expression does not depend on BCMA, so it offers a second route after BCMA therapy fails. The keratinised-tissue expression also predicts on-target skin, nail and taste toxicity.
learned: The clearest positive evidence comes from hitting GPRC5D and BCMA together. MonumenTAL-6 (talquetamab plus teclistamab) reported positive Phase 3 topline results, and IASO's BCMA/GPRC5D dual CAR-T RD140 showed a positive Phase 1 signal. Covering both antigens looks like the main direction.

Roche's forimtamig plus carfilzomib study (NCT06055075) was stopped early because the sponsor dropped forimtamig. It had a safety endpoint and no formal test, so the stop is not evidence against the mechanism. More likely it shows how hard it is for followers to stand apart from talquetamab.

Cell therapies make up 6 of the 12 programs tracked here, mostly Phase 1 studies from Chinese companies. None has yet produced a readout with a formal statistical test. The pipeline is crowded, but clinical validation still rests mainly on J&J.
opps: Among programs tracked here, only one addresses primary plasma cell leukaemia. What GPRC5D therapy can do in this aggressive plasma cell disease is still an open question.
No ADC or in vivo CAR programs appear among those tracked here. New formats or affinity tuning that reduce skin, nail and taste toxicity could be a way to stand apart from talquetamab.

No tracked trials reach primary completion in the next six months. Two questions remain open: whether GPRC5D expression or antigen loss after BCMA therapy can guide patient selection, and where single-target agents fit in earlier lines after MonumenTAL-6.

zh.why: GR是配体激活的核受体，介导皮质醇的大部分作用。激动GR可抑制炎症，但长期使用会带来代谢、骨骼等毒性；在肿瘤中，GR激活可上调抗凋亡基因，削弱化疗效果。因此这个靶点同时有两条开发方向：解离型激动剂和选择性拮抗剂。
learned: 临床数据仍然有限，且本站跟踪的两个项目方向相反：拮抗剂Relacorilant的卵巢肿瘤III期NCT05257408达到主要终点（BICR评估的PFS及OS）；解离型激动剂Vamorolone的Becker肌营养不良II期NCT05166109仅为安全性描述，无统计检验。未来六个月本站未跟踪到新的读出。
opps: NCT05257408提示GR拮抗可在卵巢肿瘤中增强疗效。其他GR高表达、化疗耐药的实体瘤在本站跟踪项目中尚无覆盖，可以考虑以肿瘤GR表达作为入组生物标志物来检验这一机制。
Vamorolone在Becker中目前只有安全性数据。下一步值得验证解离型激动剂能否在保留疗效的同时减轻激素毒性，并扩展到其他需要长期用激素的慢性炎症或肌病。
本站跟踪的项目都是小分子。组织靶向递送糖皮质激素（例如抗体偶联或局部给药）有可能把抗炎作用与全身毒性分开，目前仍是空白方向。

en.why: GR is a ligand-activated nuclear receptor that carries most of cortisol's effects. Activating GR suppresses inflammation, but long-term use causes metabolic and bone toxicity. In tumors, GR activation switches on anti-apoptotic genes and weakens chemotherapy. That opens two routes: dissociative agonists and selective antagonists.
learned: The clinical record is still thin, and the two programs tracked here push GR in opposite directions. The antagonist relacorilant met its Phase 3 primary endpoint in ovarian neoplasm (NCT05257408; PFS by BICR and OS). The dissociative agonist vamorolone's Phase 2 in Becker muscular dystrophy (NCT05166109) reported safety only, with no formal test. No readouts tracked here are due in the next six months.
opps: NCT05257408 suggests GR antagonism can make treatment work better in ovarian tumors. Among programs tracked here, no other GR-high, chemo-resistant solid tumor is being studied. Researchers could test the mechanism by enrolling patients on tumor GR expression.

Vamorolone has only safety data so far in Becker. The open question is whether dissociative agonists keep steroid efficacy while cutting toxicity, and whether they could extend to other chronic inflammatory or muscle diseases that need long-term steroids.

Every program tracked here is a small molecule. Delivering glucocorticoids to specific tissues, for example through antibody conjugates or local dosing, might separate the anti-inflammatory benefit from systemic toxicity. That approach is still untested here.

zh.why: GSPT1（eRF3a）是翻译终止因子，经cereblon分子胶可被降解，引发整合应激反应和细胞凋亡。MYC驱动的肿瘤和AML高度依赖蛋白翻译，对GSPT1缺失尤为敏感。但GSPT1在正常组织中同样必需，治疗窗口是核心问题。
learned: 临床记录仍很有限：本站追踪的仅有Monte Rosa（1/2期，小分子）和Orum（1期）两个项目，尚无读出、失败记录或未来6个月内到期的试验，暂无法判断该机制在哪些适应症有效。
opps: 已记录的适应症为NSCLC、SCLC和CD123+ AML。抗原导向的递送（如针对CD123）能否降低GSPT1降解的全身毒性、拓宽治疗窗口，是值得验证的假设。
按MYC家族扩增或高表达等翻译依赖性生物标志物筛选患者，可能是提高响应率的路径，在本站追踪的项目中尚无明确的标志物驱动设计。
除肺癌和AML外，其他MYC驱动的实体瘤以及骨髓增生异常综合征等血液病在本站追踪的项目中尚无覆盖，可作为探索方向。

en.why: GSPT1 (eRF3a) is a translation termination factor that cereblon-based molecular glues can degrade, triggering the integrated stress response and apoptosis. MYC-driven tumors and AML depend heavily on protein translation, which makes them especially sensitive to GSPT1 loss. Because normal tissues also need GSPT1, the therapeutic window is the central question.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Only two programs are tracked here, Monte Rosa (Phase 1/2, small molecule) and Orum (Phase 1). There are no readouts, no failures and no trials reaching primary completion in the next six months, so it is too early to say where the mechanism works.
opps: The recorded indications are NSCLC, SCLC and CD123+ AML. One hypothesis to test is whether antigen-directed delivery, for example to CD123, can reduce the systemic toxicity of GSPT1 degradation and widen the therapeutic window.

Selecting patients by markers of translation dependence, such as MYC-family amplification or high expression, might raise response rates. None of the programs tracked here has a clearly biomarker-driven design.
Among programs tracked here, nobody covers MYC-driven solid tumors outside the lung or blood cancers other than AML, such as myelodysplastic syndromes. These are open areas to explore.

zh.why: HDAC去除组蛋白及非组蛋白上的乙酰基，抑制基因转录并调控蛋白功能。I类HDAC1/2参与肿瘤细胞增殖与存活，HDAC6主要作用于胞质内的微管蛋白与蛋白稳态。vorinostat等泛HDAC抑制剂已在T细胞淋巴瘤中验证该机制；在DMD中，HDAC抑制有望减轻纤维化与炎症，促进肌肉再生。
learned: 临床记录尚少：本站跟踪的6个项目（4家公司，均为小分子）目前没有已判定的读出或失败记录，未来6个月内也无主要终点完成的试验，因此暂时还没有可以检验机制的事件。现有布局以Italfarmaco的Givinostat为主，覆盖DMD与骨髓增殖性肿瘤。
opps: 本站跟踪的项目均为小分子，尚无降解剂等其他modality。可以检验的假设是：针对HDAC6或HDAC1/2的亚型选择性抑制剂或降解剂，能否避开泛HDAC抑制的血液学与胃肠道毒性。
实体瘤项目（转移性结直肠癌、胰腺癌）仍处于1/2期。值得探索的方向是：用乙酰化或转录特征筛选患者，并与化疗或免疫治疗联用，验证表观遗传“预处理”能否带来增益。
在JAK2V617F阳性真性红细胞增多症和原发性血小板增多症中，可以把等位基因负荷等分子应答作为早期生物标志物；在神经肌肉领域，可进一步考察DMD以外其他以纤维化为主的肌营养不良。

en.why: HDACs strip acetyl groups from histones and non-histone proteins, which represses transcription and changes how proteins work. Class I HDAC1/2 help tumor cells grow and survive, while HDAC6 mainly acts on tubulin and protein quality control in the cytoplasm. Pan-HDAC inhibitors such as vorinostat validated the mechanism in T-cell lymphoma. In DMD, HDAC inhibition may reduce fibrosis and inflammation and help muscle regenerate.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. None of the 6 programs tracked here (4 companies, all small molecules) has a judged readout or recorded failure, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so nothing yet tests the mechanism. Italfarmaco's Givinostat leads, covering DMD and myeloproliferative neoplasms.
opps: Every program tracked here is a small molecule, and none uses another modality such as a degrader. A testable hypothesis: can inhibitors or degraders selective for HDAC6 or HDAC1/2 avoid the blood and gut toxicity of pan-HDAC inhibition?

The solid-tumor programs (metastatic colorectal and pancreatic cancer) are still in phase 1/2. One direction: select patients by acetylation or transcriptional signatures and combine with chemotherapy or immunotherapy, to test whether epigenetic priming adds benefit.

In JAK2V617F-positive polycythemia vera and essential thrombocythemia, molecular response such as allele burden could serve as an early biomarker. In neuromuscular disease, other muscular dystrophies driven mainly by fibrosis, beyond DMD, are worth exploring.

zh.why: HER2（ERBB2）是受体酪氨酸激酶，扩增或过表达时持续激活PI3K–AKT和RAS–MAPK通路，驱动约两成乳腺癌及部分胃癌、尿路上皮癌等。trastuzumab等药物早已验证该靶点；HER2突变还是部分NSCLC的独立驱动因素。
learned: HER2阳性乳腺癌近期两项III期均达到终点，分别为ADC（T-DXd新辅助pCR，NCT05113251）和小分子（tucatinib PFS，NCT05132582），两种药物形式都在继续拓展适用场景
ADC是最拥挤的赛道，占本站80个项目中的29个，SHR-A1811、TQB2102、disitamab vedotin、DP303c等多为中国企业；新闻显示T-Bren III期期中分析也达到终点，同类竞争加剧
poziotinib的NSCLC III期PINNACLE（NCT05378763）未入组即终止，原因为运营及与FDA协商重新设计，不构成对机制的否定；本站跟踪到的HER2突变肺癌项目已转向zongertinib、BAY 2927088等选择性TKI
双抗zanidatamab的两项读出（NCT03929666、NCT04276493）以安全性和ORR为终点，无正式统计检验，双抗相对ADC的定位仍缺随机证据
opps: 乳腺癌以外适应症布局较少：胃癌（NCT04704934、NCT06221748）和尿路上皮癌（NCT05302284、NCT05911295）的读出将检验ADC能否复制乳腺癌的获益，宫颈癌、结直肠癌项目更少
HER2突变NSCLC中，zongertinib的III期（NCT06151574）将是选择性TKI的首个关键检验；脑转移控制及与ADC的序贯或联合仍是待验证的假设
随着T-DXd前移至新辅助阶段，ADC耐药后的治疗缺乏系统研究；不同载荷的ADC、双抗或细胞治疗（本站跟踪6项）在ADC经治人群中的作用值得探索

en.why: HER2 (ERBB2) is a receptor tyrosine kinase whose amplification or overexpression constitutively drives PI3K–AKT and RAS–MAPK signaling, fueling about a fifth of breast cancers plus subsets of gastric, urothelial and other tumors. Trastuzumab and related drugs validated the target long ago; activating HER2 mutations are a separate driver in some NSCLC.
learned: Both recent phase 3 wins in HER2-positive breast cancer came from different modalities: an ADC (trastuzumab deruxtecan, pCR in the neoadjuvant setting, NCT05113251) and a small molecule (tucatinib, PFS, NCT05132582). Both modalities are still finding new settings.

ADCs are the most crowded lane, 29 of 80 programs tracked here, many from Chinese companies (SHR-A1811, TQB2102, disitamab vedotin, DP303c). A press release reports T-Bren also met its phase 3 interim endpoint, so differentiation within the class is getting harder.

Poziotinib's phase 3 PINNACLE in NSCLC (NCT05378763) stopped before enrolling anyone, for operational reasons and a redesign under discussion with FDA. That says nothing against the mechanism; tracked HER2-mutant lung programs have moved to selective TKIs such as zongertinib and BAY 2927088.
Both zanidatamab readouts (NCT03929666, NCT04276493) used safety and ORR endpoints with no formal hypothesis test, so there is still no randomized evidence placing bispecifics against ADCs.
opps: Few programs go beyond breast cancer. Gastric (NCT04704934, NCT06221748) and urothelial (NCT05302284, NCT05911295) readouts will test whether ADCs can repeat the breast cancer benefit; cervical and colorectal cancer have even fewer programs.
In HER2-mutant NSCLC, zongertinib's phase 3 (NCT06151574) will be the first key test of a selective TKI. CNS control and sequencing or combining with ADCs remain open hypotheses.

With trastuzumab deruxtecan moving into the neoadjuvant setting, treatment after ADC resistance has little systematic study. ADCs with different payloads, bispecifics or cell therapies (6 tracked here) in ADC-pretreated patients are worth exploring.

zh.why: HER3（ERBB3）自身激酶活性很弱，但与 HER2 或 EGFR 异二聚化后能强效激活 PI3K–AKT 通路，是 EGFR-TKI、抗 HER2 及内分泌治疗耐药的常见逃逸途径，NRG1 融合肿瘤也依赖这一轴。HER3 在多种实体瘤中广泛表达，结合抗体后可被内吞，因此也是 ADC 的递送靶点。
learned: 本站追踪的项目中尚无登记读出或失败记录。目前只有公告称 EGFR×HER3 双抗 ADC iza-bren（BL-B01D1）在经治 HR+/HER2- 乳腺癌和 EGFR 突变 NSCLC 两项中国三期达到 PFS 终点，具体数据未公布。后续检验看 NCT06118333、NCT06382129、NCT06500026。
opps: BL-B01D1 有 55 项试验，进度领先，但它同时靶向 EGFR，HER3 臂贡献多少尚不清楚。SYS6023、JSKN016、HDM2024 等单靶 HER3 ADC 可以检验 HER3 表达水平能否预测疗效，目前很少有项目回答这个生物标志物问题。
NRG1 融合是 HER3 最明确的遗传依赖。本站追踪的项目中，围绕这一人群设计的似乎只有 HER2×HER3 双抗 zenocutuzumab。HER3 ADC 在融合阳性或 HER3 高表达人群中的作用尚未验证。
乳腺癌和 NSCLC 之外，鼻咽癌（NCT06118333）和小细胞肺癌（NCT06500026）三期将检验双抗 ADC 能否扩展到 HER3 生物学依据较弱的瘤种。头颈鳞癌和消化道肿瘤的项目仍处早期。

en.why: HER3 (ERBB3) has little kinase activity of its own, but when it pairs with HER2 or EGFR it strongly activates PI3K–AKT signalling. Tumours often upregulate it to escape EGFR TKIs, HER2-targeted therapy and endocrine therapy, and NRG1-fusion tumours depend on this axis. HER3 is widely expressed and is taken into the cell after antibody binding, which also makes it a delivery target for ADCs.
learned: Among programs tracked here there are no registry readouts or failures yet. The only result comes from company announcements: the EGFR×HER3 bispecific ADC iza-bren (BL-B01D1) met PFS in two Chinese phase 3s (pretreated HR+/HER2- breast cancer; EGFR-mutant NSCLC after a third-generation TKI). The data are unpublished. The next tests are NCT06118333, NCT06382129 and NCT06500026.
opps: BL-B01D1 leads with 55 trials but also targets EGFR, so it is unclear how much of the benefit comes from the HER3 arm. Single-target HER3 ADCs (SYS6023, JSKN016, HDM2024 and others) could test whether HER3 expression level predicts activity. Few programs address this biomarker question.

NRG1 fusions are the clearest genetic dependency on HER3. Among programs tracked here, the only one built around them appears to be the HER2×HER3 bispecific zenocutuzumab. Whether HER3 ADCs work in fusion-positive or HER3-high patients is untested here.

Beyond breast cancer and NSCLC, phase 3 readouts in nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NCT06118333) and small cell lung cancer (NCT06500026) will show whether the bispecific ADC extends to tumours where the case for HER3 is weaker. Head and neck and GI programs are still early.

zh.why: HIF-2α（EPAS1）是缺氧应答的核心转录因子。VHL失活后HIF-2α持续稳定，驱动VEGF、cyclin D1等靶基因，是透明细胞肾癌的主要致癌通路；EPAS1功能获得突变也见于嗜铬细胞瘤/副神经节瘤。belzutifan获批用于VHL病相关肿瘤，验证了这一靶点。
learned: 本站收录的临床记录仍很有限。唯一的疗效检验NCT05239728中，在Keytruda+Lenvima基础上加用belzutifan未能胜出；NKT2152研究NCT05935748因组合调整终止，不能说明机制无效。下一批数据看已过主要完成日期的belzutifan I/II期研究NCT04626518和NCT04626479。
opps: 在本站收录的项目中，仅1个覆盖嗜铬细胞瘤/副神经节瘤和VHL病。EPAS1突变或VHL驱动的遗传定义人群仍是值得验证的方向。
4个项目全部是小分子。降解剂或RNA类药物有望应对药物结合口袋的获得性耐药突变，这一方向在本站收录的项目中尚无人尝试。
三联疗法失败后，哪些联用伙伴真正增效仍是悬而未决的问题。HIF-2α与CDK4/6联用（cyclin D1轴）因NCT05935748出于商业原因终止而未获检验；casdatifan的III期研究或能说明，更强的靶点抑制能否带来差异。

en.why: HIF-2α (EPAS1) is a core hypoxia-response transcription factor. When VHL is lost, HIF-2α stays stable and drives VEGF, cyclin D1 and other targets, making it the main oncogenic pathway in clear cell RCC. EPAS1 gain-of-function mutations also occur in pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma. Belzutifan's approval for VHL disease-associated tumors validated the target.
learned: The record tracked here is thin. The one efficacy test, adding belzutifan to Keytruda plus Lenvima (NCT05239728), missed. The NKT2152 stop (NCT05935748) was a portfolio decision and says nothing about the mechanism. Belzutifan Phase 1/2 RCC trials NCT04626518 and NCT04626479, past primary completion, are next to report.
opps: Among programs tracked here, only one addresses pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma and VHL disease. Genetically defined groups with EPAS1 mutations or VHL-driven disease remain a hypothesis worth testing.
All four programs are small molecules. Degraders or RNA-based agents might get around acquired resistance mutations in the drug-binding pocket, and no program tracked here has tried them.

After the triplet miss, it is still unclear which partners actually add benefit. HIF-2α plus CDK4/6 (the cyclin D1 axis) went untested because NCT05935748 stopped for business reasons. Casdatifan's Phase 3 work may show whether stronger target inhibition makes a difference.

zh.why: HLA-G是非经典MHC-Ib分子，生理上主要表达于母胎界面，通过结合ILT2、ILT4和KIR2DL4抑制T细胞、NK细胞和髓系细胞，维持免疫耐受。多种实体瘤会重新表达HLA-G以实现免疫逃逸，而正常成人组织表达有限，因此它既可作为检查点阻断靶点，也可作为细胞治疗的肿瘤选择性抗原。
learned: 本站追踪的3个项目均处于1期或1/2期，尚无读出、失败或终止记录，未来6个月也没有预计到达主要完成的试验。临床证据仍然很少，TTX-080自2020年进入1期，至今在本站未见结果，HLA-G阻断的人体概念验证尚待建立。
opps: 本站追踪的项目只有2个单抗和1个CAR.BiTE γδ T细胞疗法，尚未见到ADC、T细胞衔接双抗等利用HLA-G肿瘤选择性表达的形式，可作为模态上的探索方向。
现有项目的适应症均为泛实体瘤。按HLA-G表达水平或可溶性HLA-G筛选患者，并聚焦高表达瘤种，可能是检验该机制更清晰的途径。
阻断配体与阻断ILT2/ILT4受体在生物学上覆盖的通路并不相同。与PD-1/PD-L1抑制剂联合，以及在PD-1耐药人群中的作用，均是待回答的问题。

en.why: HLA-G is a non-classical MHC class Ib molecule, normally confined largely to the maternal-fetal interface. It binds ILT2, ILT4 and KIR2DL4 to suppress T, NK and myeloid cells. Many solid tumors re-express HLA-G to evade immunity while normal adult tissues express little, making it both a checkpoint-blockade target and a tumor-selective antigen for cell therapy.
learned: The three programs tracked here are all in phase 1 or 1/2, with no readouts, failures or early stops recorded and no trials reaching primary completion in the next six months. The record is still thin: TTX-080 entered phase 1 in 2020 but no results are tracked, so human proof of concept for HLA-G blockade is still missing.
opps: Programs tracked here comprise two monoclonal antibodies and one CAR.BiTE γδ T-cell therapy. ADCs and T-cell-engaging bispecifics, which would exploit tumor-selective HLA-G expression, are not represented and could be explored.

All tracked programs enroll broad solid-tumor populations. Selecting patients by tumor HLA-G expression or soluble HLA-G, and focusing on high-expressing tumor types, may give a cleaner test of the mechanism.
Blocking the ligand and blocking the ILT2/ILT4 receptors cover different biology. Combination with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors and activity in PD-1-refractory patients remain open questions.

zh.why: HPK1（MAP4K1）是一种主要在造血细胞中表达的丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶。它通过磷酸化SLP-76，负向调控TCR信号，同时介导PGE2和腺苷对T细胞的抑制。激酶失活小鼠的抗肿瘤免疫增强，因此HPK1被视为一个可用小分子干预的胞内免疫检查点。
learned: 临床数据目前很少。本站仅追踪到1个项目：Arvinas的小分子，2026年8月登记，正在实体瘤中开展1/2期试验。该项目尚无读出，未来6个月也没有试验到达主要完成日期，所以近期看不到对该机制的临床检验。
opps: HPK1除激酶活性外还有支架功能。降解蛋白与只抑制激酶，在T细胞激活和安全性上是否有差别，目前还没有答案。另外，对MAP4K家族其他成员（如起正向调控作用的GLK）的选择性，可能是分子设计的关键。
可以检验的假设：在PGE2或腺苷富集的肿瘤微环境中，或PD-1治疗耐药的患者里，HPK1阻断获益更明显。外周血pSLP-76可作为药效学标志物，用于剂量选择和患者富集。
本站追踪的项目只覆盖晚期实体瘤。HPK1敲除或抑制用于增强CAR-T等细胞疗法，以及用于血液肿瘤，目前都还没有项目涉及。

en.why: HPK1 (MAP4K1) is a serine/threonine kinase found mainly in blood-forming cells. It dampens T-cell receptor signaling by phosphorylating SLP-76, and it carries the suppressive effects of PGE2 and adenosine on T cells. Mice with kinase-dead HPK1 show stronger anti-tumor immunity, so HPK1 is seen as an intracellular immune checkpoint that a small molecule can reach.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site tracks one program: an Arvinas small molecule in a Phase 1/2 trial in advanced solid tumors, first posted in August 2026. It has no readouts, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term test of the mechanism is in view.
opps: HPK1 has a scaffolding role as well as kinase activity. Nobody has yet shown whether removing the protein differs from blocking the kinase in T-cell activation or safety. Selectivity against other MAP4K family members, such as GLK, which promotes T-cell signaling, may be the key design question.

A testable hypothesis: HPK1 blockade may help most in tumors rich in PGE2 or adenosine, or in patients whose tumors resist PD-1 therapy. Phospho-SLP-76 in blood could serve as a pharmacodynamic marker for choosing doses and selecting patients.
Among programs tracked here, only advanced solid tumors are covered. Knocking out or inhibiting HPK1 to strengthen CAR-T and other cell therapies, and use in blood cancers, are not yet addressed.

zh.why: 亨廷顿病由HTT基因第1外显子CAG重复扩增引起，突变huntingtin蛋白携带延长的多聚谷氨酰胺链，导致纹状体和皮层神经元进行性丢失。该病为常染色体显性单基因病，40次以上重复即完全外显，降低突变HTT表达是最直接的疾病修饰策略。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：本站追踪到2个项目（Skyhawk小分子2/3期、Roche tominersen 2期），尚无读出。2027年5月主要完成的2/3期试验NCT06873334将是首个实质检验。
opps: 两个追踪项目分别代表口服小分子与鞘内注射ASO两种路径。口服给药能否在全身暴露可耐受的前提下实现足够的中枢HTT降低，是NCT06873334有望初步回答的问题。
本站追踪项目中尚无明确的等位基因选择性方案或AAV基因治疗。基于SNP的突变HTT选择性降低可规避野生型huntingtin耗竭的顾虑，是值得验证的方向。
患者分层仍有空间：以CAG重复长度、脑脊液突变HTT和NfL等指标筛选前驱期或早期患者，并据此确定降低幅度与给药时机，或可提高检出疾病修饰效应的概率。

en.why: Huntington's disease is caused by a CAG repeat expansion in HTT exon 1. The mutant huntingtin protein carries an expanded polyglutamine tract that drives progressive loss of striatal and cortical neurons. The disease is autosomal dominant and fully penetrant at 40 or more repeats, so lowering mutant HTT is the most direct route to disease modification.
learned: The clinical record is still thin: only two programs are tracked here (Skyhawk's small molecule in Phase 2/3, Roche's tominersen in Phase 2), with no readouts yet. The Phase 2/3 trial NCT06873334, reaching primary completion in May 2027, will be the first real test.
opps: The two tracked programs represent different routes: an oral small molecule and an intrathecal ASO. Whether oral dosing can achieve enough CNS HTT lowering at tolerable systemic exposure is an open question NCT06873334 may begin to answer.
Among programs tracked here, none is described as allele-selective or AAV-delivered. SNP-based selective lowering of mutant HTT, which spares wild-type huntingtin, remains a hypothesis worth testing.

Patient selection is underexplored: enriching for prodromal or early-stage patients by CAG length, CSF mutant HTT and NfL, and using these to set lowering depth and timing, may improve the chance of detecting disease modification.

zh.why: 胎儿血红蛋白（HbF）不参与HbS聚合，能稀释镰状血红蛋白并减轻溶血和血管闭塞。BCL11A是成人期γ-珠蛋白的关键抑制因子。HPFH和BCL11A增强子变异的人群遗传学、羟基脲部分经HbF起效，以及离体BCL11A增强子编辑的临床结果，共同验证了这一机制。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄。本站唯一的读出是Fulcrum的Pociredir II期试验NCT07401823，仅入组1例即以申办方决定终止（biz），不能作为否定机制的证据。未来6个月没有已追踪的主要完成节点，近期难有新的检验。
opps: 本站追踪的2个项目都只针对镰状细胞病。HbF诱导在生物学上同样适用于β-地中海贫血，口服药在这一适应症上的空白值得评估。
已追踪的项目只有小分子和细胞治疗。体内编辑、针对BCL11A的寡核苷酸或siRNA、BCL11A/ZBTB7A降解剂等路径在此尚未出现，可作为探索方向。
口服HbF诱导剂与细胞治疗相比的定位，可能取决于能否实现全细胞（pancellular）HbF分布。按基线HbF或羟基脲应答对患者分层，以及与羟基脲联用，都是尚未回答的问题。

en.why: Fetal hemoglobin (HbF) does not join HbS polymers, so it dilutes sickle hemoglobin and reduces hemolysis and vaso-occlusion. BCL11A is a key repressor of adult γ-globin. Human genetics (HPFH, BCL11A enhancer variants), hydroxyurea's partly HbF-driven benefit and clinical results from ex vivo BCL11A enhancer editing all validate the mechanism.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout tracked here is Fulcrum's Phase 2 Pociredir trial NCT07401823, stopped by sponsor decision (biz) after 1 participant, so it says nothing against the mechanism. No tracked trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term test is scheduled.
opps: Both programs tracked here target sickle cell disease only. HbF induction is biologically relevant to β-thalassemia too, and that indication looks open for oral agents.

Among tracked programs, only small-molecule and cell-therapy approaches appear. In vivo editing, BCL11A-directed oligonucleotides or siRNA, and BCL11A/ZBTB7A degraders are untried here and could be explored.

How an oral inducer competes with cell therapy may depend on whether it achieves pancellular HbF distribution. Selecting patients by baseline HbF or hydroxyurea response, and combining with hydroxyurea, remain open questions.

zh.why: SMO是Hedgehog通路中类似GPCR的信号转导蛋白。PTCH1缺失或SMO激活突变可直接驱动基底细胞癌和髓母细胞瘤，vismodegib、sonidegib已获批用于基底细胞癌。Hedgehog通路在组织损伤后重新激活，会促进成纤维细胞活化，所以肺纤维化成为该靶点的新方向。
learned: 临床记录仍然很少：本站尚无注册试验读出，只有一条新闻称Endeavor的taladegib在IPF IIb期试验达到终点。IPF II期试验NCT06422884已过主要完成期（2026-10），它的完整数据将是首次实质性检验。
opps: 纤维化方向的跟进者很少，本站仅追踪到一个小分子项目覆盖IPF和PF-ILD。值得验证的问题包括：与现有抗纤维化药物联用是否有增量获益，以及肌痉挛、味觉障碍、脱发等SMO类效应在长期给药下能否耐受。
可探索用GLI1等通路活性标志物筛选纤维化患者，看Hedgehog信号高的亚组是否获益更大；也可以把适应症从IPF扩展到其他进展性纤维化ILD。
肿瘤方向本站追踪的项目涉及基底细胞癌和胰腺导管腺癌，包括一个重组蛋白项目和一个模态未披露的项目，均处于II期及更早阶段。非小分子模态能否绕开SMO突变介导的耐药，仍有待检验。

en.why: SMO is the GPCR-like transducer of Hedgehog signalling. PTCH1 loss or activating SMO mutations directly drive basal cell carcinoma and medulloblastoma, and vismodegib and sonidegib are approved for basal cell carcinoma. Hedgehog signalling switches back on after tissue injury and promotes fibroblast activation, which makes pulmonary fibrosis a newer rationale.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site has no registry readouts, only a news report that Endeavor's taladegib met its endpoint in a Phase IIb IPF trial. The Phase 2 IPF trial NCT06422884 has passed primary completion (2026-10), and its full data will be the first real test.
opps: Few programs follow in fibrosis: among programs tracked here, one small molecule covers IPF and PF-ILD. Open questions are whether it adds benefit on top of standard antifibrotics, and whether SMO class effects (muscle spasms, taste loss, hair loss) are tolerable with long-term dosing.

Pathway-activity biomarkers such as GLI1 could be used to select fibrosis patients, testing whether those with high Hedgehog signalling benefit more. Indications could also extend beyond IPF to other progressive fibrosing ILDs.

The oncology programs tracked here cover basal cell carcinoma and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. They include a recombinant-protein program and one with an undisclosed modality, all at Phase 2 or earlier. Whether non-small-molecule approaches can get around resistance caused by SMO mutations is still untested.

zh.why: IDH1 R132突变使酶获得新功能，产生致癌代谢物2-HG，抑制TET及组蛋白去甲基化酶，导致表观遗传紊乱和分化阻滞。该突变见于AML、低级别胶质瘤和肝内胆管癌，属于驱动事件，可用伴随诊断筛选患者；ivosidenib已获批用于IDH1突变AML。
learned: 本站追踪的IDH1项目尚无读出、失败或终止记录，未来6个月也没有到达主要完成的试验，暂时无法从数据中总结经验。目前只能看到格局：11个项目中10个为小分子，6个处于3期，以Servier的ivosidenib和vorasidenib为主，Nuvation Bio另有一个3期项目。
opps: 本站追踪的适应症集中在胆管癌、AML和胶质瘤；软骨肉瘤、MDS等同样存在IDH1突变的肿瘤尚无项目，可检验突变抑制剂在这些人群中能否带来获益。
高级别胶质瘤仅有一个4级星形细胞瘤项目。脑渗透性更强的抑制剂，或与放疗、免疫治疗联用，能否把低级别胶质瘤中的获益延伸到高级别人群，仍待验证。
现有项目几乎全是小分子。针对获得性耐药（IDH1二次突变、转换为IDH2突变）的下一代或双靶点抑制剂，以及靶向R132H新抗原的疫苗或细胞疗法，可作为差异化方向。

en.why: IDH1 R132 mutations give the enzyme a new function: it produces the oncometabolite 2-HG, which inhibits TET and histone demethylases, disrupts the epigenome and blocks differentiation. The mutation is a driver in AML, lower-grade glioma and intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, and a companion diagnostic can select patients. Ivosidenib is approved for IDH1-mutant AML.
learned: The record tracked here is still thin. There are no IDH1 readouts, failures or early stops, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so no lessons can be drawn yet. All we can see is the landscape: 10 of 11 programs are small molecules and 6 are in Phase 3. Servier's ivosidenib and vorasidenib lead, and Nuvation Bio has one more Phase 3 program.
opps: Programs tracked here focus on cholangiocarcinoma, AML and glioma. None target other IDH1-mutant tumors such as chondrosarcoma or MDS, where it remains open whether mutant-selective inhibition helps.

Only one tracked program addresses grade 4 astrocytoma. It is untested whether more brain-penetrant inhibitors, or combinations with radiotherapy or immunotherapy, can carry the benefit seen in low-grade glioma into high-grade disease.

Nearly every program is a small molecule. Possible ways to stand out: next-generation or dual inhibitors that address acquired resistance (second-site IDH1 mutations, switching to mutant IDH2), and vaccines or cell therapies aimed at the R132H neoantigen.

zh.why: IDH2 R140/R172突变使酶获得新功能，产生致癌代谢物2-HG，抑制TET2等α-KG依赖性双加氧酶，引起DNA高甲基化和髓系分化阻滞。约一成AML携带IDH2突变。enasidenib已获批用于复发/难治性IDH2突变AML，验证了这一靶点。
learned: 本站目前仅追踪到BMS的enasidenib一项1/2期项目，没有读出、失败记录，未来六个月也没有到期的试验，临床记录仍然很少，尚无法从中总结规律。
opps: 本站追踪的项目只覆盖AML。IDH2突变也见于MDS、血管免疫母细胞性T细胞淋巴瘤和部分实体瘤，这些适应症在本站仍是空白，值得验证。
获得性耐药可经IDH2第二位点突变或转为IDH1突变发生。针对这一机制，IDH1/IDH2双重抑制剂或可结合突变二聚体界面的新骨架是可检验的方向。
2-HG水平和突变等位基因清除可作为生物标志物，用于分层患者、评估与低甲基化药物或BCL-2抑制剂的联合方案，目前本站尚未追踪到此类试验。

en.why: IDH2 R140/R172 mutations give the enzyme a new function: it produces the oncometabolite 2-HG. 2-HG inhibits TET2 and other α-KG-dependent dioxygenases, which causes DNA hypermethylation and blocks myeloid differentiation. Roughly one in ten AML cases carries an IDH2 mutation. Enasidenib is approved for relapsed/refractory IDH2-mutant AML, which validates the target.
learned: The site tracks just one program here: BMS's enasidenib in a phase 1/2 trial. There are no readouts, no failures and no trials due in the next six months. The clinical record is too thin to draw lessons from.
opps: The programs tracked here cover only AML. IDH2 mutations also occur in MDS, angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma and some solid tumors. None of these is addressed among tracked programs, so they are open questions to test.

Acquired resistance can come from second-site IDH2 mutations or a switch to mutant IDH1. Dual IDH1/IDH2 inhibitors, or new chemotypes that bind the mutant dimer interface, are testable ways to address this.

2-HG levels and clearance of the mutant allele could serve as biomarkers. They could be used to select patients and to judge combinations with hypomethylating agents or BCL-2 inhibitors. No such trials are tracked here yet.

zh.why: I 型干扰素经 IFNAR1/2 激活 JAK–STAT 通路，驱动浆细胞样树突状细胞活化和自身抗体产生。多数 SLE 患者血液中有干扰素基因标签，IRF5、STAT4、TYK2 等风险位点提供遗传支持。阻断 IFNAR1 可一次性抑制所有 I 型干扰素，anifrolumab 已获批用于 SLE。
learned: 临床数据仍然有限。目前唯一的读出是 anifrolumab 的 III 期 SLE 研究 NCT04931563，应答率差异这一主要终点未达到（failures 中的两条记录对应同一试验）。首批真正的检验将来自 CLE 研究 NCT06015737（已到主要完成日，结果待公布）、系统性硬化 NCT05925803 和狼疮肾炎 NCT05138133。
opps: 在本站追踪的项目中，适应症以外扩为主：CLE、系统性硬化、狼疮肾炎三项 III 期结果将显示，干扰素驱动的皮肤和器官病变是否比全身性 SLE 终点更容易体现获益。皮肌炎以 IFN-β 为主导，目前仅有一个项目涉及，可作为进一步验证的方向。
NCT04931563 未达到主要终点，值得研究干扰素基因标签高低、人群和背景治疗是否能解释这一结果，并探讨以标签分层入组是否能提高应答差异。
本站追踪的 4 个项目全部是单抗，仅来自 AstraZeneca 和 Genrix 两家公司。针对 IFNAR 的皮下长效制剂、双抗或与 B 细胞通路的联合策略，目前在追踪范围内尚属空白。

en.why: Type I interferons signal through IFNAR1/2 and JAK–STAT, activating plasmacytoid dendritic cells and promoting autoantibody production.
