Most SLE patients carry a blood interferon gene signature, and risk loci such as IRF5, STAT4 and TYK2 add genetic support. Blocking IFNAR1 shuts down all type I interferons at once. Anifrolumab is approved for SLE.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout is anifrolumab's phase 3 SLE study NCT04931563, which missed its responder-difference primary endpoint (both failure entries refer to this one trial). The first real tests will be CLE (NCT06015737, past primary completion, results pending), systemic sclerosis (NCT05925803) and lupus nephritis (NCT05138133).
opps: Among programs tracked here, the growth is in new indications. The CLE, systemic sclerosis and lupus nephritis phase 3 results will show whether interferon-driven skin and organ disease shows benefit more readily than systemic SLE endpoints do. Dermatomyositis, which is driven mainly by IFN-β, has only one tracked program and is a candidate for further testing.

After the NCT04931563 miss, it is worth asking whether interferon-signature status, population or background therapy explain the result, and whether enrolling by signature would widen the responder gap.

All 4 tracked programs are monoclonal antibodies from just two companies, AstraZeneca and Genrix. Long-acting subcutaneous formats, bispecifics, and combinations with B-cell pathway agents against IFNAR are not represented among tracked programs.

zh.why: IKZF1/3（Ikaros/Aiolos）是淋巴细胞谱系的关键转录因子，多发性骨髓瘤细胞依赖其维持IRF4/MYC通路。lenalidomide、pomalidomide等IMiD通过cereblon（CRBN）诱导其降解，在杀伤肿瘤的同时增强T细胞功能，这一机制已获临床验证。新一代CELMoD追求更强、更快的降解。
learned: 本站尚未收录该靶点的任何读出或失败记录，临床证据仍偏少。首批关键检验将来自mezigdomide在多发性骨髓瘤中的两项III期（NCT05552976、NCT05519085），以及BMS-986369在复发/难治T细胞淋巴瘤中的I/II期（NCT06035497）。
opps: 本站收录的管线集中在多发性骨髓瘤，T细胞淋巴瘤仅有BMS-986369一项（NCT06035497）。可以检验的假说：IKZF依赖的T细胞或B细胞淋巴瘤亚型，可能成为差异化适应症。
IMiD经治患者常因CRBN通路改变而耐药，而收录管线几乎都是CRBN分子胶，且多数来自Bristol Myers Squibb。可以探索借助其他E3连接酶或不依赖CRBN的降解方式，并以CRBN状态作为入组标志物。
目前收录的试验全部在肿瘤领域，与双抗联用的管线也只有一项。IKZF1/3降解能调节B细胞和T细胞，联合T细胞衔接器、或进入自身免疫病，是尚待检验的方向。

en.why: Ikaros and Aiolos (IKZF1/3) are lymphoid transcription factors that myeloma cells need to sustain IRF4/MYC signaling. IMiDs such as lenalidomide and pomalidomide recruit them to cereblon (CRBN) for degradation. This kills tumor cells and boosts T-cell activity, a clinically validated mechanism. Newer CELMoDs aim for deeper, faster degradation.
learned: No readouts or failures for this target are tracked here yet, so the clinical record is still thin. The first real tests will be two mezigdomide Phase 3 trials in multiple myeloma (NCT05552976, NCT05519085) and the BMS-986369 Phase 1/2 in relapsed or refractory T-cell lymphoma (NCT06035497).
opps: Among programs tracked here, most target multiple myeloma, and only BMS-986369 addresses T-cell lymphoma (NCT06035497). A hypothesis to test: IKZF-dependent T- or B-cell lymphoma subtypes could be differentiated indications.

Resistance after IMiD exposure often involves changes in the CRBN pathway, yet nearly all tracked programs are CRBN glues, mostly from Bristol Myers Squibb. Degraders that use other E3 ligases or work without CRBN, with CRBN status as a selection biomarker, are open to explore.

All tracked trials are in oncology, and only one program pairs the mechanism with a bispecific. Because IKZF1/3 degradation modulates B and T cells, combinations with T-cell engagers or use in autoimmune disease remain untested hypotheses.

zh.why: IL-12由p35/p40组成，主要由树突状细胞和巨噬细胞分泌，可驱动Th1分化、诱导IFN-γ并激活NK与CD8+ T细胞，是很强的抗肿瘤细胞因子。但早年全身给予重组IL-12毒性严重，治疗窗窄。因此目前的思路是通过局部或条件性递送，把活性集中在肿瘤内。
learned: 本站跟踪的4个IL-12项目都处于1期或1/2期，均为肿瘤适应症，目前没有读出、失败或终止记录，未来6个月内也没有到达主要完成日期的试验。临床记录仍然很少，近期还看不到第一次真正的检验。从设计上看，溶瘤病毒、重组蛋白等递送方式都在设法避开全身毒性。
opps: 本站跟踪的项目中，有3项涉及胶质瘤，即复发高级别胶质瘤、GBM和高级别胶质瘤。可以考察的假设是：瘤内或局部表达IL-12能否在免疫“冷”的脑肿瘤中诱导IFN-γ和T细胞浸润，并在此基础上评估与PD-1抑制剂联用的价值。
目前各项目在溶瘤病毒、小分子、重组蛋白等不同递送平台之间分散，彼此之间尚无比较数据。值得研究的问题是：瘤内IFN-γ信号或CXCL9/10等药效标志物，能否用来比较各平台的局部活性与全身暴露，并据此筛选患者。
p40是IL-12与IL-23共享的亚基，阻断p40的ustekinumab早已用于银屑病和炎症性肠病。但本站跟踪的IL-12项目全部是肿瘤领域的激动剂，选择性靶向IL-12（不影响IL-23）的自身免疫方向在本站跟踪范围内暂无项目。

en.why: IL-12, a p35/p40 heterodimer secreted by dendritic cells and macrophages, drives Th1 differentiation and IFN-γ production and activates NK and CD8+ T cells, which makes it a strong anti-tumour cytokine. Early systemic recombinant IL-12 caused severe toxicity and left a narrow therapeutic window. Current work therefore tries to confine IL-12 activity to the tumour through local or conditional delivery.
learned: All four IL-12 programs tracked here are in oncology at phase 1 or 1/2. None has a readout, failure or early stop, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so the record is thin and no near-term test is in sight. The designs, including an oncolytic virus and a recombinant protein, all aim to avoid systemic toxicity.
opps: Three of the tracked programs list gliomas (recurrent high-grade glioma, GBM, high-grade glioma). One hypothesis to test is whether intratumoural or local IL-12 can bring IFN-γ and T cells into immunologically cold brain tumours, and whether it then adds value on top of PD-1 blockade.

The programs use different delivery platforms (oncolytic virus, small molecule, recombinant protein), and none has comparative data. A research question is whether pharmacodynamic markers such as intratumoural IFN-γ signalling or CXCL9/10 can compare local activity against systemic exposure across platforms and guide patient selection.

p40 is shared by IL-12 and IL-23, and the p40 blocker ustekinumab has long been used in psoriasis and IBD. Yet every IL-12 program tracked here is an oncology agonist. Among programs tracked here, none targets IL-12 selectively (sparing IL-23) in autoimmune disease.

zh.why: IL-13是2型炎症的核心效应细胞因子，经IL-4Rα/IL-13Rα1激活JAK–STAT6，驱动皮肤屏障破坏、瘙痒、气道黏液分泌和高反应性。IL13基因变异与哮喘和特应性皮炎易感性相关，dupilumab与tralokinumab的获批也从临床上验证了这条通路。
learned: 哮喘中lebrikizumab结果不一致：NCT01867125达到急性加重终点，NCT02104674未达到FEV1终点；NCT01875003和NCT01987492随后因申办方停止哮喘开发而终止，属商业原因，不能作为否定机制的证据
以FEV1为主要终点的气道试验在哮喘（NCT02104674）和COPD（NCT02546700）中均未达到，提示单独阻断IL-13改善肺功能的作用有限，降低急性加重的信号相对更明确
皮肤适应症表现更一致：tralokinumab在手部特应性湿疹中达到主要终点（NCT05958407），本站追踪的4个项目均覆盖特应性皮炎，lebrikizumab的NCT06280716、NCT05990725为描述性设计，不构成正式检验
气道方向转向多靶点：Sanofi的双抗lunsekimig已有9项试验进入3期、覆盖哮喘和COPD，但本站尚未追踪到其读出，双靶点能否弥补单抗在肺部的不足仍待验证
opps: 气道疾病中按2型炎症生物标志物（如血嗜酸性粒细胞、FeNO）富集患者，并以急性加重而非FEV1为主要终点，可检验IL-13在高2型亚群中的真实效用
特应性皮炎的细分表型（手部湿疹、钱币状湿疹）只有少数项目涉及，可作为差异化方向；NCT06526182预计2027年4月完成主要终点，是下一个检验lebrikizumab的节点
本站追踪的项目全部为注射用抗体，尚无口服小分子或长效制剂，延长给药间隔或开发口服IL-13通路抑制剂仍是空白

en.why: IL-13 is a core type 2 effector cytokine. Signaling through IL-4Rα/IL-13Rα1 and JAK–STAT6, it drives skin barrier damage, itch, airway mucus and hyperresponsiveness. IL13 variants are linked to asthma and atopic dermatitis risk, and the approvals of dupilumab and tralokinumab validate the pathway clinically.
learned: Lebrikizumab gave inconsistent asthma results. NCT01867125 met its exacerbation endpoint and NCT02104674 missed on FEV1. NCT01875003 and NCT01987492 then stopped when the sponsor dropped asthma development. That was a business decision and is not evidence against the mechanism.

Airway trials with an FEV1 primary endpoint missed in both asthma (NCT02104674) and COPD (NCT02546700). This suggests blocking IL-13 alone does little for lung function. The signal on exacerbations is clearer.

Skin indications have been more consistent. Tralokinumab met its primary endpoint in atopic hand eczema (NCT05958407), and all 4 programs tracked here include atopic dermatitis. Lebrikizumab's NCT06280716 and NCT05990725 were descriptive, so they were not formal tests.

Airway work is moving to multi-target designs. Sanofi's bispecific lunsekimig has 9 trials at Phase 3 across asthma and COPD, but no readouts are tracked here yet. Whether dual targeting can make up for single-agent results in the lung is still open.
opps: In airway disease, enrich for high type 2 biomarkers (e.g., blood eosinophils, FeNO) and use exacerbations rather than FEV1 as the primary endpoint. This could test whether IL-13 blockade really works in high type 2 subgroups.

Few programs address atopic dermatitis subtypes such as hand or nummular eczema, which could be a way to stand out. NCT06526182, with primary completion due April 2027, is the next test of lebrikizumab.

Every program tracked here is an injectable antibody. No oral small molecules or extended-interval formats appear, so longer dosing intervals or oral IL-13 pathway inhibitors are still open territory.

zh.why: IL-15经IL-15Rα反式呈递，通过IL-2/IL-15Rβ与共同γ链激活JAK1/3–STAT5，促进NK细胞和记忆CD8+ T细胞的增殖与存活，且对Treg扩增作用较弱。因此IL-15激动剂被用于增强BCG、免疫检查点抑制剂及CAR-NK的抗肿瘤活性。IL-15过度表达也与乳糜泻等自身免疫病相关，抑制IL-15是另一条思路。
learned: 本站追踪范围内最明确的阳性信号来自局部给药：IL-15超激动剂融合蛋白N-803（Anktiva）联合BCG在NMIBC中的QUILT-2.005研究据公司新闻稿达到主要终点。
全身给药的NKTR-255尚无经正式检验的疗效结论：NCT05327530（尿路上皮癌）为描述性读出，NCT05664217（NHL）因申办方商业决策终止，不能据此否定机制。
晚期管线集中在ImmunityBio（N-803相关试验最多），新进入者多为中国企业的早期项目，以IL-15武装的CAR-NK（如ICG318）和新型融合蛋白（FL115、IBI3013）为主。
opps: NMIBC以外的实体瘤（NSCLC、转移性实体瘤）已有项目布局但尚无读出，可检验以NK/CD8浸润为生物标志物筛选检查点耐药患者能否提高IL-15激动剂获益。
IL-15武装CAR-NK能否改善细胞持久性而不增加细胞因子毒性仍未回答，北京等机构的双靶点CAR-NK与ICG318早期数据将提供初步证据。
免疫/炎症领域仅6项试验，远少于肿瘤；IL-15阻断在乳糜泻、斑秃、白癜风等疾病中的探索较少。NCT02138734（NMIBC）已过主要完成日期，其结果值得关注。

en.why: IL-15, trans-presented by IL-15Rα, signals through IL-2/IL-15Rβ and the common γ chain via JAK1/3–STAT5. It expands and sustains NK cells and memory CD8+ T cells with little Treg expansion, which is why agonists are paired with BCG, checkpoint inhibitors and CAR-NK cells. Excess IL-15 also drives autoimmunity such as celiac disease, so blocking it is a second strategy.
learned: Among programs tracked here, the clearest positive signal comes from local delivery: the company reports that the IL-15 superagonist fusion protein N-803 (Anktiva) plus BCG met the primary endpoint of QUILT-2.005 in NMIBC.

Systemic, half-life-extended NKTR-255 has no formally tested efficacy result. NCT05327530 in urothelial carcinoma read out descriptively, and NCT05664217 in NHL was stopped by the sponsor for business reasons, which says nothing against the mechanism.

ImmunityBio holds most of the late-stage activity, with the most N-803 trials. Newer entrants are mostly early-stage Chinese programs: IL-15-armored CAR-NK cells such as ICG318, and new fusion proteins such as FL115 and IBI3013.
opps: Solid tumors beyond NMIBC, such as NSCLC and metastatic solid tumors, have programs but no readouts yet. One hypothesis: selecting checkpoint-refractory patients by NK/CD8 infiltration could show whether IL-15 agonism adds benefit.

It is still open whether IL-15 armoring makes CAR-NK cells persist longer without adding cytokine toxicity. Early data from the Beijing dual-target CAR-NK programs and from ICG318 should give a first answer.

Immune/inflammation work is thin (6 trials vs 26 in oncology), and IL-15 blockade in celiac disease, alopecia areata and vitiligo is little explored. Separately, the NMIBC trial NCT02138734 is past its primary completion date and has not yet reported.

zh.why: IL-17A与IL-17F由Th17、γδ T细胞和ILC3在IL-23驱动下分泌，经IL-17RA/RC受体激活角质形成细胞和滑膜、附着点炎症，并募集中性粒细胞。secukinumab、ixekizumab已在银屑病、PsA和中轴型脊柱关节炎中验证该通路。IL-17F在化脓性汗腺炎等病灶中同样升高，这是A/F双重阻断的依据。
learned: sonelokimab的两项2期均达到主要终点，分别为PsA（NCT05640245）和化脓性汗腺炎（NCT05322473），支持IL-17A/F双重阻断在关节和皮肤两条线上同时成立，目前已推进至3期。
tibulizumab在一项皮肤病2期中未达到终点（NCT06843239），这说明把IL-17阻断带出银屑病、脊柱关节炎和HS这些核心适应症，或与其他机制组合，疗效并不能直接外推。
ZL-1102以溶媒为对照的2期因申办方决定终止（NCT06380907），属商业原因，不能作为否定机制的证据；局部或非注射给药路线因此仍未得到检验。
本站追踪的13个项目中11个为单抗，集中在银屑病、PsA、HS和中轴型脊柱关节炎；netakimab、picankibart及secukinumab生物类似药的加入，使竞争更多转向适应症覆盖和价格。
opps: HS是接下来的主要检验场：bimekizumab（NCT04901195、NCT06921850）、sonelokimab 3期（NCT06768671）和tibulizumab（NCT06993610）结果待公布，可回答纳米抗体与IgG格式能否拉开差距，按病灶IL-17F水平或窦道负荷分层也值得探索。
在本站追踪范围内，非抗体项目只有一个，且已因商业原因终止。口服或局部IL-17抑制剂用于轻中度或不愿注射的患者仍是空白，关键在于证明组织暴露足够。
幼年型PsA、附着点炎相关关节炎和掌跖脓疱病只有少数项目覆盖，加上bimekizumab中轴型SpA 3期（NCT04436640），儿科和小众适应症仍是区分于头部产品的方向。

en.why: IL-17A and IL-17F are released by Th17 cells, γδ T cells and ILC3s under IL-23 drive. Signalling through IL-17RA/RC, they inflame keratinocytes, synovium and entheses and recruit neutrophils. Secukinumab and ixekizumab validated the pathway in psoriasis, PsA and axial spondyloarthritis. IL-17F is also raised in lesions such as hidradenitis suppurativa, which is the rationale for blocking A and F together.
learned: Sonelokimab met its primary endpoint in two phase 2 trials, in PsA (NCT05640245) and hidradenitis suppurativa (NCT05322473). That supports dual IL-17A/F blockade in both joint and skin disease, and the program has moved into phase 3.

Tibulizumab missed in a phase 2 skin-disease trial (NCT06843239). Moving IL-17 blockade outside the core psoriasis, spondyloarthritis and HS indications, or combining it with another mechanism, does not reliably carry the efficacy over.
ZL-1102's vehicle-controlled phase 2 was stopped by sponsor decision (NCT06380907). That is a business call, not evidence against the mechanism, so non-injectable or local delivery is still untested.

Eleven of the 13 programs tracked here are mAbs, clustered in psoriasis, PsA, HS and axial SpA. With netakimab, picankibart and a secukinumab biosimilar entering, competition is shifting toward indication breadth and price.
opps: HS is the next real test. Results are pending from bimekizumab (NCT04901195, NCT06921850), sonelokimab phase 3 (NCT06768671) and tibulizumab (NCT06993610). They should show whether nanobody and IgG formats differ. Stratifying patients by lesional IL-17F or tunnel burden is worth exploring.

Among programs tracked here, there is only one non-antibody program, and it stopped for business reasons. Oral or topical IL-17 inhibitors for mild-to-moderate or needle-averse patients remain open, provided enough drug reaches the tissue.

Few programs address juvenile PsA, enthesitis-related arthritis or palmoplantar pustulosis. Along with bimekizumab's axial SpA phase 3 (NCT04436640), pediatric and niche indications are a way to stand apart from the leading products.

zh.why: IL-18属IL-1家族，经炎症小体与caspase-1剪切活化，驱动Th1/NK细胞产生IFN-γ，体内由IL-18BP中和。游离IL-18升高见于巨噬细胞活化综合征及NLRC4相关自身炎症病，IL18RAP变异与IBD相关，支持其在肠道炎症中的作用。
learned: 临床记录仍很有限：本站追踪的项目中仅有GSK一款未命名的1期单抗（溃疡性结肠炎，2026年8月首次登记），尚无读出，未来六个月内也无试验到达主要完成节点。
opps: 本站追踪范围内，尚无项目覆盖游离IL-18致病性最明确的适应症，如巨噬细胞活化综合征、Still病及NLRC4或XIAP相关自身炎症；血清游离IL-18可作为现成的入组筛选标志物。
在溃疡性结肠炎中，临床前研究提示IL-18既促炎又参与上皮修复。按黏膜IL-18/IFN-γ特征分层并监测屏障指标，或可判断阻断是否仅在特定亚群获益。
目前追踪到的仅为单抗。只中和游离IL-18的设计、基于IL-18BP的生物药，或IL-18与IL-1β/TNF双靶点分子在本站尚无项目，可作为机制差异化方向。

en.why: IL-18 is an IL-1 family cytokine that becomes active when inflammasome-driven caspase-1 cleaves it. It drives IFN-γ production by Th1 and NK cells, and IL-18 binding protein holds it in check. Free IL-18 is markedly raised in macrophage activation syndrome and NLRC4 gain-of-function autoinflammation. IL18RAP variants are associated with IBD, which supports a role in gut inflammation.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Among programs tracked here, only GSK's unnamed phase 1 antibody in ulcerative colitis (first posted August 2026) is active. It has no readouts, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months.
opps: Among programs tracked here, none tests IL-18 blockade where free IL-18 is most clearly pathogenic: macrophage activation syndrome, Still's disease, and NLRC4- or XIAP-linked autoinflammation. Serum free IL-18 could serve as a ready-made biomarker for selecting patients.

In preclinical models of ulcerative colitis, IL-18 both drives inflammation and supports epithelial repair. Stratifying patients by mucosal IL-18/IFN-γ signature and tracking barrier markers could show whether blockade helps a defined subset rather than all comers.

The only modality tracked is a monoclonal antibody. Designs that neutralise only free IL-18, biologics based on IL-18BP, and bispecifics pairing IL-18 with IL-1β or TNF are untested here and could set a program apart on mechanism.

zh.why: IL-1β经NLRP3炎症小体与caspase-1切割活化，通过IL-1R1及辅助受体IL-1RAP信号放大中性粒细胞主导的炎症。CAPS等自身炎症病存在炎症小体功能获得性突变，IL-1受体拮抗剂anakinra已长期用于临床，通路的人体验证较充分。
learned: 本站跟踪的IL-1β/IL-1R项目尚无已报告的读出或失败记录，临床记录仍很薄。首个实质检验是lutikizumab在化脓性汗腺炎的3期试验NCT06468228，主要完成时间预计为2026年12月。
opps: 在本站跟踪范围内，化脓性汗腺炎、克罗恩病、溃疡性结肠炎和特应性皮炎各只有1个项目。NCT06468228的结果可以检验IL-1阻断在中性粒细胞浸润的屏障性炎症中能否带来获益，并决定是否值得在其他适应症单独布局。
现有项目以注射用生物制品为主，小分子仅HPB-092处于1期，基因治疗FX201和细胞治疗也都在早期。慢性病需要长期给药，口服或可在局部长效作用的递送方式可能是与领先抗体拉开差异的方向。
肿瘤领域有3项试验，但本站跟踪的项目适应症中没有肿瘤。IL-1β参与促瘤炎症，可以研究用炎症标志物筛选患者、或与免疫治疗联用这类假设。FMF已有2个项目，秋水仙碱应答不足人群也可作为分层方向。

en.why: IL-1β is cleaved into its active form by the NLRP3 inflammasome and caspase-1, then signals through IL-1R1 and the co-receptor IL-1RAP to amplify neutrophil-driven inflammation. Gain-of-function inflammasome mutations cause autoinflammatory diseases such as CAPS. Anakinra, an IL-1 receptor antagonist, has been in clinical use for many years, so the pathway is well validated in humans.
learned: None of the IL-1β/IL-1R programs tracked here has a reported readout or failure yet, so the clinical record is still thin. The first real test is lutikizumab's Phase 3 trial in hidradenitis suppurativa (NCT06468228), which is expected to reach primary completion in December 2026.
opps: Among programs tracked here, hidradenitis suppurativa, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis and atopic dermatitis each have just one program. NCT06468228 will test whether IL-1 blockade helps in neutrophil-rich barrier inflammation. The result could show whether these indications are worth pursuing on their own.

Most programs are injectable biologics. The only small molecule, HPB-092, is in Phase 1, and the gene therapy (FX201) and cell therapy programs are also early. For chronic diseases that need long-term dosing, oral or durable local delivery could set a program apart from the leading antibodies.

The site tracks three oncology trials, but none of the tracked programs lists a cancer indication. IL-1β drives tumor-promoting inflammation, so two hypotheses worth testing are selecting patients by inflammatory biomarkers and combining with immunotherapy. FMF already has two programs, and colchicine-inadequate responders could be a way to stratify patients.

zh.why: IL-2经IL-2Rβγ激活效应T细胞和NK细胞，但会优先结合Treg表面的高亲和力CD25。高剂量aldesleukin早已获批用于转移性黑色素瘤和肾癌，验证了这一机制，但毒性和Treg扩增限制了使用。因此新一代程序多为改造型或靶向递送的IL-2。
learned: 临床记录仍然很薄。目前收录的两项读出中，NCT01029873（ALT-801+顺铂）未设正式统计检验，NCT05194735（TCR-T+aldesleukin）因资金原因终止，两者都无法检验机制本身。未来6个月没有试验到达主要完成日期，Innovent IBI363的3期将是首个对照性检验。
opps: 本站收录的试验中，肿瘤占25项，免疫/炎症仅3项。针对自身免疫病的Treg偏向型低剂量IL-2或CD25选择性激动剂，值得作为空白领域评估。
Iovance、Alaunos等细胞疗法仍依赖全身给予IL-2，SYNCAR-001则在尝试正交IL-2信号。NCT05194735是因商业原因终止，用局部或正交IL-2替代全身IL-2能否降低毒性，问题仍未解答。
IBI363等单抗类程序已进入后期，但尚无对照数据。按PD-1阳性T细胞浸润等生物标志物筛选患者，可能是区别于领先者的方向，有待3期结果验证。

en.why: IL-2 expands effector T cells and NK cells through IL-2Rβγ, but it binds high-affinity CD25 on Tregs first. High-dose aldesleukin, approved long ago for metastatic melanoma and renal cancer, validated the mechanism, but toxicity and Treg expansion limited its use. That is why newer programs mostly use engineered or targeted IL-2.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Of the two readouts tracked, NCT01029873 (ALT-801 + cisplatin) had no formal statistical test and NCT05194735 (TCR-T + aldesleukin) stopped over funding. Neither tests the mechanism. No trial reaches primary completion in the next six months. Innovent's IBI363 phase 3 will be the first controlled test.
opps: Among trials tracked here, 25 are in oncology and only 3 in immunology/inflammation. Treg-biased low-dose IL-2 or CD25-selective agonists for autoimmune disease look like under-explored ground.

Cell therapies from Iovance and Alaunos still pair with systemic IL-2, while SYNCAR-001 tests orthogonal IL-2 signaling. NCT05194735 stopped for business reasons, so it is still unknown whether local or orthogonal IL-2 can replace systemic dosing with less toxicity.

Antibody programs such as IBI363 are in late stages but have no controlled data yet. Selecting patients by biomarkers such as PD-1-positive T-cell infiltration could set a program apart from the leaders. The phase 3 results will test this.

zh.why: IL-23由p19与p40组成，经IL-23R–JAK2/TYK2–STAT3通路维持致病性Th17细胞，驱动IL-17、IL-22分泌。IL23R基因多态性与炎症性肠病和银屑病相关，提供了遗传学验证。ustekinumab（p40）、guselkumab和risankizumab（p19）已在银屑病中获批多年，临床验证明确。
learned: 银屑病是该靶点确定性最高的领域：口服多肽IL-23R拮抗剂JNJ-77242113在NCT06095115、NCT06143878、NCT06220604中均达到主要终点，说明小分子级给药方式可以复现抗体的疗效。
JNJ-77242113在头皮、生殖器等难治部位（ICONIC-TOTAL，NCT06095102）同样达标，guselkumab在VISIBLE（NCT05272150）中也达标，证据已从泛银屑病延伸到特殊部位与特定人群。
炎症性肠病虽是本站追踪项目最集中的适应症（CD 9个、UC 7个），近期读出却缺乏假设检验：ustekinumab儿科研究NCT04630028、NCT04673357均为描述性结果。
本站追踪到的失败只有brazikumab（NCT03759288），因战略原因终止，不构成对机制的否定，更多反映后来者在成熟p19药物面前的商业压力；暂未见因安全性提前终止的研究。
opps: 口服IL-23R阻断在肠道能否达到足够暴露和疗效，在本站的读出中尚未验证；NCT06807424（银屑病关节炎）将检验JNJ-77242113向关节病的延伸，IBD适应症仍是空白。
瘘管型克罗恩病仅有一个追踪项目（guselkumab，NCT05347095），属于难治表型，结合NCT06063967（risankizumab，CD）和NCT06260163（guselkumab，UC），可检验p19药物在难治或经治人群中的上限。
在p19抗体趋于同质化的背景下，可探索按IL23R变异或IL-22/Th17通路标志物进行患者分层，以及与其他机制联用治疗难治性IBD；mirikizumab的2期UC研究（NCT06598943）结果仍待公布。

en.why: IL-23 (p19 plus p40) signals through IL-23R, JAK2/TYK2 and STAT3 to sustain pathogenic Th17 cells that produce IL-17 and IL-22. IL23R variants are linked to inflammatory bowel disease and psoriasis, which gives the target genetic support. Ustekinumab (p40), guselkumab and risankizumab (p19) have been approved in psoriasis for years, so the clinical validation is solid.
learned: Psoriasis is where the target is most proven. The oral peptide IL-23R antagonist JNJ-77242113 met its primary endpoint in NCT06095115, NCT06143878 and NCT06220604, which shows that oral dosing can reproduce antibody-level efficacy.

The evidence now reaches hard-to-treat sites and specific populations: JNJ-77242113 met its endpoint in scalp and genital disease (ICONIC-TOTAL, NCT06095102), and so did guselkumab in VISIBLE (NCT05272150).

IBD has the most programs tracked here (9 in Crohn's disease, 7 in ulcerative colitis), but the recent IBD readouts had no formal hypothesis test: the pediatric ustekinumab studies NCT04630028 and NCT04673357 were descriptive.

The only failure tracked here is brazikumab (NCT03759288), which was stopped for strategic reasons. That says nothing against the mechanism and more about the commercial pressure late entrants face against established p19 drugs. No trial tracked here was stopped for safety.
opps: Among readouts tracked here, nobody has yet tested whether oral IL-23R blockade gets enough drug to the gut to work. NCT06807424 will test JNJ-77242113 in psoriatic arthritis, but IBD is still an open question for this drug.

Fistulizing Crohn's disease has only one tracked program (guselkumab, NCT05347095). Together with NCT06063967 (risankizumab, Crohn's) and NCT06260163 (guselkumab, ulcerative colitis), it may show how far p19 drugs can go in refractory patients.

p19 antibodies are increasingly alike. One hypothesis is to select patients by IL23R variant or by IL-22/Th17 biomarkers; another is to combine IL-23 blockade with other mechanisms in refractory IBD. Results from the Phase 2 mirikizumab ulcerative colitis trial (NCT06598943) are still pending.

zh.why: IL-31主要由Th2细胞分泌，经IL-31RA/OSMRβ异二聚体受体作用于感觉神经元和角质形成细胞，是驱动慢性瘙痒的关键细胞因子，在特应性皮炎和结节性痒疹中水平升高。阻断该轴可直接打断瘙痒–搔抓循环，为以瘙痒为主的炎症性皮肤病提供不同于广谱2型抑制的路径。
learned: 临床记录尚少：本站目前仅追踪到Nemolizumab的II期药代研究NCT04921345，未做统计检验。Nemolizumab的III期研究NCT03989206（特应性皮炎）和NCT04204616（结节性痒疹）已过主要完成日期，结果尚未收录，将是对该靶点的首次实质检验。
opps: 本站追踪的项目除皮肤适应症外，也涉及系统性硬化症、不明原因慢性瘙痒和溃疡性结肠炎，但每个适应症仅一个项目。IL-31轴对纤维化和肠道炎症是否有贡献仍是开放问题。
本站追踪的3个项目均为单抗，尚无小分子、双特异抗体或长效制剂。同时靶向IL-31与IL-4Rα/IL-13的方案，或可同时兼顾瘙痒与炎症两类终点。
以瘙痒为主的表型或血清IL-31水平能否用于筛选患者尚待验证。Vixarelimab靶向共受体OSMRβ，可同时阻断OSM信号，与只阻断IL-31RA的Nemolizumab相比，是一种可供比较的差异化路径。

en.why: IL-31, made mainly by Th2 cells, signals through the IL-31RA/OSMRβ receptor on sensory neurons and keratinocytes. It is a key driver of chronic itch and is elevated in atopic dermatitis and prurigo nodularis. Blocking this axis targets the itch-scratch cycle directly, which is a different route from broad type 2 blockade for itch-dominant skin disease.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout tracked here is nemolizumab's Phase 2 PK study NCT04921345, which had no formal hypothesis test. Nemolizumab's Phase 3 trials NCT03989206 (atopic dermatitis) and NCT04204616 (prurigo nodularis) have passed primary completion, but results are not yet tracked here. They will be the first real test.
opps: Besides skin indications, programs tracked here include systemic sclerosis, chronic pruritus of unknown origin and ulcerative colitis, with one program each. Whether the IL-31 axis contributes to fibrosis or gut inflammation is still an open question.

All three programs tracked here are monoclonal antibodies. None are small molecules, bispecifics or long-acting formats. A drug that blocks both IL-31 and IL-4Rα/IL-13 might address both itch and inflammation endpoints.

It is untested whether itch-dominant phenotypes or serum IL-31 levels can be used to select patients. Vixarelimab targets the co-receptor OSMRβ, which also blocks OSM signaling. That gives a point of comparison with nemolizumab, which blocks IL-31RA only.

zh.why: IL-33是气道上皮受吸烟、病毒等损伤后释放的警报素，经ST2（IL1RL1）作用于ILC2、肥大细胞和T细胞，同时驱动2型与非2型炎症。GWAS提示IL33和IL1RL1与哮喘相关，阻断这一上游节点有望覆盖非嗜酸粒细胞型COPD。
learned: COPD急性加重上，配体和受体两种阻断方式都有阳性结果：抗ST2的astegolimab（NCT05595642、NCT05037929）、抗IL-33的itepekimab AERIFY-1（NCT04701983），以及AstraZeneca公布的tozorakimab OBERON/TITANIA。
结果重复性不稳定：设计相同的AERIFY-2（NCT04751487）在既往吸烟者队列未达到主要终点，AERIFY-1则达到，提示疗效幅度有限或存在异质性，哪类COPD患者能稳定获益仍不明确。
COPD以外的证据偏弱：itepekimab支气管扩张症II期（NCT06280391）未达到主要终点；鼻息肉CEREN-4（NCT07484230）因申办方决定终止，属于商业考量，不能据此否定机制。
竞争高度集中：本站追踪的5个项目均为III期单抗，来自3家大型药企，且主要集中在COPD，差异化更可能来自人群选择和给药方案，而不是分子形式。
opps: 应答人群的界定是主要悬而未决的问题。AERIFY-3（NCT05326412）在既往吸烟者中采集了支气管活检分子特征，若能找到解释AERIFY-1/-2结果分歧的组织或血液标志物，可作为差异化切入点；已过主要完成日期的NCT06208306可能补充证据。
itepekimab三项鼻息肉III期（NCT06834347、NCT06834360、NCT07424144）将检验：在已有成熟2型生物制剂的适应症中，IL-33阻断能否带来增量获益，不受CEREN-4终止的影响。
在本站追踪的项目中，尚未见吸入制剂或将IL-33与其他上皮细胞因子联合靶向的双抗；哮喘和重症病毒性肺部感染虽有登记试验，目前也没有追踪到读出，均为待验证的空白方向。

en.why: IL-33 is an epithelial alarmin released when airway cells are damaged by smoke, viruses or allergens. It signals through ST2 (IL1RL1) on ILC2s, mast cells and T cells, driving both type 2 and non-type 2 inflammation. GWAS link IL33 and IL1RL1 to asthma, and blocking this upstream node could reach COPD patients who are not eosinophilic.
learned: In COPD exacerbations, blocking either the ligand or the receptor has produced positive results: anti-ST2 astegolimab (NCT05595642, NCT05037929), anti-IL-33 itepekimab in AERIFY-1 (NCT04701983), and tozorakimab in OBERON and TITANIA, per AstraZeneca.

Results did not replicate reliably. Itepekimab's twin trial AERIFY-2 (NCT04751487) missed in its former-smoker cohort while AERIFY-1 met. That points to a modest or uneven effect and leaves open which COPD patients reliably benefit.

The evidence outside COPD is weaker. Itepekimab missed in a phase 2 bronchiectasis trial (NCT06280391). The CEREN-4 nasal polyp trial (NCT07484230) was stopped by sponsor decision, a business call that is not evidence against the mechanism.

The field is concentrated. All five programs tracked here are phase 3 monoclonal antibodies from three large companies, mostly in COPD, so differentiation is more likely to come from patient selection and dosing than from modality.
opps: The main open question is who responds. AERIFY-3 (NCT05326412) collected endobronchial biopsy signatures in former smokers. Tissue or blood markers that explain the AERIFY-1/-2 split could give a later entrant a way to differentiate. Itepekimab COPD trial NCT06208306, now past primary completion, may add evidence.

Three itepekimab phase 3 nasal polyp trials (NCT06834347, NCT06834360, NCT07424144) will test whether IL-33 blockade adds benefit in an indication already served by established type 2 biologics, regardless of the CEREN-4 stop.

Among programs tracked here, none use an inhaled format or a bispecific that pairs IL-33 with another epithelial cytokine. Asthma and severe viral lung infection have registered trials but no tracked readouts yet. Both remain untested openings.

zh.why: IL-36R（IL1RL2）与IL-1RAcP组成受体，接收IL-36α/β/γ信号，激活角质形成细胞并招募中性粒细胞，推动脓疱性炎症。IL36RN功能缺失突变导致天然拮抗剂IL-36Ra失效，可引发泛发性脓疱型银屑病（GPP），为该靶点提供了遗传学依据。spesolimab已获批用于GPP急性发作。
learned: 临床记录仍很有限：本站唯一读出是spesolimab在化脓性汗腺炎的NCT06241573，主要终点为安全性，无统计检验，且被记录为提前终止、原因未说明，既不能证明疗效，也不能否定机制；未来6个月本站跟踪的试验中没有预期读出。
opps: GPP之外的中性粒细胞性皮肤病仍待验证：本站跟踪的化脓性汗腺炎和坏疽性脓皮病各只有一个项目，按疗效设计的试验可检验IL-36通路能否延伸到这些适应症。
患者分层是一个未解问题：可按IL36RN、CARD14、AP1S3突变或皮损IL-36表达特征入组，检验这类患者是否在非GPP适应症中应答更好。
本站跟踪的两个项目均为单抗（spesolimab和处于2期的HB0034），尚无口服小分子、局部用药或双靶点药物，这些形式在长期维持或预防发作方面或有差异化空间。

en.why: IL-36R (IL1RL2) pairs with IL-1RAcP to signal for IL-36α/β/γ, activating keratinocytes and recruiting neutrophils into pustular inflammation. Loss-of-function IL36RN mutations disable the natural antagonist IL-36Ra and cause generalized pustular psoriasis (GPP), giving genetic validation. Spesolimab is approved for GPP flares.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout tracked here, spesolimab in hidradenitis suppurativa (NCT06241573), had a safety primary endpoint with no formal test and is logged as stopped early with no reason given. It neither shows efficacy nor counts against the mechanism. No tracked readouts are due in the next six months.
opps: Whether the mechanism reaches beyond GPP into other neutrophilic dermatoses is still untested. Hidradenitis suppurativa and pyoderma gangrenosum have one tracked program each, and efficacy-powered trials could settle it.
Patient selection is an open question. Enrolling by IL36RN, CARD14 or AP1S3 variants, or by a lesional IL-36 signature, could test whether these subgroups respond better outside GPP.

Both tracked programs are monoclonal antibodies (spesolimab and the phase 2 HB0034). Among programs tracked here, there is no oral small molecule, topical or bispecific yet, which leaves room in long-term maintenance or flare prevention.

zh.why: IL-4Rα是IL-4和IL-13受体的共用亚基，阻断后可同时抑制两者经JAK1/STAT6的信号，从而减少IgE类别转换、嗜酸性粒细胞募集、屏障损伤和瘙痒。Dupilumab已在特应性皮炎和哮喘获批多年，为这一2型炎症靶点提供了临床验证。
learned: 本站追踪到的唯一读出是NCT07330934（dupilumab联合IBI356治疗特应性皮炎的2期），因申办方决定终止，不能说明机制无效。首批实质检验将来自CM310特应性皮炎3期（NCT06495229）、rademikibart COPD急性加重（NCT06940154）和stapokibart季节性过敏性鼻炎（NCT07678931）。
opps: 本站追踪的9个项目中8个为单抗，4个针对特应性皮炎，同质化明显。差异化可能来自更长的给药间隔或制剂与装置改进（Sanofi共制剂、rademikibart预充针）；口服等非抗体形式在此尚无项目。
急性场景基本空白：本站仅rademikibart布局COPD与哮喘急性加重。NCT06940154将检验急性期阻断IL-4Rα是否有效，以及是否需要按嗜酸性粒细胞或FeNO筛选患者。
嗜酸性十二指肠炎、季节性过敏性鼻炎等较小的2型适应症各仅1-2个项目。NCT07330934因商业原因提前终止，IL-4Rα阻断叠加第二条通路能否加深应答仍无答案。

en.why: IL-4Rα is the shared subunit of the type I (IL-4) and type II (IL-4/IL-13) receptors. Blocking it shuts off JAK1/STAT6 signaling from both cytokines, which drives IgE class switching, eosinophil recruitment, barrier damage and itch. Dupilumab's long-standing approvals in atopic dermatitis and asthma validate the mechanism in type 2 disease.
learned: Among trials tracked here, the only readout is NCT07330934, a Phase 2 study of dupilumab + IBI356 in atopic dermatitis that was stopped by sponsor decision. That stop says nothing about the mechanism. The first real tests will be CM310 Phase 3 in AD (NCT06495229), rademikibart in COPD exacerbation (NCT06940154) and stapokibart in seasonal allergic rhinitis (NCT07678931).
opps: Among programs tracked here, eight of nine are monoclonal antibodies and four target atopic dermatitis. Differentiation may come from longer dosing intervals or from formulation and device work (Sanofi's coformulation, rademikibart's prefilled syringe). Non-antibody modalities such as oral agents are absent from this set.

Acute settings are barely explored: rademikibart is the only program tracked here in COPD and asthma exacerbations. NCT06940154 will test whether IL-4Rα blockade helps during an exacerbation, and whether patients need eosinophil or FeNO selection to benefit.

Smaller type 2 indications such as eosinophilic duodenitis and seasonal allergic rhinitis have only one or two programs each. Because NCT07330934 stopped early for business reasons, it is still unknown whether adding a second pathway to IL-4Rα blockade deepens response.

zh.why: IL-5驱动嗜酸性粒细胞的分化、活化与存活，IL-5Rα主要表达于嗜酸性粒细胞。中和IL-5或经IL-5Rα清除嗜酸性粒细胞，可用于嗜酸性哮喘、EGPA和HES；mepolizumab与benralizumab获批用于重度嗜酸性哮喘，机制已有临床验证。
learned: 临床记录仍偏少：已追踪读出仅NATRON（NCT04191304），benralizumab在HES中达到首次恶化时间主要终点。下一批检验是depemokimab的EGPA研究NCT05263934、benralizumab哮喘研究NCT05692180和depemokimab哮喘研究NCT07671001。
opps: 在本站追踪范围内，现有项目均为两家公司的3期单抗，尚无口服小分子、双抗（如联合TSLP或IL-13）等其他modality。对多条2型通路重叠的患者，这类设计仍是可检验的假设。
COPD仅见于一个项目的适应症列表。以血嗜酸性粒细胞计数筛选的嗜酸性COPD人群在已追踪管线中覆盖有限，可作为生物标志物驱动的拓展方向。
IL-5中和（depemokimab）与IL-5Rα介导的清除（benralizumab）孰优，在系统性嗜酸性疾病中尚无定论。NCT05263934的EGPA结果可与NATRON对照，提示长间隔给药的中和策略能否覆盖清除型抗体的获益。

en.why: IL-5 drives eosinophil differentiation, activation and survival, and IL-5Rα is expressed mainly on eosinophils. Neutralizing IL-5, or depleting eosinophils through IL-5Rα, treats eosinophil-driven diseases such as eosinophilic asthma, EGPA and HES. Approvals of mepolizumab and benralizumab in severe eosinophilic asthma have validated the mechanism clinically.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout tracked here is NATRON (NCT04191304), where benralizumab met its primary endpoint of time to first HES worsening. The next tests are depemokimab in EGPA (NCT05263934), benralizumab in asthma (NCT05692180) and depemokimab in asthma (NCT07671001).
opps: Among programs tracked here, every program is a Phase 3 monoclonal antibody from one of two companies. No oral small molecules or bispecifics (for example, pairing IL-5 with TSLP or IL-13) appear. For patients with overlapping type 2 pathways, these designs remain testable hypotheses.

COPD appears in the condition list of only one program. Eosinophilic COPD, with patients selected by blood eosinophil count, is barely covered in the tracked pipeline and could be a biomarker-led direction to explore.

It is still unclear whether neutralizing IL-5 (depemokimab) or depleting eosinophils via IL-5Rα (benralizumab) works better in systemic eosinophilic disease. Reading the EGPA results of NCT05263934 alongside NATRON may show whether a long-interval neutralizing antibody can match a depleting one.

zh.why: IL-6经膜结合型和可溶性IL-6R与gp130激活JAK–STAT3，驱动CRP等急性期反应及B/T细胞分化。tocilizumab、sarilumab已在类风湿关节炎中验证该靶点；IL6R功能缺失变异与冠心病风险降低相关，支持在心肾疾病中阻断IL-6。
learned: 甲状腺眼病中，satralizumab两项设计相同的III期结果不一致：SatraGO-2达到主要终点（NCT06106828），SatraGO-1未达到（NCT05987423）。两项各约130例，提示可能有疗效但幅度有限，重复性不足。
心肾领域证据仍停留在生物标志物层面：TOUR006在CKD中达到hs-CRP终点（NCT06362759）；ziltivekimab心衰结局试验HERMES（NCT05636176）记为终止且未说明原因，不能据此判断机制成败。
本站追踪的17个项目中15个为单抗，重心已从风湿免疫转向心血管、代谢与肾脏。后期项目主要在抗体形式和给药间隔上有所区别，最终能否差异化取决于硬终点数据。
opps: ziltivekimab心血管风险试验（NCT06118281）和心衰试验NCT06200207将首次检验hs-CRP下降能否转化为事件减少。参照IL6R遗传学，按高hs-CRP或CKD富集人群是可检验的入组策略。
satralizumab结果不一致后，甲状腺眼病仍有空间。TOUR006的TED试验（NCT06088979）可检验另一抗体能否重复疗效；按疾病活动度或病程分层，或可解释两项试验的差异。
本站追踪项目中仅有一个疫苗（Peptinov）和一个小分子。口服药物、主动免疫或选择性阻断trans-signaling，可能更适合长期心血管预防，并降低全面抑制IL-6带来的感染风险。

en.why: IL-6 signals through membrane-bound and soluble IL-6R with gp130, activating JAK–STAT3. This drives the acute-phase response (CRP) and B- and T-cell differentiation. Tocilizumab and sarilumab validated the target in rheumatoid arthritis. A common IL6R loss-of-function variant linked to lower coronary risk supports blocking IL-6 in atherosclerotic and cardiorenal disease.
learned: In thyroid eye disease, satralizumab's twin phase 3 trials used the same proptosis endpoint but split: SatraGO-2 met it (NCT06106828) and SatraGO-1 missed (NCT05987423). With about 130 patients each, any effect looks modest and does not replicate reliably.

In cardiorenal disease the evidence is still at the biomarker level. TOUR006 met its hs-CRP endpoint in CKD (NCT06362759). The ziltivekimab heart-failure outcomes trial HERMES (NCT05636176) is recorded as stopped with no stated reason, so it neither confirms nor refutes the mechanism.

Among programs tracked here, 15 of 17 are monoclonal antibodies, and the focus has moved from rheumatology to cardiovascular, metabolic and renal disease. Late-stage programs differ mainly in antibody format and dosing interval, so outcome data will decide which ones stand apart.
opps: The ziltivekimab cardiovascular-risk trial (NCT06118281) and the heart-failure trial NCT06200207 are the first chance to see whether lower hs-CRP means fewer events. The IL6R genetics suggest a testable selection strategy: enrich for high hs-CRP or CKD.

Thyroid eye disease is still open after the split satralizumab result. The TOUR006 TED trial (NCT06088979) will show whether a different antibody reproduces the effect. Selecting patients by disease activity or duration might explain why only one twin trial worked.

Only one vaccine (Peptinov) and one small molecule appear among tracked programs. Oral agents, active immunisation or selective trans-signalling blockade could suit long-term cardiovascular prevention, where the infection risk of broad IL-6 suppression matters most.

zh.why: IL-7Rα（CD127）与γc链组成IL-7受体，维持初始和记忆T细胞的存活与稳态，同时也是TSLP受体的亚基。IL7R变异与多发性硬化易感性相关；炎症性肠病黏膜IL-7R高表达与现有疗法应答不佳相关，阻断该通路有望削弱致病性记忆T细胞。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：本站追踪的唯一读出是OSE Immunotherapeutics抗IL-7R单抗在溃疡性结肠炎中的II期CoTikiS（NCT04882007），第10周改良Mayo评分达到主要终点；未来6个月暂无已追踪的读出。
opps: NCT04882007的主要终点是第10周诱导期指标，疗效能否在维持期延续、在既往高级疗法失败人群中是否成立仍待验证，需要更大规模、更长周期的研究来回答。
可检验以黏膜IL7R表达或IL-7信号特征作为富集标志物，筛选更可能应答的患者；同时需明确阻断IL-7Rα是否影响TSLP信号，这关系到疗效与安全性的取舍。
在本站追踪的项目中适应症仅限溃疡性结肠炎，克罗恩病以及多发性硬化等有遗传学证据的T细胞介导疾病仍是空白，值得验证。

en.why: IL-7Rα (CD127) pairs with the common γ chain to form the IL-7 receptor, which keeps naive and memory T cells alive. It is also a subunit of the TSLP receptor. IL7R variants are linked to multiple sclerosis risk, and high mucosal IL-7R expression in inflammatory bowel disease tracks with poor response to current therapies, so blocking it could weaken pathogenic memory T cells.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout tracked here is OSE Immunotherapeutics' Phase 2 CoTikiS trial of an anti-IL-7R antibody in ulcerative colitis (NCT04882007), which met its primary endpoint on modified Mayo score at week 10. No tracked readouts are due in the next six months.
opps: NCT04882007 used a week-10 induction endpoint. It is still unknown whether benefit lasts through maintenance and holds in patients who failed advanced therapies. Answering that needs larger, longer studies.

A testable idea: use mucosal IL7R expression or an IL-7 signaling signature to enrich for likely responders. It also needs to be settled whether blocking IL-7Rα affects TSLP signaling, which bears on both efficacy and safety.
Among programs tracked here, ulcerative colitis is the only indication. Crohn's disease and T-cell-driven diseases with genetic support, such as multiple sclerosis, have not been tested here.

zh.why: LILRB1（ILT2）、LILRB2（ILT4）和LILRB4是髓系细胞、NK及T细胞上的抑制性受体，结合HLA-G等HLA I类分子后经ITIM传递抑制信号，维持肿瘤微环境的髓系免疫抑制。阻断后有望重塑巨噬细胞与MDSC表型，补足PD-1抑制剂未覆盖的髓系耐药。
learned: 临床证据仍很薄：本站追踪的5个项目均在1期或1/2期，尚无读出或失败记录，未来六个月亦无主要完成节点；最早的MK-4830（2019年起3项试验）结果仍待公开。
opps: 血液肿瘤布局稀少：本站追踪项目中AML和多发性骨髓瘤各仅1个。LILRB4在单核细胞型AML上高表达，可作直接靶向抗原，ADC或细胞疗法尚未见于追踪项目。
患者筛选尚未建立：可检验肿瘤HLA-G表达或髓系细胞浸润程度能否富集获益人群，尤其在NSCLC、食管鳞癌、小细胞肺癌等已有项目覆盖的实体瘤中。
多靶点设计仍属早期：仅Mabwell的6MW5311为双抗，2026年11月才首次登记。同时阻断ILT2与ILT4，或在单一分子中整合PD-(L)1阻断，能否优于单抗联用尚无数据。

en.why: LILRB1 (ILT2), LILRB2 (ILT4) and LILRB4 are inhibitory receptors on myeloid cells, NK and T cells. They bind HLA class I molecules such as HLA-G and signal through ITIMs, which keeps tumor-associated myeloid cells suppressive. Blocking them could repolarize macrophages and MDSCs and address myeloid resistance that PD-1 inhibitors leave untouched.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. All five programs tracked here are in Phase 1 or 1/2. No readouts or failures are logged, and no primary completions are due in the next six months. MSD's MK-4830 has run since 2019 across three trials, and its results are still not public.
opps: Blood cancers are thinly covered: among tracked programs, AML and multiple myeloma have one program each. LILRB4 is highly expressed on monocytic AML cells, which makes it a candidate for direct tumor targeting. No ADC or cell-therapy formats appear among programs tracked here.

Patient selection is not yet defined. One hypothesis to test is whether tumor HLA-G expression or the level of myeloid infiltration picks out responders, especially in solid tumors that existing programs already cover: NSCLC, esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and small cell lung cancer.

Multi-target designs are early. Mabwell's 6MW5311 is the only bispecific and was first registered in November 2026. There are no data yet on whether blocking ILT2 and ILT4 together, or building PD-(L)1 blockade into the same molecule, beats combining separate antibodies.

zh.why: IRAK4是TLR和IL-1受体家族下游Myddosome复合物的核心激酶，同时起支架作用，驱动NF-κB等炎症信号。MYD88 L265P突变通过这条通路驱动部分B细胞淋巴瘤。先天性IRAK4缺陷患者主要在儿童期易发化脓性细菌感染，其余方面基本正常，提示抑制该靶点的安全窗可能较宽。
learned: 临床证据仍很少：本站追踪的2个II期小分子项目（AstraZeneca、Leadingtac）尚无读出，也没有失败记录，未来6个月内没有追踪中的试验到达主要完成日期，近期没有可以检验该机制的数据。
opps: 本站追踪的试验同时覆盖COPD、特应性皮炎和血液肿瘤。在血液肿瘤中按MYD88 L265P等突变筛选患者，可能是最能直接检验通路依赖性的设计。
追踪中的项目都是小分子，但现有信息无法区分激酶抑制剂和降解剂。IRAK4兼具激酶与支架功能，能否同时阻断两者，可能是与后来者拉开差距的关键问题。
化脓性汗腺炎、类风湿关节炎、狼疮等IL-1/TLR驱动的疾病，在本站追踪的项目中还没有覆盖。长期给药时的细菌感染风险也值得系统监测。

en.why: IRAK4 is the core kinase and scaffold of the Myddosome downstream of TLRs and IL-1 family receptors, driving NF-κB and other inflammatory signaling. MYD88 L265P mutations drive some B-cell lymphomas through this pathway. People born without IRAK4 are prone to pyogenic bacterial infections, mainly in childhood, but are otherwise largely healthy. That suggests blocking IRAK4 may have a reasonable safety margin.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Two Phase 2 small-molecule programs are tracked here (AstraZeneca, Leadingtac). Neither has a readout or a recorded failure, and no tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term data will test the mechanism.
opps: Tracked trials cover COPD, atopic dermatitis and blood cancers. In blood cancers, selecting patients by MYD88 L265P or related mutations may be the most direct test of whether the tumors depend on this pathway.

All tracked programs are small molecules, but the facts do not say which are kinase inhibitors and which are degraders. IRAK4 works as both a kinase and a scaffold, so whether a drug blocks both functions may be the key way to stand out.

No tracked program covers other IL-1/TLR-driven diseases such as hidradenitis suppurativa, rheumatoid arthritis or lupus. With long-term dosing, bacterial infection risk also deserves systematic monitoring.

zh.why: αvβ6整合素只在上皮细胞表达，正常组织中含量很低，但在上皮损伤、纤维化以及多种癌（如NSCLC、头颈鳞癌）中明显上调。它能激活潜伏态TGF-β，从而推动纤维化和肿瘤微环境重塑。这种肿瘤与正常组织之间的表达差异，使它适合作为ADC靶点，同时也适合作为抗纤维化干预的节点。
learned: 临床证据仍然很少。目前唯一的读出是PLN-74809在IPF中的Phase 2研究NCT06097260，经DSMB建议提前终止，原因编码为疗效，未作正式统计检验。肿瘤方向尚无读出，未来6个月内也没有试验到达主要完成日期，ADC路线的首个关键检验将来自Pfizer的Sigvotatug Vedotin Phase 3。
opps: 在本站追踪的项目中，ADC集中在NSCLC和泛实体瘤，Pfizer进展最快。头颈鳞癌和膀胱癌各只有1个项目。可以考虑在αvβ6高表达的其他上皮癌中拓展适应症，或通过不同的payload和连接子来与领先者区分。
可以检验一个假设：按αvβ6 IHC表达水平筛选患者，能否提高ADC的疗效窗口并减少对正常上皮的毒性。早期的Kelun-Biotech、Sutro及Pfizer第二代项目适合前瞻性地纳入这类生物标志物。
NCT06097260终止之后，问题仍未解决：失败是源于靶点本身（在肺内抑制TGF-β激活），还是源于具体分子和剂量。本站目前没有追踪其他纤维化项目，换用不同的给药方式或其他纤维化适应症仍有待验证。

en.why: αvβ6 is an epithelial-restricted integrin with low expression in healthy tissue. It is strongly upregulated in epithelial injury, fibrosis and many carcinomas, including NSCLC and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. It activates latent TGF-β, which drives fibrosis and remodels the tumour microenvironment. Because it is far more abundant on tumours than on normal tissue, it suits ADCs and is also a node for anti-fibrotic intervention.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout is the Phase 2 IPF trial of PLN-74809 (NCT06097260), stopped early on DSMB recommendation and coded as efficacy, with no formal statistical test. No oncology trial has read out, and none reaches primary completion in the next six months. Pfizer's Phase 3 trial of Sigvotatug Vedotin will be the first real test of the ADC approach.
opps: Among programs tracked here, the ADCs focus on NSCLC and advanced solid tumours, with Pfizer furthest along. Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma and bladder cancer have one program each. Other αvβ6-high carcinomas, or a different payload and linker, could set a program apart from the leader.

One hypothesis to test: does selecting patients by αvβ6 IHC expression widen the ADC's therapeutic window and spare normal epithelium? The early Kelun-Biotech, Sutro and second Pfizer programs could build in such a biomarker from the start.

After NCT06097260 stopped, it is still unclear whether the problem was the target (blocking TGF-β activation in the lung) or the specific molecule and dose. No other fibrosis programs are tracked here, so other routes of delivery and other fibrotic indications are untested.

zh.why: JAK1与JAK2、JAK3或TYK2配对，传导IL-6、干扰素、IL-4/IL-13、IL-31等炎症因子信号。选择性抑制JAK1可阻断这些通路，同时尽量保留JAK2依赖的造血信号。upadacitinib等已获批药物已在类风湿关节炎、炎症性肠病和特应性皮炎中验证该机制。
learned: 本站追踪的读出中，仅STOP-HS2（NCT05620836）有正式假设检验，povorcitinib在化脓性汗腺炎中达到主要终点，其余两项为描述性。下一步关键检验是povorcitinib结节性痒疹（NCT06516965、NCT06516952）和upadacitinib狼疮（NCT05843643）试验。
opps: 本站追踪的项目中，干扰素驱动和血管炎类疾病覆盖较少：Takayasu动脉炎1个、cGVHD 2个，狼疮仅NCT05843643一项。其结果可检验JAK1选择性能否控制I型干扰素驱动疾病，并为按干扰素特征选择患者提供依据。
本站追踪的8个项目均为口服全身用小分子，未见外用或肠道限制型JAK1抑制剂。局部暴露能否在皮肤或肠道病中保留疗效、同时规避JAK类药物的全身安全性顾虑，值得验证；FINCH 4（NCT03025308）正在长期随访安全性。
povorcitinib正拓展至特应性皮炎（本站已有3个项目）以外的皮肤病。结节性痒疹试验（NCT06516965、NCT06516952）及第二项HS试验（NCT06212999）将显示STOP-HS2结果能否复现，以及瘙痒和中性粒细胞驱动的皮肤病能否成为独立方向。

en.why: JAK1 partners with JAK2, JAK3 or TYK2 to signal for many inflammatory cytokines, including IL-6, interferons, IL-4/IL-13 and IL-31. Selective JAK1 inhibition aims to block these pathways while sparing JAK2-dependent blood-cell signaling. Approved drugs such as upadacitinib have validated the mechanism in rheumatoid arthritis, inflammatory bowel disease and atopic dermatitis.
learned: Of the readouts tracked here, only STOP-HS2 (NCT05620836) tested a hypothesis, and povorcitinib met its primary endpoint in hidradenitis suppurativa. The other two were descriptive. The next real tests are povorcitinib in prurigo nodularis (NCT06516965, NCT06516952) and upadacitinib in lupus (NCT05843643).
opps: Among programs tracked here, interferon-driven and vasculitic diseases get little coverage: one Takayasu arteritis program, two cGVHD programs and a single lupus trial (NCT05843643). That trial could show whether JAK1 selectivity is enough to control type I interferon-driven disease, and could support selecting patients by interferon signature.

All eight tracked programs are oral small molecules that act systemically. No topical or gut-restricted JAK1 inhibitors appear here. Such drugs could test whether local exposure keeps efficacy in skin or bowel disease while avoiding the JAK class's systemic safety concerns, which FINCH 4 (NCT03025308) is following long term.

Povorcitinib is moving into skin diseases beyond atopic dermatitis, which already has three programs here. The prurigo nodularis trials (NCT06516965, NCT06516952) and a second HS trial (NCT06212999) will show whether the STOP-HS2 result replicates, and whether itch- and neutrophil-driven skin disease is a separate opening.

zh.why: JAK2是传导EPO、TPO等细胞因子受体信号的非受体酪氨酸激酶。获得性JAK2 V617F突变见于绝大多数真性红细胞增多症，以及约半数原发性血小板增多症和原发性骨髓纤维化，会持续激活JAK–STAT通路。ruxolitinib获批用于骨髓纤维化已多年，验证了这一靶点。
learned: 本站追踪的4个项目（3个III期、1个I期）目前没有读出，也没有终止或失败记录；未来6个月内也没有到达主要完成日的试验，现阶段还无法从临床记录中总结规律。
opps: 两个处于III期的重组蛋白项目（AOP Orphan、PharmaEssentia）都集中在原发性血小板增多症。本站追踪范围内没有以真性红细胞增多症为适应症的项目，这一空白值得验证。
现有JAK2抑制剂同时抑制野生型JAK2，常伴随贫血和血小板减少。选择性抑制V617F突变体能否避开这些毒性仍是未解问题；Eli Lilly的LY5830966是本站追踪的唯一早期小分子，其选择性尚待披露。
针对MPN相关贫血，本站只追踪到1个III期项目（Bristol Myers Squibb）。以JAK2 V617F等位基因负荷作为入组分层或疾病修饰终点，可能有助于区分各项目的定位。

en.why: JAK2 is the non-receptor tyrosine kinase that carries signals from the EPO, TPO and other cytokine receptors. The acquired V617F mutation, found in most polycythemia vera and about half of essential thrombocythemia and primary myelofibrosis cases, locks JAK–STAT signaling on. Ruxolitinib has been approved in myelofibrosis for years, which validated the target.
learned: The 4 programs tracked here (3 in Phase 3, 1 in Phase 1) have no readouts and no recorded stops or failures. No trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so the clinical record is too thin to draw lessons from yet.
opps: Both Phase 3 recombinant-protein programs (AOP Orphan, PharmaEssentia) target essential thrombocythemia. Among programs tracked here, none lists polycythemia vera as its indication, which is a gap worth testing.

Current JAK2 inhibitors also hit wild-type JAK2, which commonly causes anemia and thrombocytopenia. Whether a V617F mutant-selective inhibitor can avoid these toxicities is still open. Eli Lilly's LY5830966 is the only early small molecule tracked here, and its selectivity has not been disclosed.

Only one Phase 3 program (Bristol Myers Squibb) tracked here addresses MPN-associated anemia. Using JAK2 V617F allele burden to stratify patients or as a disease-modification endpoint could help programs set themselves apart.

zh.why: JAK家族介导IL-6、干扰素、γc链细胞因子及EPO/TPO受体下游的STAT信号。JAK2 V617F等激活突变驱动骨髓纤维化等骨髓增殖性肿瘤，细胞因子轴则维持多种自身免疫和炎症性皮肤病；ruxolitinib与tofacitinib长期获批，提供了临床验证。
learned: 临床记录仍偏薄：仅TRuE-AD4（NCT06238817，ruxolitinib治疗特应性皮炎）达到主要终点，其余终止多属入组或商业原因；ruxolitinib化脓性汗腺炎III期（NCT06958211、NCT06959225）将是下一轮实质检验。
opps: 本站仅追踪到2个化脓性汗腺炎项目，NCT06958211与NCT06959225将检验JAK抑制能否覆盖这一中性粒细胞主导的毛囊炎症，可据此探索应答人群的生物标志物。
追踪的20个项目中19个为小分子，尚无降解剂或局部/组织限定型分子；这类设计或可在保留局部疗效的同时降低系统性JAK抑制的类效应安全风险。
骨髓纤维化联合用药仍未定型：RVU120联合ruxolitinib因申办方决定终止（NCT06397313，不能说明机制无效），NCT02158858无正式检验，可按突变或贫血状态筛选人群，检验能否超越脾脏缓解。

en.why: JAK kinases (JAK1/2/3, TYK2) relay STAT signalling from receptors for IL-6, interferons, γc cytokines and EPO/TPO. Activating JAK2 mutations such as V617F drive myeloproliferative neoplasms including myelofibrosis, while cytokine loops sustain autoimmune and inflammatory skin disease. Long-standing approvals of ruxolitinib and tofacitinib provide clinical validation.
learned: The clinical record is still thin: only TRuE-AD4 (NCT06238817, ruxolitinib in atopic dermatitis) met its primary endpoint, and the other stops were for enrollment or business reasons. The ruxolitinib hidradenitis suppurativa Phase 3s (NCT06958211, NCT06959225) will be the next real test.
opps: Only two hidradenitis suppurativa programs are tracked here. NCT06958211 and NCT06959225 will test whether JAK inhibition reaches this neutrophil-driven follicular inflammation, which opens a path to biomarkers that pick out responders.

Of the 20 programs tracked here, 19 are small molecules, with no degraders and no locally or tissue-restricted agents. Such designs might keep local efficacy while reducing the class safety risks of systemic JAK inhibition.

Myelofibrosis combinations remain unsettled. RVU120 plus ruxolitinib stopped on a sponsor decision (NCT06397313), which says nothing against the mechanism, and NCT02158858 had no formal test. Selecting patients by mutation or anemia status could test whether combinations go beyond spleen response.

zh.why: KAT6A/B属MYST家族组蛋白乙酰转移酶，主要催化H3K23乙酰化，可维持ESR1等雌激素通路基因的转录。KAT6A位于8p11-12扩增区，在部分ER+乳腺癌中扩增，在AML中可形成KAT6A融合基因，是激素驱动肿瘤和髓系肿瘤的表观遗传靶点。
learned: 临床记录仍然很少：本站尚未收录任何读出、失败或提前终止，未来六个月内也没有试验达到主要完成。目前进度最快的是Pfizer的PF-07248144（3期），其结果预计是该机制的首次真正检验，其余5个项目均处于1期或1/2期。
opps: 在本站追踪的项目中，适应症集中在ER+ HER2-乳腺癌，去势抵抗性前列腺癌、NSCLC和髓系肿瘤各仅有零星布局。可以检验KAT6抑制在AR驱动肿瘤或KAT6A融合AML中是否同样有效。
KAT6A扩增或高表达能否作为患者筛选标志物，目前尚无数据。早期试验若按8p11扩增分层，有助于判断获益人群，并与PF-07248144形成差异。
已追踪项目以小分子为主，尚未看到降解剂类分子。降解剂或对KAT6A/KAT6B选择性不同的分子，是否能改善疗效与耐受性的平衡，值得研究。

en.why: KAT6A and KAT6B are MYST-family histone acetyltransferases. They mainly acetylate H3K23 and keep estrogen-pathway genes such as ESR1 switched on. KAT6A sits in the 8p11-12 amplicon, which is amplified in a subset of ER+ breast cancers, and it forms fusion genes in AML. That makes KAT6 an epigenetic target in hormone-driven and myeloid cancers.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site has no readouts, failures or early stops for KAT6, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months. Pfizer's PF-07248144, in Phase 3, is furthest along and will likely give the first real test. The other five programs are in Phase 1 or 1/2.
opps: Among programs tracked here, most work is in ER+ HER2- breast cancer. Castration-resistant prostate cancer, NSCLC and myeloid cancers each have only one or two programs. An open question is whether KAT6 inhibition also works in AR-driven tumors or in AML with KAT6A fusions.

There is no data yet on whether KAT6A amplification or high expression can pick out responders. Early trials that split patients by 8p11 amplification could show who benefits and set a program apart from PF-07248144.

The tracked programs are mostly small-molecule inhibitors, and no degraders appear. Degraders, or molecules with different KAT6A vs. KAT6B selectivity, are worth testing for a better balance of efficacy and tolerability.

zh.why: KIF18A是驱动蛋白-8家族马达蛋白，调控中期染色体排列与纺锤体张力。染色体不稳定（CIN）、全基因组加倍或TP53突变的肿瘤细胞依赖KIF18A完成有丝分裂，而正常二倍体细胞基本不受影响，构成与CIN相关的合成致死窗口，高级别浆液性卵巢癌和三阴性乳腺癌是典型代表。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：本站追踪的2个项目（Volastra未命名分子、Accent的ATX-295）均为小分子、处于1/2期，尚无读出、失败或终止记录，未来6个月也无主要完成节点，机制尚未经过临床检验。
opps: 生物标志物筛选是核心未解问题：CIN评分、全基因组加倍、TP53突变或CCNE1扩增能否预测应答，有待早期剂量扩展队列验证。
本站追踪项目集中在卵巢癌、输卵管癌和乳腺癌；其他高CIN肿瘤如鳞状非小细胞肺癌、子宫浆液性癌等仍属空白，可作为适应症拓展假设。
目前仅见小分子；与PARP抑制剂、铂类或紫杉类等有丝分裂/DNA损伤药物的联合，以及降解剂等其他模式，尚待探索。

en.why: KIF18A is a kinesin-8 motor that controls chromosome alignment and spindle tension in metaphase. Chromosomally unstable (CIN) tumor cells, especially those with whole-genome doubling or TP53 loss, depend on KIF18A to finish mitosis, while normal diploid cells largely do not. That gives a CIN-linked synthetic-lethal window, with high-grade serous ovarian and triple-negative breast cancer as archetypes.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Both programs tracked here (Volastra's unnamed molecule and Accent's ATX-295) are small molecules in phase 1/2. There are no readouts, failures or early stops, and no primary completions are due in the next six months, so the mechanism is clinically untested.
opps: Patient selection is the key open question. It is untested whether CIN scores, whole-genome doubling, TP53 mutation or CCNE1 amplification predict response, and early expansion cohorts could settle it.

Programs tracked here focus on ovarian, fallopian tube and breast cancer. Other high-CIN tumors, such as squamous NSCLC or uterine serous carcinoma, look unaddressed and could be tested as indication hypotheses.
Only small molecules are tracked. Combinations with PARP inhibitors, platinum or taxanes, and other modalities such as degraders, remain unexplored.

zh.why: KIT是干细胞因子的受体酪氨酸激酶，调控肥大细胞的存活与活化。激活突变驱动多数GIST，D816V突变见于绝大多数系统性肥大细胞增多症。imatinib已在GIST验证KIT抑制的价值，抗KIT抗体通过清除肥大细胞，把这一靶点拓展到荨麻疹等炎症性疾病。
learned: 临床记录仍薄：唯一读出NCT06736262（briquilimab）因公司战略调整终止，与安全性无关，不能说明机制优劣。首个真正检验是barzolvolimab的CSU三期NCT06455202与NCT06445023，结果尚未收录。
opps: 除CSU外，本站收录的结节性痒疹、特应性皮炎、寒冷性荨麻疹各只有1个项目，可借此检验肥大细胞清除在哪些瘙痒性疾病中起主导作用。
KIT也表达于黑素细胞、生殖细胞和造血祖细胞，长期清除肥大细胞的耐受性仍待回答。可逆的口服小分子或间歇给药方案可能是慢性炎症适应症中的差异化方向。
本站收录GIST项目3个、ISM项目2个，均无读出。用ctDNA按继发KIT突变（如外显子13与17）分层，或可明确不同抑制剂分别适合哪类耐药人群。

en.why: KIT is the receptor tyrosine kinase for stem cell factor and controls mast cell survival and activation. Activating mutations drive most GISTs, and KIT D816V is found in the large majority of systemic mastocytosis cases. Imatinib validated KIT inhibition in GIST. Anti-KIT antibodies that deplete mast cells extend the target to urticaria and other inflammatory diseases.
learned: The record is still thin. The only readout, NCT06736262 (briquilimab), was stopped because company priorities changed, not for safety, so it says nothing about the mechanism. The first real test is barzolvolimab's Phase 3 CSU trials, NCT06455202 and NCT06445023. Their results are not yet tracked here.
opps: Outside CSU, prurigo nodularis, atopic dermatitis and cold urticaria each have only one program tracked here. These indications could test where mast cell depletion actually drives itch and inflammation, and where it does not.

KIT is also expressed in melanocytes, germ cells and blood progenitors, so whether long-term mast cell depletion is tolerable is still an open question. Reversible oral small molecules or intermittent antibody dosing could set a program apart in chronic inflammatory use.

Three GIST programs and two indolent systemic mastocytosis programs are tracked here, none with readouts. Grouping GIST patients by secondary KIT mutation (e.g. exon 13 vs 17) on ctDNA could show which inhibitor fits which resistance profile.

zh.why: NY-ESO-1、MAGE-A3/A4、PRAME和KK-LC-1属于癌-睾丸抗原，正常组织中基本只表达于不表达MHC的生殖细胞，却在黑色素瘤、滑膜肉瘤、肺癌等多种实体瘤中重新表达。它们是胞内蛋白，需经HLA I类分子提呈，因此主要通过TCR-T、可溶性TCR融合蛋白等TCR类手段靶向，HLA限制性决定了可入组人群。
learned: 在本站追踪的项目中，临床记录仍很薄弱：目前没有已收录的读出、失败或提前终止，未来六个月也没有到达主要完成的试验。13个项目中11个处于1期，首批真正的检验预计来自两个3期项目（Immunocore的Brenetafusp和Takara Bio的项目），但FACTS中没有给出读出时间。
opps: 13个项目中7个为细胞治疗，可溶性TCR融合蛋白、双抗和TCR类似物单抗各仅1项。现货型TCR类药物在可及性和联合用药上能否比自体TCR-T更有优势，是值得验证的假设。
多数TCR依赖常见HLA等位基因（以HLA-A*02:01为主）。覆盖其他HLA型别，或靶向KK-LC-1这类较少开发的抗原，可能扩大适用人群。
癌-睾丸抗原在肿瘤内表达常不均一。联合检测抗原表达与HLA分型来筛选患者，或同时靶向多个抗原，可能是应对抗原丢失型逃逸的方向。食管癌等瘤种在本站追踪的项目中仍较少。

en.why: NY-ESO-1, MAGE-A3/A4, PRAME and KK-LC-1 are cancer-testis antigens. In normal tissue they are largely restricted to MHC-negative germ cells, but they are re-expressed in melanoma, synovial sarcoma, lung cancer and other solid tumours. Because they are intracellular, they are presented on HLA class I and are targeted mainly with TCR-based modalities. HLA restriction limits which patients are eligible.
learned: Among programs tracked here, the clinical record is still thin. There are no tracked readouts, failures or early stops, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months. Eleven of 13 programs are Phase 1. The first real tests should come from the two Phase 3 programs, Immunocore's Brenetafusp and a Takara Bio program, but FACTS gives no readout timing.
opps: Seven of 13 programs are cell therapies, while soluble TCR fusion proteins, bispecifics and TCR-mimic antibodies have one program each. A testable hypothesis: off-the-shelf TCR-based agents may beat autologous TCR-T on access and on ease of combining with other drugs.
Most TCRs rely on common HLA alleles, mainly HLA-A*02:01. Covering other HLA types, or targeting less-developed antigens such as KK-LC-1, could widen the eligible population.

Cancer-testis antigen expression is often patchy within a tumour. Selecting patients on both antigen expression and HLA type, or targeting several antigens at once, may limit escape through antigen loss. Esophageal cancer and similar tumour types have few programs among those tracked here.

zh.why: KRAS G12C为第12位甘氨酸突变为半胱氨酸，GTP水解受损，KRAS持续处于激活状态并驱动RAS–MAPK信号。该突变见于相当比例的肺腺癌，在结直肠癌和胰腺癌中比例较低。突变的半胱氨酸让共价抑制剂得以靶向这个曾被视为“不可成药”的靶点，sotorasib和adagrasib获批验证了这一思路。
learned: 近期退出主要出于商业原因。Novartis因商业考虑终止JDQ443三期（NCT05132075）及联合trametinib研究（NCT05358249），并明确与安全性无关。本站追踪的三期项目已有7个，这类终止不能说明机制无效。
单药疗效存在上限。sotorasib在NSCLC的二期CodeBreaK201（NCT04933695）因无效终止，结直肠癌三期CodeBreak300（NCT05198934）本站记录为无统计检验，注册数据中尚无明确的阳性结果。
在本站追踪的13个项目中，11个为小分子，后期阶段以olomorasib、divarasib、JAB-21822、D-1553等新一代共价抑制剂为主，elironrasib等RAS(ON)抑制剂处于早期。靶点可及性已不是瓶颈，差异化取决于效力、耐受性和联合用药方案。
opps: 本站追踪的胰腺癌项目仅3个，NSCLC有10个。G12C在胰腺癌中少见，但该肿瘤高度依赖KRAS，可检验RAS(ON)抑制剂或联合方案带来的更深、更持久的通路抑制能否转化为获益。
本站追踪的已知模态全部为小分子，降解剂、针对G12C新抗原的疫苗或TCR疗法尚未出现。按STK11、KEAP1等共突变进行患者分层的试验设计也值得探索。
adagrasib在NSCLC（NCT05609578）和晚期肿瘤（NCT05853575）的研究，以及JAB-21822在NSCLC的研究（NCT05009329）已过主要完成日期，尚无结果。它们将是检验疗效能否在不同治疗线和瘤种中维持的下一批数据。

en.why: KRAS G12C swaps glycine for cysteine at codon 12. This impairs GTP hydrolysis, so KRAS stays active and drives RAS–MAPK signaling. It occurs in a notable share of lung adenocarcinomas and in smaller fractions of colorectal and pancreatic cancers. The mutant cysteine let covalent inhibitors reach a target once called undruggable, and the approvals of sotorasib and adagrasib validated the approach.
learned: Recent exits have been commercial. Novartis stopped JDQ443 in phase 3 (NCT05132075) and with trametinib (NCT05358249) for business reasons and stated these were not safety-related. Seven phase 3 programs are tracked here, and these stops are not evidence against the mechanism.

Single-agent activity has limits. Sotorasib's phase 2 CodeBreaK201 in NSCLC (NCT04933695) was stopped for futility. The colorectal phase 3 CodeBreak300 (NCT05198934) has no formal test recorded here, so the registry record does not yet show a clear win.

Of 13 tracked programs, 11 are small molecules. Late-stage work is led by newer covalent agents (olomorasib, divarasib, JAB-21822, D-1553), and the RAS(ON) inhibitor elironrasib is in early development. Reaching the target is no longer the hurdle. Programs now have to stand out on potency, tolerability and combination partners.
opps: Pancreatic cancer has only three tracked programs, against ten in NSCLC. G12C is rare in pancreatic cancer, but the tumor depends heavily on KRAS. It could test whether deeper, more durable suppression from RAS(ON) inhibitors or combinations leads to benefit.

Every tracked program with a known modality is a small molecule. Degraders, vaccines or TCR therapies aimed at G12C neoantigens do not appear here. Trials that select patients by co-mutations such as STK11 or KEAP1 are another open design question.

Adagrasib in NSCLC (NCT05609578) and advanced cancer (NCT05853575), and JAB-21822 in NSCLC (NCT05009329), have passed primary completion with no results posted. They are the next data on whether activity holds across treatment lines and tumor types.

zh.why: KRAS G12D是最常见的KRAS突变，多见于胰腺导管腺癌，也见于结直肠癌和肺癌。突变使KRAS锁定在GTP结合的激活态，持续驱动MAPK信号。它缺少sotorasib等G12C抑制剂所依赖的半胱氨酸，需另辟化学路径，临床候选药物近年才出现。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：本站追踪13个项目，4个已进入3期（RMC-9805及Astellas、Incyte、Genfleet项目），但尚无读出或失败，未来6个月也无追踪到的主要完成节点。
opps: 本站追踪项目中NSCLC是最常列出的适应症，而G12D占比最高的胰腺癌分散在多个标签下。专门针对PDAC的设计，尤其是更早线或围手术期，相对其生物学基础可能覆盖不足。
13个项目中11个为小分子，例外仅有AstraZeneca的自体NT-112和一个标为单抗的GFH375组。在HLA匹配患者中针对G12D新抗原的细胞治疗或疫苗在此仍少，或可与抑制剂互补。
4个3期项目并行推进，差异化可能取决于尚无读出回答的问题：激活态与失活态抑制孰优、哪些共突变预测获益、何种联用可抑制适应性耐药，如结直肠癌中的EGFR反馈。

en.why: KRAS G12D is the most common KRAS mutation in cancer. It is frequent in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma and also occurs in colorectal and lung cancers. The mutation locks KRAS in its GTP-bound active state, which keeps MAPK signalling switched on. G12D lacks the cysteine that G12C inhibitors such as sotorasib bind to, so it needs different chemistry, and clinical candidates have only appeared recently.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site tracks 13 programs, four of them in Phase 3 (RMC-9805 and programs from Astellas, Incyte and Genfleet). None has a readout or failure yet, and no tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months.
opps: Among programs tracked here, NSCLC is the indication listed most often. Pancreatic cancer, where G12D is most common, is spread across several separate labels. Designs built for PDAC, especially in earlier lines or around surgery, may be under-covered given the biology.

Eleven of the 13 tracked programs are small molecules. The only exceptions are AstraZeneca's autologous NT-112 and one antibody-labeled GFH375 arm. Cell therapies or vaccines aimed at the G12D neoantigen in HLA-matched patients are rare here and could complement inhibitors.

With four Phase 3 programs running in parallel, differentiation may depend on questions no tracked readout has answered yet: whether hitting the active or the inactive state of KRAS works better, which co-mutations predict benefit, and which partner drugs slow adaptive resistance, such as EGFR feedback in colorectal cancer.

zh.why: KRAS 是人类肿瘤中突变最常见的癌基因，G12D、G12V 等非 G12C 突变在胰腺癌和结直肠癌中占多数。这些突变没有共价 G12C 抑制剂依赖的半胱氨酸，泛 KRAS 抑制剂、等位基因选择性药物和新抗原免疫疗法因此试图覆盖这部分未满足需求。
learned: 本站追踪的 23 个项目均处于 1–2 期，尚无读出或失败记录。第一个真正的检验是 NSCLC 的 1/2 期试验 NCT05887492，主要完成日原定 2026 年 9 月，结果尚未收录。
opps: 小分子以外的路径只有 4 个细胞治疗和 1 个疫苗。TCR-T 和疫苗受 HLA 限制，是否应按 KRAS 等位基因加 HLA 分型筛选患者、能否用于小分子耐药后，仍有待验证。
所追踪试验全部为肿瘤。体细胞 KRAS 突变也驱动脑动静脉畸形等非恶性病变，胚系变异导致 RAS 病。本站尚无项目覆盖这些场景，可探索低剂量或局部给药策略。
泛 KRAS 抑制剂也会抑制野生型 KRAS，其治疗窗尚无读出验证。突变选择性与泛抑制两种策略谁更好，以及等位基因、共突变等生物标志物，可能决定 PDAC、CRC 和 NSCLC 中各项目的差异化。

en.why: KRAS is the most frequently mutated oncogene in human cancer, and non-G12C alleles such as G12D and G12V make up most cases in pancreatic and colorectal cancer. These alleles lack the cysteine that covalent G12C inhibitors bind, so pan-KRAS inhibitors, allele-selective drugs and neoantigen-directed immunotherapies aim to reach the large share of KRAS-driven tumours that current targeted drugs miss.
learned: Among programs tracked here, no readouts or failures are recorded yet. All 23 programs sit in phase 1 to 2. The first real test is NCT05887492 (phase 1/2, NSCLC). Its primary completion was expected in September 2026, and results are not yet tracked.
opps: The only approaches other than small molecules are four cell therapies and one vaccine. TCR-T and vaccines are HLA-restricted, so two questions remain open: whether patients should be selected by KRAS allele plus HLA type, and whether these therapies work after small molecules stop working.

Every tracked trial is in oncology. Somatic KRAS mutations also drive non-malignant lesions such as brain arteriovenous malformations, and germline variants cause RASopathies. No tracked program covers these settings, so low-dose or locally delivered KRAS inhibitors could be explored there.

Pan-KRAS inhibitors also block wild-type KRAS, and no tracked readout has yet tested whether the dose window is safe. Mutant-selective versus pan-inhibitor designs, and biomarkers such as allele and co-mutation status, may decide which programs stand out in PDAC, CRC and NSCLC.

zh.why: 血浆激肽释放酶由KLKB1编码，切割高分子量激肽原并释放缓激肽。C1抑制物缺陷时这一通路失控，引发遗传性血管性水肿（HAE）的反复肿胀发作。抑制该酶的疗法已在HAE中获批（如lanadelumab、berotralstat），靶点验证充分，问题在于给药方式和长期控制。
learned: 临床记录仍然较少：本站追踪的3个项目均处于3期，但目前没有已收录的读出或失败记录。首个实质性检验将是donidalorsen的3期试验NCT05392114，主要完成日期预计在2026年12月。
本站追踪的项目全部集中在HAE，竞争点在于预防性给药的便利性（口服每日给药对比反义寡核苷酸长间隔皮下给药），而不在于机制是否成立。
opps: 本站追踪的9项试验全部针对HAE。C1-INH正常型HAE、ACE抑制剂相关血管性水肿、糖尿病黄斑水肿等缓激肽驱动的疾病，可作为验证适应症扩展的假设。
本站追踪的项目中没有基因编辑类方案，儿童HAE仅有一项记录。一次性或超长间隔的KLKB1沉默方案和儿童剂量研究仍有空间。
以血浆激肽释放酶活性或裂解型HMWK作为药效标志物，或可用于个体化调整剂量和给药间隔。NCT05392114的结果有望说明长间隔反义寡核苷酸给药能否维持稳定的发作控制。

en.why: KLKB1 encodes plasma kallikrein, which cleaves high-molecular-weight kininogen to release bradykinin. When C1 inhibitor is deficient, this pathway runs unchecked and drives the recurrent swelling attacks of hereditary angioedema (HAE). Kallikrein inhibitors such as lanadelumab and berotralstat are approved for HAE, so the target is well validated. The open questions are how the drug is given and how well attacks stay controlled over the long term.
learned: The clinical record here is still thin. All 3 programs tracked here are in Phase 3, but no readouts or failures are logged yet. The first real test will be donidalorsen's Phase 3 trial NCT05392114, with primary completion expected in December 2026.

Every program tracked here targets HAE. The programs compete on how convenient prevention is (a daily oral pill versus an antisense drug injected under the skin at long intervals), not on whether the mechanism works.
opps: All 9 trials tracked here are in HAE. Other bradykinin-driven conditions are open hypotheses for expanding beyond HAE: HAE with normal C1-INH, angioedema caused by ACE inhibitors, and diabetic macular edema.

No gene-editing programs appear among those tracked here, and there is only one pediatric HAE entry. That leaves room for one-time or very long-interval KLKB1 silencing and for pediatric dosing studies.

Plasma kallikrein activity or cleaved HMWK could serve as markers of drug effect to fit dose and dosing interval to each patient. NCT05392114 should show whether long-interval antisense dosing keeps attacks steadily controlled.

zh.why: Kv7.2/7.3（KCNQ2/3）通道介导M电流，维持神经元静息电位并抑制重复放电。KCNQ2功能缺失变异可致新生儿癫痫；开放剂retigabine曾获批用于局灶性癫痫，后因组织色素沉着退市。目前开放剂正在癫痫和抑郁中接受验证，抑郁方向的依据是奖赏环路机制。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍很有限：唯一读出为XEN1101治疗MDD的X-NOVA（NCT05376150），未做正式检验。首批真正检验将来自BHV-7000局灶性癫痫（NCT06309966、NCT06132893）及azetukalner MDD（NCT06775379、NCT06922110）。
opps: 本站追踪的3个项目均为小分子开放剂，集中于癫痫和情绪障碍；尚无项目布局疼痛、咳嗽（Kv7调控伤害感受及气道感觉神经兴奋性），也没有项目以KCNQ2功能缺失型脑病作为基因筛选人群。
本站仅追踪Xenon与Biohaven两家，差异化可能取决于Kv7亚型选择性、避免retigabine式色素沉着，以及在有效抗癫痫剂量下的中枢耐受性。
抑郁适应症仍待验证：X-NOVA（NCT05376150）未做正式检验，azetukalner三项MDD三期试验（NCT06775379、NCT06922110、NCT07076407）将给出答案；可探索以快感缺失或奖赏环路指标筛选患者。

en.why: Kv7.2/7.3 (KCNQ2/3) channels carry the M-current, a slow potassium current that holds neurons near rest and damps repetitive firing. Loss-of-function KCNQ2 variants cause neonatal epilepsies. The opener retigabine was approved for focal seizures and later withdrawn over tissue pigmentation. Openers are now being tested in epilepsy and, based on reward-circuit biology, in depression.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. The only readout, X-NOVA (NCT05376150) of XEN1101 (azetukalner) in MDD, had no formal hypothesis test. The first real tests will be BHV-7000 in focal epilepsy (NCT06309966, NCT06132893) and azetukalner in MDD (NCT06775379, NCT06922110).
opps: All three programs tracked here are small-molecule openers in epilepsy and mood disorders. None targets pain or cough, although Kv7 channels control the excitability of nociceptors and airway sensory neurons. None enrolls KCNQ2 loss-of-function encephalopathy as a genetically selected population.
With only Xenon and Biohaven tracked, differentiation may rest on three things: Kv7 subtype selectivity, avoiding retigabine-type pigmentation, and CNS tolerability at doses that control seizures.

It is still open whether the depression signal holds. X-NOVA (NCT05376150) was not formally tested, and three azetukalner Phase 3 MDD trials (NCT06775379, NCT06922110, NCT07076407) will settle it. Anhedonia or reward-circuit markers could be tested as patient-selection tools.

zh.why: LAG-3（CD223）是耗竭T细胞上的抑制性受体，主要结合MHC II类分子及FGL1，常与PD-1共表达。临床前研究显示双通路阻断可协同恢复T细胞功能。relatlimab联合nivolumab获批用于晚期黑色素瘤，提供了临床验证，目前问题在于黑色素瘤以外能否复制。
learned: 在强PD-1对照下证明增益并不容易：fianlimab联合cemiplimab三期对比帕博利珠单抗，PFS未达统计学显著，仅数值占优；本站唯一达到主要终点的是favezelimab在霍奇金淋巴瘤（NCT05508867），该病本身对PD-1高度敏感
向黑色素瘤以外扩展缺少对照证据：HCC（NCT05337137）、NSCLC（NCT03516981）及多项黑色素瘤早期研究（NCT04303169、NCT04370704）均为无统计检验的安全性或ORR读出
提前终止以商业原因为主：MSD停止favezelimab在NMIBC（NCT02625961）和霍奇金（NCT03598608）的研究，Roche关闭tobemstomig联合tiragolumab的HCC研究（NCT05908786），未见安全性终止，不构成否定机制的证据
本站追踪的三期资产均为单抗，且与同公司的PD-1抗体联用；PD-1×LAG-3双抗（tobemstomig、SSGJ-709、Akeso）仍处于1-2期
opps: 两项fianlimab黑色素瘤三期（NCT05608291、NCT06246916）将检验剂量和联用方案能否与现有LAG-3/PD-1组合拉开差距；可同时探索LAG-3或MHC II表达等生物标志物来筛选获益人群
双抗能否把获益带到黑色素瘤以外，尚待tobemstomig在RCC（NCT05805501）和乳腺癌（NCT05852691）的读出，RCC中还有favezelimab研究（NCT04626518、NCT04626479）可作对照参考
霍奇金阳性结果提示MHC II高表达的淋巴瘤可能是适应证空白，本站追踪的相关项目很少；新辅助场景也值得关注，fianlimab可切除NSCLC研究（NCT06161441）是首个检验

en.why: LAG-3 (CD223) is an inhibitory receptor on exhausted T cells. It binds MHC class II and FGL1 and is often co-expressed with PD-1. Preclinical work shows that blocking both pathways restores T-cell function synergistically. The approval of relatlimab plus nivolumab in advanced melanoma validated the target; the open question is whether the benefit carries beyond melanoma.
learned: Beating a strong PD-1 comparator is hard: in Phase 3, fianlimab plus cemiplimab missed statistical significance on PFS versus pembrolizumab, ahead only numerically. The only formal hit tracked here is favezelimab in Hodgkin lymphoma (NCT05508867), a disease already highly PD-1-sensitive.

Expansion beyond melanoma lacks controlled evidence: readouts in HCC (NCT05337137), NSCLC (NCT03516981) and early melanoma studies (NCT04303169, NCT04370704) are all safety or ORR readouts with no hypothesis test.

Early stops are mostly commercial: MSD ended favezelimab studies in NMIBC (NCT02625961) and Hodgkin (NCT03598608), and Roche closed tobemstomig plus tiragolumab in HCC (NCT05908786). None were stopped for safety, so these stops are not evidence against the mechanism.
Every Phase 3 asset tracked here is a monoclonal antibody given with the same company's PD-1 antibody. PD-1×LAG-3 bispecifics (tobemstomig, SSGJ-709, Akeso) are still in Phase 1-2.
opps: Two fianlimab Phase 3 melanoma trials (NCT05608291, NCT06246916) will test whether dose and partner choice can set it apart from existing LAG-3/PD-1 combinations. Biomarkers such as LAG-3 or MHC II expression could be studied alongside to find the patients who benefit.

Whether a bispecific extends benefit beyond melanoma depends on the tobemstomig readouts in RCC (NCT05805501) and breast cancer (NCT05852691). The favezelimab RCC studies (NCT04626518, NCT04626479) offer a comparison point.

The Hodgkin hit suggests that MHC II-high lymphomas may be an open indication, with few programs tracked here. The neoadjuvant setting is also worth watching; the fianlimab resectable NSCLC study (NCT06161441) is the first test.

zh.why: LPA1 是溶血磷脂酸（LPA）的 G 蛋白偶联受体。LPA1 信号促进成纤维细胞募集、血管渗漏和上皮损伤，敲除小鼠可抵抗博来霉素诱导的肺纤维化。因此，口服 LPA1 拮抗剂被视为延缓 IPF 等进展性肺纤维化肺功能下降的合理路径。
learned: 临床证据仍然有限：本站追踪的项目中只有 BMS 的 admilparant 有数据。ALOFT-IPF 中 60 mg 组达到主要终点，120 mg 组 FVC 下降更慢但不显著，停药率与安慰剂相近。NCT06003426 已于 2026 年 10 月完成主要终点，其完整数据将是首次详细检验。
opps: 120 mg 组未达显著，带出暴露-效应问题：疗效是否已到平台，还是耐受性或变异削弱了高剂量组？NCT06003426 的完整数据和亚组分析有望指导剂量选择和患者筛选。
admilparant 是本站追踪的唯一 LPA1 项目，适应症还包括进展性肺纤维化，但尚无读出。按 LPA1 生物学，系统性硬化症、肾纤维化等肺外纤维化也值得探索，目前没有被追踪项目覆盖。
两剂量组停药率与安慰剂相近，在 nintedanib 或 pirfenidone 基础上叠加 LPA1 拮抗剂是可检验的假设；LPA 通路活性生物标志物或可帮助筛选更可能获益的患者。

en.why: LPA1 is a GPCR for lysophosphatidic acid (LPA), a lipid mediator. LPA1 signalling recruits fibroblasts, increases vascular leak and promotes epithelial injury, and knockout mice are protected from bleomycin-induced lung fibrosis. That makes an oral LPA1 antagonist a rational way to slow lung-function decline in IPF and other progressive fibrosing lung diseases.
learned: The clinical record is thin. Among programs tracked here, only BMS's admilparant has data: in ALOFT-IPF, 60 mg met the primary endpoint, 120 mg slowed FVC decline without reaching significance, and discontinuations matched placebo. Full data from NCT06003426, which reached primary completion in October 2026, will be the first detailed test.
opps: The non-significant 120 mg arm raises an exposure-response question: has the effect plateaued, or did tolerability or variability blunt the higher dose? Full NCT06003426 data and subgroup analyses could guide dose choice and patient selection.

Admilparant is the only LPA1 program tracked here. It is also listed for progressive pulmonary fibrosis, with no readout yet. LPA1 biology also points to fibrosis outside the lung, such as systemic sclerosis or kidney fibrosis, which no tracked program covers.

Discontinuations in both dose arms were similar to placebo, so adding an LPA1 antagonist on top of nintedanib or pirfenidone is a testable hypothesis. Biomarkers of LPA pathway activity might help pick the patients most likely to benefit.

zh.why: LRRK2功能获得性突变（如G2019S）是帕金森病最常见的遗传病因之一，GWAS也提示其常见变异与散发性帕金森病相关。突变会提高激酶活性，过度磷酸化Rab GTPase并损害溶酶体功能。抑制LRRK2激酶有望延缓疾病进展，而不只是缓解症状。
learned: 临床记录仍然很少。本站追踪的3个项目都处于2期，分属Denali（BIIB122，2个项目）和Neuron23（NEU-411），目前没有已公布的读出，未来6个月内也没有追踪到主要完成节点，暂时无法总结机制在临床上的成败规律。
opps: 本站追踪的项目全部针对帕金森病。LRRK2变异在遗传上也与克罗恩病等炎症性肠病相关，可以探索外周炎症适应症，这类适应症对血脑屏障穿透的要求也较低。
在已追踪项目中，明确的方式只有小分子激酶抑制。反义寡核苷酸等降低LRRK2表达的手段可作为对照假设，用来比较疗效和外周安全性，例如长期抑制带来的肺部改变。
可以比较LRRK2突变携带者与散发患者的获益差异，并用pRab10、尿BMP等靶点结合和通路生物标志物分层，这可能是区分不同项目的关键。

en.why: Gain-of-function LRRK2 mutations such as G2019S are among the most common genetic causes of Parkinson's disease, and GWAS link common LRRK2 variants to sporadic disease. Raised kinase activity hyperphosphorylates Rab GTPases and impairs lysosomal function. Inhibiting the kinase is a candidate disease-modifying approach, not just symptom relief.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The site tracks three Phase 2 programs from Denali (BIIB122, two programs) and Neuron23 (NEU-411). None has a reported readout, and no primary completions are tracked in the next six months, so there are no clinical lessons yet on where the mechanism works.
opps: Every program tracked here targets Parkinson's disease. LRRK2 variants are also genetically linked to Crohn's disease and other inflammatory bowel diseases. That suggests a peripheral inflammatory indication where the drug would not need to cross the blood-brain barrier.

The only modality identified among tracked programs is small-molecule kinase inhibition. Approaches that lower LRRK2 levels, such as antisense oligonucleotides, could test whether efficacy and peripheral safety differ, for example the lung changes seen with long-term inhibition.

Patient selection is an open question: do LRRK2 mutation carriers benefit differently from sporadic patients? Target-engagement and pathway biomarkers such as pRab10 and urinary BMP could guide stratification and help programs stand apart.

zh.why: LSD1（KDM1A）是依赖FAD的组蛋白去甲基化酶，去除H3K4me1/2，并与CoREST、GFI1B形成复合物，调控造血分化，尤其是巨核系和红系发育。抑制LSD1可解除髓系肿瘤的分化阻滞并减少血小板生成，这是其用于ET和MPN的依据。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄弱：本站跟踪的仅有Jubilant的JBI-802一个1/2期项目，目前没有读出，没有失败或提前终止，未来六个月内也没有试验到达主要完成日期，短期内尚无可检验该机制的数据。
opps: 本站跟踪的项目只覆盖ET和MDS/MPN。骨髓纤维化、AML以及依赖LSD1的神经内分泌实体瘤（如SCLC）在此尚无项目，值得作为研究假设探索。
可按JAK2、CALR、MPL驱动突变对患者分层，同时监测突变等位基因负荷与血小板计数，以区分疾病修饰效应和单纯降低血细胞计数。
目前仅有一个小分子项目。与JAK抑制剂联用，或破坏LSD1与CoREST支架作用（而非只抑制催化位点）的分子，在此均未见尝试。

en.why: LSD1 (KDM1A) is a FAD-dependent histone demethylase that removes H3K4me1/2 and, with CoREST and GFI1B, controls blood-cell differentiation, especially megakaryocyte and red-cell development. Blocking it releases the differentiation block in myeloid cancers and lowers platelet production. This is the rationale for testing it in essential thrombocythemia and other myeloproliferative neoplasms.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Only one program is tracked here, Jubilant's phase 1/2 JBI-802. It has no readouts, no failures or early stops, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so there is no near-term data to test the mechanism.
opps: Programs tracked here cover only ET and MDS/MPN. Myelofibrosis, AML and LSD1-dependent neuroendocrine solid tumors such as SCLC have no programs here and are open hypotheses to explore.

Patients could be grouped by driver mutation (JAK2, CALR, MPL), with mutant allele burden tracked alongside platelet counts. That would show whether the drug changes the disease or only lowers blood counts.

There is only one small molecule here. Combinations with JAK inhibitors, or molecules that disrupt LSD1's scaffolding role with CoREST rather than just blocking its catalytic site, have not been tried among tracked programs.

zh.why: Lp(a)是由apo(a)与apoB共价结合形成的类LDL颗粒，血浆水平主要由LPA基因决定，饮食和他汀基本无法降低。孟德尔随机化等遗传学证据把高Lp(a)与动脉粥样硬化性心血管病和钙化性主动脉瓣狭窄因果相关联，因此直接降低Lp(a)被视为针对残余风险的新路径。
learned: 单项结局试验失败即带动连锁终止：Novartis随后以疗效为由终止OLE（NCT05900141）和ACS研究（NCT07625306）。本站记录的4条失败均为疗效原因，且都与pelacarsen相关，未见安全性原因的终止。
这次阴性结果来自单一资产、单一反义寡核苷酸平台，尚不能据此否定机制。olpasiran、lepodisiran（siRNA）和口服小分子muvalaplin仍处于3期，降幅更深或更持久能否改变结论仍待回答。
opps: 钙化性主动脉瓣狭窄有遗传学支持，但本站追踪的项目中仅少数以此为适应症，可作为与ASCVD结局不同的验证方向。
患者筛选值得重新设计：pelacarsen在单采依赖的极高Lp(a)人群中达到终点，可探索按基线Lp(a)水平或相关生物标志物富集的人群。
口服小分子（muvalaplin、Shenzhen Salubris、AstraZeneca）阻断apo(a)-apoB组装，可能在一级预防中形成差异化。本站追踪的试验中未来6个月无主要完成节点，机制问题有待siRNA结局试验回答。

en.why: Lp(a) is an LDL-like particle in which apo(a) is covalently bound to apoB. Plasma levels are set largely by the LPA gene and barely respond to diet or statins. Mendelian randomization and other genetic evidence tie high Lp(a) causally to atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease and calcific aortic stenosis, which makes direct Lp(a) lowering a candidate route against residual risk.
learned: One outcomes miss set off a chain of stops: Novartis then ended its OLE (NCT05900141) and its ACS study (NCT07625306), citing efficacy. All four failures recorded here are efficacy-coded and involve pelacarsen. None was stopped for safety.
