The negative result comes from one asset on one antisense platform, so it does not settle the mechanism. Olpasiran, lepodisiran (siRNA) and oral muvalaplin remain in phase 3, and it is still open whether deeper or more sustained lowering changes the answer.
opps: Calcific aortic stenosis has genetic support, but only a few programs tracked here target it. It offers a test of the mechanism that is separate from ASCVD outcomes.
Patient selection could be redesigned. Pelacarsen succeeded in apheresis-dependent patients with very high Lp(a), which suggests enriching trials by baseline Lp(a) or related biomarkers.

Oral small molecules that block apo(a)-apoB assembly (muvalaplin, Shenzhen Salubris, AstraZeneca) could stand apart in primary prevention. No tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so the mechanism question will be answered later by the siRNA outcomes trials.

zh.why: MASP-2是凝集素途径的效应丝氨酸蛋白酶，识别分子结合病原体或受损内皮后，由它切割C4和C2，启动补体级联。MASP-3可活化前体因子D，连接旁路途径。抑制MASP-2可阻断凝集素途径，同时保留经典途径，理论上适用于内皮损伤驱动的血栓性微血管病。
learned: 该靶点的临床记录仍然很薄：本站仅追踪到Omeros的narsoplimab一项2期单抗项目（造血干细胞移植相关血栓性微血管病），尚无读出或失败记录，未来6个月也没有到达主要完成日期的试验，暂无近期数据可作为第一次真正检验。
opps: 在本站追踪的项目中尚无直接针对MASP-3的项目。MASP-3抑制可切断因子D活化、调控旁路途径，可作为与MASP-2抑制并行验证的独立假设。
目前追踪到的项目只覆盖移植相关血栓性微血管病。可用凝集素途径活化标志物（如MBL水平、C4d沉积）筛选患者，探索其他以内皮损伤为主的补体介导疾病。
追踪到的唯一模式是静脉单抗。口服小分子或长效制剂能否在慢性适应症中实现持续的凝集素途径抑制，仍是未回答的问题。

en.why: MASP-2 is the effector serine protease of the lectin pathway: once recognition molecules bind pathogens or damaged endothelium, it cleaves C4 and C2 to start the complement cascade. MASP-3 activates pro-factor D, linking to the alternative pathway. Blocking MASP-2 shuts down the lectin pathway while sparing the classical pathway, a rationale for thrombotic microangiopathies driven by endothelial injury.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site tracks one program, Omeros' narsoplimab, a phase 2 antibody in transplant-associated thrombotic microangiopathy. It has no readouts or failures on record and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term readout will be a first real test.
opps: No program tracked here targets MASP-3 directly. Inhibiting MASP-3 to block factor D activation and dampen the alternative pathway is a separate hypothesis worth testing alongside MASP-2 inhibition.

Tracked programs cover only transplant-associated TMA. Lectin-pathway activation markers such as MBL levels or C4d deposition could be used to select patients in other complement diseases driven by endothelial injury.
The only modality tracked is an intravenous antibody. Whether an oral small molecule or a long-acting format can keep the lectin pathway suppressed in chronic indications is still an open question.

zh.why: MAT2A负责合成SAM，是细胞主要的甲基供体。约15%的肿瘤存在MTAP与CDKN2A共缺失，MTA蓄积会部分抑制PRMT5。此时再抑制MAT2A、降低SAM，可进一步压低PRMT5活性，形成合成致死。这一关系已由功能基因组筛选验证，为按MTAP缺失选择患者提供了依据。
learned: 临床证据仍很薄弱：本站跟踪的4个小分子项目（S095035、IDE397、InSilico未命名化合物）均处于1期或1/2期，尚无读出，也无失败记录。未来6个月内没有已登记的主要完成节点，近期缺少检验该机制的关键数据。
opps: 本站跟踪项目多以MTAP缺失实体瘤做篮式入组，仅胃食管癌和肺腺癌被单独列出。胰腺癌、间皮瘤、尿路上皮癌等MTAP缺失高发瘤种，可以作为单独验证队列的假设。
四个项目均为小分子单药或剂量探索。机制上，MAT2A抑制与MTA协同型PRMT5抑制剂，或与紫杉类等化疗联合，可能实现更深的通路抑制，值得设计联合研究来检验。
患者选择和药效标志物尚需标准化：MTAP缺失用IHC还是NGS判定、血浆SAM下降幅度能否预测疗效，都会影响早期信号的解读。

en.why: MAT2A makes SAM, the cell's main methyl donor. About 15% of tumors carry MTAP deletion, usually together with CDKN2A, and the MTA that builds up partly inhibits PRMT5. Inhibiting MAT2A lowers SAM and pushes PRMT5 activity down further, a synthetic-lethal effect confirmed in functional genomic screens. This gives a clear way to select patients: MTAP loss.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. All four small-molecule programs tracked here (S095035, IDE397 and an unnamed InSilico compound) are in phase 1 or 1/2. None has reported a readout or a failure, and no tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term test of the mechanism is scheduled.
opps: Most tracked programs enroll a broad basket of MTAP-deleted solid tumors, and only gastroesophageal cancer and NSCLC adenocarcinoma are named on their own. Tumors where MTAP loss is common, such as pancreatic cancer, mesothelioma and urothelial cancer, could each be tested as a dedicated cohort.

All four programs test small molecules in dose-finding or single-agent designs. Pairing MAT2A inhibition with an MTA-cooperative PRMT5 inhibitor, or with chemotherapy such as a taxane, could block the pathway more deeply. That is a hypothesis combination trials could test.

Patient selection and pharmacodynamic markers still need standards. Two open questions are whether MTAP loss should be called by IHC or by NGS, and whether the size of the drop in plasma SAM predicts response. Both will shape how early signals are read.

zh.why: MC4R位于下丘脑室旁核，接收leptin–POMC–α-MSH通路信号，调控饱腹感和能量消耗。MC4R功能缺失突变是最常见的单基因重度肥胖病因。上游通路受损时（如下丘脑损伤或POMC/LEPR缺陷），直接激动MC4R可以绕过病变。setmelanotide已获批用于部分单基因肥胖。
learned: 疗效取决于通路病变是否位于MC4R上游：下丘脑性肥胖的III期NCT05774756和II期NCT06046443均达到终点，而适应症标注为Obesity的III期NCT05093634未达到，提示患者选择是关键。
Rhythm的口服小分子在NCT06046443中复现了下丘脑性肥胖的BMI获益，提示该信号来自机制本身，与多肽剂型无关；但该试验仅28例、14周，持久性仍需验证。
本站追踪的唯一失败是NCT05093634的疗效不足（同一试验记录了两次），没有安全性或商业原因的终止；所有项目均来自Rhythm一家公司，领域高度集中。
opps: Prader-Willi综合征是另一种下丘脑型疾病，NCT06772597已于2026年11月到达主要完成日期。其结果将检验PWS是否像下丘脑性肥胖一样对MC4R激动有应答。
可对NCT05093634做基因型或通路生物标志物分层，找出更广泛肥胖人群中可能应答的亚组，并探索与incretin类药物联用，作为通路受损患者的补充机制。
本站追踪的项目中，其他公司和其他模式（如长效制剂、偏向性激动剂）仍属空白；NCT06760546（2027年3月）将进一步检验下丘脑性肥胖的疗效重现性。

en.why: MC4R sits in the hypothalamic paraventricular nucleus downstream of leptin–POMC–α-MSH signaling and controls satiety and energy expenditure. Loss-of-function MC4R mutations are the most common monogenic cause of severe obesity. When the pathway is damaged upstream (hypothalamic injury, POMC/LEPR defects), a direct MC4R agonist can bypass the lesion. Setmelanotide is approved for certain monogenic obesities.
learned: Benefit tracks with where the pathway is damaged. Hypothalamic obesity trials met their endpoints in phase 3 (NCT05774756) and phase 2 (NCT06046443), while the phase 3 labelled Obesity (NCT05093634) missed. Patient selection appears decisive.

Rhythm's oral small molecule reproduced the BMI benefit in hypothalamic obesity (NCT06046443), which suggests the effect comes from the mechanism, not the peptide format. But with only 28 patients over 14 weeks, durability is still unproven.
The only failure tracked here is NCT05093634 on efficacy (one trial, recorded twice), with no safety or business stops. Every tracked program belongs to Rhythm, so the field is highly concentrated.
opps: Prader-Willi syndrome is another hypothalamic disorder. NCT06772597 reached primary completion in November 2026, and its results will test whether PWS responds to MC4R agonism the way hypothalamic obesity does.

Stratifying NCT05093634 by genotype or pathway biomarkers could identify responder subgroups within broader obesity. Combining with incretin drugs, as an added mechanism for patients with pathway damage, is a hypothesis worth testing.

Among programs tracked here, there are no other sponsors and no other modalities (e.g., long-acting formulations, biased agonists). NCT06760546 (March 2027) will further test whether the hypothalamic obesity effect replicates.

zh.why: MECP2位于X染色体，编码调控神经元基因表达的甲基化DNA结合蛋白，且对剂量高度敏感。功能缺失突变导致Rett综合征（主要见于女孩），基因重复则导致MECP2重复综合征（主要见于男孩）。致病基因明确，因此可以针对病因直接补充或下调MECP2。
learned: 临床证据仍很少。本站尚未收录任何读出或失败记录，未来六个月也没有试验到达主要完成节点。Taysha和Neurogene的两项Rett基因治疗进入3期后，其读出将是首次真正的检验。
opps: 在本站跟踪的项目中，MECP2重复综合征只有Ionis的ION440（反义寡核苷酸，1/2期）一个项目。部分下调MECP2的合适幅度尚无答案，siRNA等其他降表达手段仍有空间。
由于剂量敏感，基因替代既要补足MECP2，又要避免过表达。能定量MECP2表达或靶点结合的生物标志物，以及针对女性嵌合表达的患者分层，可能成为后续项目的差异化方向。
本站跟踪的项目中尚无激活沉默X染色体上野生型等位基因、或针对常见无义突变做碱基/RNA编辑的策略。这类方法有望在原生调控下恢复表达，可作为基因替代之外的假设方向。

en.why: MECP2 is an X-linked gene for a methyl-DNA-binding protein that regulates gene expression in neurons, and the brain is highly sensitive to its dose. Loss-of-function mutations cause Rett syndrome, mostly in girls. Duplication causes MECP2 duplication syndrome, mostly in boys. Because the causal gene is clear, therapies can replace or reduce MECP2 directly.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. No readouts or failures are tracked here, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months. The first real test will come when the two Phase 3 Rett gene therapies, from Taysha and Neurogene, report.
opps: Among programs tracked here, only one addresses MECP2 duplication syndrome: Ionis's ION440, an antisense oligonucleotide in Phase 1/2. Nobody yet knows how much MECP2 reduction is right, which leaves room for siRNA or other knockdown approaches.

Because MECP2 is dose-sensitive, gene replacement has to restore enough protein without overexpressing it. Biomarkers that measure MECP2 expression or target engagement, and patient selection that accounts for mosaic expression in females, could set later programs apart.

None of the programs tracked here tries to reactivate the healthy MECP2 copy on the silenced X chromosome, or to fix common nonsense mutations with base or RNA editing. Either could restore expression under the gene's own regulation, a hypothesis worth testing alongside gene replacement.

zh.why: MEK1/2是RAS–MAPK通路中磷酸化ERK的关键激酶，BRAF、RAS突变或NF1缺失产生的增殖信号都要经过它传递。trametinib联合dabrafenib治疗BRAF V600突变黑色素瘤、selumetinib治疗NF1丛状神经纤维瘤均已获批多年，说明MEK抑制在MAPK驱动的疾病中有效。
learned: 本站追踪的读出中，只有trametinib在分化型甲状腺癌的III期研究达到PFS主要终点（NCT04940052），与MEK在驱动明确的MAPK依赖肿瘤中最有效的认识一致。
通路纵向联合受耐受性限制：mirdametinib联合RAF抑制剂brimarafenib（BGB-3245）因联合方案无法耐受而终止（NCT05580770），叠加MAPK抑制会压缩治疗窗。
3项提前终止中有2项是商业原因：JDQ443联合trametinib用于KRAS G12C肿瘤（NCT05358249）、cobimetinib联合5-FU用于胃癌（NCT03281369）。这两项不能说明机制无效，但MEK在这些联合中的价值仍无答案。
本站追踪的13个项目全部是小分子，其中4个进入III期。新进入者集中在NF1/丛状神经纤维瘤和NSCLC（如复星的luvometinib、FCN-159），靶点本身不新，竞争主要围绕已上市药物展开。
opps: 能拓宽治疗窗的差异化设计，可能让因耐受性受阻的联合重新可行。Immuneering的III期项目和Nested的NST-628（I期）将检验新药理学特征能否让MEK更适合与RAF或KRAS抑制剂联用。
binimetinib黑色素瘤III期研究（NCT04657991）计划于2026-10-30达到主要完成，其结果将是本站追踪范围内MEK在黑色素瘤中的下一次检验。
本站追踪的试验中有9项不属于肿瘤领域，NF1丛状神经纤维瘤已有多个项目。其他RASopathy以及MAPK相关心血管疾病（仅1项试验）布局很少，可以作为假设方向：探索低剂量、长期给药并结合生物标志物筛选患者。

en.why: MEK1/2 are the kinases that phosphorylate ERK in the RAS–MAPK pathway. Growth signals from BRAF or RAS mutations and from NF1 loss pass through them. Trametinib with dabrafenib in BRAF V600 melanoma and selumetinib in NF1 plexiform neurofibroma have been approved for years, which shows that MEK inhibition works in MAPK-driven disease.
learned: Among readouts tracked here, only the trametinib phase 3 in differentiated thyroid cancer met its primary endpoint, PFS (NCT04940052). That fits the view that MEK works best in tumors with a clear MAPK driver.

Combining inhibitors along the same pathway runs into tolerability limits. Mirdametinib plus the RAF inhibitor brimarafenib (BGB-3245) was stopped because the combination was not tolerable (NCT05580770). Stacking MAPK inhibitors narrows the therapeutic window.

Two of three early stops were for business reasons: JDQ443 plus trametinib in KRAS G12C tumors (NCT05358249) and cobimetinib plus 5-FU in gastric cancer (NCT03281369). Neither counts against the mechanism, but MEK's value in these combinations is still unknown.

All 13 programs tracked here are small molecules, and four are in phase 3. Newer entrants cluster in NF1/plexiform neurofibroma and NSCLC, such as Fosun's luvometinib and FCN-159. The target is not new, so they compete mainly against established agents.
opps: Designs that widen the therapeutic window might make combinations that failed on tolerability workable. Immuneering's phase 3 program and Nested's NST-628 (phase 1) will test whether new pharmacology makes MEK a better partner for RAF or KRAS inhibitors.
Binimetinib's phase 3 in melanoma (NCT04657991) was scheduled to reach primary completion on 2026-10-30. Its results will be the next test of MEK in melanoma among programs tracked here.

Nine trials tracked here are outside oncology, and NF1 plexiform neurofibroma already has several programs. Other RASopathies and MAPK-linked cardiovascular disease (one tracked trial) have little activity. One hypothesis to test: low-dose, long-term MEK inhibition, with biomarkers used to select patients.

zh.why: MRGPRX2是皮肤等结缔组织型肥大细胞上的GPCR。P物质等神经肽及部分阳离子药物可通过它绕开IgE引发脱颗粒，参与假性过敏、神经源性炎症和瘙痒。因此阻断该受体被用于荨麻疹、特应性皮炎瘙痒和偏头痛的探索。
learned: 临床证据仍薄：唯一明确结果是EVO756在特应性皮炎2b期未达到主要终点（NCT07150845），Evommune随后据报放弃止痒方向；未来六个月本站跟踪范围内没有新的主要完成节点。
opps: 慢性自发性荨麻疹主要由肥大细胞驱动，比特应性皮炎更贴近该机制。本站尚未记录EVO756在荨麻疹的结果，这一数据有助于判断阴性结果出在适应症还是靶点本身。
Arcus的1期小分子可先用皮肤P物质或icatibant风团抑制等药效学模型确认靶点占据，排除暴露不足对阴性结果的解释，再推进2期。
本站跟踪项目均为小分子，抗体等其他模态尚未出现；围术期药物诱发假性过敏等更直接依赖MRGPRX2的场景也少有项目覆盖。

en.why: MRGPRX2 is a GPCR on connective-tissue mast cells, including those in skin. Neuropeptides such as substance P and some cationic drugs act through it to trigger IgE-independent degranulation, which drives pseudo-allergic reactions, neurogenic inflammation and itch. That is the case for blocking it in urticaria, atopic dermatitis itch and migraine.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only clear result is EVO756's Phase 2b miss in atopic dermatitis (NCT07150845), after which Evommune reportedly gave up on the antagonist for itch. No other tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months.
opps: Chronic spontaneous urticaria is mainly driven by mast cells, so it fits the mechanism better than atopic dermatitis does. No EVO756 urticaria result is recorded here yet. That data would help show whether the miss reflects the indication or the target itself.

Arcus's Phase 1 small molecule could use skin pharmacodynamic models, such as inhibiting wheals raised by substance P or icatibant, to confirm target engagement. That would rule out low exposure as the reason for a negative result before moving to Phase 2.

Every program tracked here is a small molecule, and no antibodies or other modalities appear yet. Settings that depend more directly on MRGPRX2, such as drug-induced pseudo-allergic reactions around surgery, also have few programs.

zh.why: MUC1在多种腺癌中高表达且糖基化异常，其MUC1-C亚基本身具有促癌信号功能。MUC16是血清标志物CA125的来源，在上皮性卵巢癌中高表达，并通过结合mesothelin促进腹膜转移。两者都是膜表面抗原，但胞外段会脱落，抗体和细胞治疗因此更难靶向。
learned: 在本站追踪的项目中，临床证据仍然很少：7个项目都处于1期或1/2期，其中5个是细胞治疗，目前没有读出。未来6个月内也没有试验到达主要完成日期，短期内不会有对该机制的检验。
opps: 7个项目中有5个是细胞治疗，ADC和双抗只各有1个，分别来自Whitehawk和NEOK Bio。可以用抗体类药物靶向MUC1-C或MUC16近膜段这类不脱落的表位，验证避开脱落抗原能否提高肿瘤内暴露。
已追踪项目集中在卵巢癌和乳腺癌，胰腺癌只有1个。MUC1在肺、胃、结直肠腺癌中也广泛表达，但本站追踪的项目都没有专门针对这些适应症，可作为MUC1靶向药物有待验证的方向。
双靶点CAR-NK项目EB-DNK101可用来观察双靶点能否应对卵巢癌的抗原异质性。按肿瘤特异性糖型表达筛选患者，并把血清CA125作为药效学指标，可能让早期信号更清晰。

en.why: MUC1 is overexpressed and abnormally glycosylated in many adenocarcinomas, and its MUC1-C subunit acts as a cancer-driving signalling protein. MUC16, the source of the serum marker CA125, is highly expressed in epithelial ovarian cancer and helps tumours spread across the peritoneum by binding mesothelin. Both sit on the cell surface, but their outer domains shed, which makes antibody and cell-therapy targeting harder.
learned: Among programs tracked here, there is very little clinical evidence so far: seven programs, all in Phase 1 or 1/2, five of them cell therapies, and no readouts yet. No tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so the mechanism will not be tested soon.
opps: Five of the seven tracked programs are cell therapies, with just one ADC (Whitehawk) and one bispecific (NEOK Bio). Antibody drugs aimed at epitopes that stay on the cell, such as MUC1-C or the near-membrane region of MUC16, could test whether avoiding shed antigen improves drug exposure in the tumour.

Tracked programs focus on ovarian and breast cancer, with one in pancreatic cancer. MUC1 is also widely expressed in lung, gastric and colorectal adenocarcinoma, but no tracked program names these indications. They remain untested directions for MUC1-directed drugs.

The dual-targeting CAR-NK program EB-DNK101 could show whether hitting two targets helps overcome antigen heterogeneity in ovarian cancer. Selecting patients by tumour-specific glycoform expression, and using serum CA125 as a pharmacodynamic marker, could make early signals clearer.

zh.why: Menin是KMT2A（MLL）复合物的支架蛋白，KMT2A重排及NPM1突变白血病依赖menin-KMT2A结合来维持HOXA/MEIS1致白血病转录程序。阻断这一相互作用可下调该程序并诱导分化，因此menin是这两类遗传定义AML/ALL的直接靶点。
learned: 临床记录仍较薄：本站收录的唯一读出是revumenib结直肠癌研究NCT05731947，因1b期扩展队列未达到预设疗效信号而终止，提示脱离KMT2A/NPM1背景的实体瘤难以复制血液瘤中的作用。未来6个月本站暂无到期读出。
opps: 白血病领域本站收录3个3期项目，均为小分子，适应症集中于AML；ALL仅2个项目涉及，KMT2A重排ALL及儿童患者可能是区分度更高的方向。
获得性MEN1突变是menin抑制剂的已知耐药机制，AstraZeneca、Charm、Eilean等早期项目可检验能否覆盖耐药突变，或通过与标准方案联用在一线NPM1突变AML中形成差异。
实体瘤方向在NCT05731947未达到疗效信号后，应先明确生物标志物再扩展；GIST及本站收录的1项心血管/代谢领域试验提示非白血病适应症仍是未验证的假设。

en.why: Menin is the scaffold of the KMT2A (MLL) complex. KMT2A-rearranged and NPM1-mutant leukemias depend on menin-KMT2A binding to sustain the leukemogenic HOXA/MEIS1 program. Blocking the interaction shuts down that program and drives differentiation, which makes menin a direct target in these two genetically defined AML/ALL subsets.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout tracked here is revumenib in colorectal cancer (NCT05731947), stopped after the Phase 1b expansion missed its pre-defined efficacy signals. That suggests activity outside the KMT2A/NPM1 setting does not carry over easily to solid tumors. No readouts tracked here are due in the next six months.
opps: In leukemia, three Phase 3 programs are tracked here, all small molecules and mostly in AML. Only two programs touch ALL, so KMT2A-rearranged ALL and pediatric patients may give more room to differentiate.

Acquired MEN1 mutations are a known resistance mechanism for menin inhibitors. Early programs from AstraZeneca, Charm and Eilean could test whether they cover resistant variants, or stand apart through combinations in newly diagnosed NPM1-mutant AML.

After NCT05731947 missed its efficacy signals, solid-tumor work probably needs a biomarker defined first. GIST and the one cardiometabolic trial tracked here mean non-leukemia uses remain an untested hypothesis.

zh.why: Mesothelin（MSLN）是一种GPI锚定的细胞表面糖蛋白，正常组织中主要局限于胸膜、腹膜和心包间皮，在间皮瘤、卵巢癌、胰腺癌及部分肺癌中高表达。它与CA125/MUC16结合，可能促进腹腔播散，因此是ADC、双抗和CAR细胞疗法常用的实体瘤靶点。主要难点包括可溶性MSLN的抗原沉没效应，以及对正常浆膜的在靶毒性风险。
learned: 本站追踪的临床数据还很少。唯一读出是TCR2的TC-510在间皮瘤中的Phase 1/2研究（NCT05451849），仅为描述性安全性终点，因未见明确、稳健的临床活性而提前终止，Phase 2未入组。终止原因虽归为运营类，实际反映的是疗效信号不足。未来6个月内没有预期读出，CAR-NK和双抗路线的首批数据时间尚不确定。
opps: 本站追踪的8个项目中有7个是细胞疗法，多为2026年起登记的北京CAR-NK项目，另有Context的双抗CT-95；未见ADC项目。NK平台能否克服TC-510所示T细胞疗法的活性瓶颈，仍是未解问题。
胸腺癌、B2型胸腺瘤和胰腺导管腺癌各只有1个项目覆盖。按MSLN表达密度和血清可溶性MSLN水平筛选患者，或采用腹腔、胸腔局部给药，可作为可检验的差异化假设。
肿瘤内MSLN表达异质性可能限制单靶点疗效。EB-DNK101这类双靶点设计，或与免疫检查点抑制剂联用，可用来检验能否减少抗原逃逸、改善实体瘤微环境中的细胞持续性。

en.why: Mesothelin (MSLN) is a GPI-anchored surface glycoprotein. In normal tissue it is largely limited to pleural, peritoneal and pericardial mesothelium, but it is overexpressed in mesothelioma and in ovarian, pancreatic and some lung cancers. Its binding to CA125/MUC16 may aid peritoneal spread. Shed soluble MSLN can soak up drug before it reaches the tumour, and on-target serosal toxicity is a known risk.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is thin. The only readout is TCR2's TC-510 Phase 1/2 in mesothelioma (NCT05451849). Its endpoint was descriptive safety only, and it stopped early for lack of a clear signal of robust activity, with no Phase 2 enrolment. The stop is coded operational but in practice reflects weak efficacy. No readouts are expected in the next six months.
opps: Of 8 tracked programs, 7 are cell therapies, mostly Beijing CAR-NK programs registered from 2026. The other is Context's bispecific CT-95, and no ADC is tracked here. An open question is whether NK platforms can get past the weak activity seen with TC-510's T-cell approach.

Thymic carcinoma, B2 thymoma and PDAC each have just one tracked program. Two hypotheses worth testing: selecting patients by MSLN density and serum soluble MSLN, and regional delivery into the peritoneum or pleura.

MSLN expression varies within tumours, which may cap single-target activity. Dual-targeting designs such as EB-DNK101, or combinations with checkpoint inhibitors, could test whether this reduces antigen escape and helps cells persist in solid tumours.

zh.why: Myostatin（GDF8）是 TGF-β 超家族配体，经 ActRIIB/ALK4/5–SMAD2/3 通路负向调控骨骼肌量。动物及人类功能缺失突变均导致肌肉肥大，遗传证据明确。抑制该通路有望在 SMA 等神经肌肉病中增加肌量和功能，也可能在减重治疗中保留瘦体重。
learned: 本站追踪的项目尚无读出或失败记录，临床证据仍有限。首批实质性检验来自近期到达主要完成日的试验：Apitegromab 用于 SMA 的 III 期 NCT05626855、Roche 未命名单抗的 II/III 期 NCT05115110，以及 Taldefgrobep Alfa 用于肥胖的 II 期 NCT07281495。
opps: 本站追踪的项目集中在 SMA，FSHD 仅零星布局，其他肌营养不良和肌少症基本空白。若 SMA 读出为阳性，可检验同一机制在 SMN 之外的肌病中能否获益。
肥胖适应症目前仅见 NCT07281495 一项。值得验证的假设是：与 incretin 类药物联用时，myostatin 抑制能否在保留瘦体重的同时改善肌肉功能，而不仅是改善体成分。
已追踪项目均为单抗或融合蛋白，尚未见 siRNA、反义寡核苷酸或小分子。靶向潜伏型与成熟型 myostatin 的选择性差异，以及 SMA 患者按行走能力和 SMN 背景治疗分层，均是可探索的区分方向。

en.why: Myostatin (GDF8) is a TGF-β superfamily ligand that limits skeletal muscle mass through ActRIIB/ALK4/5–SMAD2/3 signaling. Loss-of-function mutations in animals and humans cause hypermuscularity, which is strong genetic validation. Blocking it could add muscle mass and function in neuromuscular diseases such as SMA, and could preserve lean mass during weight-loss therapy.
learned: None of the programs tracked here has a readout or failure on record yet, so the clinical record is thin. The first real tests are trials now at or near primary completion: apitegromab's Phase 3 in SMA (NCT05626855), Roche's unnamed Phase 2/3 antibody (NCT05115110) and taldefgrobep alfa's Phase 2 in obesity (NCT07281495).
opps: Among programs tracked here, most activity is in SMA, FSHD has only a few programs, and other dystrophies and sarcopenia are largely untouched. If the SMA readouts are positive, a natural next question is whether the mechanism helps in myopathies that do not involve SMN.

Obesity has a single tracked trial (NCT07281495). One hypothesis to test is whether adding myostatin blockade to incretin therapy improves muscle function, not just body composition, while preserving lean mass.

All tracked programs are antibodies or fusion proteins; no siRNA, antisense or small-molecule approach appears. Two open questions could set programs apart: whether targeting latent versus mature myostatin matters, and whether SMA patients should be grouped by ambulatory status and background SMN therapy.

zh.why: NK1受体是P物质的受体，分布于脑干呕吐中枢和胃肠道，介导恶心呕吐；aprepitant早已用于化疗所致恶心呕吐，验证了该机制。本页亦收录NK3及NK1/NK3双靶点项目：雌激素下降后，下丘脑神经激肽B–NK3信号失衡，引发潮热。
learned: 临床记录仍有限：唯一读出是Vanda的tradipitant特发性胃轻瘫III期（NCT04028492），未达到恶心评分主要终点。下一检验为tradipitant恶心呕吐III期（NCT07446439），预计2026年12月达到主要完成。
opps: 胃轻瘫异质性强，NCT04028492失败后，恶心为主或糖尿病性亚组是否获益仍不明确；按症状或生物标志物富集人群，以及已收录的糖尿病胃轻瘫项目，可检验这一点。
血管舒缩症状领域，fezolinetant（NK3）与elinzanetant（NK1/NK3）均处III期；额外阻断NK1能否带来可测的睡眠或情绪获益，以及在不宜激素治疗女性中的应用，仍是待回答的差异化问题。
已收录的5个项目均为小分子，肥胖和晕动病各仅1个项目。可检验的假设之一：用NK1拮抗剂缓解肠促胰素类减重药物引起的恶心，目前尚无相关读出。

en.why: NK1 is the receptor for substance P. It sits in the brainstem vomiting centers and the gut, where it drives nausea and vomiting, and aprepitant's long use in chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting validates the mechanism. This page also groups NK3 and dual NK1/NK3 programs: when estrogen falls, hypothalamic neurokinin B–NK3 signaling becomes unbalanced and triggers hot flashes.
learned: The record is thin. The only readout tracked here is Vanda's Phase 3 tradipitant trial in idiopathic gastroparesis (NCT04028492), which missed its nausea-severity primary endpoint. The next test is tradipitant's Phase 3 in nausea and vomiting (NCT07446439), with primary completion due December 2026.
opps: Gastroparesis varies a lot between patients. After the NCT04028492 miss, it is still unclear whether nausea-predominant or diabetic subgroups respond differently. Enriching by symptoms or biomarkers, plus the separately tracked diabetic gastroparesis program, could test this.

In vasomotor symptoms, fezolinetant (NK3) and elinzanetant (NK1/NK3) are both in Phase 3 here. Two open questions for differentiation: whether also blocking NK1 gives a measurable sleep or mood benefit, and how these drugs perform in women who cannot take hormone therapy.

All five programs tracked here are small molecules, and obesity and motion sickness each have just one program. One testable hypothesis is NK1 antagonism to ease nausea caused by incretin-based obesity drugs. No tracked readout has tested this yet.

zh.why: NKG2A与CD94组成抑制性受体，表达于NK细胞和部分CD8+ T细胞，识别HLA-E后经ITIM向下传递抑制信号。许多肿瘤上调HLA-E，借此逃避NK和T细胞杀伤。阻断NKG2A有望同时释放先天和适应性免疫，并与PD-(L)1抑制互补。
learned: 本站追踪的NKG2A临床记录仍很薄：3个项目均处于1/2期，尚无读出、失败或终止记录，未来六个月内也没有追踪到达到主要完成日期的试验，近期尚无可检验该机制的数据节点。
opps: 本站追踪的项目集中在MSI-H/dMMR胃癌/胃食管结合部癌，另有NSCLC和转移性胰腺癌各1项。可检验的假设是：按肿瘤HLA-E表达或NKG2A+ CD8 TIL密度筛选患者，能否识别出获益人群。
目前追踪到的形式只有单抗（S095029）和一项重组蛋白（HY-0102）。双特异性抗体、与可诱导ADCC的抗体联用，或在CAR-NK/T细胞中敲除NKG2A，都是本站尚未覆盖的思路。
本站追踪的NKG2A试验全部属于肿瘤领域。鉴于NKG2A限制NK细胞和CD8+ T细胞功能，慢性病毒感染、移植后血液肿瘤复发等场景值得在机制层面进一步评估。

en.why: NKG2A pairs with CD94 to form an inhibitory receptor on NK cells and a subset of CD8+ T cells. When it binds HLA-E, it sends an ITIM-mediated brake signal. Many tumors raise HLA-E levels to escape NK and T-cell killing. Blocking NKG2A could release both innate and adaptive immunity and complement PD-(L)1 blockade.
learned: The NKG2A record tracked here is still thin. All 3 programs are in phase 1/2, with no readouts, failures or early stops so far. No trial tracked here reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term data point will test the mechanism yet.
opps: Among programs tracked here, most activity is in MSI-H/dMMR gastric and gastroesophageal-junction cancer, with one program each in NSCLC and metastatic pancreatic cancer. One hypothesis to test: whether selecting patients by tumor HLA-E expression or NKG2A+ CD8 TIL density identifies who responds.

The only formats tracked are monoclonal antibodies (S095029) and one recombinant protein (HY-0102). Bispecifics, pairing with ADCC-inducing antibodies, and NKG2A knockout in CAR-NK or CAR-T cells are approaches not yet represented here.

Every NKG2A trial tracked here is in oncology. Because NKG2A restrains NK and CD8+ T cells, chronic viral infection and relapse of blood cancers after transplant may deserve a closer mechanistic look.

zh.why: NKG2D是NK细胞、CD8+ T细胞和γδ T细胞上的激活型受体，识别MICA/MICB及ULBP家族配体。这些配体在细胞应激和恶性转化时上调，NKG2D因此成为广谱识别肿瘤的通路。肿瘤常通过脱落可溶性MICA逃逸，以NKG2D胞外域构建的CAR可同时覆盖多种配体。
learned: 临床记录仍然很少：本站目前追踪到的2个项目（Leucid Bio的LEU011和Nkarta的NKX101）均无读出，未来6个月内也没有到达主要完成日期的试验，暂时无法判断该机制在哪类患者中有效。
在本站追踪范围内，NKG2D项目全部集中在肿瘤领域的细胞疗法：NKX101针对复发/难治AML，LEU011针对实体瘤，且最高阶段仅为1/2期。
opps: 配体表达异质性和可溶性MICA脱落可能削弱疗效，可以假设：按MICA/MICB、ULBP表达或血清可溶性配体水平筛选患者，或联用抑制配体脱落的抗体，可提高应答率。
本站追踪的项目尚未涉及双特异性衔接分子等非细胞疗法模态，现货型、可调剂量的NKG2D配体靶向分子值得验证。
NKG2D–配体相互作用与乳糜泻、1型糖尿病等自身免疫组织损伤相关，在本站追踪范围内尚无阻断NKG2D的自身免疫项目。

en.why: NKG2D is an activating receptor on NK cells, CD8+ T cells and γδ T cells that binds MICA/MICB and ULBP ligands. These ligands are upregulated by cellular stress and malignant transformation, making NKG2D a broad tumor-recognition pathway. Tumors often escape by shedding soluble MICA, and CARs built on the NKG2D ectodomain can cover several ligands at once.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Neither tracked program (Leucid Bio's LEU011, Nkarta's NKX101) has a readout here, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so it is too early to say where the mechanism works.
Among programs tracked here, NKG2D work is entirely cell therapy in oncology: NKX101 in relapsed/refractory AML and LEU011 in solid tumors. Nothing has gone beyond Phase 1/2.
opps: Uneven ligand expression and soluble MICA shedding may limit activity. A testable hypothesis: selecting patients by MICA/MICB or ULBP expression, or by serum soluble ligand levels, or adding antibodies that block ligand shedding, could improve response.
No tracked program uses a non-cell modality such as a bispecific engager. Off-the-shelf, dose-adjustable molecules targeting NKG2D ligands are an untested approach here.
NKG2D–ligand interactions are linked to tissue damage in autoimmune diseases such as celiac disease and type 1 diabetes. No program tracked here blocks NKG2D in autoimmunity.

zh.why: NLRP3 是一种胞内传感器，能识别尿酸盐结晶、胆固醇结晶和蛋白聚集体等危险信号，活化后通过 caspase-1 释放 IL-1β 和 IL-18。NLRP3 功能获得性突变导致 CAPS，IL-1β 阻断可降低心血管事件。这些证据支持在痛风、心代谢和神经退行性疾病中开发口服抑制剂。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄。已读出的注册试验只有 NCT06771115（肥胖），主要终点是安全性，没有正式的疗效检验。首批真正的疗效检验将来自 NCT07220629（肥胖）和 NCT05658575（急性痛风发作）。
opps: 急性痛风发作中，尿酸盐结晶直接激活 NLRP3，机制链条最短。NCT05658575 是此处追踪的唯一 II/III 期项目，可检验口服小分子在生物学依据最清楚的适应症中能否显示疗效。
肥胖及心血管风险是此处项目最集中的方向。用 hsCRP 或 IL-6 升高来筛选患者，或与肠促胰素类药物联用，或许是与同类项目拉开差距的思路。
CAPS 等遗传性自身炎症病有直接的 NLRP3 遗传学验证，但此处追踪的项目中还没有针对它们的。复发性心包炎（1 个项目）和帕金森病（2 个项目）的覆盖也很少。

en.why: NLRP3 is a sensor inside the cell that detects danger signals such as urate crystals, cholesterol crystals and protein aggregates. Once activated, it drives caspase-1 to release IL-1β and IL-18. Gain-of-function NLRP3 mutations cause CAPS, and blocking IL-1β lowered cardiovascular events. This evidence supports developing oral inhibitors for gout, cardiometabolic disease and neurodegeneration.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only registry readout, NCT06771115 in obesity, had a safety primary endpoint and no formal efficacy test. The first real efficacy tests will come from NCT07220629 in obesity and NCT05658575 in acute gout flare.
opps: In acute gout flare, urate crystals activate NLRP3 directly, the shortest link from mechanism to disease. NCT05658575 is the only phase 2/3 program tracked here. It could show whether an oral small molecule works where the biology is clearest.

Obesity and cardiovascular risk is where most programs tracked here cluster. Selecting patients with high hsCRP or IL-6, or testing combinations with incretin drugs, may help a program stand apart from similar ones.

CAPS and related inherited autoinflammatory diseases have direct NLRP3 genetic validation, but no program tracked here targets them. Recurrent pericarditis (one program) and Parkinson's disease (two) also have little coverage.

zh.why: NMDA 受体是由 GluN1 与 GluN2A-D 亚基组成的谷氨酸门控钙通道，是突触可塑性和学习记忆的核心。ketamine 的快速抗抑郁作用、esketamine 获批用于难治性抑郁、memantine 获批用于阿尔茨海默病，提供了临床验证。GRIN 基因变异和抗 NMDAR 自身抗体脑炎则提供了人类遗传和免疫学证据。
learned: 口服低亲和力通道阻滞剂难以复制 ketamine 类快速抗抑郁效应：REL-1017 在 MDD 的 NCT04855747 中未达到终点，姊妹研究 NCT06011577 也因同一期中样本量再估计而提前终止。
两项 MDD 研究都在样本量再估计后被终止，提示真实效应量低于设计假设。在可测效应偏小的情况下，剂量选择和安慰剂反应控制可能比机制本身更决定成败。
AXS-05 在阿尔茨海默病激越的 ADVANCE-2（NCT05557409）中未达到 CMAI 终点。配套长期安全性研究 NCT06736509 以项目目标完成为由关闭，属描述性数据，不能作为疗效依据。
本站记录的失败全部归为疗效原因（共三项去重研究），没有安全性或商业原因的终止，说明该靶点的主要风险是疗效幅度，而不是耐受性。
opps: 亚基选择性和变构调节仍处早期：radiprodil（GRIN，1/2 期，GluN2B 选择性）和 zelquistinel（Syndeio，2 期，正向调节剂）可检验非阻滞机制能否避开广谱阻滞剂的疗效瓶颈。
免疫介导的神经精神适应症布局很少：在本站跟踪的项目中，只有 Arialys 一个单抗项目针对神经精神狼疮。以抗 NMDAR 抗体为生物标志物筛选患者，值得作为假设验证。
未来六个月本站未跟踪到主要完成节点。J&J 的两个 esketamine 3 期项目以及 EG-501、zelquistinel 的 2 期研究，可考虑引入 EEG 等靶点结合标志物来指导剂量，降低效应量不确定性。

en.why: NMDA receptors are glutamate-gated calcium channels built from GluN1 and GluN2A-D subunits and are central to synaptic plasticity and memory. Ketamine's rapid antidepressant effect, the approvals of esketamine for treatment-resistant depression and memantine for Alzheimer's disease, plus GRIN gene variants and anti-NMDAR encephalitis, give clinical, genetic and immunological validation.
learned: Oral low-affinity channel blockers have not reproduced ketamine-like rapid antidepressant effects: REL-1017 missed in MDD in NCT04855747, and the sister study NCT06011577 was stopped early after the same interim sample-size re-estimation.

Both MDD studies were stopped after sample-size re-estimation, which suggests the true effect was smaller than the design assumed. When effects are this modest, dose choice and placebo-response control may decide outcomes as much as the mechanism does.

AXS-05 missed the CMAI endpoint in Alzheimer's agitation in ADVANCE-2 (NCT05557409). The companion long-term safety study NCT06736509 closed because program objectives were complete. Its data are descriptive and are not evidence of efficacy.

Every failure recorded here is coded as efficacy (three unique trials), with no safety or business stops. Among programs tracked here, the main risk for this target is the size of the effect, not tolerability.
opps: Subunit-selective and allosteric approaches are still early: radiprodil (GRIN, Phase 1/2, GluN2B-selective) and zelquistinel (Syndeio, Phase 2, positive modulator) could test whether non-blocking mechanisms avoid the efficacy ceiling seen with broad blockers.

Immune-mediated neuropsychiatric indications are barely covered. Among programs tracked here, only one antibody program (Arialys) targets neuropsychiatric lupus. Selecting patients by anti-NMDAR antibody status is a hypothesis worth testing.

No primary completions are tracked in the next six months. The two J&J esketamine Phase 3 programs and the Phase 2 studies of EG-501 and zelquistinel could use target-engagement markers such as EEG to guide dosing and reduce uncertainty about effect size.

zh.why: KEAP1在胞质中把转录因子NRF2送去降解；氧化应激时NRF2进入细胞核，启动抗氧化和解毒基因。线粒体功能障碍相关的神经退行性疾病中这条通路功能不足，激活NRF2是治疗思路；KEAP1/NFE2L2突变则让部分肿瘤中NRF2持续活化，抑制NRF2成为另一条路线。omaveloxolone已获批用于Friedreich共济失调。
learned: 临床记录还很薄。本站追踪的3个小分子项目都还没有读出，也没有记录到失败，未来6个月内也没有试验到达主要完成日期。所以目前没有可比较的成败数据，Biogen的omaveloxolone III期项目以及Hillhurst、Vividion的早期项目暂时都无法给出新的结论。
opps: 本站追踪的肿瘤项目只有Vividion一个I期实体瘤项目。以KEAP1/NFE2L2突变或NRF2高活化作为入组标志物，可以检验抑制方向能否在生物标志物定义的人群中起效。
神经领域目前只覆盖Friedreich共济失调和帕金森病。值得研究的问题是，NRF2激活能否用在其他与氧化应激相关的疾病上，比如其他共济失调或线粒体病。同时需要NQO1诱导等靶点结合标志物来辅助确定剂量。
3个项目全是小分子。非共价的KEAP1–NRF2相互作用抑制剂，或者针对NRF2的降解剂，有可能在选择性和脱靶安全性上和亲电型激活剂拉开差距，目前在本站还没有看到相应项目。

en.why: KEAP1 marks the transcription factor NRF2 for degradation. Under oxidative stress, NRF2 enters the nucleus and switches on antioxidant and detoxification genes. Neurodegenerative diseases driven by mitochondrial dysfunction have too little of this response, so activating NRF2 is one therapeutic idea. In some tumors, KEAP1/NFE2L2 mutations keep NRF2 constantly on, which makes inhibiting it the opposite idea. Omaveloxolone is approved for Friedreich ataxia.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. None of the three small-molecule programs tracked here has a readout or a recorded failure, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months. So there are no hits or misses to compare yet, and neither Biogen's Phase 3 omaveloxolone program nor the early Hillhurst and Vividion programs can teach anything new for now.
opps: Oncology is represented here by just one program, Vividion's Phase 1 trial in solid tumors. Enrolling patients by KEAP1/NFE2L2 mutation or high NRF2 activity could test whether inhibiting NRF2 works in a biomarker-defined population.

The neurology programs tracked here cover only Friedreich ataxia and Parkinson's disease. An open question is whether NRF2 activation helps in other oxidative-stress diseases, such as other ataxias or mitochondrial disorders. Target-engagement markers like NQO1 induction would help guide dosing.

All three programs are small molecules. Non-covalent KEAP1–NRF2 interaction inhibitors or NRF2 degraders might beat electrophilic activators on selectivity and off-target safety. No programs like these are tracked here yet.

zh.why: Nav1.7（SCN9A）和Nav1.8（SCN10A）主要表达于外周伤害感受神经元，负责痛觉信号的产生与传导。SCN9A功能缺失导致先天性无痛症，功能获得突变引起红斑性肢痛症，人类遗传学验证充分。选择性外周阻断有望提供非阿片类镇痛，同时避开中枢和心脏钠通道。
learned: 临床记录尚薄：本站暂未收录该靶点的任何读出或失败。首批真正检验将是suzetrigine在糖尿病周围神经病理性疼痛中的两项III期试验，NCT06696443（主要完成日2027-01-25）与NCT07231419（2027-04-06）。
opps: 在本站收录范围内，三个项目均为Vertex的小分子，单一公司、单一模态。抗体、ASO/siRNA或基因治疗等手段在Nav1.7/Nav1.8上尚无收录项目，可作为差异化方向探索。
收录试验集中于急性疼痛和DPN。SCN9A/SCN10A功能获得突变相关的小纤维神经病、红斑性肢痛症，以及通路所涉的慢性咳嗽，可借助遗传分层富集应答人群。
NCT06696443与NCT07231419将回答外周Nav1.8阻断能否从急性疼痛延伸到慢性神经病理性疼痛并在长期给药中维持疗效，这一结果决定后续VX-993等项目的适应症取舍。

en.why: Nav1.7 (SCN9A) and Nav1.8 (SCN10A) are expressed mainly in peripheral nociceptors, where they generate and carry pain signals. SCN9A loss-of-function causes congenital insensitivity to pain and gain-of-function causes erythromelalgia, giving strong human genetic validation. Selective peripheral block promises non-opioid analgesia that spares central and cardiac sodium channels.
learned: The clinical record is still thin: no readouts or failures are tracked here for this target. The first real test will be two Phase 3 trials of suzetrigine in diabetic peripheral neuropathic pain, NCT06696443 (primary completion 2027-01-25) and NCT07231419 (2027-04-06).
opps: Among programs tracked here, all three are Vertex small molecules: one company, one modality. No antibody, ASO/siRNA or gene-therapy approach to Nav1.7/Nav1.8 is tracked, which leaves room to test differentiated modalities.

Tracked trials focus on acute pain and DPN. Small-fiber neuropathy and erythromelalgia linked to SCN9A/SCN10A gain-of-function variants, and chronic cough within this pathway, could use genetic stratification to enrich for responders.

NCT06696443 and NCT07231419 should show whether peripheral Nav1.8 block extends from acute pain to chronic neuropathic pain and holds up with long-term dosing. That answer will shape indication choices for follow-on programs such as VX-993.

zh.why: Nav1.1、Nav1.6、Nav1.2（SCN1A/SCN8A/SCN2A）调控中枢神经元兴奋性，致病变异可导致发育性癫痫性脑病。SCN1A功能缺失削弱抑制性中间神经元，引发Dravet综合征，治疗思路是上调Nav1.1；SCN8A功能获得则需要选择性抑制Nav1.6。两个方向都有直接的遗传学依据。
learned: 临床记录仍很有限。唯一读出是Neurocrine的Nav1.6抑制剂NBI-921352在SCN8A DEE中的2期试验（NCT05226780），入组8人后因申办方决定终止，无法据此判断疗效。zorevunersen的Dravet 3期试验（NCT06872125）将是首个真正的检验。
opps: NBI-921352终止后，本站追踪范围内SCN8A DEE已无在研项目。选择性抑制Nav1.6对功能获得型患者是否有效仍是未解问题，针对SCN8A的敲低型或等位基因选择性ASO在此尚无项目。
本站未追踪到Nav1.2（SCN2A）项目，而SCN2A变异分为功能获得型婴儿期癫痫和功能缺失型孤独症样表型。按变异的功能类别分层，可以决定采用抑制还是上调策略。
NCT06872125的主要终点预计2027年3月完成，将检验上调Nav1.1能否在标准治疗基础上进一步减少发作。认知与行为获益、最佳治疗年龄，以及比反复鞘内给药创伤更小的递送方式，仍待回答。

en.why: Nav1.1, Nav1.6 and Nav1.2 (SCN1A, SCN8A, SCN2A) set neuronal excitability in the brain, and variants in these genes cause developmental and epileptic encephalopathies. SCN1A loss of function weakens inhibitory interneurons and drives Dravet syndrome, so the aim there is to restore Nav1.1. SCN8A gain of function calls for selective Nav1.6 inhibition. Human genetics directly supports both approaches.
learned: The record is still thin. The only readout is a Phase 2 of Neurocrine's Nav1.6 inhibitor NBI-921352 in SCN8A DEE (NCT05226780). It stopped after 8 patients on a sponsor decision, so it tells us nothing about efficacy. Zorevunersen's Phase 3 in Dravet (NCT06872125) will be the first real test.
opps: Now that NBI-921352 has stopped, no SCN8A DEE program remains among those tracked here. Nobody has yet shown whether selective Nav1.6 inhibition works in gain-of-function patients, and no program tracked here uses knockdown or allele-selective ASOs against SCN8A.

No Nav1.2 (SCN2A) programs are tracked here. Yet SCN2A variants split into gain-of-function infantile epilepsy and loss-of-function autism-like phenotypes. Sorting patients by the functional class of their variant could show whether to inhibit or upregulate the channel.

NCT06872125, with primary completion due in March 2027, should show whether raising Nav1.1 reduces seizures on top of standard care. Still unanswered: effects on cognition and behavior, the best age to treat, and delivery methods less invasive than repeated intrathecal dosing.

zh.why: Nectin-4（PVRL4）是一种细胞黏附分子，在尿路上皮癌中高表达，在乳腺癌、肺癌等实体瘤中也常见，正常组织表达有限，主要见于皮肤等上皮。这种分布适合 ADC 递送细胞毒载荷。enfortumab vedotin 已在尿路上皮癌获批多年，靶点的临床可成药性已得到验证。
learned: 目前的有效性证据集中在尿路上皮癌，并正向更早期病程推进：enfortumab vedotin 联合 pembrolizumab 用于肌层浸润性膀胱癌围手术期，EFS 达到主要终点（NCT03924895）。
NCT03869190 的部分联合方案（如联合 niraparib）提前关闭，原因是申办方的商业决策，不能作为否定机制或联合疗效的证据。
本站跟踪的后续项目以 ADC 为主（12 个中有 7 个），另有双抗和细胞治疗，大多处于 1 期，适应症偏向实体瘤泛瘤种、NSCLC 和乳腺癌。尿路上皮以外尚无假设检验型读出，NCT04887870 只给出描述性安全性数据。
opps: 尿路上皮以外的验证仍是空白：TNBC、NSCLC 各有 3 个项目但尚无读出。可以检验按 Nectin-4 表达水平筛选患者能否提高应答率。
随着 enfortumab vedotin 前移到围手术期（NCT03924895），EV 治疗后进展的患者会越来越多。换用不同载荷的 ADC、双环毒素偶联物、双抗或细胞治疗能否克服耐药，是有待回答的问题。
CRB-701 已进入 3 期，Akeso、Rondo 的双抗以及 NK 或 CAR 类细胞治疗都处于早期。关键在于能否在保留疗效的同时减轻皮肤毒性和神经毒性，这一点有待各项目数据验证。

en.why: Nectin-4 (PVRL4) is a cell-adhesion molecule. It is highly expressed in urothelial carcinoma and often in breast, lung and other solid tumours, while normal-tissue expression is limited, mainly to skin and other epithelia. That profile suits ADC payload delivery. Enfortumab vedotin has been approved in urothelial cancer for years, which validates the target clinically.
learned: Efficacy evidence is concentrated in urothelial cancer and is moving into earlier disease. Perioperative enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab met its event-free survival endpoint in muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NCT03924895).

Some combination arms in NCT03869190, such as enfortumab vedotin plus niraparib, were closed early because the sponsor chose not to continue them. That was a business decision, not evidence against the mechanism or the combination.

Among programs tracked here, most follow-on programs are ADCs (7 of 12), with some bispecifics and cell therapies, and most are in phase 1 across solid tumours, NSCLC and breast cancer. No hypothesis-tested readout exists outside urothelial cancer yet. NCT04887870 reported safety data only, descriptively.
opps: Validation outside urothelial cancer is still open. TNBC and NSCLC each have three programs here but no readouts yet. One hypothesis to test: selecting patients by Nectin-4 expression level could raise response rates.

As enfortumab vedotin moves into the perioperative setting (NCT03924895), more patients will progress after EV. An open question is whether a different payload, a bicyclic toxin conjugate, a bispecific or a cell therapy can work after EV resistance.

CRB-701 has reached phase 3, while the Akeso and Rondo bispecifics and the NK and CAR cell therapies are early. The key question is whether any can keep efficacy while causing less skin toxicity and neuropathy. Program data have yet to answer this.

zh.why: OX40（CD134）是TNF受体超家族的共刺激受体，主要表达于活化及记忆T细胞，与抗原提呈细胞上的OX40L结合后维持效应T细胞的存活、扩增与记忆形成。阻断该通路可抑制驱动特应性皮炎等慢性炎症的致病性T细胞；激动该通路则用于增强抗肿瘤T细胞应答。
learned: OX40拮抗在特应性皮炎中已获得一致验证：rocatinlimab在四项III期研究（NCT05398445、NCT05651711、NCT05724199、NCT05704738）中均达到vIGA-AD主要终点。
向AD以外的适应症扩展被中止：哮喘II期NCT06376045和结节性痒疹III期NCT06527404均因申办方决定（商业原因）终止，这并不否定机制，但疗效问题仍未回答。
长期安全性研究ROCKET-Orbit（NCT05633355）和疫苗应答研究ROCKET-VOYAGER（NCT05899816）均无正式假设检验，T细胞共刺激阻断对免疫功能的影响仍需结合完整数据判断。
肿瘤激动剂方向仍处早期：本站追踪的仅有Inhibrx在头颈癌中的新闻稿积极信号，尚无登记试验读出；全靶点仅4个项目、4家公司。
opps: Amgen停止哮喘和结节性痒疹项目后，OX40拮抗在其他T细胞或2型炎症疾病中的疗效仍待检验，可作为后来者的适应症切入点。
肿瘤项目覆盖HNSCC、HPV阳性口咽癌和NSCLC，可探索HPV状态等生物标志物筛选及与PD-1联用，并需INBRX-106的II/III期登记数据来验证新闻稿信号。
在研药物均为单抗或未细分生物制品，双抗、肿瘤靶向激动剂等形式在本站追踪项目中尚属空白；未来6个月无预定读出，Merck KGaA新登记的I期项目值得关注。

en.why: OX40 (CD134) is a TNF-receptor superfamily co-stimulatory receptor on activated and memory T cells. Binding OX40L on antigen-presenting cells sustains effector T-cell survival, expansion and memory. Blocking it suppresses the pathogenic T cells behind chronic inflammation such as atopic dermatitis; agonizing it aims to boost anti-tumor T-cell responses.
learned: OX40 antagonism is consistently validated in atopic dermatitis: rocatinlimab met the vIGA-AD primary endpoint in four phase 3 trials (NCT05398445, NCT05651711, NCT05724199, NCT05704738).

Expansion beyond AD stopped: the asthma phase 2 NCT06376045 and prurigo nodularis phase 3 NCT06527404 ended on sponsor decision (business). That is not evidence against the mechanism, but efficacy there remains unanswered.

The long-term safety study ROCKET-Orbit (NCT05633355) and vaccine-response study ROCKET-VOYAGER (NCT05899816) had no formal hypothesis test, so the immune impact of blocking T-cell co-stimulation needs reading from full data.

The oncology agonist side is early: tracked here is only an Inhibrx press release reporting a positive signal in head and neck cancer, with no registry readout. The target has just 4 programs from 4 companies.
opps: With Amgen out of asthma and prurigo nodularis, whether OX40 blockade works in other T-cell or type 2 inflammatory diseases is untested and open to a second entrant.

Oncology programs cover HNSCC, HPV+ oropharyngeal cancer and NSCLC; HPV status or other biomarker selection and PD-1 combinations are worth testing, and registry data from the INBRX-106 phase 2/3 are needed to confirm the press-release signal.

All tracked agents are antibodies or unspecified biologics; bispecifics and tumor-targeted agonists are absent among programs tracked here. No readouts are due in six months; Merck KGaA's newly posted phase 1 is one to watch.

zh.why: OX40L主要表达于活化的抗原提呈细胞，与活化T细胞上的OX40结合，促进效应T细胞和记忆T细胞的存活与扩增，并推动Th2及其他炎症反应。阻断OX40L有望在上游重新调节T细胞失衡，而不只是抑制单一细胞因子，因此适用于特应性皮炎等多种T细胞驱动的免疫炎症疾病。
learned: 临床证据仍很有限。在本站追踪的项目中，两项Amlitelimab二期试验均已提前终止，分别为哮喘（NCT06033833）和斑秃（NCT06444451），原因是申办方决定，且明确与安全性无关，因此不能作为否定该机制的证据。首个真正的检验将是乳糜泻试验NCT06557772，其主要完成日期已过，结果尚待公布。
opps: 乳糜泻由麸质特异性T细胞驱动，与Th2型疾病不同。NCT06557772将检验OX40L阻断能否扩展到非Th2型自身免疫病。追踪的适应症中还有1型糖尿病，这一方向值得关注。
哮喘和斑秃因商业原因停止，OX40L在这两个适应症中是否有效仍无答案。可以假设，按Th2高表达或T细胞活化标志物筛选的患者群体可能更适合重新验证。
在本站追踪范围内，该靶点仅有Sanofi和Merck KGaA两家公司布局。Sanofi的双抗和Merck KGaA的一期生物制品提示，下一步的差异化可能来自同时阻断OX40L与另一条炎症通路，或延长给药间隔。

en.why: OX40L, expressed on activated antigen-presenting cells, binds OX40 on activated T cells. This helps effector and memory T cells survive and expand, and drives Th2 and other inflammatory responses. Blocking OX40L could reset T-cell imbalance upstream rather than suppress a single cytokine. That makes it relevant to atopic dermatitis and other T-cell-driven inflammatory diseases.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Among programs tracked here, two amlitelimab phase 2 trials were stopped early: asthma (NCT06033833) and alopecia areata (NCT06444451). Both stops were sponsor decisions explicitly unrelated to safety, so they say nothing against the mechanism. The first real test is the coeliac trial NCT06557772, which is past primary completion with results pending.
opps: Coeliac disease is driven by gluten-specific T cells, not Th2 inflammation. NCT06557772 will test whether OX40L blockade reaches beyond Th2 disease. Type 1 diabetes also appears among the tracked conditions, which points the same way.

Because the asthma and alopecia areata trials stopped for business reasons, whether OX40L works in those diseases is still unknown. One hypothesis: patients selected for Th2-high or T-cell activation markers could be a better population for a fresh test.

Among programs tracked here, only two companies work on this target. Sanofi's bispecific and Merck KGaA's phase 1 biologic suggest the next point of difference may be pairing OX40L with a second inflammatory pathway, or longer dosing intervals.

zh.why: P2X3是由ATP门控的阳离子通道，主要表达于迷走神经C纤维等初级感觉传入神经。气道炎症或损伤时释放的ATP激活P2X3，可使咳嗽反射敏化，被认为是难治性慢性咳嗽的核心机制之一。该通道也参与内脏痛和膀胱感觉，因此在咳嗽之外同样有合理的治疗依据。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄弱。本站目前仅追踪到一个项目，即Wuhan Createrna的一款针对咳嗽的2期小分子，尚无读出、终止记录，未来6个月内也没有到达主要完成日期的试验，暂时无法总结规律。
opps: P2X2/3异源三聚体存在于味觉传入神经，对P2X3同源三聚体的选择性可能决定味觉相关耐受性。值得验证高选择性分子能否在保持镇咳效果的同时减少味觉干扰。
本站追踪的项目只覆盖咳嗽适应症。基于P2X3在内脏痛、膀胱过度活动和子宫内膜异位症疼痛中的生物学作用，这些适应症在本站记录中仍是空白，可作为研究假设。
可探索以咳嗽高敏感性为生物标志物筛选患者（如辣椒素或ATP激发试验），用于检验富集人群能否放大疗效信号；本站追踪范围内尚无小分子以外的modality。

en.why: P2X3 is an ATP-gated cation channel on primary sensory afferents, including vagal C-fibres. ATP released during airway inflammation or injury activates P2X3 and sensitises the cough reflex, a leading mechanism behind refractory chronic cough. The channel also shapes visceral pain and bladder sensation, so the rationale reaches beyond cough.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Among programs tracked here there is one: a Phase 2 small molecule for cough from Wuhan Createrna. It has no readouts and no stops, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so there are no patterns to draw yet.
opps: P2X2/3 heteromers sit on taste afferents, so selectivity for P2X3 homotrimers may drive taste-related tolerability. A testable hypothesis: a highly selective molecule keeps the antitussive effect with less taste disturbance.

Programs tracked here cover only cough. P2X3 biology in visceral pain, overactive bladder and endometriosis pain points to indications with no tracked activity, which could be explored as research hypotheses.

Selecting patients by cough hypersensitivity (for example capsaicin or ATP challenge) could test whether an enriched population strengthens the efficacy signal. No modality other than small molecules is tracked here.

zh.why: P2Y12是血小板上的Gi偶联ADP受体，放大血小板活化并稳定动脉血栓。clopidogrel、prasugrel、ticagrelor早已是急性冠脉综合征及PCI术后抗血小板治疗的基石，靶点验证充分；新的竞争点在起效速度、给药方式、疗程和出血风险。
learned: 本站尚无该靶点读出或失败记录：Viatris的selatogrel有3项III期试验未出结果，首个实质检验是NCT05952206（冠心病1个月DAPT，III期），预计2027年1月主要完成。
opps: selatogrel是本站跟踪的唯一P2Y12新药，针对急性心梗。症状出现时自行注射能否改善结局而不增加出血，以及哪些患者获益，仍待回答。
NCT05952206将检验冠心病患者1个月DAPT是否足够。把短程方案与出血风险评分或按CYP2C19基因型选药结合，是值得验证的患者分层假设。
本站跟踪的项目均为冠心病领域小分子。外周动脉疾病、缺血性卒中，以及手术或出血时快速逆转P2Y12抑制的方案，在本站跟踪范围内尚无项目。

en.why: P2Y12 is the Gi-coupled ADP receptor on platelets that amplifies activation and stabilizes arterial thrombi. Clopidogrel, prasugrel and ticagrelor have long been mainstays after acute coronary syndrome and PCI, so the target is well validated. The open questions now are speed of onset, route of administration, treatment duration and bleeding risk.
learned: No readouts or failures are recorded among programs tracked here. Viatris's selatogrel has three Phase 3 trials without results. The first real test is NCT05952206, a Phase 3 study of 1-month DAPT in coronary artery disease, with primary completion expected in January 2027.
opps: Selatogrel is the only new P2Y12 agent tracked here, aimed at acute myocardial infarction. It is still unknown whether self-injecting at symptom onset improves outcomes without excess bleeding, and which patients benefit.

NCT05952206 will show whether one month of DAPT is enough in coronary artery disease. A selection hypothesis worth testing is to pair short DAPT with bleeding-risk scores, or to choose the P2Y12 agent by CYP2C19 genotype.

All programs tracked here are small molecules in coronary disease. None among programs tracked here address peripheral artery disease or ischemic stroke, or ways to quickly reverse P2Y12 blockade before surgery or during bleeding.

zh.why: 苯丙氨酸羟化酶(PAH)是肝脏中以BH4为辅因子、将苯丙氨酸转化为酪氨酸的酶。PAH双等位基因功能缺失导致苯丙酮尿症(PKU),苯丙氨酸蓄积损伤大脑，患者需终身限食。单基因致病、验证明确；sapropterin仅对有残余酶活性者有效，恢复酶功能是明确方向。
learned: 临床记录仍很有限：本站追踪项目尚无读出，未来六个月也无到期试验。四个项目中三个(VIVUS、Cereno、Novartis)实为肺动脉高压，属缩写重名；真正针对该酶的仅NGGT的PKU基因治疗(1/2期)。
opps: 本站追踪范围内，PKU仅有NGGT一个在靶基因治疗项目。mRNA-LNP递送、针对常见突变的碱基编辑、小分子折叠伴侣等恢复肝脏PAH活性的路径尚未出现，可作为替代方案探索。
双无效等位基因且BH4无应答的患者从基因替代中获益最大。AAV方案在肝脏生长或更新时的持久性仍待回答，这将决定首批人群应选儿童还是成人。
血苯丙氨酸是常用替代终点，但饮食放开程度、酪氨酸水平及神经认知与情绪结局，可能更能区分一次性疗法与长期用药，早期试验宜纳入这些指标。

en.why: Phenylalanine hydroxylase is the liver enzyme that converts phenylalanine to tyrosine using the cofactor BH4. Biallelic loss-of-function PAH variants cause phenylketonuria (PKU), where phenylalanine buildup damages the brain unless held down by lifelong diet. The disease is monogenic and fully validated, and sapropterin helps only patients with residual enzyme activity, so restoring enzyme function is a clear goal.
learned: The clinical record is still thin: among programs tracked here there are no readouts and no trials completing in the next six months. Three of the four listed programs (VIVUS, Cereno Scientific, Novartis) are for pulmonary arterial hypertension, an acronym clash; only NGGT's Phase 1/2 PKU gene therapy is on-target.
opps: Among programs tracked here, PKU has a single on-target program, an NGGT gene therapy. Other routes to restore hepatic PAH activity, such as mRNA-LNP delivery, base editing of recurrent variants, or small-molecule folding chaperones, are not represented and could be explored as alternatives.

Patients with two null alleles and no BH4 response stand to gain most from gene replacement. A key open question for AAV approaches is durability as the liver grows or turns over, which bears on whether children or adults are the better first population.

Blood phenylalanine is the standard surrogate, but diet liberalization, tyrosine levels and neurocognitive or mood outcomes may better separate a one-time therapy from chronic options; early trials could be designed to capture them.

zh.why: PARP1承担了细胞内大部分PARP活性，负责单链断裂修复。它被抑制并“捕获”在DNA上后，会在BRCA1/2等同源重组缺陷的肿瘤中造成合成致死。olaparib等第一代药物同时抑制PARP1和PARP2，而血液学毒性与PARP2有关。选择性PARP1抑制剂的设计目标是扩大治疗窗，并为联合用药留出空间。
learned: 本站追踪的PARP1选择性项目目前还没有任何读出或失败记录，临床证据仍很薄弱。AstraZeneca的saruparib是唯一进入3期的项目。第一个真正的检验是前列腺癌试验NCT07336446，该试验的主要完成日期为2026年11月，结果尚未收录。
opps: 在本站追踪的项目中，前列腺癌（含mHSPC/mCSPC）和乳腺癌、卵巢癌最集中，肺腺癌仅有1个项目，胰腺癌没有。可以检验的假设是：耐受性更好的PARP1选择性药物能否在BRCA以外的HRR基因突变或HRD阳性人群中扩大获益。
saruparib是唯一的3期领先者，身后有6家公司的8个早期项目，其中Eikon有3个，Haisco、Hansoh等中国公司也有布局。后来者可以考虑从脑穿透、PARP抑制剂耐药后的治疗线或新的联合方案入手做差异化，而不是重复领先者的适应症。
NCT07336446的结果将初步说明，PARP1选择性在前列腺癌中能否转化为可联合用药的安全性。早期项目中有5个尚未公开分子类型，降解剂等其他形式能否进一步拉开与小分子的差距，目前仍无数据。

en.why: PARP1 accounts for most cellular PARP activity and repairs single-strand DNA breaks. When it is inhibited and trapped on DNA, tumours that lack homologous recombination repair, such as BRCA1/2-mutant cancers, die (synthetic lethality). First-generation drugs like olaparib block both PARP1 and PARP2, and PARP2 inhibition is linked to blood toxicity. PARP1-selective inhibitors aim for a wider therapeutic window and room for combinations.
learned: The clinical record for PARP1-selective agents tracked here is still thin: no readouts or failures yet. AstraZeneca's saruparib is the only Phase 3 program. The first real test is the prostate cancer trial NCT07336446, which reached primary completion in November 2026. Its results are not yet tracked.
opps: Among programs tracked here, prostate (including mHSPC/mCSPC), breast and ovarian cancer are the most crowded. Lung adenocarcinoma has one program and pancreatic cancer has none. One hypothesis to test: whether better-tolerated PARP1-selective agents extend benefit to patients with non-BRCA HRR mutations or HRD-positive tumours.

Saruparib is the only Phase 3 leader, followed by eight early programs from six companies: three from Eikon, plus Haisco, Hansoh and other Chinese firms. Followers could set themselves apart through brain penetration, use after PARP inhibitor resistance, or new combination partners, rather than repeating the leader's indications.

NCT07336446 should give a first view of whether PARP1 selectivity in prostate cancer gives a safety profile that allows combinations. Five early programs have not disclosed their modality. There are no data yet on whether degraders or other modalities could separate further from small molecules.

zh.why: PARP7（TIPARP）是一种单ADP核糖基转移酶，受AHR诱导表达，可抑制TBK1依赖的I型干扰素信号，相当于肿瘤细胞内的“干扰素刹车”。抑制PARP7有望恢复肿瘤自身的干扰素应答，同时产生直接抗肿瘤作用和免疫激活作用。
learned: 目前临床证据仍很有限：本站跟踪的仅有Nerviano Medical Sciences (Shanghai)的atamparib一个1/2期项目，针对实体瘤和NSCLC腺癌。尚无读出，未来6个月也没有达到主要完成日期的试验，机制的首次检验时间尚不明确。
opps: 生物标志物筛选尚待验证：TIPARP所在3q区域扩增、AHR通路活性或基线干扰素信号低的肿瘤，可能是对PARP7抑制更敏感的人群，值得前瞻性分层。
机制上PARP7抑制可恢复干扰素信号，与PD-1/PD-L1抑制剂联用的协同作用是一个开放问题；本站跟踪的项目尚未覆盖明确的联用设计。
本站跟踪的项目仅限小分子和NSCLC/实体瘤。鳞癌、AR驱动的前列腺癌等适应症，以及降解剂等其他分子类型仍属空白。

en.why: PARP7 (TIPARP) is a mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase whose expression is induced by AHR. It suppresses TBK1-dependent type I interferon signaling, acting as a tumor-intrinsic brake on interferon. Blocking PARP7 may restore the tumor's own interferon response, with both direct antitumor and immune-activating effects.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Among programs tracked here, Nerviano Medical Sciences (Shanghai)'s atamparib is the only one: a phase 1/2 small molecule in solid tumors and NSCLC adenocarcinoma. It has no readouts, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so it is unclear when the mechanism gets its first real test.
opps: Biomarker selection is untested. Tumors with 3q amplification covering TIPARP, high AHR activity or low baseline interferon signaling may respond better to PARP7 inhibition and could be tested as prospective strata.
Since PARP7 inhibition restores interferon signaling, whether it works synergistically with PD-1/PD-L1 blockade is an open question. No tracked program has a clearly defined combination design.

Tracked work covers only small molecules in NSCLC and solid tumors. Other indications, such as squamous cancers and AR-driven prostate cancer, and other modalities, such as degraders, are still white space.

zh.why: PARP1/2参与DNA单链断裂修复，抑制剂可将PARP“捕获”在DNA上，在BRCA1/2突变或同源重组缺陷（HRD）肿瘤中造成合成致死。olaparib等早已获批，卵巢癌、乳腺癌、前列腺癌是这一机制验证最充分的领域。
learned: 在本站追踪范围内，该领域已高度成熟且集中：21个项目中12个处于3期，几乎全为小分子，以olaparib、niraparib、talazoparib、rucaparib为主，适应症集中在卵巢、乳腺和前列腺癌。
卵巢癌仍是随机对照证据最扎实的领域：DUO-O（NCT03737643）达到PFS主要终点；L-MOCA（NCT03534453）为描述性分析，不构成成败判断。
已记录的4条失败均为商业原因：olaparib联合pembrolizumab治疗TNBC（NCT04191135）及niraparib联合enfortumab vedotin治疗尿路上皮癌（NCT03869190）提前终止，并非机制被否定，但联合疗法的价值也因此仍未得到回答。
超出HRD富集瘤种的探索多为无统计检验的单臂研究，如实体瘤篮式研究NCT03742895和mCRPC联合用药研究NCT03568656，泛瘤种和新联合方案尚缺乏对照证据。
opps: 新一代分子是差异化方向：PARP1选择性、可入脑的AZD9574，以及Acerand、Nerviano、Merck KGaA的早期项目，可检验降低血液毒性后能否实现泛PARP难以耐受的联合方案，以及脑转移场景。
适应症外延将迎来检验：fuzuloparib治疗mCRPC（NCT04691804）和talazoparib（NCT05059522）预计2026年底完成，olaparib肺癌研究（NCT04380636）2027年完成，HRR突变或HRD评分的患者筛选可能决定成败。
因商业原因中断的ADC或免疫联合问题仍有空间，可在HRD筛选人群中重新设计；另有NCT04884360、NCT06433219已过主要完成日期，结果尚待披露。

en.why: PARP1/2 repair DNA single-strand breaks. Inhibitors trap PARP on DNA, which kills tumours that lack BRCA1/2 or are otherwise homologous-recombination deficient (HRD). This is synthetic lethality. Olaparib and others have long been approved, and ovarian, breast and prostate cancer are where the mechanism is best validated.
learned: Among programs tracked here, the field is mature and concentrated. Twelve of 21 programs are in phase 3, nearly all are small molecules, and olaparib, niraparib, talazoparib and rucaparib dominate. Most target ovarian, breast and prostate cancer.
Ovarian cancer has the firmest randomized evidence. DUO-O (NCT03737643) met its PFS primary endpoint. L-MOCA (NCT03534453) was descriptive, so it counts as neither a success nor a failure.

All four recorded failures were stopped for business reasons: olaparib plus pembrolizumab in TNBC (NCT04191135) and niraparib plus enfortumab vedotin in urothelial cancer (NCT03869190). This says nothing against the mechanism, but it leaves the value of these combinations untested.

Outside HRD-rich tumours, the evidence mostly comes from single-arm studies with no formal hypothesis test. Examples are the solid-tumour basket NCT03742895 and the mCRPC combination NCT03568656. Tumour-agnostic use and new combinations still lack controlled data.
opps: Next-generation molecules offer a way to differentiate. They include the PARP1-selective, brain-penetrant AZD9574 and early programs from Acerand, Nerviano and Merck KGaA. A hypothesis to test: if they cause less blood toxicity, they may allow combinations pan-PARP drugs could not tolerate, or work in brain metastases.

Trials in new indications are about to report. Fuzuloparib in mCRPC (NCT04691804) and talazoparib (NCT05059522) reach primary completion by end-2026, and olaparib in lung cancer (NCT04380636) in 2027. Selecting patients by HRR mutation or HRD score may decide the outcome.

Combinations with ADCs and immunotherapy that stopped for business reasons could be redesigned in HRD-selected patients. Separately, NCT04884360 and NCT06433219 are past their primary completion dates, and their results have not yet been reported.

zh.why: PCSK9与肝细胞LDL受体结合，把受体引向溶酶体降解，从而升高血浆LDL-C。功能获得突变导致家族性高胆固醇血症，功能缺失变异则伴随终身LDL-C偏低和冠心病风险下降，人类遗传学验证充分。evolocumab、alirocumab等抗体已获批多年，目前的竞争主要在给药模式和给药频率上。
learned: 口服多肽MK-0616（NCT05952856）、融合蛋白lerodalcibep（NCT04797104）及tafolecimab单药III期均达到LDL-C主要终点，降脂疗效本身已难形成差异。
evolocumab大型结局试验VESALIUS-CV（NCT03872401）达到冠心病死亡、心梗或缺血性卒中复合终点，进一步支持PCSK9通路降LDL-C可转化为事件获益。
已追踪项目中唯一的提前终止NCT06700720为小样本斑块影像II期，系申办方要求终止（商业原因），未见因疗效或安全性中止，机制本身未受质疑。
管线重心转向给药便利：15个项目中siRNA占6个，口服MK-0616、AZD0780及Salubris小分子已进入II-III期，Qilu、Akeso、Dinovate等中国企业布局密集。
opps: 口服药物能否在依从性和长期事件上兑现优势仍待验证，AZD0780的HeFH（NCT07000136）与心血管病（NCT07000123）III期及MK-0616的NCT07216482将提供下一批数据。
急性期和斑块层面证据较少：inclisiran的ACS（NCT07102628）与冠心病（NCT05360446）试验可检验早期强化降脂的价值，斑块影像终点因NCT06700720终止仍属空白。
已追踪项目集中于高胆固醇血症和ASCVD，纯合子FH、儿童及他汀不耐受人群未作为单独适应症出现；更长给药间隔或与Lp(a)等靶点联用可能是差异化方向。

en.why: PCSK9 binds the hepatic LDL receptor and sends it for lysosomal degradation, which raises plasma LDL-C. Gain-of-function mutations cause familial hypercholesterolemia. Loss-of-function variants bring lifelong low LDL-C and lower coronary risk, so the human genetic validation is strong. The antibodies evolocumab and alirocumab have been approved for years. Competition now turns on modality and dosing frequency.
learned: LDL-C lowering holds up across modalities. The oral peptide MK-0616 (NCT05952856), the fusion protein lerodalcibep in HeFH (NCT04797104) and tafolecimab as monotherapy (per Innovent) all met their primary endpoints. Lipid efficacy alone no longer sets programs apart.

Evolocumab's large outcomes trial VESALIUS-CV (NCT03872401) met its composite of CHD death, MI or ischemic stroke. This adds support that lowering LDL-C through PCSK9 leads to fewer cardiovascular events.

The only early stop tracked here, NCT06700720, was a small phase 2 plaque-imaging study ended at the sponsor's request (business reasons). No program here stopped for efficacy or safety, so attrition reflects strategy, not the mechanism.

The pipeline is moving toward easier dosing. siRNA accounts for 6 of 15 programs, and oral agents (MK-0616, AZD0780, a Salubris small molecule) are in phase 2-3. Many Chinese sponsors, including Qilu, Akeso and Dinovate, are active.
opps: It is still unproven that oral agents improve adherence and long-term event outcomes. AZD0780's phase 3 trials in HeFH (NCT07000136) and cardiovascular disease (NCT07000123), plus MK-0616's NCT07216482, should supply the next data.

There is little evidence in the acute setting or at the plaque level. Inclisiran trials in ACS (NCT07102628) and coronary artery disease (NCT05360446) can test early intensive lowering. With NCT06700720 stopped, plaque-imaging endpoints remain an open question.

Tracked programs cluster in hypercholesterolemia and ASCVD. Homozygous FH, pediatric and statin-intolerant patients do not appear as separate indications here. Longer dosing intervals or combinations with targets such as Lp(a) are possible ways to stand out in a crowded field.

zh.why: PD-1与肿瘤及髓系细胞上的PD-L1结合后抑制活化T细胞，肿瘤借此实现免疫逃逸。阻断该轴可恢复抗肿瘤免疫，pembrolizumab、nivolumab等早已成为多癌种标准治疗。本站追踪231个项目、170家公司，是最拥挤的检查点靶点。
learned: 围手术期并非普遍获益：TNBC新辅助（NCT03036488）和肌层浸润性膀胱癌辅助（NCT04660344）达到终点，atezolizumab联合白蛋白紫杉醇新辅助治疗NSCLC的EFS未达到（NCT03456063）。
疗效标杆正由患者筛选和双抗抬高：dMMR子宫内膜癌一线pembrolizumab单药PFS优于化疗（KEYNOTE-C93），胆道癌一线ivonescimab联合化疗OS优于durvalumab联合化疗（HARMONi-GI1）。
终止多出于商业原因：42项终止中24项为商业、10项为疗效，包括acasunlimab（NCT05117242）、botensilimab+balstilimab（NCT05529316）、小分子INCB099280（NCT05888844），反映赛道拥挤而非机制失败。
骨架之上增量有限：lenvatinib联合pembrolizumab治疗HCC仅部分达到主要终点（NCT04246177），皮下nivolumab以药代动力学为终点（NCT04810078），生命周期竞争转向剂型与便利性。
opps: 本站追踪约30个双抗，VEGF以外的第二靶点能否超越PD-1单抗尚无定论；volrustomig（PD-1/CTLA-4）NSCLC III期（NCT05984277）与tobemstomig肾癌研究（NCT05805501）将给出近期答案。
患者筛选仍是空白：dMMR已预测单药获益，但结直肠癌（22个项目）在本站尚无正式疗效检验，NCT04952753与NCT05589597均提前终止；区分单药与双抗/联合获益人群的标志物值得探索。
肿瘤外领域几乎空白：本站仅追踪2项免疫/炎症试验。以PD-1激动抑制自身反应性T细胞，以及口服小分子（20个项目）用于便捷给药或联合方案，均是尚少验证的假设。

en.why: PD-1 on activated T cells binds PD-L1 on tumor and myeloid cells to dampen T-cell activity, which tumors exploit to escape immune attack. Blocking the axis restores anti-tumor immunity; pembrolizumab, nivolumab and others are long-established standards across many cancers. With 231 programs from 170 companies tracked here, it is the most crowded checkpoint target.
learned: Perioperative benefit is not universal: neoadjuvant pembrolizumab in TNBC (NCT03036488) and adjuvant atezolizumab in muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NCT04660344) met their endpoints, while neoadjuvant atezolizumab plus nab-paclitaxel in NSCLC missed EFS (NCT03456063).

Selection and bispecifics are raising the bar: pembrolizumab monotherapy beat chemotherapy on PFS in first-line dMMR endometrial cancer (KEYNOTE-C93), and ivonescimab plus chemotherapy improved OS over durvalumab plus chemotherapy in first-line biliary cancer (HARMONi-GI1).

Most attrition is commercial: of 42 coded stops, 24 were business-driven and 10 efficacy-driven, including acasunlimab (NCT05117242), botensilimab plus balstilimab (NCT05529316) and small-molecule INCB099280 (NCT05888844). This reflects crowding, not evidence against the mechanism.

Gains on top of the backbone are incremental: lenvatinib plus pembrolizumab in HCC only partly met its primary endpoints (NCT04246177), and subcutaneous nivolumab was assessed on pharmacokinetics (NCT04810078), showing lifecycle competition shifting to formulation and convenience.
opps: About 30 bispecifics are tracked here; whether a second arm beyond VEGF beats a PD-1 antibody is unsettled. The volrustomig (PD-1/CTLA-4) phase 3 in NSCLC (NCT05984277) and tobemstomig in renal cancer (NCT05805501) are near-term tests.

Patient selection remains open: dMMR status predicted a monotherapy win, but colorectal cancer (22 programs) has no formal efficacy test here, with NCT04952753 and NCT05589597 stopped early. Biomarkers separating monotherapy responders from those needing a bispecific or combination are a gap.

Outside oncology the field is nearly empty, with only 2 immune/inflammation trials tracked. PD-1 agonism to restrain autoreactive T cells, and oral small molecules (20 programs) for convenience or combination dosing, remain little-tested hypotheses among programs tracked here.

zh.why: PDE10A富集于纹状体中型多棘神经元，水解cAMP和cGMP，调控直接与间接通路平衡。抑制它可不经D2阻断调节多巴胺相关信号，支撑精神分裂症和运动障碍的开发；PDE10A突变可导致儿童期起病的运动亢进障碍，提供了人类遗传学依据。
learned: 记录仍薄：CPL500036两项II期（异动症NCT05297201、精神分裂症NCT05278156）均无统计检验，不判成败；未来6个月无到期试验，Gemlapodect尚无读出。
opps: 在此追踪的项目中，只有Gemlapodect布局抽动症；结合PDE10A突变导致运动亢进的遗传学，运动障碍可能比精神病更契合机制，其读出将检验这一假设。
在此追踪的项目中，亨廷顿病舞蹈症等其他运动亢进适应症尚无布局；纹状体PDE10A表达随亨廷顿病和帕金森病进展而下降，按病程早期分层入组可能是关键。
可借助PDE10A PET配体，按靶点占有率确定剂量；NCT05297201与NCT05278156的完整数据或可显示，异动症与阳性症状哪个方向更值得推进确证性研究。

en.why: PDE10A is concentrated in striatal medium spiny neurons, where it breaks down cAMP and cGMP and sets the balance between the direct and indirect pathways. Inhibiting it modulates dopamine-linked signaling without blocking D2 receptors, which is the case for schizophrenia and movement disorders. PDE10A mutations cause childhood-onset hyperkinetic movement disorders, which gives human genetic support.
learned: The record is still thin. Both CPL500036 phase 2 readouts (dyskinesia NCT05297201, schizophrenia NCT05278156) have no formal hypothesis test, so neither counts as a hit or a miss. No tracked trials finish in the next six months, and Gemlapodect has no readout yet.
opps: Among programs tracked here, only Gemlapodect targets Tourette syndrome. Because PDE10A mutations cause hyperkinetic disorders, movement disorders may fit the mechanism better than psychosis. A Gemlapodect readout would test this.

No programs tracked here address Huntington's chorea or other hyperkinetic indications. Striatal PDE10A expression falls as Huntington's and Parkinson's progress, so enrolling earlier-stage patients may matter.
PDE10A PET ligands could link dose to target occupancy. Full data from NCT05297201 and NCT05278156 may show whether dyskinesia or positive symptoms is the better route to a confirmatory trial.

zh.why: PDE4是免疫和气道细胞中降解cAMP的主要酶，抑制后可下调TNF、IL-17、IL-23等炎症信号，并有抗纤维化作用。roflumilast（COPD）和apremilast（银屑病、白塞病等）已验证该机制，但胃肠道不良反应和体重下降限制了口服剂量，因此出现了亚型选择性、吸入和外用药物的开发。
learned: 此处临床记录仍很有限：唯一读出为roflumilast银屑病试验（NCT05763082），未做正式统计检验，也没有失败记录。首批实质检验将来自nerandomilast的IPF与ILD试验（NCT06241560、NCT06238622、NCT06806592）及ensifentrine COPD试验（NCT07016412）。
opps: 纤维化肺病是此处追踪项目中最主要的新方向。nerandomilast在IPF及更广泛ILD中的III期（NCT06238622、NCT06806592）将检验PDE4B偏好性抑制能否覆盖不同纤维化表型，按进展速度等指标分层仍有探索空间。
限制全身暴露的给药方式可与口服药物形成差异。吸入型PDE3/4双重抑制剂ensifentrine（NCT07016412）能否从COPD拓展到哮喘、支气管扩张等适应证，目前仍无答案。
口服银屑病领域渐趋拥挤：新闻稿称prifemilast在III期头对头研究中优于apremilast，apremilast另有III期待读出（NCT06088199）。新药需在耐受性或头对头上有明确优势，系统性硬化相关ILD、白塞病等领域竞争相对较少。

en.why: PDE4 is the main enzyme that breaks down cAMP in immune and airway cells. Blocking it dampens TNF, IL-17, IL-23 and other inflammatory signals, and it also has anti-fibrotic effects. Roflumilast (COPD) and apremilast (psoriasis, Behçet's and others) validated the mechanism, but nausea, diarrhoea and weight loss cap oral dosing. That limit drives work on subtype-selective, inhaled and topical agents.
learned: The record here is thin. The only tracked readout, roflumilast in psoriasis (NCT05763082), had no formal statistical test, and no failures are logged. The first real tests will be nerandomilast in IPF and ILD (NCT06241560, NCT06238622, NCT06806592) and ensifentrine in COPD (NCT07016412).
opps: Fibrotic lung disease is the main new direction among programs tracked here. The nerandomilast phase 3 trials in IPF and broader ILD (NCT06238622, NCT06806592) should show whether PDE4B-preferential inhibition works across fibrotic phenotypes. Selecting patients by markers such as progression rate is still open.

Routes that limit systemic exposure offer a way to stand apart from oral drugs. Whether inhaled dual PDE3/4 inhibitor ensifentrine (NCT07016412) can extend beyond COPD into asthma or bronchiectasis is still unanswered.

Oral psoriasis is getting crowded. A press release reports prifemilast beat apremilast head-to-head in phase 3, and apremilast has another phase 3 pending (NCT06088199). New entrants likely need a clear tolerability or head-to-head edge. Systemic sclerosis-related ILD and Behçet's look less contested.

zh.why: PDGFRα是受体酪氨酸激酶，驱动间质细胞、平滑肌细胞和成纤维细胞的增殖与迁移。PDGFRA激活突变是部分GIST的致癌驱动因素。在PAH中，PDGF信号推动肺血管平滑肌增殖和血管重构。imatinib的PAH研究提示该通路可干预，但全身用药耐受性欠佳。
learned: 本站追踪的PDGFR临床记录仍然很少：仅有两个3期小分子项目（GB002和Ripretinib），尚无已收录的读出或失败案例。第一个实质性检验是GB002在PAH中的3期研究NCT06274801，预计2026年12月达到主要完成日期。
opps: NCT06274801将回答一个关键问题：PDGFR靶向小分子能否在PAH中兼顾疗效与耐受性。递送方式或激酶选择性可能决定它能否避开全身性TKI的安全性短板。
在本站追踪的项目中，没有针对纤维化疾病（如IPF、系统性硬化症）的PDGFR项目，而成纤维细胞活化高度依赖PDGF信号，这一方向值得作为假设验证。
目前追踪到的项目全部是小分子。在GIST中按PDGFRA突变亚型（如D842V）入组，或尝试抗体、降解剂等其他模态，仍是空白。

en.why: PDGFRα is a receptor tyrosine kinase that drives proliferation and migration of mesenchymal, smooth-muscle and fibroblast cells. Activating PDGFRA mutations drive a subset of GIST. In PAH, PDGF signalling drives pulmonary vascular smooth-muscle proliferation and remodelling. Imatinib studies in PAH suggested the pathway is druggable, but systemic dosing was poorly tolerated.
learned: The PDGFR clinical record tracked here is still thin. There are only two Phase 3 small-molecule programs (GB002 and Ripretinib) and no logged readouts or failures. The first real test is GB002's Phase 3 PAH trial NCT06274801, with primary completion expected in December 2026.
opps: NCT06274801 will answer a key question: can a PDGFR-targeted small molecule deliver efficacy in PAH with acceptable tolerability? Delivery route or kinase selectivity may decide whether it avoids the safety limits of systemic TKIs.
No program tracked here addresses fibrotic disease (e.g. IPF, systemic sclerosis), even though fibroblast activation depends heavily on PDGF signalling. This is a hypothesis worth testing.
Every program tracked here is a small molecule. Enrolling GIST patients by PDGFRA mutation subtype (e.g. D842V), or trying other modalities such as antibodies or degraders, remains open.

zh.why: PIK3CA编码PI3K催化亚基p110α，其热点突变是实体瘤中最常见的致癌突变之一，在HR+乳腺癌中尤为高发；体细胞嵌合突变还会导致PROS和淋巴管畸形。alpelisib联合氟维司群获批用于PIK3CA突变乳腺癌，验证了该靶点。但抑制野生型p110α带来的高血糖一直限制治疗窗。
learned: 目前临床记录仍偏少：本站追踪的读出中，NCT03439046无统计检验，NCT04729387（alpelisib联合olaparib，卵巢癌）未达到主要终点，NCT04251533因入组缓慢终止，后者不能作为否定机制的证据。首批真正的检验将是NCT05038735、NCT04208178和NCT05894239。
opps: 在本站追踪的项目中，RLY-2608、zovegalisib、LY4064809、STX-478等新一代分子已推进至Phase 3或早期阶段，可检验对突变型p110α的选择性能否减轻高血糖，从而提高剂量强度和联合用药空间。
ETX-636是本站追踪项目中唯一的降解剂；PROS、淋巴管畸形和NSCLC各仅有1-2个项目。降解剂模式以及乳腺癌以外的适应症仍属较少探索的方向。
NCT04208178在HER2+晚期乳腺癌中测试alpelisib，将提示PI3Kα抑制在HER2驱动背景下是否有价值；NCT05894239将补充inavolisib在乳腺癌中的证据。

en.why: PIK3CA encodes p110α, the catalytic subunit of PI3Kα. Its hotspot mutations are among the most common oncogenic mutations in solid tumours, especially HR+ breast cancer, and somatic mosaic mutations cause PROS and lymphatic malformations. Alpelisib plus fulvestrant is approved for PIK3CA-mutant breast cancer, which validates the target. Hyperglycaemia from inhibiting wild-type p110α has limited the therapeutic window.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Among readouts tracked here, NCT03439046 had no formal test, NCT04729387 (alpelisib plus olaparib, ovarian cancer) missed its primary endpoint, and NCT04251533 stopped for slow enrollment, which says nothing against the mechanism. NCT05038735, NCT04208178 and NCT05894239 will be the first real tests.
opps: Newer molecules tracked here, including RLY-2608, zovegalisib, LY4064809 and STX-478, have reached Phase 3 or earlier stages. They can test whether selectivity for mutant p110α reduces hyperglycaemia and allows higher dose intensity and more room for combinations.

ETX-636 is the only degrader among programs tracked here, and PROS, lymphatic malformations and NSCLC each have only one or two programs. Degraders and indications outside breast cancer remain little explored.

NCT04208178 tests alpelisib in advanced HER2+ breast cancer and should show whether PI3Kα inhibition adds value when HER2 drives the tumour. NCT05894239 will add to the evidence for inavolisib in breast cancer.

zh.why: I类PI3K各亚型将PIP2转化为PIP3，激活AKT–mTOR通路，调控细胞生长、存活与代谢。PIK3CA突变和PTEN缺失在子宫内膜癌、前列腺癌中常见，PTEN缺失肿瘤常依赖PI3Kβ。血小板PI3Kβ参与高剪切力下的血栓形成，因此该靶点也延伸到卒中领域。
learned: 临床证据仍很薄弱：本站跟踪的8个项目均处于1–2期，尚无读出或失败记录，未来六个月也没有试验到达主要完成时间，近期缺少检验机制的数据节点。
opps: 本站跟踪的项目集中在子宫内膜癌（3个）和mCRPC（2个），两者PTEN缺失比例都较高。按PTEN或PIK3CA状态入组，可检验亚型选择性是否能转化为疗效差异。
非肿瘤方向仅TBO-309一个项目（缺血性卒中/串联闭塞）。PI3Kβ抗血小板能否在不增加出血风险的前提下改善再通，仍是未回答的问题。
跟踪项目均为小分子。泛PI3K抑制常受胰岛素反馈性高血糖限制，亚型/突变选择性、给药方案或降解剂等新模式可能是区分方向。

en.why: Class I PI3K isoforms convert PIP2 to PIP3 and activate AKT–mTOR signaling, which controls cell growth, survival and metabolism. PIK3CA mutations and PTEN loss are common in endometrial and prostate cancer, and PTEN-null tumors often rely on PI3Kβ. Platelet PI3Kβ also drives thrombus formation under high shear, which extends the target to stroke.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. All 8 programs tracked here are in Phase 1–2, none has a readout or failure on record, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term data point will test the mechanism.
opps: Among programs tracked here, most target endometrial cancer (3) and mCRPC (2), two tumor types where PTEN loss is common. Enrolling by PTEN or PIK3CA status could test whether isoform selectivity leads to different efficacy.

TBO-309 (ischemic stroke and tandem occlusion) is the only non-oncology program tracked here. An open question is whether PI3Kβ antiplatelet activity can improve reperfusion without adding bleeding risk.

Every tracked program with a known modality is a small molecule. Pan-PI3K inhibition is often limited by insulin-feedback hyperglycemia, so isoform- or mutant-selective agents, new dosing schedules, or degraders are possible ways to differentiate.

zh.why: PIM1/2/3是一组持续活化的丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶，由JAK/STAT信号转录诱导，通过磷酸化BAD、稳定MYC、支持mTORC1信号促进细胞存活和增殖。PIM在多种血液肿瘤中高表达，在骨髓纤维化中与纤维化进展及JAK抑制剂耐药有关，因此被视为JAK通路下游的补充靶点。
learned: 目前临床证据仍很有限：本站追踪的只有Sumitomo的小分子nusivertib一个项目，处于骨髓纤维化1/2期，没有已公布的读出，也没有失败记录，未来六个月内也没有预计完成主要终点的试验，短期内暂无可验证该机制的数据节点。
opps: PIM受JAK/STAT诱导，可提出这样的假设：PIM抑制与JAK抑制剂联用，或用于JAK抑制剂应答不佳的骨髓纤维化患者，可能比单药更有机会显示疗效，可以把这一点作为首要验证问题。
在本站追踪的项目中，适应症只覆盖骨髓纤维化，形式也只有小分子；多发性骨髓瘤、AML、淋巴瘤等PIM高表达的血液肿瘤，以及降解剂等其他形式，目前都还是空白。
以PIM1表达水平、JAK通路突变状态或骨髓纤维化分级作为入组或分层标志物，或许能更早判断哪些患者最可能获益。

en.why: PIM1/2/3 are constitutively active serine/threonine kinases induced by JAK/STAT signaling. They promote cell survival and growth by phosphorylating BAD, stabilizing MYC and supporting mTORC1 signaling. PIM is overexpressed in many blood cancers. In myelofibrosis it is linked to fibrosis and to resistance to JAK inhibitors, which makes it a candidate target downstream of JAK.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Among programs tracked here there is only one: Sumitomo's small molecule nusivertib, in a Phase 1/2 myelofibrosis trial. It has no reported readouts and no failures, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term data point will test the mechanism.
opps: Because JAK/STAT induces PIM, one hypothesis is that PIM inhibition works better added to a JAK inhibitor, or in myelofibrosis patients who respond poorly to JAK inhibitors, than it does alone. This is the first question worth testing.

Among programs tracked here, the only indication is myelofibrosis and the only modality is small molecules. Other blood cancers with high PIM expression (myeloma, AML, lymphoma) and other modalities such as degraders are open.
Using PIM1 expression, JAK-pathway mutation status or fibrosis grade to select or stratify patients might show earlier which patients are most likely to benefit.

zh.why: PKC是一组丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶。PKCβ位于B细胞受体（BCR）信号中BTK和PLCγ2的下游，可激活NF-κB，维持CLL细胞存活；PKCθ则介导T细胞受体信号。在BCR信号通路之下抑制PKC，有望覆盖上游靶点耐药的肿瘤。
learned: 临床记录仍很有限：本站仅追踪到1个项目，即MingSight的小分子MS-553，处于1/2期，适应症为CLL/SLL，目前尚无读出、失败记录，未来6个月内也没有预计达到主要完成日期的试验，暂时无法检验该机制。
opps: PKCβ位于BTK和PLCγ2下游，可检验MS-553等PKC抑制剂在携带BTK或PLCG2耐药突变的CLL中能否维持活性，并据此进行患者筛选。
在本站追踪的项目中，PKC靶点仅有1个小分子、1家公司，与BCL2抑制剂（如venetoclax）的联合用药，以及其他依赖BCR信号的B细胞淋巴瘤，均尚无项目覆盖。
PKCθ在T细胞活化中起作用，但本站未追踪到针对自身免疫或炎症疾病的项目。可评估亚型选择性抑制剂在这类疾病中的潜力。

en.why: PKC is a family of serine/threonine kinases. PKCβ sits downstream of BTK and PLCγ2 in B-cell receptor (BCR) signaling and drives the NF-κB activation that keeps CLL cells alive. PKCθ carries T-cell receptor signals. Blocking PKC below the BCR could reach tumors that resist drugs aimed at targets higher up the pathway.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site tracks one program: MingSight's small molecule MS-553, in Phase 1/2 for CLL/SLL. It has no readouts or failures, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so the mechanism has not yet been tested.
opps: PKCβ acts downstream of BTK and PLCγ2. That makes it worth testing whether PKC inhibitors such as MS-553 still work in CLL with BTK or PLCG2 resistance mutations, and using those mutations to select patients.

Among programs tracked here, PKC has one small molecule from one company. No tracked program covers combinations with BCL2 inhibitors such as venetoclax, or other B-cell lymphomas that depend on BCR signaling.
PKCθ has a role in T-cell activation, yet no tracked program targets autoimmune or inflammatory disease. Isoform-selective inhibitors could be evaluated in these diseases.

zh.why: PKMYT1磷酸化CDK1 Thr14位点使其失活，阻止细胞在DNA复制完成前进入有丝分裂。CCNE1扩增或FBXW7、PPP2R1A缺失的肿瘤高度依赖这一刹车，抑制PKMYT1可迫使细胞提前进入有丝分裂而死亡，该合成致死关系由CRISPR筛选发现。
learned: 临床证据仍很薄弱。本站追踪的仅有两款I期小分子：Lunresertib（Debiopharm，2021年登记）和FXS0260（Shanghai Fosun，2026年11月登记），均面向泛实体瘤。目前没有读出或失败记录，未来六个月也没有到达主要完成日的试验，近期无法从这里得到首次真正检验。
opps: 两项在追踪的试验均入组泛实体瘤。可前瞻性筛选CCNE1扩增或FBXW7、PPP2R1A改变的肿瘤（如卵巢癌、子宫内膜癌、胃癌），检验合成致死假设能否在临床上成立。
PKMYT1抑制与ATR抑制剂或吉西他滨等加剧复制压力的化疗之间可能存在协同。联合用药究竟能拓宽治疗窗，还是叠加骨髓毒性，本站追踪的记录尚未涉及。
在追踪的项目中只有小分子。相对WEE1及其他激酶的选择性，或降解剂等新模态，可能是后来者的差异化方向。

en.why: PKMYT1 phosphorylates CDK1 on Thr14, which keeps it inactive and stops cells from entering mitosis before DNA replication is finished. Tumors with CCNE1 amplification, or with loss of FBXW7 or PPP2R1A, rely heavily on this brake. Blocking PKMYT1 forces them into mitosis too early, and they die. CRISPR screens identified this synthetic-lethal relationship.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Only two phase 1 small molecules are tracked here, both in broad solid-tumor populations: Lunresertib (Debiopharm, registered 2021) and FXS0260 (Shanghai Fosun, registered November 2026). No readouts or failures are tracked, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months.
opps: Both tracked trials enroll broad solid-tumor populations. Selecting CCNE1-amplified or FBXW7/PPP2R1A-altered tumors up front (for example ovarian, endometrial or gastric cancer) would test whether the synthetic-lethal hypothesis holds in patients.
