PKMYT1 inhibition may work synergistically with ATR inhibitors or with chemotherapy that increases replication stress, such as gemcitabine. The records tracked here do not show whether combinations widen the therapeutic window or simply add bone-marrow toxicity.
Only small molecules are tracked. Better selectivity over WEE1 and other kinases, or a different modality such as a degrader, could set a later entrant apart.

zh.why: PLK1是调控有丝分裂进入、中心体成熟、纺锤体组装和胞质分裂的丝氨酸/苏氨酸激酶，在多种实体瘤中高表达。临床前研究提示KRAS突变细胞对PLK1抑制存在合成致死依赖，这为在以KRAS突变为主的胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）中开发PLK1抑制剂提供了依据。
learned: 临床证据仍很少：本站仅追踪到一项读出，即Cardiff Oncology的onvansertib联合纳米脂质体伊立替康二线PDAC研究（NCT04752696），以ORR为主要终点、无正式统计检验，因申办方认为入组和数据已足够而提前结束，归为运营原因，不能说明机制有效或无效。未来6个月内没有登记的读出可作为下一次检验。
opps: 本站追踪的PLK1项目只有一个，适应症仅限PDAC。其他KRAS驱动肿瘤（如结直肠癌、非小细胞肺癌）在追踪范围内尚无项目，可检验合成致死假设是否适用于胰腺以外的肿瘤。
NCT04752696的终止说明提到将支持后续PDAC试验。前移到更早治疗线、更换化疗骨架，并按KRAS突变亚型或ctDNA动态变化筛选患者，是有待检验的方向。
本站追踪到的仅为小分子ATP竞争型抑制剂，靶向polo-box结构域的分子或降解剂尚未见于追踪范围，可能有助于改善选择性和治疗窗。

en.why: PLK1 is a serine/threonine kinase that controls mitotic entry, centrosome maturation, spindle assembly and cytokinesis, and it is overexpressed in many solid tumors. Preclinical work suggests KRAS-mutant cells are synthetically dependent on PLK1, which is the reason to test PLK1 inhibitors in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), a cancer dominated by KRAS mutations.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Only one readout is tracked here: Cardiff Oncology's onvansertib plus nanoliposomal irinotecan in PDAC (NCT04752696). Its primary endpoint was ORR with no formal test. The sponsor ended it once enrollment and data were judged sufficient (coded operational), so it says nothing for or against the mechanism. No readouts are scheduled in the next six months.
opps: Only one PLK1 program is tracked here, and only in PDAC. Among programs tracked here, other KRAS-driven tumors such as colorectal or non-small cell lung cancer have none, which leaves open whether the synthetic-lethality idea holds outside the pancreas.

The stop note for NCT04752696 says the data will support future PDAC trials. Testing earlier lines of therapy, other chemotherapy backbones, and patient selection by KRAS variant or ctDNA dynamics are open hypotheses.
Only ATP-competitive small molecules are tracked here. Polo-box-domain binders or degraders could improve selectivity and widen the therapeutic window, and none appears among tracked programs.

zh.why: PNPLA3编码定位于肝细胞脂滴的蛋白，其常见I148M变异是脂肪肝、MASH、肝纤维化及肝癌最强的遗传风险因素。突变蛋白在脂滴上蓄积并阻碍脂肪动员，因此在携带者中降低肝脏PNPLA3表达，是有遗传学依据的MASH治疗思路。
learned: 临床证据仍很有限。本站追踪的唯一读出是AstraZeneca的AZD2693二期FORTUNA研究（NCT05809934），52周NASH消退且纤维化不恶化的主要终点未达到。未来6个月没有PNPLA3试验到达主要完成节点。
opps: FORTUNA（NCT05809934）未达到终点，是机制问题还是终点问题尚不清楚。按I148M纯合或杂合、肝脏脂肪及纤维化标志物分层分析，可检验获益是否集中于特定遗传人群。
本站追踪范围内仅有AZD2693一个PNPLA3项目，只有一家公司参与。siRNA，或选择性清除脂滴上148M蛋白的小分子等其他路径，仍有待验证。
52周组织学终点对进展缓慢的遗传驱动型纤维化可能过短或不够敏感。延长疗程，或与全身性代谢治疗联用，都是尚未检验的假设。

en.why: PNPLA3 encodes a protein that sits on lipid droplets in liver cells. Its common I148M variant is the strongest inherited risk factor for fatty liver disease, MASH, fibrosis and liver cancer. The mutant protein builds up on lipid droplets and blocks fat mobilisation, so lowering liver PNPLA3 in carriers is a genetically grounded way to treat MASH.
learned: The clinical record is thin. Among programs tracked here, the only readout is AstraZeneca's phase 2 FORTUNA trial of AZD2693 (NCT05809934). It missed its 52-week primary endpoint of NASH resolution without fibrosis worsening. No PNPLA3 trials reach primary completion in the next six months.
opps: It is unclear whether the FORTUNA miss (NCT05809934) reflects the mechanism or the endpoint. Analyses split by I148M dose (two copies vs one), liver-fat change and fibrosis markers could test whether benefit is limited to a narrower genetic group.

Among programs tracked here, AZD2693 is the only PNPLA3 program, and only one company is involved. Other approaches, such as siRNA or small molecules that selectively clear the 148M protein from lipid droplets, remain untested.

A 52-week histology endpoint may be too short or too insensitive for a genetic driver of slowly progressing fibrosis. Longer treatment, or pairing PNPLA3 lowering with systemic metabolic therapies, are hypotheses no one has tested yet.

zh.why: POLQ编码的Polθ是微同源介导末端连接（MMEJ/TMEJ）的核心酶，正常组织中表达低，在BRCA1/2缺失等同源重组缺陷（HRD）肿瘤中上调，成为备用修复通路。抑制Polθ与HRD构成合成致死，也被认为可能克服PARP抑制剂耐药。
learned: 临床证据仍很薄：本站仅追踪到Danatlas一个未命名小分子处于1期（晚期实体瘤），尚无读出，未来6个月内也没有到达主要完成节点的试验，近期缺少验证机制的数据。
opps: 患者选择是首要问题：以BRCA1/2突变、HRD评分或PARP抑制剂耐药人群做富集，可检验合成致死假设能否转化为临床获益。
Polθ有解旋酶和聚合酶两个结构域，本站追踪的项目只有一个小分子；按结构域区分抑制剂，或尝试降解剂等其他模态，可能带来差异化。
联合策略尚未覆盖：与PARP抑制剂、放疗或其他DNA损伤药物联用，有望加深HRD肿瘤中的合成致死，值得在早期试验中设计验证。

en.why: POLQ encodes Polθ, the key enzyme of microhomology-mediated (theta-mediated) end joining. It is barely expressed in normal tissue but upregulated in homologous recombination-deficient tumors, such as BRCA1/2-mutant cancers, which depend on it as a backup repair route. Blocking Polθ is synthetic lethal with HR deficiency and is proposed as a way to overcome PARP inhibitor resistance.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Among programs tracked here there is one unnamed Danatlas small molecule in phase 1 for advanced solid tumors, with no readouts and no trials reaching primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term test of the mechanism is in view.
opps: Patient selection is the first open question: enriching for BRCA1/2 mutations, HRD scores or PARP inhibitor-resistant disease would test whether the synthetic-lethal rationale holds up in patients.
Polθ has both a helicase and a polymerase domain, and only one small molecule is tracked here. Inhibitors aimed at a specific domain, or other modalities such as degraders, could set a program apart.

No combination strategy is tracked yet. Pairing Polθ inhibition with PARP inhibitors, radiotherapy or other DNA-damaging agents may deepen synthetic lethality in HR-deficient tumors and is worth building into early trials.

zh.why: PRMT5催化精氨酸对称二甲基化，调控RNA剪接。约10–15%肿瘤存在MTAP与CDKN2A共缺失，MTA蓄积使PRMT5部分受抑，形成合成致死窗口；MTA协同型抑制剂选择性作用于MTAP缺失细胞，有望避开第一代抑制剂的血液学毒性。
learned: 临床记录仍很有限：本站尚无PRMT5读出或失败记录。17个项目多为1–1/2期小分子，BMS-986504与navlimetostat已进入2/3期；未来六个月无追踪试验到达主要完成。
opps: 追踪项目集中于NSCLC、PDAC及MTAP缺失实体瘤泛瘤种。胶质母细胞瘤、间皮瘤、尿路上皮癌等同样常见MTAP缺失，却少有专门入组，可作为脑渗透型或瘤种特异开发的切入点。
12家公司的小分子路线高度同质，差异化可能来自合理联用（如在PDAC、NSCLC中联合KRAS或MAT2A抑制剂），以及统一IHC与测序对MTAP缺失的判定标准。
有2个追踪项目涉及非霍奇金淋巴瘤，血液肿瘤中能否按MTAP状态或剪接因子突变界定获益人群尚未验证；BMS的2/3期项目将是实体瘤中首个后期检验。

en.why: PRMT5 symmetrically dimethylates arginine residues and supports RNA splicing. About 10–15% of cancers lose MTAP alongside CDKN2A; the resulting MTA buildup partly inhibits PRMT5, creating a synthetic-lethal window. MTA-cooperative inhibitors exploit this to hit MTAP-deleted cells selectively, aiming to avoid the blood toxicity that limited first-generation PRMT5 inhibitors.
learned: The clinical record is still thin: no scored readouts or failures among programs tracked here. Of 17 programs from 12 companies, most are phase 1–1/2 small molecules; BMS-986504 and navlimetostat are in phase 2/3. No tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months.
opps: Tracked programs focus on NSCLC, PDAC and MTAP-deleted solid tumors broadly. Other cancers where MTAP deletion is common, such as glioblastoma, mesothelioma and urothelial cancer, rarely appear as dedicated indications, a possible niche for brain-penetrant or tumor-specific development.

With 12 companies pursuing largely similar small molecules, differentiation may come from rational combinations (for example with KRAS or MAT2A inhibitors in PDAC and NSCLC) and from defining MTAP loss consistently across IHC and sequencing assays.

Two tracked programs list non-Hodgkin lymphoma; whether a responder group can be defined in blood cancers, by MTAP status or splicing-factor mutations, is untested here. The BMS phase 2/3 programs will be the first late-stage test in solid tumors.

zh.why: PSMA（FOLH1）是一种II型跨膜谷氨酸羧肽酶，在前列腺癌细胞表面高表达，并随去势抵抗和高级别病变而上调；配体结合后可内化，适合放射性配体的显像与治疗。177Lu-PSMA-617获批用于mCRPC，已在临床上验证该靶点。
learned: 检验性读出仍少：仅PSMAddition（NCT04720157）达到rPFS主要终点；acapatamab（NCT04631601）因商业原因停止，并非机制失败。下一步看NCT06004661、NCT06235151和NCT07052214。
opps: α核素是主要差异化方向：FPI-2265、225Ac-PSMA-R2、AZD2265处于早期临床。可检验其在177Lu治疗后进展患者中的获益，以及唾液腺和肾毒性的代价。
非放射性配体路线仍处早期：本站追踪3个细胞治疗、2个偶联药物，T细胞衔接器acapatamab因商业原因停止。能否覆盖PSMA低表达或异质性肿瘤尚无答案。
本站追踪试验全部集中于前列腺癌，但PSMA也表达于多种实体瘤的新生血管。以PET筛选的前列腺外适应症，以及PSMAddition之后的寡转移等更早阶段仍待验证。

en.why: PSMA (FOLH1) is a type II transmembrane glutamate carboxypeptidase heavily overexpressed on prostate cancer cells, rising with castration resistance and high grade. It internalises after ligand binding, which suits radioligand imaging and therapy. Approval of 177Lu-PSMA-617 in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer validated the target clinically.
learned: The tested record is thin: among programs tracked here, only PSMAddition (NCT04720157) met its primary rPFS endpoint, and acapatamab (NCT04631601) stopped for business reasons, not as a mechanism failure. NCT06004661, NCT06235151 and NCT07052214 are the next tests.
opps: Alpha emitters are the main differentiation bet: FPI-2265, 225Ac-PSMA-R2 and AZD2265 are in early clinical development. A testable question is whether they benefit patients progressing after 177Lu therapy, and at what cost in salivary and renal toxicity.

Non-radioligand modalities remain early among programs tracked here: three cell therapies and two conjugates, with the T-cell engager acapatamab halted for business reasons. Whether they reach PSMA-low or heterogeneous tumours is still open.

All tracked trials are in prostate cancer, yet PSMA is also expressed on tumour neovasculature in several other solid tumours. PET-selected trials outside prostate, and earlier settings such as oligometastatic disease after PSMAddition, remain untested.

zh.why: PTK7是一种缺乏催化活性的假激酶受体，参与Wnt/平面细胞极性信号，在卵巢癌、三阴性乳腺癌、非小细胞肺癌等实体瘤中高表达，并富集于肿瘤起始细胞，而在多数正常成人组织中表达较低。正因如此，它适合作为ADC等靶向表面抗原疗法的靶点。
learned: 临床证据仍很薄弱：本站追踪的3个项目（Whitehawk的HWK-007、Day One与Kivu各一个未命名药物）均为1期ADC，尚无读出，未来6个月内也没有试验到达主要完成日期，目前无法判断疗效或安全性规律。
opps: 本站追踪的项目集中在卵巢癌、子宫内膜癌及泛实体瘤，三阴性乳腺癌和非小细胞肺癌同样有PTK7高表达报道，但尚无专门针对这两类肿瘤的项目，可作为适应症假设加以验证。
现有项目全部为ADC，双抗、CAR-T或放射性偶联药物尚未出现。PTK7富集于肿瘤起始细胞，可考虑验证这些模态能否覆盖ADC难以清除的细胞亚群。
三个同类1期ADC之间如何拉开差异尚无答案。按PTK7表达水平筛选患者、选择不同载荷与连接子，可能是剂量扩展阶段需要回答的关键问题。

en.why: PTK7 is a catalytically inactive pseudokinase receptor in Wnt/planar cell polarity signalling. It is overexpressed in ovarian cancer, triple-negative breast cancer and non-small cell lung cancer, is enriched on tumour-initiating cells, and has limited expression in most normal adult tissue. That profile makes it a candidate for ADCs and other therapies aimed at surface antigens.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. All three programs tracked here are phase 1 ADCs: Whitehawk's HWK-007 and one unnamed drug each from Day One and Kivu. None has reported a readout, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no efficacy or safety pattern can be drawn yet.
opps: Tracked programs focus on ovarian, endometrial and all-comer solid tumours. PTK7 is also reported to be highly expressed in triple-negative breast cancer and NSCLC, yet no program tracked here is dedicated to either. These are indication hypotheses worth testing.

Every tracked program is an ADC. No bispecific, CAR-T or radioconjugate approaches appear yet. Because PTK7 is enriched on tumour-initiating cells, one hypothesis is that these modalities could reach cell subsets that ADCs clear poorly.

It is still unclear how three similar phase 1 ADCs will differentiate. Selecting patients by PTK7 expression level, and the choice of payload and linker, are likely key questions for dose-expansion cohorts.

zh.why: RAS–MAPK通路中，BRAF/CRAF以二聚体形式传递信号。第一代BRAF V600抑制剂对二聚体无效，还会引起反常激活。pan-RAF抑制剂同时阻断单体和二聚体，主要面向BRAF非V600突变、BRAF融合，以及NRAS/KRAS突变驱动的肿瘤，例如儿童低级别胶质瘤和低级别浆液性卵巢癌。
learned: 本站跟踪的8个项目全部为小分子，其中tovorafenib、avutometinib、naporafenib已进入3期，但目前还没有收录任何读出或失败记录，临床证据仍然很少。avutometinib针对KRAS突变的NCT05669482已过主要完成日期，其结果将是本站收录的第一个实际检验。
opps: 本站跟踪的适应症集中在黑色素瘤、低级别浆液性卵巢癌和低级别胶质瘤。KRAS突变的常见实体瘤覆盖较少，可以研究pan-RAF或RAF/MEK抑制剂与KRAS直接抑制剂联用，能否延缓通路再激活。
目前收录的全部是小分子抑制剂，RAF二聚体降解剂等其他机制尚未出现。考虑到胶质瘤这一适应症，入脑能力和CNS暴露量也可以作为区别于领先项目的方向。
RAF改变类型差异很大，包括非V600 BRAF、融合、NRAS和KRAS。可以检验按改变类型分层入组能否区分获益人群，NCT05669482在KRAS突变人群中的结果可作为第一个参照。

en.why: In RAS–MAPK signaling, BRAF and CRAF signal as dimers. First-generation BRAF V600 inhibitors cannot block dimers and can paradoxically activate the pathway. Pan-RAF inhibitors block both monomers and dimers. They are aimed at tumors driven by non-V600 BRAF mutations, BRAF fusions, or NRAS/KRAS mutations, such as pediatric low-grade glioma and low-grade serous ovarian cancer.
learned: All 8 programs tracked here are small molecules, and tovorafenib, avutometinib and naporafenib have reached phase 3. But no readouts or failures are recorded yet, so the clinical record is still thin. Avutometinib's KRAS-mutant trial NCT05669482 has passed its primary completion date, and its results will be the first real test tracked here.
opps: Among programs tracked here, indications cluster in melanoma, low-grade serous ovarian cancer and low-grade glioma. Common KRAS-mutant solid tumors get less coverage. One hypothesis to test is whether combining pan-RAF or RAF/MEK agents with direct KRAS inhibitors delays pathway reactivation.

Every program tracked here is a small-molecule inhibitor, and no other mechanism, such as RAF-dimer degraders, appears yet. Since glioma is a target indication, brain penetration and CNS exposure are another way to stand apart from the leading programs.

RAF alterations vary widely: non-V600 BRAF, fusions, NRAS and KRAS. Trials could test whether enrolling by alteration class identifies who benefits. NCT05669482 in KRAS-mutant patients will give the first reference point.

zh.why: RAS（KRAS、NRAS、HRAS）突变见于约四分之一的人类肿瘤，胰腺导管腺癌中KRAS突变率超过90%。RAS-ON抑制剂直接结合活化的GTP结合态，可覆盖G12D、G12V、Q61等多种突变，弥补G12C特异性药物覆盖面窄、易因RAS再激活而耐药的不足。
learned: 本站跟踪的项目中尚无读出、无失败记录，未来六个月也没有到达主要完成日期的试验，临床证据仍很薄。daraxonrasib是唯一进入3期的项目，其余多处于1期或1/2期，首个真正的检验暂未排入本站跟踪的时间表。
opps: 本站跟踪的试验集中在PDAC和未经选择的晚期实体瘤，CRC和NSCLC各仅1个项目，黑色素瘤等NRAS驱动肿瘤尚无项目。30项试验均为肿瘤适应症，RAS病等非肿瘤方向也是空白。
9个项目中仅ERAS-0015为降解剂。在可耐受剂量下，降解RAS能否比三元复合物等抑制剂带来更深、更持久的通路抑制，仍是一个可以通过临床前和早期临床对比回答的问题。
泛RAS药物同时作用于正常组织中的野生型RAS，治疗窗是后来者面临的核心问题。按等位基因（G12D、G12V、G12R、Q61）及共突变选择患者、用于G12C抑制剂耐药后，或与上下游通路抑制剂联用，都是与daraxonrasib形成差异的可能路径。

en.why: RAS genes (KRAS, NRAS, HRAS) are mutated in roughly a quarter of human cancers, and KRAS in over 90% of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. RAS-ON inhibitors bind the active, GTP-bound state and cover G12D, G12V, Q61 and other alleles that G12C-selective drugs miss. They may also blunt resistance driven by RAS reactivation.
learned: Among programs tracked here there are no readouts and no failures, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so the clinical record is still thin. Daraxonrasib is the only phase 3 program. Most others are in phase 1 or 1/2, and no first real test is scheduled yet.
opps: Trials tracked here cluster in PDAC and unselected advanced solid tumors. CRC and NSCLC have one program each, and NRAS-driven tumors such as melanoma have none. All 30 trials are in oncology, which leaves non-oncology RASopathies open too.

ERAS-0015 is the only degrader among the nine programs tracked here. Whether degrading RAS gives deeper or longer-lasting pathway suppression than tri-complex or other inhibitors, at a tolerable dose, is still open. Preclinical and early clinical comparisons could answer it.

Pan-RAS agents also hit wild-type RAS in normal tissue, so the therapeutic window is the main question for later entrants. Ways to differ from daraxonrasib include selecting patients by allele (G12D, G12V, G12R, Q61) and co-mutation, treating after G12C-inhibitor resistance, and combining with upstream or downstream blockers.

zh.why: RBP4由肝脏分泌，负责将视黄醇运送到包括视网膜在内的外周组织。抑制RBP4可减少视网膜的视黄醇供应，从而减少A2E等双视黄醛毒性产物的积累，因此被视为Stargardt病和地图样萎缩的潜在靶点。RBP4升高还与胰岛素抵抗相关。
learned: 该靶点的临床记录仍很有限：本站仅追踪到Aspire的1个2期小分子项目，暂无读出、失败记录，未来6个月也没有达到主要完成日期的试验，尚无可检验机制的近期数据节点。
该项目的适应症标注为支气管肺发育不良，治疗领域却归入眼科，两者并不一致。早产儿补充维生素A被认为对支气管肺发育不良有保护作用，降低视黄醇供应的思路与此相反，建议对照注册信息核实真实适应症。
opps: 在本站追踪的项目中，Stargardt病和地图样萎缩尚无明确布局。可以验证的假设是：降低血清RBP4能否在这些患者中稳定减少视网膜双视黄醛积累，并转化为病灶进展减缓。
血清RBP4和视黄醇浓度可作为药效学标志物，用来寻找既能抑制双视黄醛生成、又能尽量减少暗适应延迟等视觉循环相关不良反应的剂量窗口。
胰岛素抵抗等代谢适应症在本站追踪的项目中尚无人布局。需要回答的问题是：RBP4与胰岛素抵抗的关联究竟是因果关系还是伴随现象，可借助人类遗传学数据先行检验。

en.why: RBP4 is the liver-secreted carrier that delivers retinol to peripheral tissues, including the retina. Blocking it limits retinol supply to the eye and reduces the build-up of toxic bisretinoids such as A2E, which makes it a candidate target in Stargardt disease and geographic atrophy. Elevated RBP4 has also been linked to insulin resistance.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site tracks a single Phase 2 small-molecule program from Aspire. It has no readouts and no failures, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term data point will test the mechanism.

The program is listed for bronchopulmonary dysplasia but filed under ophthalmology. Vitamin A supplementation is thought to protect preterm infants against bronchopulmonary dysplasia, so cutting retinol delivery would run against that rationale. The actual indication is worth checking against the registry.
opps: Among programs tracked here, none clearly addresses Stargardt disease or geographic atrophy. A testable hypothesis: does lowering serum RBP4 reliably reduce retinal bisretinoid build-up in these patients, and does that slow lesion growth?
Serum RBP4 and retinol levels could serve as pharmacodynamic markers for finding a dose that suppresses bisretinoid formation while limiting visual-cycle side effects such as delayed dark adaptation.
No tracked program addresses metabolic indications such as insulin resistance. Whether the RBP4 link is causal or only a bystander effect is still open, and human genetic data could test it first.

zh.why: RET是受体酪氨酸激酶，经RAS–MAPK通路驱动细胞增殖。KIF5B-RET等融合见于约1–2%的NSCLC及部分甲状腺乳头状癌，M918T等激活突变驱动髓样甲状腺癌，胚系突变导致MEN2。选择性抑制剂selpercatinib获批，验证了RET作为致癌驱动靶点。
learned: 临床记录仍较薄：本站追踪的4个RET项目均为小分子，尚无读出、失败记录，未来六个月也无到达主要完成日期的试验，短期内没有新的检验节点。Eli Lilly的selpercatinib（3期）进展最快，Hansoh、Ellipses（EP0031）和Taiho处于1/2–2期。
opps: Hansoh、EP0031和Taiho的项目落后于selpercatinib，可检验的假设是：针对一代选择性抑制剂后出现的获得性耐药突变（如溶剂前沿G810突变）保持活性，是最清晰的差异化路径。
本站追踪的项目全部为小分子，适应症集中于NSCLC和甲状腺癌。降解剂、针对MET或KRAS旁路耐药的联合方案，以及肺和甲状腺以外的RET融合实体瘤，在追踪范围内尚属空白。
病种列表中出现婴儿肌纤维瘤病，提示儿童罕见肿瘤也在探索范围内。儿科和泛瘤种场景下系统筛查RET变异能否检出足够患者，仍是未解问题。

en.why: RET is a receptor tyrosine kinase that signals through RAS–MAPK. Fusions such as KIF5B-RET drive about 1–2% of non-small cell lung cancers and some papillary thyroid cancers. Activating mutations such as M918T drive medullary thyroid cancer, and germline mutations cause MEN2. The approval of the selective inhibitor selpercatinib confirmed RET as an oncogenic driver.
learned: The clinical record here is still thin. All four RET programs tracked here are small molecules, and none has a readout or failure on record. No trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term test is scheduled. Eli Lilly's selpercatinib (phase 3) leads; Hansoh, Ellipses (EP0031) and Taiho are in phase 1/2–2.
opps: The Hansoh, EP0031 and Taiho programs trail selpercatinib. One testable hypothesis is that keeping activity against resistance mutations acquired on first-generation selective inhibitors, such as solvent-front G810 changes, is the clearest way to stand apart.

Every program tracked here is a small molecule aimed at lung or thyroid cancer. Degraders, combinations that target MET- or KRAS-driven bypass resistance, and RET-fusion tumors outside the lung and thyroid are all untested among tracked programs.

Infantile myofibromatosis appears among the listed conditions, which points to work in rare pediatric tumors. It remains open whether systematic RET screening in pediatric and tumor-agnostic settings can find enough patients.

zh.why: ROCK1/2是RhoA下游激酶，调控肌动球蛋白收缩与细胞骨架，参与血管收缩、组织纤维化、Th17/Treg失衡及轴突再生抑制。ROCK2选择性抑制剂belumosudil已获批治疗慢性GVHD，ripasudil在日本用于青光眼，说明该靶点可成药且有临床验证。
learned: 临床记录仍很有限：唯一读出为ripasudil白内障术后角膜水肿3期试验，第12周ECD主要终点未达到（NCT05528172）；未来六个月本站未追踪到新读出，其余项目尚待检验。
opps: 肺血管疾病是可检验的方向：本站追踪的PAH与PH-ILD各有一项试验。ROCK同时介导血管收缩与重构，可假设肺部局部给药或亚型选择性有助于避开全身低血压。
神经领域覆盖稀少，本站仅追踪到ALS和Friedreich共济失调试验。结合神经丝轻链等体液标志物，或可尽早确认靶点结合并筛选可能获益的患者。
belumosudil在cGVHD中的免疫-纤维化逻辑或可延伸至肺移植排斥。角膜方向上，NCT05528172未达终点，提示可考虑第12周ECD以外的终点，如角膜厚度或更长随访。

en.why: ROCK1/2 are kinases downstream of RhoA. They drive actomyosin contraction and cytoskeletal remodeling, which feed vasoconstriction, fibrosis, Th17/Treg imbalance and blocked axon regrowth. The ROCK2-selective inhibitor belumosudil is approved for chronic GVHD, and ripasudil is used for glaucoma in Japan. Both show the target can be drugged and has clinical validation.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout tracked here is ripasudil's Phase 3 trial in corneal edema after cataract surgery, which missed its week-12 endothelial cell density (ECD) primary endpoint (NCT05528172). No readouts are tracked for the next six months, so the other programs remain untested.
opps: Pulmonary vascular disease is one place to test the mechanism: one trial each in PAH and PH-ILD is tracked here. ROCK drives both vasoconstriction and vascular remodeling. One hypothesis is that lung-targeted delivery or isoform selectivity could separate benefit from systemic hypotension.

Neurology has few programs: only ALS and Friedreich's ataxia trials are tracked here. Pairing ROCK inhibition with fluid biomarkers such as neurofilament light could confirm target engagement early and help pick out patients likely to respond.

Belumosudil's immune-fibrotic rationale from cGVHD may extend to lung transplant rejection, which is tracked here. In the cornea, the miss in NCT05528172 suggests trying endpoints other than week-12 ECD, such as corneal thickness or longer follow-up.

zh.why: ROR1是Wnt5a的受体，属癌胚抗原：胚胎期高表达，成人正常组织中表达很低，但在CLL、套细胞淋巴瘤及三阴乳腺癌、肺腺癌、卵巢癌等多种实体瘤中重新出现。它能促进肿瘤细胞存活和迁移，表达又相对局限于肿瘤，因此适合ADC、双抗和CAR-T等靶向肿瘤表面抗原的疗法。
learned: 目前临床证据很少。本站追踪的2个项目（CTTQ的ADC TQB2101、NEOK Bio的双抗）均在1期，尚无读出、失败或提前终止，未来6个月也没有到达主要完成日期的试验，首批1期数据才是第一次真正检验。
opps: 本站追踪的项目中，一个针对晚期血液肿瘤，一个针对晚期实体瘤，CAR-T等细胞疗法暂未出现。可以考虑在ROR1表达较高的CLL、套细胞淋巴瘤中验证细胞疗法。
可以检验ROR1的IHC表达水平能否预测ADC或双抗的疗效，在三阴乳腺癌、肺腺癌、卵巢癌等瘤种中按表达分层入组，从而与不加筛选的篮式设计拉开差异。
ADC与双抗作用机制不同，可以对比两者在靶点表达偏低时的活性，以及在ROR1低表达正常组织中的毒性，这是早期数据最值得关注的问题。

en.why: ROR1, a Wnt5a receptor, is an oncofetal antigen: high in embryos, low in most adult tissue, but re-expressed in CLL, mantle cell lymphoma and solid tumours such as triple-negative breast, lung adenocarcinoma and ovarian cancer. It supports tumour-cell survival and migration, and its tumour-restricted expression suits ADCs, bispecifics and CAR-T.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Both programs tracked here, CTTQ's ADC TQB2101 and an unnamed NEOK Bio bispecific, are in phase 1. Neither has readouts, failures or early stops, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months. Their first phase 1 data will be the first real test.
opps: Among programs tracked here, one targets advanced haematologic cancers and one advanced solid tumours, and there is no CAR-T or other cell therapy. Cell therapy could be tested in ROR1-high CLL or mantle cell lymphoma.

A hypothesis to test: does ROR1 expression on IHC predict response to ADCs or bispecifics? Enrolling by expression level in triple-negative breast, lung adenocarcinoma or ovarian cancer could set a program apart from unselected basket designs.
ADCs and bispecifics work differently. Comparing their activity when target expression is low, and their toxicity in normal tissues with low ROR1, is the key question for early data.

zh.why: ROS1融合使激酶持续激活，驱动MAPK、PI3K、STAT3信号，约见于1–2%的NSCLC，也散见于胆管癌、胶质瘤等。crizotinib获批用于ROS1阳性NSCLC，验证了该靶点。临床难点在于溶剂前沿突变（如G2032R）所致耐药和脑转移。
learned: 本站尚未收录任何ROS1读出或失败，临床记录仍偏薄。首批检验将来自entrectinib的两项NSCLC III期试验（NCT04603807，所列主要完成日期已过，结果待更新；NCT05170204）以及repotrectinib的III期试验NCT06140836。
opps: 本站收录的9个项目中7个为小分子，另有多家处于I期的中国企业（Simcere、JOYO、Ascentage、Avistone）。后来者的差异化方向可能在于覆盖G2032R、更强的脑渗透，以及像zidesamtinib那样在设计上避开TRK以减少神经系统不良反应。
适应症集中在NSCLC和泛实体瘤，胆管癌、CNS肿瘤、乳腺癌各仅1个项目。可以假设：在罕见的ROS1融合肿瘤（含儿童胶质瘤）中做基于篮式设计、ctDNA筛选的研究，仍有空间。
本站未见降解剂、ADC等非小分子模式，也未见针对TKI后旁路耐药（如MET、KRAS）的联合方案。NCT05170204、NCT06140836的结果或可说明一线使用新一代TKI与序贯用药孰优，这个问题目前仍未解答。

en.why: ROS1 fusions switch the kinase on constantly, driving MAPK, PI3K and STAT3 signaling. They occur in about 1–2% of NSCLC and turn up rarely in cholangiocarcinoma, glioma and other tumors. Crizotinib's approval in ROS1-positive NSCLC validated the target. The main clinical problems are resistance from solvent-front mutations such as G2032R, and brain metastases.
learned: No ROS1 readouts or failures are tracked here yet, so the clinical record is thin. The first real tests will be two entrectinib Phase 3 NSCLC trials and the repotrectinib Phase 3 trial NCT06140836. One entrectinib trial, NCT04603807, has passed its listed primary completion date but has no results here yet. The other is NCT05170204.
opps: Seven of the 9 programs tracked here are small molecules, and several Chinese companies have Phase 1 programs (Simcere, JOYO, Ascentage, Avistone). Newer entrants might stand out by covering G2032R, getting better into the brain, or avoiding TRK by design, as zidesamtinib does, to reduce nervous-system side effects.

Programs focus on NSCLC and solid tumors in general. Cholangiocarcinoma, CNS tumors and breast cancer have one program each. Hypothesis: basket trials that use ctDNA to find patients with rare ROS1-fusion tumors, including pediatric glioma, remain largely open.

No degraders, ADCs or other non-small-molecule approaches are tracked here. Nor are combinations aimed at bypass resistance after TKIs (e.g., MET, KRAS). Results from NCT05170204 and NCT06140836 may help show whether a next-generation TKI first is better than using drugs in sequence, which is still an open question.

zh.why: RXFP1是肽类激素relaxin-2的G蛋白偶联受体，经cAMP和一氧化氮通路舒张血管，增加肾血流和肾小球滤过率，并抑制纤维化与炎症，妊娠期肾脏的适应性变化即由其介导。这一特性契合肾灌注骤降的场景，如心脏手术相关急性肾损伤。
learned: 本站仅追踪到River 2 Renal一个2期项目（药物与分子类型未披露），针对心脏及瓣膜手术相关急性肾损伤，2026年6月首登。尚无读出，未来六个月亦无主要完成节点。
opps: 本站未见长效relaxin类似物、RXFP1小分子或激动型抗体。围术期AKI可用短期输注，肾脏、心脏纤维化等慢性适应症则需长效选择性激动剂，信号偏向性是设计要点。
仅按临床风险入组易稀释疗效。可检验的假设：以尿TIMP-2·IGFBP7等肾应激标志物富集人群，并在体外循环前给药，在损伤形成前发挥舒血管与抗纤维化作用。
慢性肾病、伴肾淤血的HFpEF、肝肺纤维化、子痫前期等场景本站均无追踪项目。River 2 Renal试验日后的肾血流或GFR数据可为拓展方向提供早期参考。

en.why: RXFP1 is the GPCR for the peptide hormone relaxin-2. Acting through cAMP and nitric oxide, it dilates blood vessels, raises renal blood flow and glomerular filtration, and dampens fibrosis and inflammation. It drives the kidney's adaptation to pregnancy. That profile fits settings where kidney perfusion drops suddenly, such as acute kidney injury after cardiac surgery.
learned: This site tracks only one program: a Phase 2 program from River 2 Renal (drug and modality not disclosed), first posted June 2026, in acute kidney injury after cardiac and valve surgery. It has no readouts, and no primary completions are due in the next six months.
opps: No long-acting relaxin analogue, small-molecule RXFP1 agonist or agonist antibody is tracked here. A short infusion may suit perioperative AKI, but chronic uses such as kidney or cardiac fibrosis would need a durable, selective agonist. Signalling bias is a key design question.

Enrolling on clinical risk alone can dilute an effect. A testable idea: enrich with kidney-stress biomarkers such as urinary TIMP-2·IGFBP7 and dose before bypass. The vasodilatory and antifibrotic actions should then work before the injury sets in.

No programs are tracked here in chronic kidney disease, HFpEF with renal congestion, liver or lung fibrosis, or preeclampsia. When the River 2 Renal trials eventually report renal blood flow or GFR data, those results could help show which of these is worth pursuing.

zh.why: S1P1 受体调控淋巴细胞从淋巴结外出，功能性拮抗剂使受体内化，把自身反应性淋巴细胞滞留在淋巴结内，减少其向中枢神经或肠道浸润。fingolimod 早年已获批用于复发型 MS，验证了这一机制，此后同类药物扩展到溃疡性结肠炎等免疫炎症疾病。
learned: 临床记录仍然较少。本站追踪的唯一读出是 Pfizer 的 etrasimod 用于克罗恩病的 CULTIVATE（NCT04173273），因子研究 1 缺乏疗效提前终止，未达到主要终点；未来六个月没有本站追踪的试验到达主要完成日期，近期不会有新的检验。
opps: 本站追踪的 UC 项目有 3 个，etrasimod 却在克罗恩病中失败（NCT04173273）。值得研究的是，单药淋巴细胞滞留对透壁性病变是否力度不足，与生物制剂联用或按病变部位、严重度筛选患者能否改变结果。
本站追踪的 8 个项目全部是小分子，且集中在 MS 和 UC，银屑病、儿童 MS 各只有 1 个。受体亚型更选择性、组织局限暴露的设计，或可减轻心动过缓、黄斑水肿等已知类效应，从而形成差异化。
唯一的早期项目是 Priothera 新登记的 1 期试验，治疗领域另有 2 项试验归入“其他”。这些试验的适应症可以说明 S1P 调节能否走出 MS 和 IBD 这一经典范围。

en.why: S1P1 controls lymphocyte exit from lymph nodes. Functional antagonists internalize the receptor and hold autoreactive lymphocytes in the nodes, which reduces infiltration into the CNS or gut. Fingolimod's long-established approval in relapsing MS validated the mechanism, and the class has since expanded into ulcerative colitis and other immune-inflammatory diseases.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout tracked here is Pfizer's CULTIVATE trial of etrasimod in Crohn's disease (NCT04173273), which missed its primary endpoint and stopped early for lack of efficacy in sub-study 1. No tracked trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so there is no near-term test.
opps: Three UC programs are tracked here, but etrasimod failed in Crohn's disease (NCT04173273). One hypothesis to test: lymphocyte sequestration alone may be too weak for transmural disease. Combining with biologics, or selecting patients by disease location and severity, could change the outcome.

All eight programs tracked here are small molecules, and they cluster in MS and UC. Psoriasis and pediatric MS have one program each. Designs with more subtype selectivity or tissue-restricted exposure could reduce known class effects such as bradycardia and macular edema, and so set a drug apart.

The only early-stage program is Priothera's newly posted Phase 1, and two tracked trials fall outside the main therapy areas. Which indications these trials target will show whether S1P modulation can move beyond the classic MS and IBD setting.

zh.why: 3CL 蛋白酶（Mpro）将病毒多聚蛋白切割为复制所需的功能蛋白，抑制它可阻断 SARS-CoV-2 复制。其活性位点在冠状病毒间高度保守，人体内无近似同源酶，利于开发选择性抑制剂。nirmatrelvir 联用 ritonavir 已在高危 COVID-19 患者中验证该机制。
learned: 此处追踪的记录仅有 S-217622（Shionogi）一项 III 期读出：SCORPIO-HR（NCT05305547，n=2093）未达到持续症状缓解时间这一主要终点。未来六个月没有试验到达主要完成日，近期不会有新的检验。
opps: NCT05305547 未达到的是症状缓解终点。可检验的假设是：在病毒复制持续驱动病情的人群（如病毒长期排出的免疫低下患者）中，改用病毒学或住院终点评估，3CL 抑制的获益是否更明确。
此处追踪的仅有一家公司的一个小分子。鉴于活性位点保守，面向未来疫情的泛冠状病毒抑制剂，以及与聚合酶抑制剂联用以降低耐药风险，在本数据集中尚无项目覆盖。
按发病至给药时间或基线病毒载量入组，可检验获益是否集中在早期、高复制的患者中；仅凭一项症状终点阴性的试验无法回答这一问题。

en.why: 3CL protease (Mpro) cuts viral polyproteins into the proteins the virus needs to replicate, so blocking it halts SARS-CoV-2 replication. Its active site is highly conserved across coronaviruses and has no close human counterpart, which makes selective inhibitors feasible. Nirmatrelvir given with ritonavir has shown the mechanism works clinically in high-risk COVID-19.
learned: The record tracked here is thin: one Phase 3 readout for S-217622 (Shionogi). SCORPIO-HR (NCT05305547, n=2093) missed its primary endpoint, time to sustained symptom resolution. No trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so there will be no further test soon.
opps: NCT05305547 missed on a symptom-resolution endpoint. One hypothesis to test: 3CL inhibition may show clearer benefit in groups where ongoing viral replication drives disease, such as immunocompromised patients with prolonged shedding, if measured with virological or hospitalization endpoints.

Among programs tracked here, the field is one small molecule from one company. Because the active site is conserved, no program in this dataset yet covers pan-coronavirus inhibitors for future pandemics or combinations with polymerase inhibitors to limit resistance.

Enrolling patients by time since symptom onset or by baseline viral load could test whether the benefit sits mainly in early, high-replication patients. A single trial that missed a symptom endpoint cannot answer this.

zh.why: SGLT2由SLC5A2编码，负责近端肾小管大部分葡萄糖重吸收。抑制后可促进尿糖排泄和尿钠排泄，并通过管球反馈降低肾小球内压。SLC5A2功能缺失导致的家族性肾性糖尿基本属良性，提供了遗传学支持。empagliflozin、dapagliflozin早已获批，适应症已从2型糖尿病扩展到心衰和CKD。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍然有限，已有读出多把SGLT2抑制剂作为联合用药的背景治疗，而非检验对象，如LEGEND（NCT05232071，达到）和CONFIDENCE（NCT05254002，无统计检验）。真正的检验将来自NCT06481891（sotagliflozin，HCM）、NCT07107945和NCT06926660（empagliflozin，CKD）以及NCT07093476（2型糖尿病）。
opps: 本站追踪项目中，只有sotagliflozin在做肥厚型心肌病（NCT06481891，梗阻性），另有非梗阻性适应症。可借此验证SGLT1/2双重抑制的心肌获益能否延伸到结构性心肌病，以及梗阻和非梗阻患者的应答是否不同。
联合用药是主要方向：CONFIDENCE（NCT05254002）把empagliflozin与盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂联用，石药的DPP-4联合方案也已披露积极顶线。可按UACR等基线指标分层，检验叠加的肾脏获益。
肿瘤领域只有一个转移性乳腺癌/TNBC项目。可假设SGLT2抑制能缓解PI3K通路药物引起的高血糖，或抑制肿瘤摄取葡萄糖，这方面尚待验证。

en.why: SGLT2, encoded by SLC5A2, handles most glucose reabsorption in the proximal tubule. Blocking it causes glycosuria and natriuresis and lowers intraglomerular pressure through tubuloglomerular feedback. Familial renal glycosuria from SLC5A2 loss-of-function is largely benign, which supports the target genetically. Empagliflozin and dapagliflozin have long been approved, and their use has grown from type 2 diabetes to heart failure and CKD.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. In most readouts so far the SGLT2 inhibitor was a combination backbone, not the drug being tested: LEGEND (NCT05232071, met) and CONFIDENCE (NCT05254002, no formal test). The first real tests will be NCT06481891 (sotagliflozin, HCM), NCT07107945 and NCT06926660 (empagliflozin, CKD), and NCT07093476 (type 2 diabetes).
opps: Among programs tracked here, only sotagliflozin is being studied in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (NCT06481891, obstructive), and a non-obstructive indication is also listed. These trials can test whether dual SGLT1/2 inhibition helps the heart muscle in structural cardiomyopathy, and whether obstructive and non-obstructive patients respond differently.

Combinations are the main path forward. CONFIDENCE (NCT05254002) paired empagliflozin with a mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist, and CSPC has announced positive topline results for a DPP-4 combination. Stratifying patients by baseline UACR or similar markers could show whether the kidney benefits add up.

Oncology has a single metastatic breast cancer/TNBC program. Untested hypotheses include SGLT2 inhibition offsetting the high blood sugar caused by PI3K-pathway drugs, or limiting how much glucose tumors take up.

zh.why: SHP2由PTPN11编码，是非受体型酪氨酸磷酸酶，把RTK信号传给SOS并促进RAS-GTP加载，是RAS–MAPK通路的关键节点。PTPN11胚系功能获得突变导致Noonan综合征，体细胞突变见于JMML。KRAS G12C抑制剂作用于GDP结合态，抑制SHP2可阻断RTK反馈性再激活，是联合用药的主要依据。
learned: 临床记录仍很有限：本站追踪的3个项目均无读出、无失败或提前终止记录，未来六个月也没有试验到达主要终点。进展最快的是Allist的JAB-3312（3期），集中在KRAS G12C突变NSCLC，其3期结果将是该机制的第一次真正检验。
opps: 本站追踪的项目几乎都集中在KRAS G12C NSCLC，仅一项涉及结直肠癌。RTK驱动的肿瘤、非G12C的KRAS等位基因，以及PTPN11突变的JMML等血液肿瘤，在本站追踪的项目中尚无覆盖，值得作为验证假设。
已追踪的项目中，有明确模式的均为别构小分子，降解剂等其他模式尚未出现。可以检验降解SHP2能否带来更持久的通路抑制，或改善与靶点相关的耐受性。
目前缺少疗效生物标志物。可探索以RTK反馈激活程度、共突变谱或MAPK通路输出作为患者筛选依据，以区别于未经富集的联合方案。

en.why: SHP2, encoded by PTPN11, is a non-receptor tyrosine phosphatase that relays RTK signals to SOS and promotes RAS-GTP loading, making it a key RAS–MAPK node. Germline gain-of-function PTPN11 mutations cause Noonan syndrome, and somatic ones occur in JMML. KRAS G12C inhibitors bind GDP-bound RAS, and blocking SHP2 blunts adaptive RTK reactivation, which is the main reason to combine the two.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. None of the 3 programs tracked here has a readout or a recorded failure or early stop, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months. The most advanced is Allist's JAB-3312 (phase 3) in KRAS G12C-mutant NSCLC. Its phase 3 result will be the first real test of the mechanism.
opps: Nearly all programs tracked here target KRAS G12C NSCLC, and only one includes colorectal cancer. Programs tracked here do not yet cover RTK-driven tumors, non-G12C KRAS alleles, or PTPN11-mutant blood cancers such as JMML. These are open hypotheses to test.

Every tracked program with a stated modality is an allosteric small molecule, and no degraders appear. A worthwhile question is whether degrading SHP2 gives more durable pathway suppression or better on-target tolerability.

There are no response biomarkers yet. Patients could be selected by how strongly RTK feedback is activated, by co-mutation profile, or by MAPK pathway output. That would set a program apart from combination regimens given without selection.

zh.why: SIRPα表达于巨噬细胞、树突状细胞等髓系细胞，与肿瘤细胞上的CD47结合后经SHP-1/2传递“别吃我”信号，抑制吞噬。CD47在红细胞上广泛表达，直接靶向SIRPα有望在保留吞噬激活的同时减少贫血等血液学毒性。
learned: 本站追踪的6个项目（4家公司）均处于1期，尚无读出、失败或终止记录，未来6个月也没有到达主要完成日的试验，因此目前还无法判断该机制在临床上能否成立，第一次真正的检验时间也尚不明确。
opps: 本站追踪的项目以晚期实体瘤为主，淋巴瘤和多发性骨髓瘤仅各有少数。可以验证一个假设：在血液肿瘤中联合利妥昔单抗等调理性抗体，吞噬增强效应是否更容易显现。
目前追踪到的项目只有单抗和SIRPα-Fc融合蛋白两种形式，尚未见双抗或ADC。肿瘤靶向的双特异性设计也许能把髓系激活集中到肿瘤局部。
SIRPα存在V1/V2等多态性，SIRPγ在T细胞上表达，抗体对等位基因的覆盖度以及是否回避SIRPγ，可能成为同类项目差异化和患者筛选的依据。

en.why: SIRPα sits on macrophages, dendritic cells and other myeloid cells. When it binds CD47 on tumor cells it signals through SHP-1/2 to block phagocytosis, the "don't eat me" signal. CD47 is abundant on red cells, so hitting the receptor side instead may release phagocytosis with less anemia and other blood toxicity than anti-CD47 agents.
learned: All 6 programs tracked here, from 4 companies, are in Phase 1. None has a readout, failure or early stop on record, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months. So the clinical case for the mechanism is untested, and it is unclear when the first real test will come.
opps: Most tracked programs are in advanced solid tumors, with only a few in lymphoma and myeloma. One hypothesis to test: whether boosting phagocytosis shows up more readily in blood cancers when paired with opsonizing antibodies such as rituximab.
The tracked programs use only two formats, monoclonal antibodies and SIRPα-Fc fusions. No bispecifics or ADCs appear. A tumor-targeted bispecific might confine myeloid activation to the tumor.

SIRPα comes in variants (V1/V2), and the related SIRPγ is found on T cells. How fully an antibody covers these variants, and whether it spares SIRPγ, could set programs apart and guide patient selection.

zh.why: SMARCA2（BRM）与旁系同源蛋白SMARCA4（BRG1）是SWI/SNF染色质重塑复合物中可相互替代的ATP酶亚基。SMARCA4缺失的肺癌、胃食管癌等肿瘤依赖SMARCA2存活，因此SMARCA2是合成致死靶点。两者高度同源，能否抑制SMARCA2同时不影响正常组织中的SMARCA4是关键。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：本站仅追踪到Plexium的PLX-61639和Eli Lilly一款未命名小分子，均为1期，尚无读出，未来六个月内也没有追踪到的试验到达主要完成节点。
opps: 已追踪项目列出的适应症为胃腺癌、食管鳞癌和转移性实体瘤。SMARCA4缺失在NSCLC中较常见，但在本站追踪的项目中未单列为适应症，可考察专门的NSCLC队列能否更早显示信号。
SMARCA4缺失的定义方式（截短突变、IHC蛋白缺失或错义突变）可能决定获益人群，SMARCA2表达同时缺失可能预示无效。早期试验可检验哪种生物标志物最能预测疗效。
本站追踪的两个项目均为小分子。不同的选择性实现方式（降解剂、ATP酶或别构抑制）及与化疗、免疫治疗或KRAS抑制剂的联合，尚未见于追踪项目，可作为差异化方向。

en.why: SMARCA2 (BRM) and its paralog SMARCA4 (BRG1) are interchangeable ATPase subunits of the SWI/SNF chromatin-remodeling complex. Tumors that lose SMARCA4, including subsets of lung, gastric and esophageal cancer, depend on SMARCA2 to survive, which makes SMARCA2 a synthetic-lethal target. The two proteins are highly similar, so the central challenge is blocking SMARCA2 while sparing SMARCA4 in normal tissue.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site tracks only two Phase 1 small molecules, Plexium's PLX-61639 and an unnamed Eli Lilly compound. Neither has a readout, and no tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months.
opps: Tracked trials list gastric adenocarcinoma, esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and metastatic solid tumors. SMARCA4 loss is relatively common in NSCLC, but among programs tracked here NSCLC is not named as a separate indication. Dedicated NSCLC cohorts could test whether a signal shows up earlier there.

Who benefits may depend on how SMARCA4 loss is defined: truncating mutation, protein loss on IHC, or missense variant. Tumors that have also lost SMARCA2 expression may not respond. Early trials could test which biomarker best predicts response.

Both tracked programs are small molecules. Other ways to get selectivity (degraders, ATPase or allosteric inhibitors) and combinations with chemotherapy, immunotherapy or KRAS inhibitors do not appear among tracked programs. These are possible ways to stand apart.

zh.why: 脊髓性肌萎缩症（SMA）由SMN1缺失引起。旁系同源基因SMN2的外显子7有一个单碱基差异，导致该外显子常被跳过，只能产生少量全长SMN蛋白。SMN2拷贝数与病情轻重相关。用剪接调节促进外显子7保留，是已获验证的治疗策略，nusinersen与risdiplam均已获批多年。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍很有限：仅有2个项目（ASO nusinersen与小分子risdiplam），没有已追踪的读出和失败案例。nusinersen的III期试验NCT04729907原定2026年7月完成主要终点，但本站尚未追踪到结果，它将是首个真正的检验。
opps: 在本站追踪的范围内，在研项目都是作用于SMN2外显子7的剪接调节剂，与SMN无关的机制（如肌肉、神经保护）和SMN2基因编辑尚未出现。Scholar Rock出现在nusinersen试验中，提示联合用药可能是一个值得验证的方向。
可以检验SMN2拷贝数、神经丝轻链等生物标志物，能否用于识别对剪接调节剂应答欠佳的患者，并指导剂量调整或换药。
现有两类药物分别是鞘内注射和每日口服，作用更持久、给药负担更低的剂型能否改善成人及晚发型患者的长期获益，仍有待回答。

en.why: Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) is caused by loss of SMN1. Its paralog SMN2 differs by one base in exon 7, so that exon is usually skipped and little full-length SMN protein is made. SMN2 copy number tracks with disease severity. Splicing modulation that keeps exon 7 in is a validated strategy: nusinersen and risdiplam have both been approved for years.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. There are only two programs (the ASO nusinersen and the small molecule risdiplam), with no tracked readouts or failures. The phase 3 nusinersen trial NCT04729907 was due to reach primary completion in July 2026, but no result is tracked here yet. It will be the first real test.
opps: Among programs tracked here, every agent is a splicing modifier aimed at SMN2 exon 7. No SMN-independent approaches (muscle-directed, neuroprotective) or SMN2 gene editing appear. Scholar Rock is listed on nusinersen trials, which hints that combination therapy is worth testing.
A testable hypothesis: biomarkers such as SMN2 copy number and neurofilament light could identify patients who respond poorly to splicing modifiers and guide dose escalation or switching.

The two drug classes are given intrathecally or as a daily oral dose. An open question is whether longer-acting, lower-burden formats could improve long-term benefit in adults and later-onset patients.

zh.why: SOD1突变约占家族性ALS的两成，突变蛋白错误折叠、聚集，以毒性获得性功能损伤运动神经元。降低SOD1表达是直接对因的思路。血液和脑脊液中的神经丝轻链（NfL）可作为药效和疾病进展的生物标志物，有助于在小样本中评估疗效。
learned: 本站追踪到的SOD1临床记录仍很少：仅有Biogen的tofersen（ASO，3期）和UniQure一个1/2期项目，没有已记录的读出或失败，未来六个月也没有试验到达主要完成日期，因此暂时没有近期的检验节点。
opps: 症状出现前干预：在本站追踪的项目中，还没有数据回答在SOD1突变携带者发病前降低SOD1能否推迟发病，可结合NfL升高来筛选高风险人群。
给药负担上的差异化：tofersen需要反复鞘内注射，UniQure的1/2期项目是本站追踪到的唯一替代方案，一次性或长效递送方式还有探索空间。
野生型SOD1错误折叠可能参与部分散发性ALS，但降低SOD1能否惠及非突变患者尚未得到验证，需要伴随生物标志物来做患者分层。

en.why: SOD1 mutations cause roughly a fifth of familial ALS. The mutant protein misfolds and aggregates, damaging motor neurons through a toxic gain of function, so lowering SOD1 targets the cause directly. Neurofilament light chain (NfL) in blood and CSF can serve as a pharmacodynamic and progression biomarker, which helps assess effect in small trials.
learned: The SOD1 clinical record tracked here is still thin. It has two programs: Biogen's tofersen (ASO, phase 3) and a UniQure phase 1/2 program. No readouts or failures are recorded, and no tracked trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so there is no near-term test.
opps: Presymptomatic treatment: among programs tracked here, no data yet show whether lowering SOD1 in mutation carriers before onset delays disease. Rising NfL could be used to pick out high-risk carriers.

Dosing burden as a point of difference: tofersen needs repeated intrathecal injections. The UniQure phase 1/2 program is the only alternative tracked here, so one-time or long-acting delivery is still open to exploration.
Misfolded wild-type SOD1 may play a role in some sporadic ALS. Whether lowering SOD1 helps patients without mutations is untested and would need biomarkers to select patients.

zh.why: SSTR2是垂体生长激素腺瘤和分化良好神经内分泌瘤（NET）上表达最多的生长抑素受体亚型。激动该受体可抑制GH及多种激素分泌，并抑制细胞增殖。受体表达量高、配体结合后会内化，因此也适合做诊疗一体化靶点。octreotide、lanreotide和177Lu-DOTATATE已上市多年，靶点已经过验证。
learned: 在本站追踪的管线中，多肽、口服小分子和放射性配体三类分子都在推进。paltusotine的2期研究NCT04261712因商业原因终止，申办方说明与获益风险变化无关，不能据此否定口服非肽类激动剂，Crinetics仍有3期项目在推进。
SSTR2激动的适应症已从内分泌和肿瘤扩展到囊性疾病。CAM2029在多囊肝病的POSITANO研究（NCT05281328）中达到身高校正肝体积主要终点，与抑制cAMP驱动囊肿生长的机制相符。
在放射性配体方向，换用更强的载荷可能克服耐药。ACTION-1期中分析显示，锕-225标记的RYZ101用于Lu-177治疗后进展的GEP-NET，PFS显著优于对照，说明患者β粒子治疗进展后SSTR仍可作为靶点，但公司未公布风险比。
opps: RYZ101的3期研究NCT05477576（GEP-NET）预计2026年12月到达主要完成日，另一款177Lu-DOTATATE（NCT07057622）的3期研究也在近期到达主要完成日。值得关注的是α粒子的获益能否持续，以及骨髓和肾脏的长期安全性。
本站追踪的项目集中在GEP-NET和肢端肥大症，乳腺癌只有少量项目。小细胞肺癌、脑膜瘤、嗜铬细胞瘤等SSTR2阳性肿瘤在本站基本没有项目，可以用SSTR PET摄取程度筛选患者，探索适应症扩展。
本站追踪的多囊肝病项目目前只有CAM2029注射剂。口服SSTR2激动剂能否用于多囊肝病或其他cAMP驱动的囊性疾病的长期治疗，是一个尚未检验的问题。

en.why: SSTR2 is the main somatostatin receptor subtype on GH-secreting pituitary adenomas and well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumors (NETs). Activating it suppresses GH and other hormone secretion and slows cell growth. The receptor is highly expressed and internalizes after ligand binding, which makes it a theranostic target. Long-approved octreotide, lanreotide and 177Lu-DOTATATE validate it.
learned: Among programs tracked here, peptides, oral small molecules and radioligands are all advancing. Paltusotine's Phase 2 NCT04261712 was stopped for business reasons, which the sponsor said were unrelated to benefit-risk. That says nothing against oral nonpeptide agonism, and Crinetics still has Phase 3 programs.

SSTR2 agonism now reaches beyond endocrine disease and cancer. CAM2029 met its height-adjusted liver volume endpoint in polycystic liver disease in POSITANO (NCT05281328). This fits the mechanism of reducing cAMP-driven cyst growth.

For radioligands, switching to a stronger payload may overcome resistance. At interim analysis in ACTION-1, Ac-225 RYZ101 significantly improved PFS over standard options in GEP-NET that progressed after Lu-177. SSTR stays targetable after beta therapy, but the company did not disclose a hazard ratio.
opps: RYZ101's Phase 3 NCT05477576 (GEP-NET) reaches primary completion in December 2026, and another 177Lu-DOTATATE Phase 3 (NCT07057622) reaches primary completion about now. Key questions: does the alpha benefit hold up, and what is the long-term marrow and kidney safety?

Programs tracked here focus on GEP-NET and acromegaly, with only a few in breast cancer. Other SSTR2-positive tumors, such as small-cell lung cancer, meningioma and pheochromocytoma, have almost no programs here. Selecting patients by SSTR PET uptake could support expansion into them.

CAM2029, an injectable, is the only polycystic liver disease program tracked here. Whether an oral SSTR2 agonist could serve as long-term therapy for polycystic liver disease or other cAMP-driven cystic diseases has not been tested.

zh.why: STAT3是IL-6/JAK等信号下游的转录因子，在多种实体瘤和血液肿瘤中持续激活，驱动增殖、存活和免疫抑制性微环境。它没有可结合的酶活性口袋，长期被视为难成药靶点，降解剂提供了新的干预方式。胚系功能缺失会导致高IgE综合征，提示需关注感染风险。
learned: 临床记录尚薄：此处追踪的仅有Medsyn一项STAT3降解剂1/2期项目（胃癌、三阴性乳腺癌），2026年10月才登记，尚无读出，未来六个月内也没有预计达到主要完成的试验。
opps: 此处追踪的唯一项目覆盖胃癌和TNBC。存在STAT3体细胞激活突变的血液肿瘤（如大颗粒淋巴细胞白血病、部分ALCL）尚无项目，遗传学依据更清晰，可作为验证机制的场景。
STAT3参与维持肿瘤免疫抑制。降解剂联用PD-1/PD-L1抑制剂，或按pSTAT3、IL-6水平筛选患者，在此处追踪的项目中均未见，可作为早期探索的假设。
该模式首先要回答的问题是：降解剂能否在肿瘤中实现充分、持久的STAT3清除，又不出现类似高IgE综合征的感染或免疫缺陷。早期研究宜同时纳入药效学和免疫功能监测。

en.why: STAT3 is a transcription factor downstream of IL-6/JAK and other signals. It is persistently active in many solid and blood cancers, where it drives proliferation, survival and an immunosuppressive microenvironment. It has no enzymatic pocket to bind, so it was long considered undruggable, and degraders offer a new way in. Germline loss of function causes hyper-IgE syndrome, which flags infection risk.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Among programs tracked here there is only one: a Medsyn STAT3 degrader in Phase 1/2 for gastric cancer and TNBC, registered in October 2026. It has no readouts, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months.
opps: The only tracked program covers gastric cancer and TNBC. No program here addresses blood cancers with somatic STAT3-activating mutations, such as large granular lymphocytic leukemia or some ALCL. Their clearer genetics could make them a cleaner test of the mechanism.

STAT3 helps keep tumors immunosuppressed. Among programs tracked here, none pairs a degrader with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors or selects patients by pSTAT3 or IL-6 levels. These are worth testing early as hypotheses.

The first question for this modality: can a degrader clear STAT3 from tumors deeply and durably without causing hyper-IgE-like infections or immune deficiency? Early studies should track pharmacodynamics and immune function together.

zh.why: STAT6是IL-4与IL-13经IL-4Rα信号的核心转录因子，驱动Th2分化、IgE类别转换和嗜酸性炎症。dupilumab阻断IL-4Rα，已在特应性皮炎和哮喘中验证这一通路。STAT6功能获得性突变可致严重过敏性疾病。转录因子过去难以成药，降解剂为口服替代生物制剂提供了可能。
learned: 临床记录仍很有限：本站暂无STAT6相关读出，未来六个月也没有试验到达主要完成日期。Sanofi已终止Nurix来源的Phase 1降解剂SAR448272，未披露原因，不能据此否定机制。Kymera的Phase 2小分子项目将是首个真正检验。
opps: 本站追踪的项目仅覆盖特应性皮炎和哮喘。嗜酸性食管炎、伴鼻息肉的慢性鼻窦炎、结节性痒疹等dupilumab已验证的2型炎症适应症，目前尚无STAT6项目覆盖。
核心未解问题是口服降解剂能否达到与IL-4Rα抗体相当的通路抑制深度。可用TARC、IgE、FeNO、eotaxin-3等生物标志物，在早期确定剂量并检验靶点作用。
可考虑按患者分层：STAT6功能获得性突变患者，或对生物制剂应答不足的2型炎症患者。另一方向是与TSLP、IL-5等机制联用，以区别于单纯替代注射剂的定位。

en.why: STAT6 is the transcription factor that carries IL-4 and IL-13 signaling through IL-4Rα. It drives Th2 differentiation, IgE class switching and eosinophilic inflammation. Dupilumab, which blocks IL-4Rα, validated this axis in atopic dermatitis and asthma, and STAT6 gain-of-function variants cause severe allergic disease. Transcription factors were long considered undruggable. Degraders could offer an oral alternative to injectable biologics.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. No STAT6 readouts are tracked here, and no trials reach primary completion in the next six months. Sanofi dropped Nurix's Phase 1 degrader SAR448272 without giving a reason, so this does not count against the mechanism. Kymera's Phase 2 small molecule will be the first real test.
opps: The programs tracked here cover only atopic dermatitis and asthma. No STAT6 program here addresses eosinophilic esophagitis, chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps or prurigo nodularis, all type 2 diseases where dupilumab has validated the axis.

The open question is whether an oral degrader can block the pathway as deeply as an IL-4Rα antibody. Biomarkers such as TARC, IgE, FeNO and eotaxin-3 could support early dose selection and show the drug is hitting its target.

Patient selection is one option: STAT6 gain-of-function carriers, or type 2 patients who respond poorly to biologics. Combining with TSLP or IL-5 mechanisms is another. Either could set a program apart from simply replacing injections.

zh.why: STEAP1是一种六次跨膜的细胞表面蛋白，在前列腺癌（包括转移性去势抵抗阶段）中高表达，正常组织表达有限，适合作为ADC和T细胞衔接器的靶点。它在PSMA低表达的肿瘤中也常有表达，可作为PSMA以外的补充选择。
learned: 临床证据仍很少：本站跟踪的2个项目（Amgen双抗、Adcentrx的ADC ADRX-0405）均处于1期，尚无读出，也没有终止记录，未来6个月内也没有到达主要完成日期的试验，暂时无法判断哪种模式更有效、安全性如何。
opps: 已跟踪项目中出现了高危生化复发人群。可以检验一个假设：在肿瘤负荷较低的早期阶段，T细胞衔接器是否比在晚期mCRPC中更容易起效、耐受性更好。
本站跟踪的项目中还没有CAR-T或放射性配体。STEAP1可在PSMA低表达或异质性肿瘤中补位，可以考虑按STEAP1表达（IHC或PET显像）筛选患者。
ADRX-0405的实体瘤试验可用于探索前列腺以外的STEAP1阳性肿瘤（如Ewing肉瘤）。这类适应症在已跟踪项目中几乎是空白。

en.why: STEAP1 is a six-transmembrane surface protein that is highly expressed in prostate cancer, including metastatic castration-resistant disease, with limited expression in normal tissue. That makes it a good fit for ADCs and T-cell engagers. It is often expressed in tumours with low PSMA, so it could complement PSMA-directed approaches.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Both programs tracked here, an Amgen bispecific and Adcentrx's ADC ADRX-0405, are in Phase 1. There are no readouts or stops yet, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months. Efficacy, safety and which modality works better all remain open.
opps: High-risk biochemical recurrence appears among the tracked conditions. One hypothesis to test: a T-cell engager may work better and be better tolerated at low tumour burden than in late-stage mCRPC.
No CAR-T or radioligand programs are tracked here. STEAP1 could fill a gap in PSMA-low or heterogeneous tumours, with patients selected by STEAP1 expression on IHC or PET imaging.
ADRX-0405's solid-tumour trial could be used to explore STEAP1-positive cancers outside the prostate, such as Ewing sarcoma. Among tracked programs, these indications are almost untouched.

zh.why: STING是内质网接头蛋白，接收cGAS感知胞质DNA后生成的cGAMP，经TBK1-IRF3诱导I型干扰素，促进树突状细胞交叉呈递和T细胞启动，被视为将“冷”肿瘤转“热”的靶点。STING1功能获得性突变致SAVI，提示抑制剂可用于干扰素病。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：本站仅追踪到OncoNano一个1期项目（TNBC和DLBCL），尚无读出、失败或提前终止，未来6个月内也无试验到达主要完成日期，近期没有真正的检验节点。
opps: 本站追踪的唯一项目只覆盖TNBC和DLBCL，其他实体瘤尚无项目；可检验STING激活能否在T细胞浸润低或PD-1耐药的肿瘤中恢复免疫应答。
肿瘤常通过表观遗传沉默STING或cGAS，按通路完整性（STING/cGAS表达、干扰素特征）筛选患者，可能区分应答者；本站尚未见按生物标志物入组的项目。
本站追踪的项目均为肿瘤激动方向，未见针对SAVI等干扰素病或其他STING驱动炎症的抑制剂项目，抑制端仍是空白。

en.why: STING is an ER adaptor that responds to cGAMP, which cGAS makes when it senses cytosolic DNA, and signals through TBK1-IRF3 to induce type I interferon. This drives dendritic-cell cross-presentation and T-cell priming, the rationale for using STING to turn immunologically cold tumors hot. Gain-of-function STING1 mutations cause SAVI, so inhibitors could also treat interferonopathies.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site tracks one Phase 1 program, from OncoNano, in TNBC and DLBCL, with no readouts, failures or early stops. No trials reach primary completion in the next six months, so no real test is scheduled soon.
opps: The only tracked program covers TNBC and DLBCL, and no programs in other solid tumors are tracked here. One hypothesis to test: can STING activation restore immune responses in tumors with low T-cell infiltration or PD-1 resistance?

Tumors often silence STING or cGAS epigenetically. Selecting patients by pathway integrity (STING/cGAS expression, interferon signature) might separate responders, and no biomarker-selected program is tracked here.
All tracked activity is oncology agonism. No inhibitor programs for SAVI, other interferonopathies or STING-driven inflammation are tracked here, so the inhibitor side is still open.

zh.why: Sigma-1受体是位于内质网–线粒体接触面的分子伴侣，调节钙信号、内质网应激和自噬。SIGMAR1功能缺失突变可致青少年型ALS和远端遗传性运动神经病，提供了人类遗传学依据；激动剂和拮抗剂分别被用于探索神经退行性疾病、精神疾病和疼痛。
learned: 临床记录尚薄：此处仅追踪到2个小分子项目，即Anavex的一个II期项目和Luye的LY03015（I期），均无读出。未来6个月内也没有试验到达主要完成日，近期没有能真正检验该靶点的节点。
opps: 在此处追踪的项目中，尚无针对SIGMAR1突变相关运动神经元病的项目。在遗传学定义的人群中做概念验证，或可更直接地检验调节该受体能否改变病程。
追踪项目中仅1个指向精神分裂症，且全部为小分子。可探索以SIGMAR1基因型或受体占有率PET作为患者分层和剂量选择工具，以便更清楚地识别疗效信号。
此处未追踪到拮抗剂或疼痛适应症项目。Sigma-1拮抗在神经病理性疼痛中有临床前依据，在所追踪项目中仍属空白。

en.why: Sigma-1 is a chaperone at the contact zone between the endoplasmic reticulum and mitochondria, where it regulates calcium signalling, ER stress and autophagy. Loss-of-function SIGMAR1 mutations cause juvenile ALS and distal hereditary motor neuropathy, which gives the target human genetic support. Agonists are being explored for neurodegenerative and psychiatric disease, and antagonists for pain.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Only two small-molecule programs are tracked here, an Anavex Phase 2 program and Luye's LY03015 in Phase 1, and neither has a readout. No trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term test of the target is scheduled.
opps: No tracked program addresses motor neuron disease linked to SIGMAR1 mutations. A proof-of-concept study in a genetically defined population could test more directly whether modulating the receptor changes disease course.

Only one tracked program lists schizophrenia, and every program is a small molecule. SIGMAR1 genotype or receptor-occupancy PET could be tested as tools for patient selection and dose finding, making efficacy signals easier to read.
No antagonist or pain program is tracked here. Sigma-1 antagonism has preclinical rationale in neuropathic pain, which remains white space among tracked programs.

zh.why: GRN杂合功能缺失导致颗粒体蛋白（progranulin）水平不足，是遗传性额颞叶痴呆（FTD-GRN）的明确病因。progranulin参与溶酶体功能，sortilin负责结合并内吞降解细胞外progranulin。阻断sortilin或补充GRN基因可提高progranulin水平，因此遗传学依据扎实。
learned: 临床证据仍然有限：本站追踪的项目中，真正检验疗效的只有AL001的3期试验NCT04374136，该试验未达到减缓FTD-GRN进展的临床共同主要终点。Passage Bio的PBFT02（NCT04747431）提前终止，申办方说明是出于公司资源调配考虑，与安全性无关，不能据此否定机制。未来6个月内没有本站追踪的试验到达主要完成节点。
opps: AL001的阴性结果提示，单纯通过阻断sortilin提高细胞外progranulin可能不足以带来临床获益。AviadoBio等基因治疗项目直接补充GRN，检验的是另一种假设；Passage Bio退出后，这一方向的有效性仍待验证。
AL001试验的主要终点针对有症状患者。在症状前GRN携带者中，以progranulin水平、NfL等生物标志物入组并开展早期干预，是尚待验证的思路。
Denali项目（本站未注明其模态）等早期项目可探索提高脑内progranulin的不同路径。可以考察靶点结合与临床获益之间的脱节，究竟出在暴露部位、给药时机还是终点选择上。

en.why: Heterozygous loss-of-function GRN mutations lower progranulin levels and are an established cause of familial frontotemporal dementia (FTD-GRN). Progranulin supports lysosomal function, and sortilin binds extracellular progranulin and routes it for degradation. Blocking sortilin or delivering GRN by gene therapy can raise progranulin levels, so the genetic rationale is strong.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Among programs tracked here, the only real efficacy test is AL001's Phase 3 NCT04374136, which missed its clinical co-primary endpoint of slowing FTD-GRN progression. Passage Bio stopped PBFT02 (NCT04747431) for strategic resourcing reasons and said the stop was unrelated to safety, so it says nothing against the mechanism. No tracked trials reach primary completion in the next six months.
opps: The AL001 miss suggests that raising extracellular progranulin through sortilin blockade alone may not be enough. Gene-replacement programs such as AviadoBio's test a different hypothesis by delivering GRN directly. With Passage Bio out, whether that approach works is still open.

AL001's primary endpoint was measured in symptomatic patients. Treating presymptomatic GRN carriers earlier, with enrollment guided by biomarkers such as progranulin levels and NfL, has not yet been tested.

Earlier programs, including Denali's (modality not specified here), could test other ways to raise progranulin in the brain. A useful question is why target engagement did not translate into clinical benefit: where the drug reaches, when it is given, or which endpoint is used.

zh.why: TAAR1是由痕量胺激活的Gs偶联GPCR，在中脑VTA和中缝核表达，可在突触前调节多巴胺和5-HT神经元的放电。激动TAAR1有望在不阻断D2受体的情况下产生抗精神病作用，从而避开锥体外系反应、高泌乳素血症和代谢负担，是精神分裂症领域的一条非D2新路径。
learned: SEP-363856的两项设计相近的III期研究都以第6周PANSS总分为主要终点、样本量都约460例，结果却不一致：NCT04092686达到，NCT04072354未达到。机制可能有效，但疗效能否稳定复现仍未确定。
在本站追踪的项目中，后期证据全部来自Otsuka的SEP-363856。Roche的Ralmitaront和Newleos的项目都还在I期，这条靶点的临床判断目前几乎取决于单一分子。
目前记录在案的失败只有一项，即NCT04072354，原因为疗效不足，没有安全性或商业原因导致的终止。阴性结果更可能与效应量不足或安慰剂反应有关，而非耐受性问题。
opps: 两项III期结果分化，说明患者选择可能是关键：按病程、症状维度（如阴性症状）或入组地区分层，或许能找到更稳定的获益人群，可作为后续研究假设。
适应症拓展仍处于早期，广泛性焦虑障碍和酒精使用障碍各只有一个项目。TAAR1对多巴胺奖赏通路的调节与成瘾生物学相吻合，值得设计带生物标志物的概念验证研究。
未来6个月没有预期读出。Otsuka在2026年8月新登记的III期项目会是复现性的下一次检验；联合D2拮抗剂的增效方案和非小分子形式在本站追踪的项目中尚未出现。

en.why: TAAR1 is a Gs-coupled GPCR activated by trace amines. It is expressed in the VTA and raphe nuclei, where it tunes presynaptic dopamine and serotonin firing. Agonists may give antipsychotic effects without D2 blockade, avoiding extrapyramidal symptoms, hyperprolactinemia and metabolic burden. This makes TAAR1 a non-D2 route in schizophrenia.
learned: SEP-363856 ran two Phase 3 trials with similar designs: both used week-6 PANSS total score as the primary endpoint and enrolled about 460 patients each. The results split. NCT04092686 met its endpoint and NCT04072354 missed. The mechanism may work, but whether the effect replicates is still unsettled.

Among programs tracked here, all late-stage evidence comes from Otsuka's SEP-363856. Roche's ralmitaront and Newleos's compound are both in Phase 1, so the clinical case for this target currently rests on one molecule.
The only failure on record is NCT04072354, stopped for efficacy. No program was stopped for safety or business reasons. The miss points more to effect size or placebo response than to tolerability.
opps: Because the two Phase 3 results diverged, patient selection may be the lever. A hypothesis to test: stratifying by illness stage, symptom domain (such as negative symptoms) or enrollment region could identify patients with a more consistent benefit.

Moving into other indications is still early, with one program each in generalized anxiety disorder and alcohol use disorder. TAAR1 modulates dopamine reward circuits, which fits addiction biology, so biomarker-guided proof-of-concept studies are a reasonable next step.

No readouts are expected in the next six months. Otsuka's new Phase 3 program, posted in August 2026, will be the next test of whether the effect replicates. Among programs tracked here, none tests adjunctive use with D2 antagonists or a modality other than small molecules.

zh.why: TEAD1-4是Hippo通路下游的转录因子，与YAP/TAZ结合后驱动增殖和存活基因的表达。NF2或LATS1/2失活会导致YAP/TAZ持续入核，这在间皮瘤中尤为常见；YAP/TEAD信号还参与KRAS、EGFR抑制剂的适应性耐药，因此是多种实体瘤的候选靶点。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍很薄弱：仅有2个小分子项目（TYK Medicines的TYK-01054和InSilico的一个未命名分子），均处于1/2期，尚无读出、失败或终止记录，未来6个月内也没有到达主要完成日期的试验，暂时无法判断机制在哪些人群中有效。
opps: 两个项目都纳入间皮瘤。按NF2/LATS失活或YAP/TAZ融合等生物标志物筛选患者，可能是早期验证单药活性最直接的方向。
本站追踪范围内尚无联合用药项目。与KRAS或EGFR抑制剂联用以延缓适应性耐药，是值得检验的假设。
目前项目均为小分子。降解剂、YAP-TEAD蛋白相互作用阻断剂或TEAD亚型选择性分子尚未出现，可能有助于拉开差异并改善治疗窗。

en.why: TEAD1-4 are the Hippo pathway's downstream transcription factors. Bound to YAP/TAZ, they switch on proliferation and survival genes. Loss of NF2 or LATS1/2, common in mesothelioma, leaves YAP/TAZ constantly active in the nucleus. YAP/TEAD signalling also drives adaptive resistance to KRAS and EGFR inhibitors, making TEAD a candidate target across solid tumors.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. There are two Phase 1/2 small molecules: TYK-01054 from TYK Medicines and an unnamed InSilico compound. Neither has a readout, failure or early stop, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months, so there is not yet evidence on where the mechanism works.
opps: Both programs enroll mesothelioma. Selecting patients by biomarker (NF2/LATS loss, YAP/TAZ fusions) may be the most direct way to test single-agent activity early.
No combination programs are tracked here. Pairing a TEAD inhibitor with a KRAS or EGFR inhibitor to delay adaptive resistance is a hypothesis worth testing.

All tracked programs are small molecules. Degraders, drugs that block the YAP-TEAD interaction directly, or isoform-selective TEAD drugs have not appeared and could set a program apart or widen the therapeutic window.

zh.why: TFPI通过抑制FXa和TF-FVIIa复合物来下调外源性凝血途径。阻断TFPI可以增加凝血酶生成，从而绕开FVIII或FIX缺陷、重建止血平衡。理论上，这一机制对血友病A和B均有效，也不受抑制物状态影响，并且可以皮下给药。
learned: 临床记录仍然较少。目前仅NCT03938792（marstacimab，血友病A，含抑制物队列，n=188）一项3期读出，结果达到主要终点。追踪范围内既没有失败或提前终止的试验，未来6个月也没有预计完成的试验，所以短期内不会有新读出来检验结论。
opps: 本站追踪的项目只有Pfizer和Novo Nordisk的两款单抗，均处于3期。siRNA、小分子、双抗或长效改构等其他调控TFPI的方式尚无项目，可作为实现差异化的假设方向。
止血再平衡疗法面临的核心问题是疗效与血栓风险的窗口。如果用游离TFPI水平或凝血酶生成检测来指导剂量和筛选患者，有可能更好地界定获益人群。
在追踪范围内，适应症全部集中于血友病A和B。对于其他出血性疾病，例如血管性血友病，TFPI阻断是否同样有效，目前还是一个未经检验的假设。

en.why: TFPI damps the extrinsic coagulation pathway by inhibiting FXa and the TF-FVIIa complex. Blocking it increases thrombin generation and rebalances haemostasis without replacing FVIII or FIX. In principle this works in both haemophilia A and B, with or without inhibitors, and allows subcutaneous dosing.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. There is a single Phase 3 readout: NCT03938792 (marstacimab in haemophilia A, including an inhibitor cohort, n=188) met its primary endpoint. No failures or early stops are tracked here, and no trials are due to reach primary completion in the next six months, so no near-term readout will add to this record.
opps: Among programs tracked here, there are only two monoclonal antibodies, from Pfizer and Novo Nordisk, both in Phase 3. No siRNA, small-molecule, bispecific or long-acting engineered approaches to TFPI appear, which leaves a possible way to differentiate.
Rebalancing therapies have to balance efficacy against thrombotic risk. Using free-TFPI levels or thrombin-generation assays to guide dosing and select patients could help define who benefits most.
All tracked programs are in haemophilia A or B. Whether TFPI blockade helps in other bleeding disorders, such as von Willebrand disease, remains an untested hypothesis.

zh.why: TGF-β1促使成纤维细胞转化为肌成纤维细胞，驱动细胞外基质沉积和上皮间质转化，是IPF等纤维化疾病的核心通路；它在肿瘤微环境中还抑制免疫并排斥T细胞。已获批用于IPF的pirfenidone，部分作用正是下调TGF-β信号。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍很薄。三项读出均来自STP705：NCT04669808与NCT05421013无统计检验，NCT05196373入组前即取消；提前终止的原因为商业或未说明，不能据此否定机制。首批真正的检验将是NCT06241560（IPF）和NCT07388680（放射性肺损伤）。
opps: 本站追踪的9个项目中7个为小分子，多为pirfenidone的新剂型或仿制，尚未见直接阻断配体的抗体或trap。考虑到全身性阻断的毒性顾虑，局部给药或只针对TGF-β激活环节（如整合素αvβ6、GARP）的设计值得验证。
IPF以外的适应症覆盖很少：放射性肺损伤、免疫相关肺炎、尘肺各仅1个项目。NCT07388680将回答pirfenidone能否延伸到放射性肺损伤，若结果为阳性，可进一步检验免疫相关肺炎。
STP705在BCC和isSCC中局部敲低TGF-β1的数据仅为描述性，项目因商业原因收缩。局部TGF-β1沉默能否带来组织学清除仍未回答，可结合病灶内TGF-β通路活性做患者筛选。

en.why: TGF-β1 turns fibroblasts into myofibroblasts and drives matrix deposition and epithelial-mesenchymal transition. That makes it a core pathway in IPF and other fibrotic diseases. In tumors it also suppresses immunity and keeps T cells out. Pirfenidone, approved for IPF, works in part by dampening TGF-β signaling.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is thin. All three readouts are for STP705: NCT04669808 and NCT05421013 had no formal test, and NCT05196373 was cancelled before enrolling anyone. These stops were for business or unstated reasons, so they say nothing against the mechanism. The first real tests will be NCT06241560 (IPF) and NCT07388680 (radiation-induced lung injury).
opps: Seven of the nine programs tracked here are small molecules, mostly new formulations or generics of pirfenidone. No ligand-blocking antibodies or traps appear. Given the toxicity concerns with blocking TGF-β throughout the body, local delivery or blocking only the activation step (integrin αvβ6, GARP) is worth testing.

Few programs go beyond IPF: radiation-induced lung injury, immune-related pneumonitis and pneumoconiosis have one program each. NCT07388680 will show whether pirfenidone works in radiation lung injury. If it does, immune-related pneumonitis is a logical next test.

STP705 knocks down TGF-β1 locally, but its data in BCC and isSCC are descriptive only, and the program was scaled back for business reasons. Whether local TGF-β1 silencing clears lesions on histology is still open. Selecting patients by TGF-β pathway activity in the lesion could sharpen a future test.

zh.why: THR-β是肝脏中主要的甲状腺激素受体亚型，激活后可促进脂肪酸β氧化和线粒体活性，降低LDL-C和甘油三酯。MASH肝内甲状腺激素信号偏弱，肝选择性THR-β激动剂旨在减轻脂肪变性和炎症，同时避开THR-α介导的心脏与骨骼效应。
learned: 本站追踪的范围内尚无THR-β的读出或失败记录，临床证据仍然有限。首批检验将来自NCT05500222（3期，NASH，主要完成2026-12）和NCT04951219（Resmetirom 3期，NAFLD，主要完成2027-03）。
opps: 本站追踪的项目中，肝硬化和HFpEF各只出现在一个项目的适应症里。THR-β激动能否改善代偿期肝硬化的临床结局，或通过改善代谢获益于HFpEF，仍待验证。
在追踪范围内仅有两个小分子项目，后来者为CTTQ的Kylo 0603（2期）。可探索的差异化方向包括更高的肝脏选择性、与减重类药物联用，或尝试小分子以外的模式。
SHBG升高、LDL-C下降、MRI-PDFF变化等靶点参与指标可能用于富集应答人群。即将到来的NCT05500222和NCT04951219读出或有助于判断哪类患者获益更明显。

en.why: THR-β is the main thyroid hormone receptor isoform in the liver. Activating it raises fatty acid oxidation and mitochondrial activity and lowers LDL-C and triglycerides. Thyroid hormone signalling inside the liver is weaker in MASH, so liver-selective THR-β agonists aim to reduce steatosis and inflammation while sparing the heart and bone effects that run through THR-α.
learned: No THR-β readouts or failures are tracked here yet, so the clinical record is still thin. The first real tests will be NCT05500222 (phase 3, NASH, primary completion 2026-12) and NCT04951219 (resmetirom phase 3, NAFLD, primary completion 2027-03).
opps: Among programs tracked here, liver cirrhosis and HFpEF each appear in only one program's indication list. Whether THR-β agonism improves outcomes in compensated cirrhosis, or helps HFpEF through its metabolic effects, has not yet been tested.

Only two small molecules are tracked, with CTTQ's Kylo 0603 (phase 2) as the newer entrant. A new program could set itself apart through greater liver selectivity, by pairing with weight-loss drugs, or by using a modality other than a small molecule.

Target-engagement markers such as a rise in SHBG, a drop in LDL-C or a change in MRI-PDFF could help enrich trials for likely responders. The upcoming NCT05500222 and NCT04951219 readouts may show which patients benefit most.

zh.why: TIGIT是CD8 T细胞、NK细胞和Treg上的抑制性受体，以高于CD226的亲和力结合肿瘤及髓系细胞上的CD155，削弱共刺激信号。它与PD-1共表达于耗竭的肿瘤浸润T细胞，临床前与PD-1/PD-L1阻断有协同，这是几乎所有临床项目的立论基础。
learned: 一线NSCLC中tiragolumab联合atezolizumab结果不一致：SKYSCRAPER-01（NCT04294810）记录为PFS达到，但NCT04513925未达到，NCT04619797结果存疑并导致NCT06267001终止。
失败并非个别分子问题：MSD的MK-7684A（此处列于pembrolizumab名下）两项NSCLC III期OS未达到，NCT05226598因无效终止，NCT04738487另注明商业原因。两种抗体均在肺癌受挫，指向机制或人群选择。
肺癌以外疗效证据很少：Roche因商业原因关闭HCC（NCT05908786）和尿路上皮癌（NCT03869190）研究，不构成否定机制的证据；黑色素瘤及篮子研究（NCT04303169、NCT04305041、NCT05661578）以安全性为主，无正式假设检验。
opps: domvanalimab的NSCLC（NCT05211895）和上消化道腺癌（NCT05568095）III期待读出，可检验Fc沉默设计是否有别于Fc活性的tiragolumab，以及消化道肿瘤能否在肺癌之外见效；tiragolumab食管鳞癌（NCT04543617）是另一项肺外检验。
双抗是尚未回答的关键问题：AstraZeneca的PD-1/TIGIT双抗rilvegostomig（亦以AZD2936追踪）在此试验数最多但尚无读出，连同D3L-002，将检验单分子靶向PD-1阳性细胞上的TIGIT是否优于两药联用。
仅凭PD-L1筛选未能找到获益人群。可探索CD226表达（TIGIT阻断依赖完整CD226信号）、CD155水平或TIGIT阳性CD8 T细胞密度等标志物，以及RCC（NCT04626479、NCT05805501）和头颈癌（NCT06062420）等较少涉足的适应症。

en.why: TIGIT is an inhibitory receptor on CD8 T cells, NK cells and Tregs. It binds CD155 on tumour and myeloid cells with higher affinity than the costimulatory receptor CD226, dampening anti-tumour immunity. It is co-expressed with PD-1 on exhausted tumour-infiltrating T cells, and preclinical synergy with PD-1/PD-L1 blockade underpins nearly all clinical programs.
learned: In first-line NSCLC, adding tiragolumab to atezolizumab gave inconsistent results: SKYSCRAPER-01 (NCT04294810) is recorded as meeting its PFS endpoint, but SKYSCRAPER-03 (NCT04513925) missed, and the ambiguous SKYSCRAPER-06 (NCT04619797) led Roche to stop SKYSCRAPER-15 (NCT06267001).

The setbacks are not tied to one antibody. MSD's MK-7684A program (listed here under pembrolizumab) ended two Phase 3 NSCLC trials after missing overall survival: NCT05226598 for futility, NCT04738487 also citing business reasons. Two antibodies falling short in lung points to mechanism or patient selection.

Outside lung the record says little about efficacy. Roche closed HCC (NCT05908786) and urothelial (NCT03869190) studies for business reasons, which is not evidence against the mechanism, and the melanoma and basket studies (NCT04303169, NCT04305041, NCT05661578) were safety-focused without formal hypothesis tests.
opps: Pending domvanalimab Phase 3 readouts in NSCLC (NCT05211895) and upper GI adenocarcinoma (NCT05568095) can test whether an Fc-silent antibody behaves differently from Fc-active tiragolumab, and whether GI tumours respond where lung did not; tiragolumab in ESCC (NCT04543617) is another non-lung test.

Bispecifics are the main open modality question. AstraZeneca's PD-1/TIGIT rilvegostomig (also tracked as AZD2936) has the most trials tracked here but no readouts yet; with D3L-002 it will show whether hitting TIGIT on PD-1-positive cells in one molecule beats co-administration.

PD-L1 selection alone has not found responders. Candidate biomarkers include CD226 expression (TIGIT blockade needs intact CD226 signalling), CD155 levels or TIGIT-positive CD8 T-cell density, alongside less-crowded settings such as RCC (NCT04626479, NCT05805501) and head and neck cancer (NCT06062420).

zh.why: TIM-3（HAVCR2）在耗竭的CD8+ T细胞上常与PD-1共表达，也表达于Treg、髓系细胞及AML/MDS白血病干细胞，配体包括galectin-9、磷脂酰丝氨酸和CEACAM1。临床前研究中PD-1/TIM-3双重阻断可恢复T细胞功能，因此被视为克服PD-1耐药的候选靶点。
learned: 临床记录仍薄：唯一做了统计检验的读出是2/3期COSTAR Lung（NCT04655976），cobolimab联合dostarlimab治疗NSCLC，OS未达到；Incyte的NCT04370704只有安全性数据。下一个检验是cobolimab黑色素瘤试验NCT06521567。
opps: 髓系肿瘤的立论不同：TIM-3表达于白血病干细胞，不只依赖T细胞耗竭。本站追踪的项目中仅Novartis的sabatolimab覆盖MDS/CMML，这条路径能否不受NSCLC失败影响仍待回答。
本站追踪的读出均未检验生物标志物富集。按浸润T细胞TIM-3/PD-1共表达或配体表达筛选患者是一个待验证的假设；即将公布的黑色素瘤读出或可提示瘤种之间是否存在差异。
本站追踪的5个项目均为单抗。若新形式能把TIM-3阻断限定在PD-1+耗竭T细胞，或作用于同样表达TIM-3的髓系及树突状细胞，可用来区分失败出在机制本身还是药物形式。

en.why: TIM-3 (HAVCR2) is co-expressed with PD-1 on exhausted CD8+ T cells and is also found on Tregs, myeloid cells and leukemic stem cells in AML/MDS. Its ligands include galectin-9, phosphatidylserine and CEACAM1. In preclinical studies, blocking PD-1 and TIM-3 together restores T-cell function, which made TIM-3 a candidate for overcoming PD-1 resistance.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout with a formal test, phase 2/3 COSTAR Lung (NCT04655976), missed OS with cobolimab plus dostarlimab in NSCLC. Incyte's NCT04370704 reported safety only. The cobolimab melanoma trial NCT06521567 is the next test.
opps: Myeloid cancers rest on a different rationale: TIM-3 on leukemic stem cells, not only T-cell exhaustion. Among programs tracked here, only Novartis's sabatolimab addresses MDS/CMML. Whether this path holds up regardless of the NSCLC miss is still open.

No readout tracked here has tested biomarker enrichment. Selecting patients for TIM-3/PD-1 co-expression on infiltrating T cells, or for ligand expression, is an untested hypothesis. The upcoming melanoma readout may show whether tumor type matters.

All five programs tracked here are monoclonal antibodies. New formats that limit TIM-3 blockade to PD-1+ exhausted T cells, or that act on the myeloid and dendritic cells that also express TIM-3, could show whether the problem was the mechanism or the drug format.

zh.why: TL1A（TNFSF15）与 T 细胞和固有淋巴细胞上的 DR3 结合，放大 Th1/Th17/Th2 炎症，并激活成纤维细胞、促进纤维化。GWAS 显示 TNFSF15 变异与 IBD（尤其克罗恩病）相关，因此阻断 TL1A 有望同时抗炎和抗纤维化。
learned: 临床记录仍少：tulisokibart 在 UC 诱导期（ATLAS-UC）和首个皮肤科 II 期中均为阳性，但尚无失败案例可对照；首批关键检验看 Afimkibart UC III 期（NCT06588855、NCT06589986）、AD（NCT06863961）和 tulisokibart RA（NCT07176390）。
opps: 纤维化是验证最少的方向：本站追踪的项目中 ILD 和 MASH 各只有一个，也未见针对狭窄型克罗恩病的项目。以纤维化为终点，或可与其他 IBD 机制拉开差异。
肠道外是否有效仍待验证：皮肤科阳性目前只是单一信号，Afimkibart 的 AD 试验（NCT06863961）和 tulisokibart 的 RA 试验（NCT07176390）将检验皮肤和关节适应症。
本站追踪的 8 个项目均为单抗，其中 3 个已在 UC/CD 进入 III 期。后来者可考虑生物标志物或基因型分层、半衰期延长（如 Vial 的 HLE 项目），或本站尚未见到的双抗与联合用药。

en.why: TL1A (TNFSF15) signals through DR3 on T cells and innate lymphoid cells. It amplifies Th1, Th17 and Th2 inflammation and activates fibroblasts. GWAS link TNFSF15 variants to IBD, especially Crohn's disease, so blocking TL1A could treat inflammation and fibrosis at the same time.
learned: The record is still thin. Tulisokibart was positive in UC induction (ATLAS-UC) and in a first dermatology Phase II, but there are no failures to compare against. The first real tests: afimkibart's UC Phase 3 trials (NCT06588855, NCT06589986), its atopic dermatitis trial (NCT06863961) and tulisokibart in RA (NCT07176390).
opps: Fibrosis is the least-tested part of the biology. Among programs tracked here, ILD and MASH have one program each, and none targets stricturing Crohn's. Fibrosis-focused endpoints could set TL1A apart from other IBD mechanisms.

It is still unclear whether TL1A blockade works outside the gut. The dermatology hit is a single signal. Afimkibart in atopic dermatitis (NCT06863961) and tulisokibart in RA (NCT07176390) will test whether the effect carries over to skin and joints.

All eight programs tracked here are monoclonal antibodies, and three are in Phase 3 for UC and Crohn's. Later entrants could set themselves apart with biomarker or genotype-based patient selection, longer half-life (as Vial's HLE program is trying), or bispecifics and combinations, which none of the tracked programs use yet.

zh.why: TLR4是识别细菌LPS及组织损伤释放的内源性危险信号的模式识别受体，经MyD88/TRIF通路驱动NF-κB与I型干扰素反应。过度激活与脓毒症、ARDS等炎症性肺损伤相关，因此可作为拮抗靶点；适度激活可增强适应性免疫，MPL等TLR4激动剂已作为疫苗佐剂使用。
learned: 临床证据仍然很薄。此处追踪的唯一读出是Edesa单抗在COVID-19中的2/3期试验NCT04401475，因商业原因提前终止，申办方明确表示与安全性无关，因此对机制有效性既无正面也无反面结论；未来6个月内也没有追踪到的试验到达主要完成节点。
opps: 拮抗TLR4能否降低炎症性肺损伤死亡率，这个问题仍未回答：NCT04401475因商业原因中止。可考虑转向非COVID病因的ARDS，并按炎症生物标志物富集高TLR4活性人群。
两个1期项目分布在肺结核和黑色素瘤（包括黏膜型），可检验TLR4激活能否增强疫苗应答或抗肿瘤免疫；黏膜黑色素瘤对现有免疫治疗应答较差，适合作为联合用药的检验场景。
在此追踪的项目中仅有单抗和重组蛋白，尚无小分子或口服药物，全领域仅3个项目，竞争稀疏；按激动或拮抗方向和组织靶向做出区分，仍有较大空间。

en.why: TLR4 is a pattern-recognition receptor for bacterial LPS and endogenous danger signals from tissue damage. It drives NF-κB and type I interferon responses via MyD88/TRIF. Overactivation contributes to sepsis and ARDS-type lung injury, which makes it an antagonist target. Controlled activation boosts adaptive immunity, and TLR4 agonists such as MPL are already used as vaccine adjuvants.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readout tracked here, Edesa's Phase 2/3 antibody trial in COVID-19 (NCT04401475), was terminated for business reasons, with the sponsor stating it was unrelated to safety. That says nothing for or against the mechanism, and no tracked trials reach primary completion in the next six months.
opps: Whether TLR4 antagonism lowers mortality in inflammatory lung injury is still unanswered, because NCT04401475 stopped for business reasons. One hypothesis is to test it in non-COVID ARDS, enriching for patients with high TLR4 pathway activity using inflammatory biomarkers.

The two Phase 1 programs, in pulmonary tuberculosis and in melanoma (including mucosal), could test whether TLR4 activation strengthens vaccine responses or antitumor immunity. Mucosal melanoma responds poorly to current immunotherapy, which makes it a natural setting to test combinations.

Programs tracked here are only an antibody and a recombinant protein, with no small-molecule or oral agents, and the field has just three programs. There is room to stand out by agonist versus antagonist direction and by tissue targeting.

zh.why: TLR7/8识别内体单链RNA，TLR9识别CpG DNA，经MyD88驱动I型干扰素和炎症因子。TLR7功能获得性突变可致人类狼疮，X连锁剂量效应或与女性易感有关，支持在自身免疫中抑制该通路；肿瘤中则用激动剂激活固有免疫，如外用imiquimod治疗皮肤癌。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍很薄：5个项目（肿瘤4个、CLE/SLE 1个），尚无读出和失败记录，未来6个月也无主要终点完成的试验，近期没有数据能检验该机制。
opps: 本站追踪的项目中仅1个针对自身免疫（CLE/SLE）。干燥综合征、皮肌炎、狼疮肾炎等干扰素驱动疾病尚无覆盖；按干扰素特征或TLR7变异筛选患者，可能让信号更清晰。
肿瘤试验多为未经筛选的晚期实体瘤人群，多数项目未披露分子类型。全身性激动易引发细胞因子相关毒性，瘤内或缓释给药、靶向髓系细胞的偶联物、联用检查点抑制剂都是可能的差异化方向。
TLR7、8、9分布于不同细胞：TLR7/9主要在pDC和B细胞，TLR8主要在髓系细胞。选择性与双靶点抑制或激动哪种疗效-安全性平衡更好，仍待这些早期项目回答。

en.why: TLR7 and TLR8 sense single-stranded RNA and TLR9 senses CpG DNA inside endosomes, driving type I interferon and inflammatory cytokines via MyD88. TLR7 gain-of-function variants cause human lupus, and X-linked gene dosage may contribute to female bias, supporting blockade in autoimmunity. In tumors, agonists aim to switch on innate immunity, as topical imiquimod does in skin cancer.
learned: Among programs tracked here the clinical record is still thin: five programs (four in oncology, one in CLE/SLE), no readouts, no recorded failures, and no primary completions due in the next six months, so no near-term readout will test the mechanism.
opps: Only one program tracked here targets autoimmunity (CLE/SLE). Other interferon-driven diseases such as Sjögren's disease, dermatomyositis or lupus nephritis are not addressed among these programs. Selecting patients by interferon signature or TLR7 variants could sharpen signals.

Oncology trials enroll broad, unselected advanced solid tumor populations, and most programs do not disclose modality. Systemic agonism tends to cause cytokine-driven toxicity, so intratumoral or sustained-release delivery, myeloid-targeted conjugates and checkpoint-inhibitor combinations are possible ways to differentiate.

TLR7, 8 and 9 act in different cells: TLR7/9 mainly in pDCs and B cells, TLR8 mainly in myeloid cells. Whether selective or dual blockade or agonism gives the better efficacy-safety balance is still open for these early programs to answer.

zh.why: TMPRSS6（matriptase-2）通过切割 hemojuvelin 抑制铁调素表达，铁调素则通过降解 ferroportin 限制肠道铁吸收和储存铁释放。模拟铁调素、沉默 TMPRSS6 或抑制 ferroportin 都能减少供给红系造血的铁，可在真性红细胞增多症中控制红细胞压积、减少放血，也可纠正遗传性血色病中铁调素缺乏导致的铁过载。
learned: 临床记录仍然有限。目前唯一有正式检验的注册试验读出是 rusfertide 的 III 期 VERIFY（NCT05210790），在真性红细胞增多症中达到主要终点；另有一项整理的 divesiran SANRECO 研究结果为阳性，同样是这一适应症。两者分别是肽类铁调素模拟物和 siRNA，指向同一通路，但这些证据还看不出疗效与安全性的边界。下一个检验是 SLN124 的 I/II 期研究 NCT05499013，主要完成时间登记为 2026-09，结果尚待公布。
opps: 本站追踪的项目中，有 4 个集中在真性红细胞增多症，遗传性血色病只有 1 个。在铁调素缺乏是直接病因的铁过载疾病中，这一机制的验证仍属空白，可作为扩展适应症的假设。
真性红细胞增多症领域渐趋拥挤，差异化可能来自给药方式：siRNA 和 ASO（如 sapablursen）给药间隔较长，口服小分子 vamifeport 尚在 II 期，频繁皮下注射的肽类则是对照。给药频率、依从性和长期铁缺乏的管理，是值得比较的问题。
可以按基线铁指标或放血负担分层，检验哪些患者获益最大；与细胞减灭治疗联合时的疗效和安全性，在已有读出中也尚未回答。
