That led to pairing it with a peripherally restricted antagonist and to M4-selective designs.
learned: The record is still thin. Both readouts tracked here are descriptive safety studies with no formal hypothesis test: KarXT NCT06572449, and emraclidine NCT05443724, which stopped for business reasons, not safety. The first efficacy tests are KarXT's Alzheimer's studies NCT06585787 and NCT06126224, both reaching primary completion by December 2026.
opps: Alzheimer's disease is the next frontier. Four programs tracked here target it, and KarXT's NCT06585787 and NCT06126224 will show whether efficacy and cholinergic tolerability hold up in older patients with neurodegeneration. Agitation and autism irritability have one program each.

Selectivity is still unproven. M4-selective agents such as NBI-1117568, now in phase 3, test whether skipping M1 agonism and the peripheral blocker keeps efficacy while improving tolerability. Emraclidine's business stop (NCT05443724) means the PAM approach has not been fully tested.

Cognition is open. No program tracked here targets cognitive impairment associated with schizophrenia, even though M1 is linked to cognition. All tracked programs are small molecules. M1-preferring agents, and selecting patients by cholinergic or cognitive-deficit biomarkers, are still untested hypotheses.

zh.why: 激活素、GDF等TGF-β超家族配体经ActRIIA/IIB受体传导SMAD2/3信号，抑制晚期红系成熟，并在肺动脉高压中推动血管重构，同时负向调控骨骼肌量。luspatercept已获批用于β-地中海贫血和MDS贫血，sotatercept已获批用于PAH，均为配体陷阱类药物，该机制已有临床验证。
learned: 在肺动脉高压中，sotatercept的2期CADENCE（NCT04945460）以肺血管阻力为主要终点并达到，说明配体陷阱在血管重构适应症上的获益可通过血流动力学指标体现。
骨髓纤维化是该机制目前的主要短板：luspatercept的3期INDEPENDENCE（NCT04717414）未达到输血独立终点，在MDS和地贫中有效的红系成熟机制不能直接外推到纤维化骨髓。
本站追踪到的6个项目里，进度最快的两个都是融合蛋白（MSD、BMS），单抗处于1–2期；目前失败均因疗效，未见安全性或商业原因终止。
opps: 体重管理：Lilly的bimagrumab（2期）阻断ActRII以保留肌肉，本站尚未追踪到其读出。与肠促胰素联用能否改善减重质量（脂肪与瘦体重之比），仍是待验证的假设。
受体或配体选择性单抗（CTTQ的TQF6422、GSK未命名项目）可用来检验：比广谱配体陷阱更窄的阻断，能否保住疗效同时改变耐受性特征。
INDEPENDENCE失败后，骨髓纤维化贫血或需按生物标志物（如纤维化程度、红系无效造血特征）筛选亚组再做验证。未来6个月本站没有到期读出，近期证据有限。

en.why: Activin, GDF ligands and related TGF-β superfamily members signal through ActRIIA/IIB and SMAD2/3. This blocks late red-cell maturation, drives vascular remodeling in pulmonary arterial hypertension and limits skeletal muscle mass. Ligand traps validate the mechanism: luspatercept is approved for anemia in beta-thalassemia and MDS, and sotatercept for PAH.
learned: In pulmonary hypertension, sotatercept's phase 2 CADENCE (NCT04945460) met its primary endpoint, pulmonary vascular resistance. The ligand-trap benefit on vascular remodeling shows up in hemodynamic measures.

Myelofibrosis is where the mechanism falls short so far. Luspatercept's phase 3 INDEPENDENCE (NCT04717414) missed transfusion independence. The red-cell maturation effect seen in MDS and thalassemia did not carry over to a fibrotic marrow.

Of the 6 programs tracked here, the two most advanced are fusion proteins (MSD, BMS), and the antibodies are in phase 1–2. Every recorded failure so far was for efficacy. None were stopped for safety or business reasons.
opps: Weight management: Lilly's bimagrumab (phase 2) blocks ActRII to preserve muscle, and no readout is tracked here yet. Whether adding it to incretins improves the quality of weight loss (fat vs lean mass) is still an open hypothesis.
Receptor- or ligand-selective antibodies (CTTQ's TQF6422, GSK's unnamed program) could test whether blocking less than a broad ligand trap keeps efficacy while changing the tolerability profile.

After INDEPENDENCE, anemia in myelofibrosis may need biomarker-selected subgroups (e.g., fibrosis grade, signs of ineffective erythropoiesis) for any new test. No tracked readouts are due in the next six months, so new evidence will be slow to arrive.

zh.why: 盐皮质激素受体是醛固酮激活的核受体，在肾、心和血管中过度激活会引起钠潴留、炎症和纤维化，推动高血压、心衰和CKD进展。spironolactone和eplerenone长期用于心衰，非甾体finerenone在糖尿病CKD中带来肾脏和心血管获益，但高钾血症限制了使用。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍然很少：仅有两项finerenone读出，且都以UACR为替代终点。FINE-ONE（NCT05901831）在CKD中达到终点，CONFIDENCE（NCT05254002）的联合治疗比较未做正式检验。下一个关键检验是2027年4月到期的III期CKD研究NCT05196035。
opps: 在本站追踪的项目中，除finerenone外只有AstraZeneca的balcinrenone进入III期。值得检验的假设是：新一代非甾体MR调节剂能否拓宽血钾安全窗，从而在联合用药中做出差异化。
适应症仍集中在糖尿病CKD。finerenone已布局1型糖尿病和儿童心衰/左室收缩功能不全，Starlight的spironolactone是唯一的肿瘤（胶质母细胞瘤）项目，可探索用生物标志物筛选MR依赖的患者。
目前所有读出都用UACR作终点。UACR下降能否转化为1型糖尿病和非糖尿病CKD中的硬终点获益，以及能否找到高钾风险的预测指标，仍是未解决的问题。

en.why: The mineralocorticoid receptor is a nuclear receptor activated by aldosterone. Overactivation in kidney, heart and vessels drives sodium retention, inflammation and fibrosis, which push hypertension, heart failure and CKD forward. Spironolactone and eplerenone have long been used in heart failure. Nonsteroidal finerenone added kidney and cardiovascular protection in diabetic CKD, but hyperkalemia limits use of the class.
learned: The record tracked here is still thin: just two finerenone readouts, both using UACR as a surrogate endpoint. FINE-ONE (NCT05901831) met its endpoint in CKD. CONFIDENCE (NCT05254002) ran no formal test of its combination comparison. The next real test is the Phase 3 CKD trial NCT05196035, due April 2027.
opps: Among programs tracked here, AstraZeneca's balcinrenone is the only Phase 3 MR program besides finerenone. A hypothesis to test: can a newer nonsteroidal MR modulator widen the potassium safety window enough to stand apart, especially in combination regimens?

Most activity is in diabetic CKD. Finerenone is also being studied in type 1 diabetes and pediatric heart failure/LV dysfunction. Starlight's spironolactone in glioblastoma is the only oncology program; biomarkers could help select MR-dependent patients.
Every readout so far uses UACR. Still open: does albuminuria reduction lead to hard-outcome benefit in type 1 diabetic and non-diabetic CKD, and can predictors of hyperkalemia risk be found?

zh.why: 组织因子(TF，F3)结合FVIIa，启动外源性凝血途径，并经PAR2信号促进肿瘤血管生成、侵袭和转移，同时与肿瘤相关血栓有关。TF在宫颈癌、胰腺癌、头颈鳞癌、NSCLC等实体瘤中高表达，结合抗体后内吞较快，适合做ADC靶点。tisotumab vedotin已获批用于复发性宫颈癌。
learned: 本站追踪的临床记录仍然很少。唯一的读出NCT03786081(tisotumab vedotin联合bevacizumab等，宫颈癌)因申办方战略决定提前终止，不能说明机制无效。upcoming_6m中没有即将读出的试验，近期没有可检验的节点。
opps: 本站追踪的新一代TF ADC(Adcendo、Evopoint、Nanolattix、Sutro)均处于1期，适应症覆盖NSCLC、胰腺癌、结直肠癌和头颈鳞癌。可以检验更换载荷或偶联技术能否把疗效从宫颈癌推广到这些瘤种。
目前追踪的项目多以泛实体瘤入组。TF表达水平(IHC)能否预测疗效、能否用来筛选患者，还有待验证，这可能是新进入者区分于领先项目的切入点。
已追踪项目几乎都是ADC，没有看到TF双抗、CAR-T或放射性偶联药物。NCT03786081终止后，联合抗血管生成治疗的价值也没有得到回答。

en.why: Tissue factor (TF, F3) binds FVIIa to start extrinsic coagulation and, through PAR2 signalling, drives tumour angiogenesis, invasion, metastasis and cancer-associated thrombosis. TF is overexpressed in cervical, pancreatic, head and neck, and non-small-cell lung cancers, and it internalises quickly once bound, which makes it an ADC target. Tisotumab vedotin is approved for recurrent cervical cancer.
learned: The clinical record tracked here is still thin. The only readout, NCT03786081 (tisotumab vedotin plus bevacizumab and others in cervical cancer), was stopped early for the sponsor's strategic reasons, which says nothing against the mechanism. No tracked trials read out in the next six months, so there is no near-term test.
opps: The next-generation TF ADCs tracked here (Adcendo, Evopoint, Nanolattix, Sutro) are all in Phase 1, in NSCLC, pancreatic, colorectal and head and neck cancer. One hypothesis to test: whether new payloads or conjugation methods extend activity beyond cervical cancer.

Most tracked programs enrol broad solid-tumour populations. Whether TF expression (IHC) predicts response, and could be used to select patients, is still unproven. Answering that could set a newcomer apart from the leaders.
Nearly every tracked program is an ADC. None tracked here is a TF bispecific, CAR-T or radioconjugate. The stop of NCT03786081 also leaves open whether adding anti-angiogenic therapy helps.

zh.why: 缓激肽通过内皮细胞上的B2受体增加血管通透性。遗传性血管性水肿(HAE)患者缺乏C1抑制物,血浆激肽释放酶失去控制,缓激肽蓄积，引发水肿发作。注射剂icatibant已证实B2拮抗可治疗急性发作，现在要回答的是口服拮抗剂能否同时用于按需治疗和预防。
learned: 临床记录仍有限，本站仅追踪到deucrictibant一个项目。II期NCT05047185达到发作率终点，提前结束是因为申办方把患者转入延长研究，与疗效无关。III期NCT06669754的注册结果将是首个正式检验。
opps: deucrictibant的适应症中包含C1抑制物缺乏所致获得性血管性水肿(AAE-C1-INH),但本站追踪的专门开发很少。该病同样由缓激肽驱动，可用来检验B2拮抗能否推广到遗传型以外的患者。
ACE抑制剂相关血管性水肿、C1抑制物正常的HAE等其他缓激肽介导的水肿，本站未见在研项目。可以考虑用缓激肽生成类生物标志物筛选患者，再验证B2拮抗是否有效。
icatibant是间歇给药，预防用药则需要长期持续阻断B2,而B2在血管和心脏保护中也有作用。长期安全性仍待回答，延长研究NCT06679881的数据可以提供参考。目前追踪到的项目均为小分子。

en.why: Bradykinin acts on the B2 receptor on endothelial cells to increase vascular permeability. In hereditary angioedema (HAE), C1-inhibitor deficiency leaves plasma kallikrein unchecked, so bradykinin builds up and triggers swelling attacks. Injectable icatibant, a B2 antagonist, showed that blocking this receptor treats acute attacks. The open question is whether an oral antagonist can serve both on-demand treatment and prevention.
learned: The clinical record is thin: deucrictibant is the only program tracked here. Phase 2 NCT05047185 met its attack-rate endpoint. It ended early because the sponsor moved patients into an extension study, not because of efficacy. Registry results from Phase 3 NCT06669754 will be the first formal test.
opps: Acquired angioedema due to C1-inhibitor deficiency (AAE-C1-INH) is among deucrictibant's listed conditions, but few programs tracked here are dedicated to it. It is also driven by bradykinin, so it can test whether B2 blockade works beyond hereditary disease.

No tracked programs address other bradykinin-driven angioedemas, such as ACE-inhibitor-associated angioedema or HAE with normal C1-inhibitor. Biomarkers of bradykinin generation could be used to select patients and test whether B2 blockade helps them.

zh.why: AGT主要由肝脏合成，是肾素的唯一底物，经肾素和ACE切割生成血管紧张素II，驱动血管收缩、钠潴留与醛固酮分泌。ACE抑制剂、ARB和aliskiren已验证该通路；在肝脏源头沉默AGT，有望以低频给药实现持久降压、缓解依从性问题。
learned: 临床记录仍很薄：本站尚无该靶点的读出，未来6个月也无试验到达主要完成日期。Alnylam的Zilebesiran III期（2项试验，高血压及高心血管风险人群）将是首个真正检验，但不在这一窗口内。
opps: 可逆的siRNA与永久性基因编辑（CRISPR的CTX340，I/II期）并行；低血容量或急性肾损伤时需恢复RAAS，永久敲低AGT的安全边界与剂量分级是关键待解问题。
本站追踪的项目均集中于高血压和高心血管风险人群；慢性肾病、心衰等同样由RAAS驱动的疾病尚无项目，但需密切关注高钾血症和肾功能波动。
患者分层尚待探索：以基线肾素活性或血浆AGT水平筛选高应答人群，或聚焦难治性及依从性差的高血压患者，可能是区别于传统口服药的切入点。

en.why: Angiotensinogen (AGT), made mainly in the liver, is renin's only substrate; renin and ACE convert it to angiotensin II, which drives vasoconstriction, sodium retention and aldosterone release. ACE inhibitors, ARBs and the renin inhibitor aliskiren validate the pathway. Silencing AGT at its hepatic source could give durable blood-pressure control with infrequent dosing, addressing poor adherence.
learned: The clinical record is still thin: no readouts are tracked for this target, and no trial reaches primary completion in the next six months. Alnylam's Phase 3 zilebesiran program (two trials, hypertension and high cardiovascular risk) will be the first real test, but not within that window.
opps: Reversible siRNA and permanent gene editing (CRISPR's CTX340, Phase 1/2) are both in play. Since RAAS must recover during volume depletion or acute kidney injury, the safety margin of permanent AGT knockdown and how to grade the dose are open questions.

Among programs tracked here, all focus on hypertension and high cardiovascular risk; CKD and heart failure, also RAAS-driven, have no programs, though hyperkalemia and renal-function shifts would need close monitoring.

Patient selection is unexplored: baseline renin activity or plasma AGT could identify likely responders, and resistant or poorly adherent hypertension may be where infrequent dosing differs most from oral drugs.

zh.why: CYP46A1是脑特异性酶，把胆固醇转化为24S-羟基胆固醇，这是脑内清除胆固醇的主要途径。24S-羟基胆固醇能正向调节NMDA受体，所以抑制该酶被设想可减轻难治性儿童癫痫中的谷氨酸能过度兴奋。在神经退行性疾病模型中，增强该酶活性则显示出保护作用。
learned: 证据仍有限：仅Takeda的soticlestat进入3期。其延伸研究NCT05163314因SKYLINE、SKYWAY结果阴性而终止，与安全性无关。本站追踪范围内未来6个月没有新的读出。
opps: 失败源于机制还是分子本身尚无定论。血浆24S-羟基胆固醇可反映靶点结合程度，用已有数据分析其降低幅度与发作结局的关系，可判断更强或脑选择性更高的抑制是否值得再试。
反向策略在本站追踪范围内还没有项目：通过基因治疗或激动剂提高CYP46A1活性，用于亨廷顿病或阿尔茨海默病。临床前模型提示，加快脑内胆固醇代谢具有保护作用。

en.why: Cholesterol 24-hydroxylase (CYP46A1) is a brain-specific enzyme that turns cholesterol into 24S-hydroxycholesterol, the main way the brain clears cholesterol. 24S-hydroxycholesterol enhances NMDA receptor activity, so blocking the enzyme was proposed as a way to calm glutamate-driven hyperexcitability in severe childhood epilepsies. In models of neurodegeneration, boosting the enzyme's activity looks protective.
learned: The record is thin: only one program, Takeda's soticlestat, has reached Phase 3. Its open-label extension NCT05163314 was stopped because the pivotal SKYLINE and SKYWAY studies were negative, not for safety reasons. Among programs tracked here, no readouts are due in the next six months.
opps: It is still unclear whether the mechanism failed or the molecule did. Plasma 24S-hydroxycholesterol shows how well the drug hits its target. Linking how far it fell to seizure outcomes in existing data could show whether deeper or more brain-selective inhibition is worth testing.

No program tracked here tries the opposite approach: raising CYP46A1 activity, for example with gene therapy or activators, in Huntington's or Alzheimer's disease. Preclinical models suggest that faster cholesterol turnover in the brain is protective.

zh.why: 胰岛素受体是受体酪氨酸激酶，结合胰岛素后经IRS–PI3K–AKT通路促进肌肉和脂肪摄取葡萄糖，并抑制肝糖输出。1型糖尿病缺乏胰岛素，2型糖尿病胰岛素分泌不足且存在抵抗，因此外源性激动该受体是验证最充分的降糖手段。当前研发重点是把基础胰岛素的给药间隔延长到每周一次。
learned: 临床记录仍然有限：本站目前只有Novo Nordisk的insulin icodec两项2型糖尿病III期读出（NCT06340854、NCT05813912），均达到HbA1c主要终点，尚无失败或提前终止记录。真正的新检验是GZR4的III期NCT06767735（主要完成日期为2026-08，结果待公布）和icodec在1型糖尿病的NCT07076199（2027-01）。
opps: 1型糖尿病是尚未验证的领域：本站追踪的icodec阳性结果均来自2型糖尿病。NCT07076199将检验在低血糖风险更高、剂量需频繁调整的人群中周制剂是否同样可行，低血糖与剂量调整方案可能是关键区分点。
在本站追踪的项目中，GZR4是唯一进入III期的第二款周制剂。NCT06767735能否在低血糖发生率、剂量调整的简便性或与GLP-1类药物联用方面体现差异，将决定后来者的定位空间。
三个项目均为多肽/蛋白激素。本站未追踪到葡萄糖响应型胰岛素、口服制剂或胰岛素受体激动性抗体，也没有项目针对INSR突变导致的严重胰岛素抵抗综合征，这些都可作为研究假设进一步评估。

en.why: The insulin receptor is a receptor tyrosine kinase. When insulin binds, IRS–PI3K–AKT signalling drives glucose uptake in muscle and fat and suppresses glucose output from the liver. Type 1 diabetes lacks insulin, and type 2 combines too little insulin with resistance to it, so agonising this receptor is the best-validated way to lower glucose. Current work focuses on stretching basal insulin dosing to once a week.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. This site has only two Phase 3 readouts, both for Novo Nordisk's insulin icodec in type 2 diabetes (NCT06340854, NCT05813912). Both met their HbA1c primary endpoint, and no failures or early stops are recorded. The real new tests are GZR4's Phase 3 NCT06767735 (primary completion 2026-08, results pending) and icodec in type 1 diabetes, NCT07076199 (2027-01).
opps: Type 1 diabetes is still unproven: all of icodec's tracked hits come from type 2. NCT07076199 will test whether weekly dosing holds up in patients with higher hypoglycaemia risk and frequent dose changes. Hypoglycaemia and titration rules may decide who stands out.

Among programs tracked here, GZR4 is the only other weekly insulin in Phase 3. How much room later entrants have will depend on whether NCT06767735 shows a difference in hypoglycaemia rates, ease of titration, or fit with GLP-1-based therapy.

All three programs are peptide or protein hormones. None tracked here is a glucose-responsive insulin, an oral form, or an agonist antibody to the receptor. None targets the severe insulin-resistance syndromes caused by INSR mutations. Each is open as a research hypothesis.

zh.why: 胰淀素由胰岛β细胞与胰岛素共同分泌，作用于后脑降钙素受体与RAMP组成的受体复合物，可抑制摄食、延缓胃排空，并抑制餐后胰高血糖素。它的饱腹通路不同于GLP-1，因此既可单药、也可与GLP-1联用治疗肥胖。2005年获批的pramlintide已在人体中验证了这一机制。
learned: 临床记录尚薄：仅有1项登记读出，即 eloralintide 2期 NCT06230523，未做正式统计检验，也没有失败记录。首批真正的检验将来自 petrelintide NCT06926842、CagriSema 3期 NCT07011667，以及 cagrilintide 单药3期 NCT07220642 和 NCT07220759。
opps: 口服小分子是最明显的空白。本站追踪的项目中只有 Structure 旗下 Aconcagua 和 Ascletis 两个，分别处于1/2期和1期，注射多肽则有8个。小分子能否达到多肽的受体覆盖和耐受性，目前还没有数据。
肥胖以外的布局稀疏：追踪项目中2型糖尿病2个、心血管疾病3个，睡眠呼吸暂停和骨关节炎各1个。胰淀素能抑制胰高血糖素，糖尿病和合并症终点研究仍有探索空间。
耐受性或可成为差异化方向。ZUPREME-2 显示 petrelintide 的胃肠道相关停药率与安慰剂相近。cagrilintide 单药3期（NCT07220642、NCT07220759）与 CagriSema（NCT07011667）对照来看，可估计胰淀素单药的贡献，为GLP-1不耐受人群或维持治疗提供依据。

en.why: Amylin is co-secreted with insulin by pancreatic beta cells. It acts on calcitonin receptor–RAMP complexes in the hindbrain to reduce food intake, slow gastric emptying and suppress glucagon after meals. Because this satiety pathway is distinct from GLP-1, amylin agonists are being developed both alone and as GLP-1 partners for obesity. Pramlintide, approved for diabetes in 2005, showed the mechanism works in humans.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. There is one tracked registry readout, the eloralintide Phase 2 trial NCT06230523, which had no formal statistical test, and there are no failures. The first real tests will be petrelintide NCT06926842, CagriSema Phase 3 NCT07011667, and cagrilintide monotherapy Phase 3 NCT07220642 and NCT07220759.
opps: Oral small molecules are the clearest white space. Among programs tracked here only two are small molecules, from Structure's Aconcagua (Phase 1/2) and Ascletis (Phase 1), against eight injectable peptides. No data yet show whether a small molecule can match peptide receptor coverage and tolerability.

Few tracked programs go beyond obesity: two in type 2 diabetes, three in cardiovascular disease, and one each in sleep apnea and osteoarthritis. Because amylin suppresses glucagon, diabetes and comorbidity-outcome trials are still open ground.

Tolerability may set programs apart. In curated ZUPREME-2 data, petrelintide's GI-related discontinuations were close to placebo. Comparing cagrilintide monotherapy Phase 3 (NCT07220642, NCT07220759) with CagriSema (NCT07011667) should show how much amylin contributes alone, which matters for GLP-1-intolerant patients and maintenance use.

zh.why: GCGR 主要分布于肝脏，激活后促进肝脂肪酸氧化、减少肝脏脂肪，并提高能量消耗。单独激动会升高血糖，与 GLP-1（可加 GIP）激动联用可抵消这一作用，因此多靶点激动剂有望在肥胖、2 型糖尿病和 MASH 中带来更大幅度的减重和肝脏获益。
learned: 在 GLP-1 骨架上加入 GCGR 激动，可在肥胖中带来深度减重：retatrutide 的 TRIUMPH-1/2/3 和 survodutide 的 SYNCHRONIZE-1 均为阳性，survodutide 在 T2D 三期中也达到终点。
本站追踪的 6 个项目全部是多肽类多靶点激动剂，retatrutide 进度最快，礼来计划递交上市申请；各项目差异化更多取决于靶点组合和适应症布局，而不是作用机制本身。
肝脏是这一靶点的标志性获益器官：SYNCHRONIZE-1 显示肝脏和内脏脂肪下降，但 efinopegdutide 的 NCT06482112 以肝脂肪为终点却未做正式检验，MASH 的组织学证据仍不足。
获益并非延伸到所有器官：retatrutide 在 NCT05936151 中未改善 24 周实测 GFR，这是目前追踪到的唯一疗效失败；尚无因安全性或商业原因终止的记录。
opps: MASH 组织学是下一道关口：IBI362 的 NCT06937749 和 efinopegdutide 的 NCT06465186 可检验影像学上的肝脂肪下降能否转化为组织学改善，按基线肝脂肪筛选患者值得探索。
适应症可以向代谢以外拓展：pemvidutide 的 NCT06987513 在酒精使用障碍中开展，CKD 和 ASCVD 在本站追踪项目中各仅一个；NCT05936151 失败后，肾脏获益需要更长期、更硬的终点来验证。
在本站追踪的项目中，剂型全部为注射多肽，口服小分子 GCGR 激动剂和优化 GLP-1:GCGR 活性比例（兼顾瘦体重和心率）的分子仍属空白。

en.why: GCGR sits mainly in the liver. Activating it drives hepatic fat oxidation, lowers liver fat and raises energy expenditure. On its own it raises glucose, but GLP-1 co-agonism (sometimes with GIP) offsets that. Multi-agonists can therefore aim for larger weight loss and liver benefit in obesity, type 2 diabetes and MASH.
learned: Adding GCGR agonism to a GLP-1 backbone gives deep weight loss in obesity. Retatrutide's TRIUMPH-1/2/3 and survodutide's SYNCHRONIZE-1 were all positive, and survodutide also met its Phase 3 endpoints in T2D.

All six programs tracked here are multi-agonist peptides. Retatrutide is furthest along, and Lilly plans a filing. Programs stand apart through their receptor mix and choice of indications, not the mechanism itself.

The liver is where this target stands out. SYNCHRONIZE-1 lowered liver and visceral fat. Efinopegdutide's NCT06482112 used liver fat as its endpoint but ran no formal test, so evidence on MASH histology is still thin.
The benefit does not reach every organ. Retatrutide did not improve measured GFR at 24 weeks in NCT05936151, the only efficacy failure tracked. No stops for safety or business reasons are recorded.
opps: MASH histology is the next test. IBI362's NCT06937749 and efinopegdutide's NCT06465186 can show whether liver-fat drops on imaging lead to histologic gains. Selecting patients by baseline liver fat is worth exploring.

There is room beyond metabolism. Pemvidutide's NCT06987513 is testing alcohol use disorder, and CKD and ASCVD have one tracked program each. After NCT05936151, a kidney benefit needs longer studies with harder endpoints.
Every program tracked here is an injectable peptide. Oral small-molecule GCGR agonists, and molecules with a GLP-1:GCGR balance tuned to protect lean mass and heart rate, remain open.

zh.why: C3是经典、凝集素和旁路三条补体途径的汇合点，其裂解产物C3b驱动调理作用和旁路放大环，并启动下游C5和膜攻击复合物。CFH、C3等基因变异与AMD和C3G相关。在PNH中，阻断C3可同时控制血管内和血管外溶血，这是C5抑制剂做不到的。pegcetacoplan已获批用于PNH和地图样萎缩。
learned: 临床记录仍然很薄。已披露的读出只有pegcetacoplan的两项长期安全性研究（NCT03531255、NCT04770545），均无正式假设检验；NCT07020832（移植肾功能延迟恢复）虽被标为疗效失败，但终止说明写明是管线优先级调整、与安全性无关，不能据此否定机制。第一次真正的疗效检验将是IBI302的nAMD III期研究NCT05972473。
opps: 本站追踪的项目中已有两款C3 siRNA（Qilu II期、Rigerna I期），可验证肝脏沉默C3能否实现低频给药，并充分抑制肾脏和眼部的局部补体活性。深度、持续的全身C3耗竭会带来荚膜菌感染风险，需前瞻性监测。
IBI302是融合蛋白，设计上在抗VEGF基础上叠加补体阻断。NCT05972473将检验这一组合能否在nAMD中超越单纯抗VEGF，例如是否减少纤维化或萎缩进展，这是该适应症目前尚未回答的问题。
肾脏适应症（C3G、IC-MPGN、移植后复发性肾小球病、ESRD）在本站追踪的项目中各只有一个。以低血清C3、C3肾炎因子或补体基因变异筛选患者，可能是提高信号的方向；NCT07020832终止后，C3在缺血再灌注损伤中的作用仍未得到验证。

en.why: C3 is where the classical, lectin and alternative complement pathways meet. Its cleavage product C3b drives opsonization and the alternative-pathway amplification loop, and triggers downstream C5 and the membrane attack complex. CFH and C3 variants are linked to AMD and C3G. In PNH, blocking C3 controls both intravascular and extravascular hemolysis, which C5 inhibitors cannot do. Pegcetacoplan is approved for PNH and geographic atrophy.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. The only readouts are two long-term pegcetacoplan safety studies (NCT03531255, NCT04770545), neither with a formal hypothesis test. NCT07020832 (delayed graft function) is coded as an efficacy failure, but its stop note cites portfolio reprioritization, not safety, so it says nothing against the mechanism. The first real efficacy test will be IBI302's Phase 3 nAMD trial, NCT05972473.
opps: Two C3 siRNAs are tracked here (Qilu Phase 2, Rigerna Phase 1). They could test whether silencing C3 in the liver allows infrequent dosing and still suppresses complement enough in the kidney and eye. Deep, sustained systemic C3 depletion carries a risk of infection by encapsulated bacteria, which needs prospective monitoring.

IBI302 is a fusion protein designed to add complement blockade to anti-VEGF. NCT05972473 will show whether this combination beats anti-VEGF alone in nAMD, for example by slowing fibrosis or atrophy. That question is still open in this indication.

Each kidney indication (C3G, IC-MPGN, recurrent glomerular disease after transplant, ESRD) has only one program among those tracked here. Selecting patients by low serum C3, C3 nephritic factor or complement gene variants could sharpen the signal. With NCT07020832 stopped, C3's role in ischemia-reperfusion injury remains untested.

zh.why: C5 裂解生成 C5a（经 C5aR1 招募并激活中性粒细胞）和 C5b（启动膜攻击复合物 C5b-9），是补体终末通路的关键节点。PNH 红细胞缺乏 CD55/CD59，终末补体直接导致血管内溶血；aHUS、AChR 抗体阳性 gMG 和 AQP4 阳性 NMOSD 也由补体介导损伤驱动。eculizumab 和 ravulizumab 在 PNH 中已获批多年。
learned: 在补体直接致病的 PNH 中，C5 抑制的结果稳定：ravulizumab（NCT06578949）和 eculizumab（NCT05886244）均以 LDH 为终点达到主要终点。两项试验规模都很小，更像是人群扩展或桥接研究，而不是对机制的新检验。
把适应症扩展到病因复杂、未经筛选的损伤场景则失败了：ravulizumab 在 TMA（NCT04543591）未达到终点，在 ARTEMIS（NCT05746559）中因缺乏疗效提前终止。补体只是这些场景中的致病因素之一。
crovalimab 在 aHUS 的 COMMUTE-a（NCT04861259）和 COMMUTE-p（NCT04958265）为单臂描述性结果，没有正式假设检验，只能作为支持性证据，不能视为确证。
在本站追踪的项目中，竞争主要体现在给药方式和分子形式上，包括皮下单抗、多肽、siRNA 和口服小分子。BioCryst 的口服 PNH 项目 REDEEM-1（NCT05116774）因申办方决定终止，属于商业原因，不构成否定机制的证据。
opps: TMA 和 AKI 均告失败，提示非经典适应症需要做患者富集。可检验的假设是：按 sC5b-9 等补体活化标志物或补体基因变异入组，能否让 C5 抑制在异质性人群中显现疗效。
PNH 已相当拥挤，gMG 和 NMOSD 的项目较少。gefurulimab（NCT06607627）、zilucoplan（NCT04225871、NCT06055959）和 eculizumab NMOSD（NCT06724809）的结果，将检验长效或自行给药能否形成差异化。
NCT05133531 在 PNH 中对比 pozelimab 与 ravulizumab、eculizumab，将回答新组合能否改善 C5 阻断的深度或持续性。C5 抑制无法覆盖 C3 介导的血管外溶血，选择性靶向 C5a/C5aR1 而保留 MAC 的思路，在本站追踪的项目中仍然很少。

en.why: Cleaving C5 releases C5a, which recruits and activates neutrophils through C5aR1, and C5b, which starts the membrane attack complex (C5b-9). In PNH, red cells lack CD55/CD59, so terminal complement drives intravascular hemolysis. Complement-mediated injury also underlies aHUS, AChR-positive gMG and AQP4-positive NMOSD. Eculizumab and ravulizumab have long been approved for PNH.
learned: In PNH, where complement directly causes disease, C5 blockade works reliably: ravulizumab (NCT06578949) and eculizumab (NCT05886244) both met LDH endpoints. Both trials were small and look more like population-extension or bridging studies than new tests of the mechanism.

Moving into heterogeneous, unselected injury settings failed. Ravulizumab missed in TMA (NCT04543591), and ARTEMIS (NCT05746559) was stopped early for lack of efficacy. In both settings complement is only one of several drivers.
Crovalimab's aHUS readouts, COMMUTE-a (NCT04861259) and COMMUTE-p (NCT04958265), were single-arm and descriptive with no formal hypothesis test. They are supportive evidence, not confirmation.

Among programs tracked here, competition is mostly about dosing and format: subcutaneous antibodies, a peptide, siRNA and oral small molecules. BioCryst's oral PNH program REDEEM-1 (NCT05116774) stopped by sponsor decision, a business stop that says nothing against the mechanism.
opps: The TMA and AKI misses suggest patient enrichment is needed outside classic indications. One hypothesis to test: selecting patients by complement-activation markers such as sC5b-9, or by complement gene variants, could reveal a benefit in heterogeneous populations.

PNH is crowded, while gMG and NMOSD have fewer programs. Readouts for gefurulimab (NCT06607627), zilucoplan (NCT04225871, NCT06055959) and eculizumab in NMOSD (NCT06724809) will test whether long-acting or self-administered dosing sets programs apart.

NCT05133531 compares pozelimab with ravulizumab and eculizumab in PNH and will show whether a new regimen gives deeper or more durable C5 blockade. C5 inhibition does not address C3-mediated extravascular hemolysis, and few programs tracked here target C5a/C5aR1 selectively while sparing the MAC.

zh.why: 补体因子B是旁路途径C3转化酶（C3bBb）的催化亚基，驱动补体放大环路，可同时影响C3和C5下游效应，并保留经典途径与凝集素途径。PNH、C3G、IgA肾病等疾病由旁路途径过度激活驱动，CFB基因变异也与AMD风险相关。
learned: 临床记录仍有限：APPLAUSE-IgAN（NCT04578834）达到主要终点；狼疮肾炎研究NCT05268289因申办方策略原因终止，不能据此否定机制。C3G（NCT04817618）与gMG（NCT06517758）将是下一轮检验。
opps: 在本站追踪的6个项目中有4个是口服小分子。Roche的ASO与Regeneron的siRNA靶向肝脏合成的因子B，值得验证低频给药能否达到与小分子相当的抑制深度，并在依从性上形成差异。
狼疮肾炎因策略原因终止，ANCA血管炎和IC-MPGN也仅有个别项目布局，旁路途径在这些疾病中的作用仍未验证。gMG研究NCT06517758将检验以经典途径为主的疾病是否同样依赖旁路放大。
AMD研究NCT05230537已过主要完成日期，结果尚未披露。可探索按CFB/CFH基因型筛选患者，检验全身性口服抑制能否惠及眼科适应症。

en.why: Factor B is the catalytic subunit of the alternative-pathway C3 convertase (C3bBb). It drives the complement amplification loop, so blocking it dampens both C3- and C5-mediated effects while leaving the classical and lectin pathways intact. Overactive alternative-pathway signaling drives PNH, C3G and IgA nephropathy, and CFB variants are linked to AMD risk.
learned: The record is still thin. APPLAUSE-IgAN (NCT04578834) met its primary endpoint. The lupus nephritis trial NCT05268289 was stopped for strategic reasons, so it says nothing against the mechanism. The C3G (NCT04817618) and gMG (NCT06517758) readouts will be the next real tests.
opps: Four of the six programs tracked here are oral small molecules. Roche's ASO and Regeneron's siRNA target factor B made in the liver. They could test whether infrequent dosing reaches inhibition as deep as the small molecules and gives an adherence advantage.

Lupus nephritis was stopped for strategic reasons, and ANCA vasculitis and IC-MPGN have only single programs, so the role of the alternative pathway there is still untested. The gMG trial NCT06517758 will show whether classical-pathway-driven disease also depends on alternative-pathway amplification.
The AMD trial NCT05230537 is past its primary completion date with no results yet. Selecting patients by CFB/CFH genotype could test whether oral systemic inhibition can help in eye disease.

zh.why: 因子D是丝氨酸蛋白酶，负责裂解C3bB中的因子B，是补体旁路途径及其放大环路的限速步骤。它的血浆浓度极低，适合用口服小分子抑制。旁路途径过度活化会造成PNH患者在C5抑制下仍残留的C3介导血管外溶血，也参与C3肾小球病和IgA肾病的发病。
learned: 证据仍然很少。目前追踪到的读出只有BioCryst的BCX9930两项2期试验（PNH，NCT05116787；C3G，NCT05162066），都因申办方决定终止，属于商业原因，不能据此否定机制。首个真正的检验将是Danicopan的3期PNH试验NCT05389449，本站尚未追踪到其结果。
opps: 肾病领域基本空白。在已追踪项目中，针对C3G或IgA肾病的因子D试验只有BCX9930一项，且因商业原因终止（NCT05162066）。口服因子D抑制能否降低C3G患者的蛋白尿，目前仍未得到验证。
NCT05389449将补充Danicopan在PNH中的3期数据。这类药物尚待回答的问题是：因子D抑制更适合作为C5抑制的联合用药，还是可以单药使用；红细胞C3沉积能否用来筛选有残余血管外溶血的患者。
因子D血浆浓度低但更新极快，疗效依赖持续、接近完全的抑制。已追踪项目只有两个小分子，长效化合物或能在给药间隔内平稳维持抑制的其他药物形式还没有人尝试，可以作为差异化方向，同时需要监测奈瑟菌感染风险。

en.why: Factor D is the serine protease that cleaves factor B within C3bB. This is the rate-limiting step of the alternative complement pathway and its amplification loop. Because plasma levels of factor D are very low, an oral small molecule can inhibit it. Overactivity of the alternative pathway drives the C3-mediated extravascular hemolysis that persists in PNH under C5 blockade, and it contributes to C3 glomerulopathy and IgA nephropathy.
learned: The record is thin. The only tracked readouts are two phase 2 trials of BioCryst's BCX9930, in PNH (NCT05116787) and C3G (NCT05162066). Both stopped by sponsor decision, a business reason that says nothing against the mechanism. The first real test will be danicopan's phase 3 PNH trial, NCT05389449. Its results are not yet tracked here.
opps: Kidney disease is largely open. Among tracked programs, the only factor D trial in C3G or IgA nephropathy was BCX9930's, which stopped for business reasons (NCT05162066). No one has yet shown whether oral factor D blockade lowers proteinuria in C3G.

NCT05389449 will add phase 3 data on danicopan in PNH. Open questions for the class: does factor D inhibition work best added to C5 blockade or on its own? Can C3 deposition on red cells pick out patients with residual extravascular hemolysis?

Factor D levels are low but turnover is fast, so efficacy depends on sustained, near-complete inhibition. Only two small molecules are tracked. Longer-acting compounds, or other modalities that keep suppression steady between doses, are an untried way to differentiate. Meningococcal infection risk needs monitoring.

zh.why: CYP11B2在肾上腺球状带催化醛固酮合成的最后几步。醛固酮过多会导致钠潴留、高血压，以及肾脏和心脏纤维化。盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂已验证这一通路，但会出现醛固酮逃逸和高钾血症。直接抑制醛固酮合成可从源头阻断，难点在于对CYP11B1（皮质醇合成酶）的选择性。
learned: Baxdrostat在两项III期研究中均达到主要终点：BaxHTN（NCT06034743）用诊室坐位收缩压，Bax24（NCT06168409）用24小时动态收缩压。两种测量方式下降压效应一致，可信度更高
高血压以外的证据还很早期：CKD方面目前只有Mineralys的II期（NCT06150924）读出，且无统计检验；本站追踪的项目中尚无肾脏或心血管硬终点结果
10个项目里没有失败或提前终止，已知模态都是小分子。III期集中在BI、AZ和Mineralys三家，Salubris、InnovStone和Zhejiang Yangli于2026年进入II期
opps: 降压疗效能否转化为肾脏获益，vicadrostat的CKD研究NCT06926660（II期）和NCT06531824（III期）将是首次检验，同时也会显示肾功能下降人群中的血钾安全性
原发性醛固酮增多症和心衰分别只有1个和2个项目。用醛固酮/肾素比值等生物标志物富集患者，可能更清楚地呈现机制获益
II期跟进者若想区别于领先者，可在CYP11B1选择性、血钾控制、给药频次或与现有降压药组成固定复方等方面寻求差异

en.why: CYP11B2 catalyzes the final steps of aldosterone synthesis in the adrenal zona glomerulosa. Excess aldosterone drives sodium retention, hypertension, and kidney and cardiac fibrosis. Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists validate the pathway but run into aldosterone escape and hyperkalemia. Blocking synthesis acts at the source. The challenge is selectivity over CYP11B1, the enzyme that makes cortisol.
learned: Baxdrostat met its primary endpoint in two Phase 3 trials: BaxHTN (NCT06034743) on seated office systolic BP, and Bax24 (NCT06168409) on 24-hour ambulatory systolic BP. The effect held under both measurement methods, which makes it more credible.

Outside hypertension the evidence is still early. For CKD there is only Mineralys' Phase 2 (NCT06150924), which reported without a formal hypothesis test. No kidney or cardiovascular hard-outcome results have read out among programs tracked here.

None of the 10 programs has failed or stopped early, and every program with a known modality is a small molecule. Phase 3 work sits with BI, AZ and Mineralys. Salubris, InnovStone and Zhejiang Yangli entered Phase 2 in 2026.
opps: Does BP lowering turn into kidney benefit? Vicadrostat's CKD trials, NCT06926660 (Phase 2) and NCT06531824 (Phase 3), will be the first test. They should also show how potassium holds up in patients with declining kidney function.
Primary hyperaldosteronism has 1 program and heart failure has 2. Selecting patients by aldosterone/renin ratio or similar biomarkers could show the mechanism's benefit more clearly.
Phase 2 followers could set themselves apart from the leaders on CYP11B1 selectivity, potassium control, dosing frequency, or fixed-dose combinations with existing BP drugs.

zh.why: 食欲素（hypocretin）通过OX1R/OX2R维持觉醒稳定。1型发作性睡病由下丘脑食欲素神经元丢失引起，补充信号的OX2R激动剂直接针对病因。反向的双重受体拮抗剂（如suvorexant、daridorexant）已获批用于失眠，证明该通路在人体可调控。
learned: 临床记录尚薄：已读出的仅TAK-861两项NT1三期（NCT06470828、NCT06505031），均达到MWT主要终点，但仅限一个药物、一个适应症。首批真正检验将是ALKS 2680在IH（NCT06843590）、NT1（NCT07455383）和NT2（NCT07502443）中的读出。
opps: NT2和特发性嗜睡患者食欲素水平多数正常，激动剂能否在非缺失人群中起效尚无答案；NCT07502443与NCT06843590将给出首批证据，可借脑脊液食欲素水平分层患者。
本站追踪的项目全部为小分子，且集中在NT1；在受体选择性、给药时间窗及长期耐受性上做出差异，或拓展至其他伴日间嗜睡的疾病，仍是可检验的方向。
拮抗剂端在本站仅有suvorexant和daridorexant各一项新试验，失眠以外的适应症（如伴睡眠障碍的精神或神经疾病）研究仍少。

en.why: Orexin (hypocretin) acting at OX1R/OX2R keeps wakefulness stable. Narcolepsy type 1 is caused by loss of hypothalamic orexin neurons, so an OX2R agonist that restores the signal treats the cause directly. Dual receptor antagonists such as suvorexant and daridorexant are approved for insomnia, which shows the pathway can be modulated in humans.
learned: The clinical record is still thin. Only two readouts exist: two TAK-861 Phase 3 NT1 trials (NCT06470828, NCT06505031), and both met their MWT primary endpoints. That is one drug in one indication. The first real tests beyond it will be ALKS 2680 in IH (NCT06843590), NT1 (NCT07455383) and NT2 (NCT07502443).
opps: Most NT2 and idiopathic hypersomnia patients have normal orexin levels, so it is open whether agonists work without a deficit. NCT07502443 and NCT06843590 will give the first evidence. Stratifying patients by CSF orexin could help explain the results.

Every program tracked here is a small molecule, and most target NT1. Open hypotheses include differentiating on receptor selectivity, dosing window or long-term tolerability, or testing agonists in other disorders with daytime sleepiness.

On the antagonist side, only one new trial each for suvorexant and daridorexant is tracked here. Uses beyond primary insomnia, such as sleep disturbance in psychiatric or neurological disease, remain little explored.
